games.text: Relaxing sailing experience. Discover Akalana Islands.

games.name: Baldi's Basics Plus
games.text: ——— is an active stealth roguelike that parodies cheap '90s edutainment with a subtle horror twist! Play Hide & Seek with Baldi as he chases you through procedurally generated levels while using your surroundings, items, and game knowledge to shift chaos in your favor.

games.name: FPV SkyDive : FPV Drone Simulator
games.text: ——— is a free-to-play realistic drone racing and freestyle simulator. Feel the adrenaline of high speed first-person view drone racing in single-player or multi-player scenarios. The future is now, become an FPV pilot today!

games.name: Esports Godfather
games.text: E-sports Godfather is a Deck-building game simulating MOBA e-sports. You will play a role as team coach and build your team. You need to train players and make strategies in various game versions, beat other teams and finally, take the Champion of the World. Be nobody, or lead your team to dominate!

games.name: Astral Ascent
games.text: Choose one of four heroes and explore the Garden, an astral prison guarded by 12 powerful mystical bosses: the Zodiacs. Challenge them with dozens of unique spells and faithful friends by your side to unfold the story of this platform roguelite with lightning fast combat.

games.name: Interstate Drifter 2000
games.text: Drift through the interstates and sideroads of this open game world, win street races and try to avoid traffic and police.

games.name: Task Force Admiral - Vol.1: American Carrier Battles
games.text: Experience the thrill of leading American aircraft carriers to victory in this innovative full 3D command simulation wargame set in the Pacific in 1942. First-person or God’s eye, you lead your fleet and planes right from the center of the battle.

games.name: Strinova
games.text: ——— is an anime-style third-person tactical competitive shooter. Switch freely between three-dimensional and two-dimensional forms in this one-of-a-kind game that offers a unique tactical shooting system for an unparalleled experience.

games.name: Loop Hero
games.text: The Lich has thrown the world into a timeless loop and plunged its inhabitants into never ending chaos. Wield an expanding deck of mystical cards to place enemies, buildings, and terrain along each unique expedition loop for the brave hero.

games.name: The Planet Crafter
games.text: A space survival open world terraforming crafting game, designed for 1 to 10 players. Alter the ecosystem of an inhospitable planet to render it habitable for humanity. Survive, gather resources, and build your base. Then, generate oxygen, warmth, and pressure to create a brand new biosphere.

games.name: Guild Wars 2®
games.text: ——— is an award-winning online roleplaying game with fast-paced action combat, deep character customization, and no subscription fee required. Choose from an arsenal of professions and weapons, explore a vast open world, compete in PVP modes and more. Join over 16 million players now!

games.name: GWENT: The Witcher Card Game
games.text: Command mighty Witcher-world heroes in epic online PvP card battles!

games.name: Borderlands 4
games.text: ——— is a mayhem-fueled looter shooter, jam-packed with billions of weapons, deadly enemies, and intense co-op action. Break free from a dangerous hidden planet as one of four new badass Vault Hunters.

games.name: Ultimate Racing 2D 2
games.text: The ultimate top-down racing game is back! ——— includes new cars, new tracks, car/track editor, time-trial mode, improved online multiplayer and career mode, new settings and more.

games.name: VR Skater
games.text: The most authentic, challenging, and immersive skating game ever

games.name: Sea Power : Naval Combat in the Missile Age
games.text: From the lead designer of Cold Waters, ——— lets you control NATO and Warsaw Pact forces in modern naval conflict campaigns. Use your advanced naval weaponry and sensors to respect rules of engagement and defeat the enemy forces in a tense fight for initiative and air/naval supremacy.

games.name: BPM: BULLETS PER MINUTE
games.text: ——— is a rhythm-action FPS rogue-like where you must shoot, jump and dodge to the beat of an epic rock soundtrack. Delve into a randomly generated dungeon where one missed note can lead to your death. Gain game-changing abilities and loot powerful weaponry to defeat your ancient enemy: Nidhogg.

games.name: STAR WARS™: The Old Republic™
games.text: ———™ is a free-to-play MMORPG that puts you at the center of your own story-driven saga. Play as a Jedi, Sith, Bounty Hunter, or one of many other iconic ——— roles in the galaxy far, far away over three thousand years before the classic films.

games.name: Tour de France 2020
games.text: Compete against the peloton in all 21 stages of the Tour de France in the official game! To wear the yellow jersey, you will need to take risks, attack, sprint and perfect your race tactics. Challenge your friends in Downhill or Sprint Challenge mode!

games.name: Way of the Hunter
games.text: Become the new owner of a hunting lodge nestled among gorgeous habitats and rich animal populations. Explore vast open world environments and hunt with a premium selection of firearms. Enjoy the perfect hunt on your own or with friends in co-op.

games.name: Neyyah
games.text: ——— is a first-person point-and-click adventure game from Defy Reality Entertainment. You are thrown into a strange secretive world called ———. Use careful observation and logic to uncover the mysteries entwined within ———'s peculiar landscapes and bizarre cultures.

games.name: Elasto Mania Remastered
games.text: The original cult classic returns. A blast from the past, better than ever. Are you ready?

games.name: Gecko Gods
games.text: Explore a forgotten land in ———, a puzzle-adventure as a tiny gecko. Climb walls, solve ancient puzzles and uncover a lost civilisation in a world full of hidden paths, quiet secrets and natural wonder.

games.name: Warpips
games.text: ——— is the ultimate quick to learn but amazingly deep tug-of-war strategy game. Deploy the right composition of soldiers, tanks, helicopters and planes in this tight, streamlined strategy-focused war game. Compose the best army, research the right tech; overwhelm your enemy!

games.name: Cartridge Defense
games.text: ——— is a tower defense game with over 300 distinct collectible cards that you will use to create your own decks to defend against robots in the cyberpunk inspired future. Play cards (cartridges) to spawn towers, upgrades, special abilities and more in a campaign or rogue-like mode.

games.name: 3on3 FreeStyle: Rebound
games.text: ——— allows players to Team up for fast-paced street basketball, dive into single-player Career Mode PVE, and grow your skills with dynamic gameplay and enhanced Lumen-powered visuals.

games.name: Cube Escape Collection
games.text: In this classic point-and-click adventure anthology you follow the path of Dale and Laura and other famous Rusty lake characters such as Mr. Crow and Mr. Owl. The series will be updated, preserved and bundled to survive the end of the Flash Games era.

games.name: Ash of Gods: The Way
games.text: Solve tactical puzzles in constantly changing battles and overcome circumstances that are NEVER in your favor. Defend your commander, win duels, capture points, experiment with your strategy to defeat a superior enemy, and make decisions that affect your story.

games.name: Rollerdrome
games.text: ——— is a BAFTA award-winning third person action shooter that seamlessly blends high octane, visceral combat with fluid movement and tricking mechanics into one complementary and challenging whole, to create an original adrenaline-pumping shooter experience like no other.

games.name: HARD BULLET
games.text: ——— is a physics-based action game, where enemies flood the neon-lit city bringing destruction to its streets. Use slow-motion, a huge arsenal, and brutal combat to survive and unlock new weapons. Prepare for the next RIDE by mastering your skills in Sandbox and Arena modes.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector
games.text: ——— is a fast-paced turn-based strategy game set in the grimdark universe of the 41st Millennium. Pick your force, develop your army, field mighty heroes and fight for victory using superior strategy, awesome abilities, and devastating weaponry.

games.name: DRAGON QUEST® XI S: Echoes of an Elusive Age™ - Definitive Edition
games.text: The Definitive Edition includes the critically acclaimed DRAGON QUEST XI, plus additional scenarios, orchestral soundtrack, 2D mode and more! Whether you are a longtime fan or a new adventurer, this is the ultimate DQXI experience.

games.name: Draconia
games.text: Create your dragon, customize it, level it. Explore the world of ——— and unravel its story. ——— is an MORPG where YOU play as the dragon!

games.name: The Mortuary Assistant
games.text: Alone with the dead... Embalm corpses, banish demons, save your soul.

games.name: Peglin
games.text: ——— is a Pachinko Roguelike - Fight enemies by collecting special orbs and popping pegs to deal damage. Acquire special relics that radically change the game and ensure no two runs are the same. Aim carefully to survive in this unique turn-based RPG!

games.name: 暖雪 Warm Snow
games.text: 'Warm Snow' is a Rogue-like action game with a background set in a dark fantasy world, where the eerie 'Warm Snow' holds sway. You will play as the Warrior 'Bi-an' on a crusade against the Five Great Clans, in order to save a world teetering on the brink of destruction.

games.name: Sunday Rivals
games.text: Easy to pickup, hard hitting, fully customizable arcade football is back with ———! Battle high-octane offenses and bone crushing tacklers in the harshest weather conditions to bring home championship glory!

games.name: Wanderstop
games.text: From the creator of The Stanley Parable and The Beginner’s Guide comes ———, a narrative-centric cozy game about change and tea.

games.name: Fabled Lands
games.text: ——— is a challenging old-school narrative RPG set in an open world. Complete quests, fight, trade goods and develop your character. Explore a vast land of adventure: travel across the war-torn kingdom, survive the plains of howling darkness, and escape the Court of Hidden Faces.

games.name: World Racing 2 - Champion Edition
games.text: ——— is back - revamped with a new look! The highly acclaimed racing spectacle makes the streets on your screen glow like never before! The new Champion Edition offers modding and Steam Workshop support. Are you ready to start the race of your life? The roads are waiting for you!

games.name: Inertial Drift: Sunset Prologue
games.text: Set in a 90's retro future, ——— offers a driving experience genuinely unlike anything you've played before – boasting twin stick drifting mechanics that need to be felt to be believed.

games.name: Labyrinthine
games.text: A co-op horror game like no other... Play with 1-8 players online as you solve puzzles, collect items and run from the horrors that lie within. Follow in the footsteps of Joan in the story mode or tackle procedurally generated maps that scale with your level and bring a fresh experience each game..

games.name: Mini Motor Racing X
games.text: Welcome to the world of ———! Strap yourself in, or strap on your VR headset, and jump into a nitro fueled world where little cars mean BIG fun!

games.name: Elementallis
games.text: Top-down action-adventure with elemental magic gameplay. Guided by guilt, you embark on a journey to restore the elements in a dying world. Harness and master elemental powers to fight enemies, solve puzzles, and explore a vast world filled with ancient temples.

games.name: Monster Energy Supercross - The Official Videogame 4
games.text: Cross is Super Again! The official videogame of the Monster Energy AMA Supercross Championship is back with its fourth edition, the most extreme ever!

games.name: Urge
games.text: Fight, build, explore, survive, while the dynamic player-caused hazardous fog is slowly changing the rules of the world around you.

games.name: The Magister
games.text: ——— is a murder-mystery card-battler RPG. Build and customise your deck to fight in battles, or use ‘Tactical Diplomacy’ to pacify those who stand in your way. Gather clues and discover motives as you investigate the death of your predecessor and unmask the guilty culprit.

games.name: The Outlast Trials
games.text: Red Barrels invites you to experience mind-numbing terror, this time with friends. Whether you go through the trials alone or in teams, if you survive long enough and complete the therapy, Murkoff will happily let you leave… but will you be the same?

games.name: GearBlocks
games.text: Explore a world of creative building, interactive machines, and gears - lots of gears. Build all things mechanical: cars, trucks, cranes, tanks, gearboxes, engines, clocks, anything you can think of. Test your creations to destruction in challenging scenarios, and share them in the workshop!

games.name: Barro Racing
games.text: Jump!

games.name: Craftopia
games.text: ——— is the brand new multiplayer survival action game made in Japan. We combined many features we find enjoyable, such as hunting, farming, hack-and-slash, building, automation to develop this game.

games.name: TOEM: A Photo Adventure
games.text: Set off on a delightful expedition and use your photographic eye to uncover the mysteries of the magical ——— in this hand-drawn adventure game. Chat with quirky characters, solve their problems by snapping neat photos, and make your way through a relaxing landscape!

games.name: GRID Legends
games.text: ——— delivers thrilling wheel-to-wheel motorsport action. Create dream race events, hop into live races, experience a dramatic virtual production story, and embrace the sensation of spectacular racing.

games.name: Kingdoms Reborn
games.text: A city builder with simulated citizens, set in a procedurally-generated world map. Grow your kingdom through the eras from a tiny medieval hamlet into a prosperous global empire! Cooperate or compete in real-time with your friends in multiplayer mode.

games.name: Cult of the Lamb
games.text: Start your own cult in a land of false prophets, venturing out into diverse and mysterious regions to build a loyal community of woodland Followers and spread your Word to become the one true cult.

games.name: Achilles: Legends Untold
games.text: Rewrite fate with every strike. Face gods, mythic heroes, and legendary beasts in this souls-like Action RPG set in ancient Greece. Master brutal combat, unlock divine skills, and shape ——— into the warrior only you can become.

games.name: X-Fitness
games.text: ——— is a fun and innovative way to enjoy an intensive VR full-body workout! Stand and fight off the pounds in the virtual arena. Punch, cut, block, and dodge your way to a slimmer you! Start burning those calories with handcrafted tracks or your own MP3 files.

games.name: Three Kingdom: The Journey
games.text: Craft a legendary deck and lead your troops to protect the Kingdom for the glory of the Han Dynasty in this fast-paced deck-building strategy roguelike. The Kingdom is on the verge of disaster against the Yellow Turbans rebellion, and only you – and your skills as a general – stand in their way!

games.name: Tin Can
games.text: You've barely managed to escape your exploding spaceship. Now in an old escape pod, you hurtle through space at the mercy of the cosmos. With no knowledge of the pod’s complex systems, your life depends on a technical manual and your own wits. How long can you survive?

games.name: shapez
games.text: ——— is an easy-going, minimalistic factory building game about the automation of shapes through extraction and satisfying production lines. Adapt to increasingly complex shapes and grow your factory across an infinitely expanding map. Your only limitation is your creativity!

games.name: Duck Life 8: Adventure
games.text: Duck Life is back and bigger than ever! Design your own duck and embark on a epic adventure. Explore an enormous new area to find training dojos, shops and ducks to race and battle. Play 16 new training games to level up your duck in 8 skills and become the greatest duck adventurer ever!

games.name: Cassette Beasts
games.text: Collect awesome monsters to use during turn-based battles in this open-world RPG, now with online multiplayer mode. Combine any two monster forms using ———’ Fusion System to create unique and powerful new ones!

games.name: Battle Bands: Rock & Roll Deckbuilder
games.text: Get the band together and take on the world in this battle of the bands, deckbuilding card game set in the fantasy land of Riff City. Play solo or with friends to conquer offbeat bosses in a coop campaign. Wits and a sick riff are key to becoming a rock legend.

games.name: Stranded: Alien Dawn
games.text: Brave a new world in ———, a planet survival sim placing the fate of a small marooned group in your hands. Forge your story through compelling and immersive strategic gameplay as you make vital decisions to protect your survivors.

games.name: Turbo Golf Racing
games.text: An action-packed fusion of racing and golf. Traverse across a diverse range of courses, using your car to skilfully putt your ball in the hole. Face off against 7 opponents in Race mode, make every shot count in golf mode, or test your skills against the clock in Time Trials.

games.name: Car Parking Simulator VR
games.text: Car Parking Simulator is a fully interactive, realistic and immersive car parking experience. The game has one of the best vehicle physics simulations in VR.

games.name: Easy Red 2
games.text: Experience massive battles with infantry, tanks, artillery, and aircraft on large destructible open-world maps. Equip yourself, coordinate with your squad, and fight through World War II in singleplayer, co-op, or multiplayer!

games.name: Nioh 2 – The Complete Edition
games.text: Battle hordes of yokai in this masocore Action RPG. Create your protagonist and embark on an adventure through a myriad of locales across Japan during the Sengoku period. Utilize the new Yokai Shift ability to defeat even the most ferocious yokai and be prepared to brave through Dark Realms created by your enemies. Prepare to unleash your darkness in ———!

games.name: Sons Of The Forest
games.text: Sent to find a missing billionaire on a remote island, you find yourself in a cannibal-infested hellscape. Craft, build, and struggle to survive, alone or with friends, in this terrifying new open-world survival horror simulator.

games.name: Quantum Protocol
games.text: A deckbuilding card game where it's always your turn. Play as the master hackers of Quantum and take on the most dangerous malware in the world. Every action matters. Make plays, upgrade your deck, and break the enemy board!

games.name: Need for Speed™ Hot Pursuit Remastered
games.text: Feel the thrill of the chase and the rush of escape behind the wheels of the world’s hottest high-performance cars in ———– a heart-pumping, socially competitive racing experience.

games.name: Mass Effect™ Legendary Edition
games.text: The ——— includes single-player base content and over 40 DLC from the highly acclaimed Mass Effect, Mass Effect 2, and Mass Effect 3 games, including promo weapons, armors, and packs — remastered and optimized for 4K Ultra HD.

games.name: Lost in Play
games.text: Solve puzzles, riddles, and embark on an exciting journey of discovery! Join Toto and Gal as they explore dreamscapes and befriend magical creatures. Lost in their imagination, the brother and sister must stick together and solve puzzles to find their way home.

games.name: Karting
games.text: Climb aboard your kart and beat records alone or with friends in a unique arcade game!

games.name: Stolen Realm
games.text: ——— is a simultaneous turn-based tactical dungeon crawling looter with action RPG elements where you control up to 6 heroes, solo or through online co-op, venturing forth in adventures set in a high-fantasy, low-poly world.

games.name: Becastled
games.text: Build a castle by day and defend it by night. ——— blends cozy city-building with challenging tower defense strategy. Lead the Sun Kingdom’s last stand against the Moon Beasts and end the ancient conflict between light and darkness!

games.name: Big Ambitions
games.text: ——— is a revolutionary role-playing business sim. Go from nothing to the biggest entrepreneur in New York by opening small businesses or slowly building huge corporations any way you like.

games.name: Stray
games.text: Lost, alone and separated from family, a ——— cat must untangle an ancient mystery to escape a long-forgotten cybercity and find their way home.

games.name: Thief Simulator 2
games.text: The door to your robber’s career is waiting! Just crowbar the lock off and force your way through the threshold. Learn skills, collect tools and become a master of the thieving trade!

games.name: Stream Racer
games.text: ——— is a racing game for streamers. Build your own tracks, host your own races, stream it on and have your viewers join you. Engage more with your viewers by giving them a racing car on your stream. Get ready for a hilariously chaotic time for your viewers and you!

games.name: Operation: Tango
games.text: It takes two to save the world in this cooperative spy adventure. Pair up with a friend as Agent or Hacker—with only your voices to connect you—and work together to bring a hi-tech global menace to its knees. Now with a FREE CONTENT UPDATE!

games.name: Len's Island
games.text: An open-world survival crafting game for 1–8 players, blending intense dungeon crawling and ARPG combat with peaceful farming and creative building. Take on quests and explore a vast, procedurally-generated world full of danger and discovery.

games.name: Against the Storm
games.text: A dark fantasy city builder where you must rebuild civilization in the face of apocalyptic rains. As the Queen’s Viceroy, lead humans, beavers, lizards, foxes, and harpies to reclaim the wilderness and secure a future for civilization's last survivors.

games.name: Risk of Rain Returns
games.text: Carefully designed, beautifully remastered, and loaded with new ways to play—Risk of Rain is back and better than ever! Dive into the iconic roguelike full of unique loot combinations, enhanced with new Survivors, overhauled multiplayer, fan favorite content from Risk of Rain 2, and more!

games.name: Choice of Life: Middle Ages
games.text: A card game in a Medieval setting where you make decisions on which not only your life will depend, but also the future of the kingdom!

games.name: AFTERBLAST
games.text: ——— is a challenging FPS roguelite. Play SOLO or in CO-OP (1-4 players). Get stronger each run. Obtain powerful abilities, weapons and find a way to save your planet. Stand up against the Gods and defeat hordes of monsters in intense bullet-hell combat!

games.name: Infinite Tournament Paintball
games.text: Infinite is a modern era paintball game that aims to capture the real world aspects of tournament style paintball. Featuring X-Ball format of up to 10V10, Online and Offline Play, markers set to 10.5 ramping, slide or dive into your bunker and engage in competitive matches

games.name: We Were Here Forever
games.text: You both awaken imprisoned inside the sinister Castle Rock - were you betrayed, or simply not that clever? Find out in the greatest co-op puzzle adventure in the We Were Here Series! Do you and your partner have what it takes to face the dark forces of this realm or will you be trapped… forever?

games.name: Hellsweeper VR
games.text: DARE TO DESCEND INTO HELL? ——— is an intense first-person action-combat VR experience. Traverse the underworld where every step brings a challenge or a chance. Gain mastery of your weapons and elemental magic, or fall to the unrelenting onslaught of hell's twisted souls.

games.name: Thymesia
games.text: ——— is a gruelling action-RPG with fast-paced combat and an intricate plague weapon system. In a kingdom where death spreads, play as a mysterious character known by the code name "Corvus". Prey upon your enemies, wield the power of disease and find the truth in your own memories.

games.name: Old School RuneScape
games.text: The best retro fantasy MMORPG on the planet. Old School is RuneScape but… older! This is the open world you know and love, but as it was in 2007. Saying that, it’s even better than that – Old School is shaped by you, its players, with regular new content, fixes and expansions voted for by the fans!

games.name: RuneScape ®
games.text: ——— is a high fantasy open world MMORPG. Explore an ever changing and evolving living world where new challenges, skills, and quests await. Featuring unprecedented player freedom, you choose how to play, adventure, and grow.

games.name: RiMS Racing
games.text: The first motorbike simulation that combines a realistic racing challenge with engineering and mechanics! Ride the world's most powerful motorbikes and optimise their performance by swapping out parts and analysing data in real time.

games.name: Wargroove 2
games.text: Trouble stirs on the shores of Aurania. An ambitious new faction has unearthed forbidden relics capable of catastrophic consequences. But how far will they go to achieve glory? Take to the battlefield, sea, and sky with a cast of new Commanders, using your wits to wage turn-based war!

games.name: 5D Chess With Multiverse Time Travel
games.text: It's the first ever chess variant with spatial, temporal, and parallel dimensions. It's ———! Move pieces back in time to create branching timelines. Send a rook to a parallel dimension. Protect your kings in the present and in the past!

games.name: DPS IDLE
games.text: Collect cards, upgrade cards, defeat monsters, join guilds and hire heroes. Raise your DPS!

games.name: IMMORTALITY
games.text: Marissa Marcel was a film star. She made three movies. But none of the movies were ever released. And Marissa Marcel disappeared. An interactive trilogy from Sam Barlow, creator of Her Story.

games.name: Taxi Life: A City Driving Simulator
games.text: Climb into the driver's seat of your car and your business, transport passengers across Barcelona and grow your company! Can you help relieve the transportation challenges of a city that never sleeps?

games.name: Idle Slayer
games.text: Start from nothing and grow into a legendary Slayer. Explore countless dimensions, collect souls, unlock powerful upgrades, craft powerful gear, defeat epic bosses, and enjoy a deep idle RPG with active and offline progression.

games.name: RAILGRADE
games.text: ——— is the train RTS game! Construct dense vertical railroads, build cities, construct vast factory chains with train automation! Restore an off world colony's economy all in the intense story driven campaign or relaxing sandbox mode!

games.name: Who Wants To Be A Millionaire
games.text: Put your general knowledge to the test in « ———? », the official game!

games.name: Hexarchy
games.text: ——— is an innovative, fast-paced, historical 4x strategy game where you use cards and deckbuilding to make your decisions. Single-player and online multiplayer.

games.name: STRANGER OF PARADISE FINAL FANTASY ORIGIN
games.text: Developed in cooperation between Square Enix and Team NINJA (Koei Tecmo Games), ——— is a hard-core action RPG that takes the FINAL FANTASY series in a new direction. Experience the boldest and most merciless battles in FINAL FANTASY history.

games.name: The Infected
games.text: ——— is a sandbox, first-person, open-world survival game. Build bases, craft, farm, hunt, and survive changing seasons. Choose whether to face the hybrid “Vambies” or turn them off for a pure survival experience.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide
games.text: Take back the city of Tertium from hordes of bloodthirsty foes in this intense and brutal action shooter. ——— is the new co-op focused experience from the award-winning team behind the Vermintide series. As Tertium falls, Rejects Will Rise.

games.name: The Room 4: Old Sins
games.text: The disappearance of an ambitious engineer and his high-society wife provokes a hunt for a precious artefact. The trail leads you to the attic of their home, and the discovery of an old, peculiar dollhouse. What secrets lie within these walls?

games.name: Manor Lords
games.text: ——— is a medieval strategy game featuring in-depth city building, large-scale tactical battles, and complex economic and social simulations. Rule your lands as a medieval lord – the seasons pass, the weather changes, and cities rise and fall.

games.name: First Racer
games.text: ——— - Arcade racing. Compete, overtake, conquer. Upgrade and customize your cars. Embark on a journey from city cars to high-speed supercars. Join the race, alone or with friends, and immerse yourself in a world of incredible speeds.

games.name: Street Fighter™ 6
games.text: Here comes Capcom’s newest challenger! ——— launches worldwide on June 2nd, 2023 and represents the next evolution of the Street Fighter™ series! ——— spans three distinct game modes, including World Tour, Fighting Ground and Battle Hub.

games.name: Cybershock: Future Parkour
games.text: ——— is a runner game with outrun aesthetics in which you are an antivirus. Your mission is to destroy all the viruses on your computer before they destroy you. For this you must parkour through the different levels and avoid all the obstacles that stand in your way.

games.name: Dyson Sphere Program
games.text: Build the most efficient intergalactic factory in space simulation strategy game ———! Harness the power of stars, collect resources, plan and design production lines and develop your interstellar factory from a small space workshop to a galaxy-wide industrial empire.

games.name: MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM BATTLE OPERATION 2
games.text: This is a free-to-play team battle action game based on the "Mobile Suit Gundam" series of the Universal Century. Whether by land or by space, lay waste to your foes using either your favorite Mobile Suit or roam the battlefield as infantry and capture important objectives.

games.name: Tony Stewart's All-American Racing
games.text: In ———, it’s always a Saturday night at the local short track! With three different styles of racing to choose from and a variety of tracks, it’s sure to be a good time for all!

games.name: Corsair Cove
games.text: Build a sprawling pirate haven, raise a fleet to explore the high seas, and take on the Crown to keep the Age of Piracy alive! From ale to flintlock pistols, and from scallywags to swashbucklers, you’ll need to manage complex production chains and govern a rowdy crew to reign supreme over the seas!

games.name: RollerCoaster Tycoon® 3: Complete Edition
games.text: Build the park of a lifetime and rediscover the critically acclaimed rollercoaster simulation bestseller. Feel the thrill of a genre-defining classic, complete with two huge expansion packs.

games.name: Motor Town: Behind The Wheel
games.text: Enjoy realistic driving in the open world. Relaxing cargo deliveries or driving buses and taxis will give you enough money to buy new cars and parts. You can test your driving skills at the race track. It's all about pure driving pleasure!

games.name: Solar Expanse - Space Exploration Manager
games.text: Explore the Solar System. Mine and drop asteroids. Colonize and terraform. Lead the space race and compete with other corporations on your way to profit. Watch the expansion of human race over the centuries.

games.name: Myth of Empires
games.text: ——— is a multiplayer war sandbox game featuring a high degree of freedom and multiple civilizations. Players must survive, craft, create, and lead troops in their quest to conquer PVE or PVP territory and build their own empire. Xizhou Civilization Pack is now officially released!

games.name: Card Shark
games.text: ——— is an adventure game full of cunning, intrigue, and delectable deceit. Enter a world where you’ll need to play your opponents better than you play your cards.

games.name: No Rest for the Wicked
games.text: From Moon Studios, the award-winning creators of Ori and the Blind Forest and Ori and the Will of the Wisps, comes ———, a unique, visceral Action RPG set in a hand-crafted world with Souls-like combat. Featuring co-op for up to four players.

games.name: Fly Corp
games.text: Develop your own transport network in different regions and cities: open new routes, buy and upgrade new planes, and increase airport capacity!

games.name: INDIKA
games.text: Play a third-person, story-driven game set in alternative Russia at the turn of the XIX century where religious visions clash with harsh reality. ——— tells the story of a young nun who sets off on a journey of self-discovery with the most unusual companion by her side, the devil himself.

games.name: RuneScape: Dragonwilds
games.text: On ———'s forgotten continent of Ashenfall, dragons have awoken. Gather, build, skill and craft in this co-operative survival adventure. Only by mastering survival and uncovering ancient secrets can you hope to face the ferocious Dragon Queen.

games.name: Swarm Grinder
games.text: An action roguelite game with alien swarms and mechs. Battle enemies to make your way through a mass of spreading and evolving cells hosting dormant enemies. Collect a variety of game-changing skills and upgrades to create unique builds.

games.name: Big Mutha Truckers 2: Truck Me Harder
games.text: Ma Jackson, Hick State County's most infamous trucker, has been incarcerated on charges of tax evasion, 7,973 parking tickets, and six counts of being a comedy stereotype! Imprisoned, Ma's only hope lies with her kids. It's up to them to locate 6 members of the jury that are to try Ma and bribe them

games.name: Draft of Darkness
games.text: ——— is a survival horror RPG with deck building and roguelike dungeon exploration. Recruit allies, synergize their decks to create powerful card combos. Manage your limited resources and explore procedurally generated maps to determine the story's outcome.

games.name: 80's OVERDRIVE
games.text: ——— is a 2D pixelart racing game, designed to take you back in time to when 8 and 16 bit consoles and arcade games ruled the world. Compete against opponents in career mode to unlock new races, buy new cars and upgrade them with state-of-the-art technologies!

games.name: Viewfinder
games.text: Challenge perception, redefine reality, and reshape the world around you with an instant camera. ——— is a new single player game offering gamers hours of interesting and fun experiences while uncovering the mysteries left behind.

games.name: Persona® 5 Strikers
games.text: Join the Phantom Thieves and strike back against the corruption overtaking cities across Japan. A summer vacation with close friends takes a sudden turn as a distorted reality emerges; reveal the truth and redeem the hearts of those imprisoned at the center of the crisis!

games.name: Ballex²: The Hanging Gardens
games.text: ——— is an indie high-altitude rolling game focused on physics and skillful control. Here, you will take control of nine unique spheres to conquer breathtaking aerial wonders and experience an unprecedented challenge that combines physics-based puzzles with demanding controls.

games.name: Interstate Drifter 1999
games.text: Drift between the states, collect bits, beat rivals and get a high score.

games.name: Nickelodeon Kart Racers 2: Grand Prix
games.text: Nickelodeon Kart Racers is back and we’re kicking it into overdrive! In ———, you can select from 30 playable racers and 70 team members to assemble your ultimate pit crew.

games.name: GUILTY GEAR -STRIVE-
games.text: The cutting-edge 2D/3D hybrid graphics pioneered in the Guilty Gear series have been raised to the next level in “———-“. The new artistic direction and improved character animations will go beyond anything you’ve seen before in a fighting game!

games.name: Across the Obelisk
games.text: Set forth in a co-op roguelite deckbuilder where every choice matters! Craft decks of breathtaking power. Journey alone or with up to three friends. Plot your party’s path to glory and face powerful enemies in deep tactical combat on your quest to save the kingdom of Senenthia in ———!

games.name: My Village Life
games.text: ——— is an open world village simulator vehicle driving game.

games.name: Doki Doki Literature Club Plus!
games.text: Welcome to the club! Write poems for your crush and experience the terror of school romance in this critically-acclaimed psychological horror story.

games.name: Mech Armada
games.text: Create and command custom Mechs to outmaneuver The Swarm in this post-apocalyptic tactical turn-based rogue-lite. Leverage the terrain, learn each Mech's unique skills and use strategy and resources to survive an ever-changing series of battles to give humanity hope.

games.name: Little Nightmares III
games.text: ——— is an atmospheric adventure game in which you follow the journey of Low and Alone, two best friends in search of a way out of the Nowhere. In 2 players online cooperation or solo with an A.I., work together to solve puzzles and survive in this nightmarish world.

games.name: Time Break Chronicles
games.text: ——— is a fusion of classic JRPGs and modern Roguelites, with a cast of 100 playable classes to find and unlock. Build your team, customize their abilities, and venture into a procedurally generated adventure through space-time and beyond!

games.name: Breach Wanderers
games.text: A fresh take on Roguelike Deckbuilders that lets you fine-tune your decks before each run to adapt your strategy on your way to victory. Over 1,200 cards to choose from, ten characters with their own set of unique skills, and dozens of items and missions to evolve your tactics.

games.name: The Séance of Blake Manor
games.text: ——— is a supernatural detective mystery, set in 1897 Ireland, where you investigate the disappearance of Evelyn Deane in a remote hotel full of secrets and other-worldly occurrences.

games.name: Primateria
games.text: Embark on an epic journey in ———, a game redefining the roguelike deckbuilder with a nod to classic Yu-Gi-Oh! experience. Fuse cards, battle divine beings, and navigate through a universe teeming with challenges and surprises. Embrace the thrill of endless combinations and tactical depths.

games.name: Jetborne Racing
games.text: Put your flight skills to the test in the online multiplayer air racing game from the creator of VTOL VR. Pilot a high performance jet through challenging courses in a race to the finish. Fly in VR or on desktop with either virtual or physical HOTAS. Do you have what it takes for a podium position?

games.name: Rise of Piracy
games.text: The perfect blend of Action, Adventure and RTS. Begin your journey as the lowly captain of a small vessel. End as the commander of a threatening fleet. Rise to glory how you see fit. Trade, fight, recruit, grow, pillage, ally, destroy & conquer.

games.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley
games.text: Explore a world filled with the magic of Disney as you discover rich stories and build the perfect neighborhood alongside Disney and Pixar heroes and villains in this new life-sim adventure game. Welcome to ———.

games.name: Luck be a Landlord
games.text: ——— is a roguelike deckbuilder about using a slot machine to earn rent money and defeat capitalism. This game does not contain any real-world currency gambling or microtransactions.

games.name: World of Tanks
games.text: ——— is a tactical action game with very different gameplay depending on the vehicle type and role. Aside from regular PvP, there are competitive and clan-based modes, special PvE and PvPvE events, and much more. Whether you play to dominate or just enjoy the ride, you'll fit right in.

games.name: Walkabout Mini Golf VR
games.text: Escape into a fun and beautiful world filled with the best mini golf courses you’ve ever seen! Play by yourself, meet someone new, or challenge your friends in a private game with up to 8 people. Extremely realistic physics create the perfect experience for hardcore golfers and casual players alike.

games.name: Call of the Wild: The Angler™
games.text: The Angler is an open world fishing game that can be played solo or with friends. Discover and catch a wide variety of unique fish species, from common to rare, on your journey to become a master angler.

games.name: Urbek City Builder
games.text: Urbek is a city building game where you can build your own neighbourhoods: from nightlife district to industrial district. Don't exhaust your natural resources before you have an educated population to build more efficient structures.

games.name: Metroplex Zero: Sci-Fi Card Battler
games.text: Neo-cyberpunk roguelike card battler. Strategically construct your decks, gain powerful cybernetic upgrades, and vanquish sinister MegaCorps in challenging card combat. Dive into a replayable single-player experience that blends RPG progression, deck-building strategy, and a futuristic sci-fi world.

games.name: Shadow Man Remastered
games.text: He is coming, stalking criminals in the spirit world and the real world. A possessed man is coming, a voodoo mask in his chest and lines of power in his back. Shadow Man is coming, trailing evil from Liveside to Deadside. To stop an apocalypse. To save your soul.

games.name: The Shimmering Horizon and Cursed Blacksmith
games.text: "Try all you can, through hell and fire's end..." Forge yourself the best weapon you can, and jump into the ever-changing dungeon searching for your memory and the truth of this world! Roguelike X Smithing X Souls-like. Turn-Based Strategic Dungeon Crawling RPG

games.name: PalmRide
games.text: ———, the retrofuturistic fast-paced driving game inspired by classic games, and the modern outrun aesthetics. Drive through busy streets of the city, climb the tallest mountains, or just chill out on your way to the beach. Avoid obstacles and be the first in the leaderboard! Be the rad guy!

games.name: PBA Pro Bowling 2021
games.text: ——— is the ultimate game for all bowling fans! Play online versus your friends, or start your PBA Career in a deep single player experience. This game has something for everyone with options for both an authentic simulation mode or an explosive arcade style of gameplay!

games.name: My Singing Monsters
games.text: Dive into the Musical World of ———! Breed them, feed them, listen to them sing! Breed & collect a menagerie of Monsters, each a living instrument! Build your paradise across 35+ Islands, customize your world, and enjoy endless music! There's never a dull moment in the Monster World!

games.name: Fraymakers
games.text: ——— is the ultimate customizable platform fighting game, featuring a cast of some of indie gaming's biggest icons. Duke it out with up to 4 players and call on assists to help out in the heat of battle. Create and play custom characters, stages, modes, and more for infinite fun!

games.name: Battle Shapers
games.text: ——— is an action-packed, sci-fi FPS roguelite in which you shoot and smash your way through swarms of corrupt robots. Wield powerful weapons, abilities, and game-changing new powers stolen from ruthless Overlords.

games.name: SimRail - The Railway Simulator
games.text: ——— is new, advanced railway simulator. Master high-speed long-distance EMU, heavy freight hauls and suburban trains. Travel 500 km of geodetic-data based real routes. Become train dispatcher and control the traffic according to the schedule or cooperate with other players on multiplayer mode.

games.name: Dodgeball Academia
games.text: ——— is a sports RPG game featuring rookie dodgeball student, Otto. Join Otto and an eclectic cast of characters as they train to dominate on and off the courts of the academia.

games.name: Glider Sim Deluxe – Soaring Simulator
games.text: Soar through 3 custom maps or explore the entire globe with Google Earth integration. Pilot hang gliders, paragliders, paramotors, mini-wings, speed-wings, ultralight trikes, or racing drones. Customize weather conditions and fly solo or with friends. Perfect for seasoned pilots and newcomers alike!

games.name: Wobbledogs
games.text: A 3D pet simulation where you raise your own personal hive of mutating dogs, physically simulated all the way down to their guts! ——— is a casual and chill sandbox for players of all ages who want to care for their very own virtual pets in a surprising, unique, and stress-free environment.

games.name: Bunny Hill
games.text: Carve the slopes of the ——— on your skis in this fast paced physics racing game. With up to 8 player Online Multiplayer, dodge bushes and tag flags on randomly generated maps to reach infinite scaling speed with your friends.

games.name: The Solitaire Conspiracy
games.text: We need your help, Spymaster. Join a world of near-future spies and take on a supervillain in this supercharged take on classic Solitaire. Precision engineered for replayable espionage action.

games.name: Botany Manor
games.text: Welcome to ———, a stately home in 19th century England. You play as inhabitant Arabella Greene, a retired botanist. Explore your house and gardens, filled with research, to figure out the ideal habitat of forgotten flora. Grow each plant to discover the mysterious qualities they hold…

games.name: It Takes Two
games.text: Embark on the craziest journey of your life in ———. Invite a friend to join for free with Friend’s Pass and work together across a huge variety of gleefully disruptive gameplay challenges. Winner of GAME OF THE YEAR at the Game Awards 2021.

games.name: Instruments of Destruction
games.text: Crash through walls and tear down buildings in ———, a vehicle-action game featuring advanced physics-based demolition. Pilot 130+ unique vehicles across scores of challenge-packed missions or design your own contraptions and wreck highly-interactive sandbox worlds.

games.name: Mech Engineer
games.text: A dark sci-fi mech assembling manager with semi-auto battles against mutating, alien bio-weapon.

games.name: Little Sim World
games.text: Welcome to Little London! ——— is a cosy 2D life sim set in the heart of a little city full of charm, dreams, and surprises. Design your perfect home, meet quirky locals, build your routine, and live life at your own pace. A gentle world, a fresh start, and a story only you can write!

games.name: Clash: Artifacts of Chaos
games.text: Hunted by mercenaries of an enemy with untold power, the fighter Pseudo and the creature under his protection begin a perilous quest to the edges of strange lands.

games.name: Aquarist
games.text: Build beautiful aquariums, care for exotic marine life, complete creative customer jobs, and grow your own aquarium business into a world-class oceanarium in this relaxing sandbox simulation.

games.name: Astatos
games.text: Leave your influence in your wake as you bring together a broken land in a card-battling adventure filled with gods, heroes, and the instability of yourself and those around you. Play the story, or go online with fellow Crown Mages for tabletop card action.

games.name: Golazo! Soccer League
games.text: Golazo is a dynamic arcade football game with a medium-sized fields, no fouls and offsides whistled. Just pure fun!

games.name: Liftoff®: Micro Drones
games.text: Explore the world of FPV like never before! In ——— any indoor area becomes an exciting aerial playground. Explore, customize and compete in this simulator dedicated to the micro drones class.

games.name: Sun Haven
games.text: Build your farm and relationships with townsfolk, or forge ahead on a quest of magic, monsters, and dragons. Level up through a skill tree in 8 person multiplayer, or adventure solo!

games.name: Car Detailing Simulator
games.text: ———, you get a chance to renew any car and restore its splendor at the request of demanding customers! A nice and well-groomed vehicle can be the pride of every human being! Clean, polish and marvel at your creations in this highly realistic game where every little detail counts!

games.name: Lawnmower Game: Racing
games.text: New part for Lawnmower saga. Now first racing version. Select lawnmower and track and start racing against other mowers

games.name: Duck Life: Retro Pack
games.text: Play the 3 classic ——— Flash games like you've never seen them before!

games.name: HighFleet
games.text: Battle for survival in the skies of a mysterious future Earth in this unique action-strategy game mixing arcade combat, exploration, management and diplomacy. As giant flying ships wage spectacular aerial warfare, a prophecy tells of one who will save the world – could it be you?

games.name: Escape Simulator
games.text: First-person puzzler you can play solo or in an online co-op. Explore a set of highly interactive escape rooms. Move furniture, pick up and examine everything, smash pots and break locks! Play thousands of community-made rooms through the level editor.

games.name: Peripeteia
games.text: You are Marie, a cyborg mercenary dropped into the rot of a post-Soviet city of corruption and opportunity. Shoot, sneak, hack, climb or talk your way through alt-history cyberpunk Poland in an immersive sim where every problem has multiple solutions and every rooftop is reachable.

games.name: Sam & Max Save the World
games.text: An open-and-shut case of petty vandalism balloons into a far-flung mind-control conspiracy involving former child stars, the media, the mafia, the government, the internet, and the bright side of the moon. Telltale's episodic classic, lovingly remastered by members of the original development team.

games.name: Zeepkist
games.text: Welcome to ———! You race soapboxes down hills!

games.name: Tanto Cuore
games.text: ——— is a Japanese deck-building card game where you employ maids to serve you!

games.name: Storage Hunter Simulator
games.text: Play as one of the bidders for abandoned warehouses and uncover hidden treasures! Storage Hunter is a garage auction simulation game. Bid, win, and sell for profit! Become the king of storage auction.

games.name: Hamster Playground
games.text: Prepare for cuteness overload, relentless training, and fierce rivalry as you and your hamsters take on challenges while traversing the maze and riding a skateboard, with more modes coming soon! Be the first to cross the finish line to earn rewards and yummy treats!

games.name: Rogue
games.text: Experience the commercial port of the game that spawned a thousand '———-likes'. Venture into the Dungeons of Doom in search of the legendary Amulet of Yendor, and hopefully escape with your life! Randomly generated dungeons await you, full of nasty monsters, insidious traps, and glittering loot.

games.name: Turbo Sloths
games.text: ——— is an adrenaline-fueled shooter-racing game set on another planet, where you drive not a sports car, but a massive turbocharged truck turned into a war machine. Join the insane Wasteland League — here, it's not the fastest who wins, but the strongest.

games.name: House
games.text: Try to survive through the night in a ——— that's trying its best to kill you and your family.

games.name: Turing Complete
games.text: Learn CPU architecture with puzzles

games.name: Make Way
games.text: Speed around loops, dart through train crossings, drift around helter skelters, and unleash wacky weaponry in this modern take on classic top-down multiplayer racing games such as Micro Machines and Mashed. The twist? You build the track.

games.name: MONSTER HUNTER RISE
games.text: Rise to the challenge and join the hunt! In ———, the latest installment in the award-winning and top-selling Monster Hunter series, you’ll become a hunter, explore brand new maps and use a variety of weapons to take down fearsome monsters as part of an all-new storyline.

games.name: MotoGP™21
games.text: Take your place on the starting grid and get ready for the most realistic and immersive MotoGP™ videogame ever. Live the most authentic 2-wheels racing experience with the new ———!

games.name: Hydrofoil Generation
games.text: ——— is a realistic sailing and foiling simulator. An exciting and accurate first-person simulation of multiplayer "in-shore" regattas, now featuring official Global Racing League SailGP content. Put your skills and heart to the test!

games.name: Very Very Valet
games.text: Your next chaotic couch co-op party game is here! Drive, boost, and crash like wild with friends in this parking palooza

games.name: The Outer Worlds 2
games.text: ——— is the sequel to the award-winning first-person sci-fi RPG from Obsidian Entertainment.

games.name: Bassmaster® Fishing
games.text: ———, the official video game is OUT NOW, bringing the thrill of competitive big bass fishing to PC. Dive into the fully licensed content from the Bassmaster series from amateur to elite events.

games.name: The Walking Dead: The Telltale Definitive Series
games.text: ——— contains all 4 Seasons, 400 Days, and ———: Michonne, which includes over 50 hours of gameplay across 23 unique episodes.

games.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Master Duel
games.text: ——— is the ultimate free-to-play cross-platform strategy card game with fast-paced Duels, stunning HD graphics and a new, dynamic soundtrack! Get ready to challenge Duelists around the world!

games.name: Concordia: Digital Edition
games.text: ——— is a strategic, Euro-style board game. 🏺 Players take the roles of powerful Roman merchants and follow the Roman expansion with their trade routes, franchises, and production houses. 🏛️

games.name: Undisputed
games.text: Become ——— in the most authentic boxing game to date! Featuring true to life visuals, bone-jarring action, and more licensed boxers than ever before, ——— gives you unprecedented control to master every inch of the ring.

games.name: Underground Garage
games.text: Welcome to the world of high-stakes tuning and street racing! Welcome to ———! It's your playground where you can unleash your creativity and mechanical prowess. Fix cars, tune them up, and hit the road.

games.name: STARSEEKER: Astroneer Expeditions
games.text: Join the ESS ——— crew to explore strange new worlds, working together with friends to complete planet-wide objectives before the station journeys on to new planetary destinations. Collect and unlock powerful tech to help the crew tackle the perils of space!

games.name: Cookie Clicker
games.text: An idle game about making cookies! Originally released in 2013 on the web, and actively developed since then. This is the official version for Steam.

games.name: THE GAME OF LIFE 2
games.text: The official sequel to the hit board game played by 50 million fans! ——— adds vibrant 3D animation and brand-new choices in every turn. Customise your peg, spin the spinner and build your best life!

games.name: Dorfromantik
games.text: ——— is a peaceful building strategy and puzzle game where you create a beautiful and ever-growing village landscape by placing tiles. Explore a variety of colorful biomes, discover and unlock new tiles and complete quests to fill your world with life!

games.name: Initial Drift Online
games.text: Drift over some of Japan's most legendary mountain passes, compete against your friends or players from around the world in epic battles, make deliveries, buy new cars and set records in the world rankings!

games.name: ROBOBEAT
games.text: Keep your trigger finger on the pulse! In rhythm shooter ———, you'll play as Ace - a bounty hunter on a mission to capture robot-gone-rogue Frazzer in his ever-shifting lair. Wall run, slide, and shoot to your own beat using the in-game custom music editor, blasting through Frazzer's armies!

games.name: Marfusha:Sentinel Girls
games.text: A high-tempo shooting game with simple controls! Upgrade your character with cards and defend the gates from your enemies.

games.name: Carnivores: Dinosaur Hunt
games.text: ——— is a first-person hunting simulator where you hunt the largest and most dangerous beasts to ever exist – DINOSAURS.

games.name: Duck Life 4
games.text: Raise your duckling into a champion racer! Train your duck in 15 mini-games and watch proudly as it competes in tournaments against rival ducks, discovering exciting worlds and learning new skills

games.name: Rogue Command
games.text: True RTS gameplay reinforced with roguelite build crafting. Control units with bullet-time precision. Call down bases and raise armies. Drafted from a different arsenal every run. Weave builds that break the game. Or the game breaks you.

games.name: FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE
games.text: Cloud Strife, an ex-SOLDIER operative, descends on the mako-powered city of Midgar. The world of the timeless classic FINAL FANTASY VII is reborn, using cutting-edge graphics technology, a new battle system and an additional adventure featuring Yuffie Kisaragi.

games.name: Lost in Random™
games.text: Play the odds in ———™, a gothic-fairy-tale-inspired action-adventure where every citizen’s fate is determined by a roll of the dice.

games.name: WRC 10 FIA World Rally Championship
games.text: Hailed by reviewers and professional drivers, the standard-setting off-road racing simulation has been reinvented! Reach the 2021 season podium, and to celebrate the 50th anniversary of the competition, relive the highlights at the wheel of legendary cars.

games.name: SnowRunner
games.text: Get ready for the next-generation off-road experience! Drive powerful vehicles and overcome extreme open environments to complete dozens of challenging missions solo or with up to 3 friends!

games.name: The Crust
games.text: Automate a lunar base as you become the savior of humanity exploring the future on the moon. Mine, craft, research, and trade resources with Earth in this gripping narrative basebuilder.

games.name: Kathy Rain 2: Soothsayer
games.text: In this point-and-click urban thriller, down-and-out private eye Kathy Rain will embark on her most dangerous case yet — the pursuit of the notorious serial killer known as the Soothsayer. Find clues, gather evidence, connect the dots, and confront the murderer before the hunter becomes the hunted…

games.name: Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition
games.text: Celebrating its first year of delighting millions of global players, the award-winning and best-selling strategy franchise continues with ———, putting you at the center of even more epic historical battles that shaped the world.

games.name: Ultimate Epic Battle Simulator 2
games.text: Welcome to ———, the most ridiculous and insane battle simulator in existence! Create eye watering battles with hundreds of thousands, even millions of characters on screen! Jump into multiple campaigns in game or player made, or play in sandbox mode and FPS invasion

games.name: 鬼谷八荒 Tale of Immortal
games.text: Tale of Immortal is an open-world sandbox based on Chinese mythology and cultivation. You will grow to become immortal, conquer the beasts from the Classic of Mountains and Season, make your choices carefully and grasp your own destiny.

games.name: SYNTHETIK 2
games.text: ——— is a unrelenting tactical-shooter rogue-lite. Play alone or with friends. Loot powerful tech. Experience the next level in gun-play. Upgrade your androids to rival the machine gods!

games.name: Reality Break
games.text: Rewrite the universe! Break reality to change your fate, and use your powers to stop sinister forces from altering existence itself. Discover the origin of your new abilities in a fast-paced ARPG Loot Collection Roguelite where you will bend, break, and change the laws of the universe!

games.name: (the) Gnorp Apologue
games.text: (——— is the journey of the gnorps as you guide them towards their goal of delightfully excessive wealth accumulation.

games.name: Horse Tales: Emerald Valley Ranch
games.text: Set off on a captivating horseback adventure and discover the mysteries of Emerald Valley!

games.name: 3 Minute Heroes
games.text: ——— is a real-time strategy game that combines tower defense, deck building, and rogue-like genres. Place your champions, use cards, and keep your home safe for 3 minutes!

games.name: Ghostwire: Tokyo
games.text: Tokyo's population has vanished, and deadly supernatural forces prowl the streets. Use an arsenal of elemental abilities to unravel the truth behind the disappearance and save Tokyo.

games.name: Rugby 22
games.text: Crouch, bind, set! Discover the true rugby experience. Play with best clubs and top nations, enjoy dynamic gameplay that stays faithful to the sport, and experience the intensity of big matches.

games.name: Northwind
games.text: A fusion of deckbuilding, monster-hunting, and roguelite progression all its own. Hunt strange beasts, win tug-of-war duels, craft a unique deck, and evolve your strategy at ———!

games.name: IdleOn - The Incremental MMO
games.text: The incremental idle MMO where your heroes keep fighting while you're gone! Spend their loot on upgrades, unlock classes from Elemental-Wizard to Cannon-Pirate, and level 20 unique skills like Farming, Sailing, and Construction!

games.name: Depersonalization
games.text: "May all stories find their best endings." "———" is an anthology-style game featuring standalone chapters and diverse story genres. We continuously collect and create a wide variety of stories, ultimately housing them in a library that transcends the flow of time.

games.name: EZ2ON REBOOT : R
games.text: ——— – The latest entry in the beloved rhythm-action franchise is now released on Steam! Revisit the huge collection of classics with remastered audiovisual. Catch up with the freshest new songs and experiences.

games.name: Fights in Tight Spaces (Prologue)
games.text: Play the first mission of Fights in Tight Spaces for free! A stylish blend of deck-building, turn-based tactics, and thrilling fight sequences in action-movie settings. Learn to balance your hand, momentum, and positioning to overcome the odds to defeat your adversaries. Full game OUT NOW.

games.name: Turbo Sliders Unlimited
games.text: Driving game with Unlimited possibilities. Spiritual successor to classic top-down racing games, but in 3D with modern online features, countless game modes and extensive moddability. For casual fun, serious competition, or to unleash your creativity with the editors.

games.name: Big Walk
games.text: Hang out and get lost with close friends in a big world. A cooperative online walker-talker from the creators of Untitled Goose Game.

games.name: ZEPHON
games.text: From the developers of Warhammer 40,000: Gladius, ——— is a post-apocalyptic 4X strategy game built on Proxy’s unique tactical combat system. Guide survivors through a turbulent future, navigating unexpected disasters, eldritch horror and cyberpunk monstrosities. What will you do to survive?

games.name: Dragon Fist: VR Kung Fu
games.text: First-Person VR kung fu fighter with high-fidelity, physics-based combat, and an artistic style that pays homage to the golden era of martial arts films. Play with friends in Co-Op mode, challenge others in PvP battles, or embark on epic single-player adventures.

games.name: Maniac
games.text: Ever just tired of it all? Ready for change? Wanna bet it all on sheer mayhem and destruction? In comes ———, a rogue-lite crime action game in which the world goes against you, and your insanity creates chaos!

games.name: Speed Stars
games.text: Simple but challenging rhythm-based running game. Compete to achieve the highest rank, unlock more characters, set personal bests, and climb the leaderboards.

games.name: Dead Estate
games.text: Cornered with nowhere else to turn, can you escape the monster-filled mansion? ——— is a gory, fast-paced, challenging roguelike shooter with a heavy emphasis on horror.

games.name: BoomBox
games.text: ——— is a VR rhythm game blending music, fitness, and community. Download community maps directly in-game, enjoy full-body workouts with unique note placements, and pet an adorable virtual cat. Customize with skins and unlock achievements in vibrant, colorful environments!

games.name: Tempest Rising
games.text: Command distinct factions in a desperate struggle for power and resources in ——— - a classic RTS set on Earth after a nuclear war.

games.name: Super Mega Baseball™ 4
games.text: ——— is where the Legends play. The signature combo of arcade-inspired style and immersive gameplay returns with over 200 baseball Legends and a grand slam of presentation upgrades.

games.name: Broken Universe - Tower Defense
games.text: Get ready to rethink all your defense strategies! Build barricades to stop monsters, or lure them into a maze and attack. A variety of stages that change each time depending on how you play them.

games.name: Nuumonsters
games.text: Welcome to the wonderful *New* world of ———! A short, retro-style Creature Collector RPG — play as Yana or Yasaka and battle your way through the Hana region, with 70+ creatures to catch and train!

games.name: Symphony of War: The Nephilim Saga
games.text: Enter Tahnra, a land savaged by war. You, a fresh academy graduate with humble beginnings, will grow to lead a grand army against a corrupt adversary. Gather heroes, form bonds, and lead your force in turn-based battles. Make use of tactics, terrain, morale and more to bring peace to the land!

games.name: Football Simulator
games.text: Step onto the gridiron with ——— and experience the most dynamic and physics-driven football game ever made. Break through tackles, juggle tipped passes, and dive for interceptions to lead your team to victory. Features a fully moddable environment.

games.name: sunny-place
games.text: A game about cute girls and speedy cars! Race THE TRACKS OF THE ABYSS, socialize with online strangers (or friends), furnish your apartment and explore the new much improved hell city.

games.name: Marble World
games.text: ——— is a physics sandbox simulator with marbles. Create your own marble races, runs and machines. Customize a variety of tracks, decorations and marbles to create a beautiful world.

games.name: Eternal Strands
games.text: A next-generation action experience where the elements obey you, the terrain bends to your will, and every victory is entirely your own.

games.name: Venba
games.text: ——— is a short narrative cooking game, where you play as an Indian mom who immigrates to Canada with her family in the 1980s. Cook various dishes and restore lost recipes, hold branching conversations, and explore South Indian food in this story about family, love, and loss.

games.name: Silica
games.text: ——— blends FPS and RTS in epic, photorealistic battles. Choose to fight on the ground or command from above as humans or aliens. Dive into thrilling multiplayer combat or master strategic command. Are you ready to survive and conquer?

games.name: Rogue Voltage
games.text: The engineering roguelike. Construct your combos by wiring circuits. Build crazy machines to zap the monsters and trigger satisfying chain reactions. Discover devastating synergies and create overpowered builds.

games.name: Mortal Sin
games.text: ——— is a chaotic, blood-soaked roguelike where skill is power, and overconfidence is death. Carve through procedurally generated nightmares with brutal melee and flashy, satisfying combos.

games.name: Scoot
games.text: ——— is an open world scooter riding game. Enter this physics based game and perform over 40 different tricks, customise your scooter and rider, build your dream park, film clips, or play online with friends!

games.name: Dragon Creek
games.text: Ever wanted your own dragon? ——— is a dragon raising game where every dragon is procedurally generated. Enter a code at the shrine and see your dragon come to life. Care for your dragon as you train it for battle and compete in tournaments!

games.name: Gotham Knights
games.text: Batman is dead. It is now up to the Batman Family - Batgirl, Nightwing, Red Hood, and Robin - to protect Gotham City.

games.name: COCOON
games.text: From Jeppe Carlsen, the lead gameplay designer of LIMBO and INSIDE — ——— takes you on an adventure across worlds within worlds. Master world-leaping mechanics and solve intricate puzzles to unravel a cosmic mystery.

games.name: Wheel World
games.text: Dive into ——— as Kat, a rider chosen by ancient cycling spirits. Race elite teams, trick out your bike, and perform the long overdue Great Shift ritual to save a universe on the brink! Your bike is your destiny.

games.name: The Ranchers
games.text: ——— is an open world country-life sim for 1-4 players. Raise animals, grow tasty crops, craft helpful tools and build your dream house. Explore the open world and earn the villagers' respect and esteem.

games.name: Lords of the Fallen
games.text: A vast world awaits in the medieval, dark fantasy action-RPG, ———. As a fabled Dark Crusader, embark on an epic quest to overthrow Adyr, the demon God. The final major update Version 2.5 is out now: features deadlier boss battles and all-new Veteran Mode.

games.name: SuperSpec Rallycross
games.text: Top-down arcade rallycross with big jumps, joker-lap strategy, time trials, and 4-player local split-screen.

games.name: Minit Fun Racer
games.text: Buckle up: ——— is a peculiar little racing game with 100% of developer and Devolver's profits going directly to charity. Forever.

games.name: The Ramp
games.text: A digital toy for skateboard loving people. Pure flow, no extra fluff.

games.name: Cards & Tankards
games.text: Grab a drink, invite your friends and ready your deck! ——— is the first social collectible card game available for both PC and VR.

games.name: Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator
games.text: Buy, sell, and trade organs in a strange and evolving universe. Dive into the quivering innards of alien capitalism in the sci-fi body horror market tycoon game you didn't know you needed.

games.name: Kemono Mahjong
games.text: Riichi Mahjong - A fun, strategic variant of the classic multiplayer game!

games.name: Settlement Survival
games.text: In this city-building game, you will lead a group of survivors in their search for a new home. Manipulate the landscape, manage limited supplies, plant crops, hunt wildlife, gather resources, and develop trade routes to build a bustling and unique town.

games.name: PICO PARK

games.text: Boot up your Z5 Powerlance and dial into ———, the last game from Zachtronics! The Barkeep’s loaded up his retro computer with a full set of puzzle games for you to download and play. No need to worry about copy protection, they’re all fully cracked and ready to enjoy!

games.name: Punch A Bunch

games.name: All-In-One Sports VR
games.text: 13 Sports in 1 Game ! What type of sports acitivities will be safer during the pandemic era? ——— offers the most safe way to keep you healthy for both physically and mentally with zero contact.

games.name: Neodash
games.text: Drift at full speed across gaps, traps, and neon-drenched environments that react to a captivating soundtrack. Build and play community-made tracks, or dive straight into a spectacular campaign.

games.name: The Past Within
games.text: ——— is the new co-op experience from Rusty Lake! Play together with someone you deem trustworthy: one in The Past, the other in The Future. Observe and communicate what you see around you. Solve the puzzles and uncover Albert Vanderboom’s plan.

games.name: Super Sports Blast
games.text: Volley, Tennis or Soccer - choose your favorite sport, take to the field and prepare to have a blast!!

games.name: Battlefield™ 2042
games.text: ——— is a first-person shooter that marks the return to the iconic all-out warfare of the franchise.

games.name: The Doors of Trithius
games.text: ——— is an open-world RPG roguelike. Engage in tactical turn-based combat in a living world of warring factions, wandering behemoths, and ancient magic. Level your skills, cook, craft, and explore dungeons. Will you follow the story, or let adventure be your guide?

games.name: Mon Bazou
games.text: Build your crappy vehicle into a race car, install the parts yourself. Make money by cutting wood, racing at night or delivering pizza. Maybe you want to manage a sugar shack or build yourself a big garage?

games.name: Casual Pro Wrestling
games.text: ——— is a professional wrestling game with an emphasis on fun. Wrestle your dream match and enjoy the ragdoll physics for additional drama and whiplash. Play couch or online multiplayer with your friends and get creative with a plethora of possibilities for wrestler creation.

games.name: Perfect Heist 2
games.text: ——— is a round-based online game, where robbers try to hide in plain sight while robbing a bank without being noticed by the cop team!

games.name: Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed
games.text: Embark on a magical journey in ———! Shape your adventure with the stroke of a brush and transform Wasteland as Mickey Mouse in this beautifully recreated 3D platformer.

games.name: Orcs Must Die! 3
games.text: Slice, burn, toss, zap, grind and gib massive hordes of repugnant orcs in this long-awaited successor to the award-winning Orcs Must Die! series.

games.name: Supraland Six Inches Under
games.text: A mix between Portal, Zelda and Metroid. Exploration, puzzles, combat! A first-person-metroidvania taking place six inches under Supraland.

games.name: Wartales
games.text: ——— is an open world RPG in which you lead a group of mercenaries in their search for wealth across a massive medieval universe. Explore the world, recruit companions, collect bounties and unravel the secrets of the tombs of the ancients!

games.name: Distant Worlds 2
games.text: ——— is a vast, pausable real-time 4X space strategy game.

games.name: Mars First Logistics
games.text: Build physically simulated rovers to transport awkwardly shaped cargo across the rugged terrain of Mars. Earn funds, unlock new parts, and use your ingenuity to help the Martians establish a new home. Playable solo or in online co-op!

games.name: Gorilla Tag
games.text: Run, jump, and climb using only your hands. Play tag or infection with people online. Run away from the infected players, or outmaneuver the survivors to catch them. Embrace your inner ape.

games.name: Neon White
games.text: ——— is a single-player speedrunning FPS where you can sacrifice your guns for godlike parkour moves.

games.name: Super Woden GP
games.text: Feel the excitement of the 90s with the isometric perspective, its huge number of vehicles and its brilliant soundtrack. More than 70 cars from six manufacturers from different countries to buy, an extensive campaign mode, dozens of circuits, rally stages, championships, and much more awaits you!

games.name: Terminus: Zombie Survivors
games.text: ——— is a 2D turn-based survival roguelike set during a zombie apocalypse. Each journey is unique, and every decision can mean the difference between life and death. Can you brave hunger, cold, and the undead in order to reach the ——— and find salvation?

games.name: Eggcelerate!
games.text: ———! is a silly yet very challenging time-trial racing game where you try over and over again to improve your time without dropping an egg.

games.name: Galactic Glitch
games.text: A physics-powered action roguelike. Grab asteroids, catch missiles, and hurl them back at swarming enemies. Build wild loadouts, defeat colossal bosses, and push deeper into a collapsing galaxy.

games.name: Disney Speedstorm
games.text: Welcome to ———! Drift into the ultimate hero-based combat racing game, set on high-speed circuits inspired by Disney and Pixar worlds. Master each character’s unique skills and claim victory in this thrilling arcade racing experience from the creators of the Asphalt series!

games.name: SRX: The Game
games.text: Do you have what it takes to compete with the best of the best in the Superstar Racing Experience? ——— is your chance to prove it.

games.name: Squiggle Football
games.text: ——— is a deck-building football management roguelike, where you create a team and form powerful combinations of players, coaches, tactics and culture. Recruit, trade & innovate through nail-biting matches to reach & conquer the National League. Inspired by Australian Rules Football.

games.name: Shadow Gambit: The Cursed Crew
games.text: Assemble your crew and set sail on an infamous ghost ship to sneak, stab, and spellcast your way through the Inquisition in this non-linear stealth strategy game. Chart a course, develop uncanny abilities, and use unconventional tactics to find a powerful pirate artifact!

games.name: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas – The Definitive Edition
games.text: ———: San Andreas: It’s the early ’90s. After a couple of cops frame him for homicide, Carl ‘CJ’ Johnson is forced on a journey that takes him across the entire state of San Andreas, to save his family and to take control of the streets.

games.name: Virtual Hunter
games.text: ——— brings realistic hunting to virtual reality. Pack your gear and put your hunting skills and tactics to the test in the open wilderness.

games.name: 9th Dawn Remake
games.text: Rediscover the magic of the 9th Dawn series with this complete re-imagining of the original game. Venture into a massive 2.5D open world. Explore 45 new dungeons in single-player or online/local co-op, craft weapons, raise pets, play a deck-building card game, and take down the Castle of Maltyr!

games.name: Forza Horizon 5
games.text: Explore the vibrant open world landscapes of Mexico with limitless, fun driving action in the world’s greatest cars.

games.name: Deepest Chamber: Resurrection
games.text: Delve into the depths of ———, where card boosting is your key to survival. Employ this unique mechanic to augment your abilities, strategize your next moves and endure a series of increasingly perilous descents in this gripping rogue-lite, card-battling adventure!

games.name: The Jackbox Party Pack 8
games.text: Plan your next game night! Jackbox Games is back with 5 hilarious new party games including Drawful Animate, Job Job, The Poll Mine, Weapons Drawn, and The Wheel of Enormous Proportions.

games.name: Castle Constructor
games.text: Build and defend using a modular system of castle blocks. Fend off enemies who will climb over and break through your defenses. Collect new blocks and research techs to improve their strengths. From lowly soldiers to powerful siege weapons; defeat them all as you strive to protect your kingdom.

games.name: DriveCrazy
games.text: This is the power of the kei truck!

games.name: Isonzo
games.text: Ferocious Alpine warfare will test your tactical skills in this authentic WW1 FPS. Battle among the scenic peaks, rugged valleys and idyllic towns of northern Italy. The Great War on the Italian Front is brought to life and elevated to unexpected heights!

games.name: RoboDunk
games.text: DUNK FROM SPACE in the 1st basketball roguelite! Smash and blast in the replayable single player and coop campaign: buy robots, upgrade their stats and unlock tons of new skills. Choose your path among different opponents, traps and rewards.. Up to 4 players versus where every match is different!

games.name: ROUNDS
games.text: ——— is a 1v1 rogue-lite shooter where each round gets more intense. The losing player of each round unlocks clever upgrades to create a better build to counter their opponent.

games.name: Gear.Club Unlimited 2 - Ultimate Edition
games.text: With the pedal to the metal, race along more than 3,000 kilometers of tracks that await you! On the mountainside, through a nature park, in the middle of the desert or along the coast, defend your position in more than 250 races, with championships, exhibition races and Grand Prix.

games.name: The Ranch of Rivershine
games.text: Saddle up and build your own horse ranch! Raise foals, care for your horses and train them as you explore the countryside. Participate in cross country competitions and become your town's champion! Befriend the villagers who'll help you on your adventure at ———!
