games.name: Rising Front
games.text: A FPS WW1 & Revolutionary War battle simulator with a focus on Workshop Content, rag-doll physics, intelligent AI, massive battles, procedural AI cover system, real-time building system and FPS combat!

games.name: DREDGE
games.text: ——— is a single-player fishing adventure with a sinister undercurrent. Sell your catch, upgrade your boat, and ——— the depths for long-buried secrets. Explore a mysterious archipelago and discover why some things are best left forgotten.

games.name: Tape to Tape
games.text: ——— is a roguelite hockey game where every choice matters on your journey to build the best hockey team. Choose your path, hire unique players, discover synergies between them, pick unique abilities, bribe the referees or visit the Blademaster on your way to restore hockey's former glory.

games.name: Goose Goose Duck
games.text: ——— is a game of social deduction for up to 16 players. Players are separated into different groups that are each assigned a different objective. Complete your team’s objective to win!

games.name: Vivid Knight
games.text: "———" is a "party-building roguelike" game in which you collect friends who have been turned into jewels and fight by combining their abilities! Explore the ever-changing dungeon and harness the gems you have gathered to challenge the labyrinth!

games.name: Blue Prince
games.text: Welcome to Mt. Holly, where every dawn unveils a new mystery. Navigate through shifting corridors and ever-changing chambers in this genre-defying strategy puzzle adventure. But will your unpredictable path lead you to the rumored Room 46?

games.name: Hero Realms
games.text: From the makers of the award-winning Star Realms Deckbuilding Game ®, ——— combines the fun of deckbuilding games with the interactivity of trading card game-style combat.

games.name: Street Legal 1: REVision
games.text: Raw, unfiltered street racing, where high speeds are deadly, and every dent matters! REVision Edition of this 2002 bargain-bin classic brings countless bug fixes, optimizations, quality-of-life improvements, and optional gameplay extensions!

games.name: Infinity Kingdom
games.text: Conquer the city, discover the Infinity! ——— is a cartoon-style mmo strategy game. As a resourceful lord, you must defend the land of Norheim against the evil gnomes while protecting yourself from other invading players!

games.name: My Friendly Neighborhood
games.text: Something scary is happening with everyone's favorite Saturday morning puppet show, The Friendly Neighborhood! Play as Gordon, a repairman sent to get to the bottom of this disturbing dilemma. Fend off puppets and solve puzzles in this survival horror adventure.

games.name: Strange Horticulture
games.text: ——— is an occult puzzle game in which you play as the proprietor of a local plant store. Find and identify new plants, pet your cat, speak to a coven, or join a cult. Use your collection of powerful plants to influence the story and unravel Undermere’s dark mysteries.

games.name: Until Then
games.text: A fateful meeting sets off a chain reaction, upending Mark's life. People disappear and memories prove unreliable. Uncover a hidden truth with Mark and his friends in this narrative adventure and race to unravel the mystery before it's too late.

games.name: Wander Stars
games.text: Unleash custom attacks by combining words in this Super! Anime! Turn-Based! RPG! Collect all 200 words, earn Pep Ups from honorable victories and become a Kiai master. Befriend your rivals, uncover dark mysteries, and seek out the pieces of the Wanderstar map in a wild race across the universe.

games.name: Twisted Tower
games.text: Blast your way through an abandoned 1950s theme park crawling with fairy-tale mascots, twisted puzzles, and deadly traps. Uncover the dark secrets of your past as you race to the top to win back the love of your life.

games.name: Armageddon Empires
games.text: ——— is a computer turn based strategy game that takes the best elements of collectable card games, board games, and computer games and brings them all together to provide a unique interactive strategy war game experience.

games.name: Mister Furry: Hot Muscles
games.text: ♂ Unique Furry Horror with Muscular Mister Furries, Deep Plot, Great Sound Effects and Creepy Atmosphere of Furry Dungeon. Hot Milk, Dungeon Items, Gym, Gay-Bar, Pool, Locker Room, Atmospheric Music and much more! Will you be able to escape punishment from ———? ♂

games.name: My Garage
games.text: ——— is a car simulation game with main focus being simulating real car repair, maintenance and physics.

games.name: Citizen Sleeper
games.text: Roleplaying in the ruins of interplanetary capitalism. Live the life of an escaped worker, washed-up on a lawless station at the edge of an interstellar society. Inspired by the flexibility and freedom of TTRPGs, explore the station, choose your friends, escape your past and change your future.

games.name: Shadow Tactics: Aiko's Choice
games.text: Aiko's Choice is the anticipated standalone expansion to the acclaimed stealth strategy game ———. Set in Edo Japan, you take control of the skillful kunoichi adept Aiko and her deadly assassin friends to hunt down the ghosts of her past.

games.name: The Light Brigade: Definitive Edition
games.text: An award-winning roguelike VR shooter with realistic gunplay & immersive light magic. Ascend the ranks of ——— to unlock new weapons, upgrades, classes, and abilities as you fight to restore light to the darkness.

games.name: Erannorth Chronicles
games.text: ——— blends old-school card strategy with deep RPG progression in a vast sandbox world. With no fixed story, revel in unmatched freedom and limitless character customization.

games.name: The Legend of Bear-Truck Trucker
games.text: The physics bear driving stacking hauling trading game

games.name: Caravan SandWitch
games.text: Embark on a journey across vast landscapes in ———, a captivating narrative-driven exploration adventure.

games.name: High On Life
games.text: HIGH ON KNIFE DLC OUT NOW!! - Humanity is being threatened by an alien cartel who wants to use them as drugs. It’s up to you to rescue and partner with charismatic, talking guns, take down Garmantuous and his gang, and save the world!

games.name: Pro Soccer Online
games.text: ——— is a 1st/3rd person, highly skill based, online multiplayer soccer game. It offers a sports game experience unlike any other with smooth, physics based, input driven gameplay that is competitive and rewarding with no pay to win mechanics.

games.name: Under The Island
games.text: Embark on an epic adventure in ———! A 2D action-adventure steeped in ‘90s charm, step into the shoes of Nia, and battle fierce monsters, solve clever puzzles, and explore a world alive with mystery as you race to save your new home before it’s too late.

games.name: Touhou Mystia's Izakaya
games.text: A brand new pixel art restaurant simulator based on the Touhou Project! Play as Mystia, the owner of a small izakaya. Collect ingredients by day, cater to the customers by night, learn recipes from familiar characters, and become the best izakaya owner in all of Gensokyo!

games.name: Melatonin
games.text: ——— is a rhythm game about dreams and reality merging together. It uses animations and sound cues to keep you on beat without any intimidating overlays or interfaces. Harmonize through a variety of dreamy levels containing surprising challenges, hand-drawn art, and vibrant music.

games.name: Roll
games.text: ——— Dice. Get Dopamine. ——— is a highly replayable, deeply strategic, and ultra satisfying dicebuilding game!

games.name: NEOGEO POCKET COLOR SELECTION Vol. 1 Steam Edition
games.text: Retro game fans rejoice! ——— is SNK's legendary handheld console dream collection, containing 10 handheld defining classics, is coming to Steam!

games.name: Blood West
games.text: Weird west legends meet eldritch horror in ———, an immersive stealth FPS. Become the Undead Gunslinger, doomed to roam the barren lands until he manages to purge their curse, freeing his soul. 3 varied scenarios, perk-based character progression, and 20+ hours of gameplay await you!

games.name: Let's Ride! Silver Buckle Stables
games.text: ——— challenges you to become the best horse rider you can be. Aim for the blue ribbon in barrel racing and agility, while taking care of prize horses in your very own stables.

games.name: Demonlore
games.text: A rogue-lite action strategy game with deck building. Fight the undead legion, forge your path, and gain powerful permanent progression. Godlike difficulty modes, mutators, heroic units, elite enemies, and unlockable rewards - endless replayability awaits!

games.name: Cairn
games.text: Reach a summit never climbed before in this survival-climber from the creators of Furi and Haven. Climb anywhere and plan your route carefully, managing pitons and resources to survive unforgiving Mount Kami. Discover what Aava is willing to sacrifice to achieve the ascent of a lifetime.

games.name: Tyrion Cuthbert: Attorney of the Arcane
games.text: In ———, you play as a defense attorney who practices law in a world of fantasy and wizards. You must defend clients accused of various crimes committed using magic and use the rules of magic to prove them innocent.

games.name: JARS
games.text: ——— is a strategy game featuring puzzles and elements of tower defense. Join Victor in his spooky yet endearing world and prepare for a quest to uncover the secrets of his family’s basement. Will you save the world or get grounded by mother?

games.name: Drift Phonk 666
games.text: You have to collect all the PHONK mixtapes straight from hell so people hear how good 𝖒𝖚𝖘𝖎𝖈 sounds.

games.name: BONELAB
games.text: ——— is an experimental physics action game. Explore a mysterious lab filled with weapons, enemies, challenges and secrets. Escape your reality, or wreak havoc. No wrong answers.

games.name: Selaco
games.text: ——— is a brand new original shooter inspired by classics, featuring thrilling action set pieces, destructibility, smart enemies and a fleshed out story taking place within an immersive game world.

games.name: Kitten Burst
games.text: ——— is an Adventure/Racing Game about a Flying Cat set in the year 200X. Explore Sites on the Web, Race through Circuits, & Battle Bullet Hell Bosses to Save Cyberspace.

games.name: Terra Nil
games.text: ——— is an intricate environmental strategy game about transforming a barren wasteland into a thriving, balanced ecosystem. Bring life back to a lifeless world by purifying soil, cleaning oceans, planting trees, and reintroducing wildlife, then leave without a trace.

games.name: God of War
games.text: His vengeance against the Gods of Olympus years behind him, Kratos now lives as a man in the realm of Norse Gods and monsters. It is in this harsh, unforgiving world that he must fight to survive… and teach his son to do the same.

games.name: Wreckreation
games.text: ——— is an evolving open-world driving playground built around choice. Play solo, explore on- and off road, create your own races and challenges, hang out online with friends using full cross-play. With fast updates shaped by players, this world keeps evolving.

games.name: Victory Heat Rally
games.text: Welcome to VHR! Unlock the secrets of speed in this turbocharged neo super scaler arcade racing experience. Dominate the track & drift your way to the finish line on the road to becoming the VHRC champion.

games.name: Captain of Industry
games.text: Build an industrial empire on a remote island. Mine resources, reshape terrain with excavators, grow food, construct factories, lay train tracks, and trade with the outside world. Research 100+ technologies to advance from basic metal smelting all the way to nuclear power and space flight.

games.name: Little Witch in the Woods
games.text: ——— tells the story of Ellie, an apprentice witch. Explore the mystical forest, help the charming residents, and experience the daily life of the witch.

games.name: Killer Bean
games.text: You are ———, a rogue assassin coffee bean, who takes out the trash in this world, one bullet at a time. This is a first person / third person action roguelike.

games.name: Lost Ark
games.text: Embark on an odyssey for the ——— in a vast, vibrant world: explore new lands, seek out lost treasures, and test yourself in thrilling action combat in this action-packed free-to-play RPG.

games.name: PlateUp!
games.text: Cook and serve your dishes, design and decorate your restaurants, and expand your culinary kingdom with new unlocks, abilities and dishes in procedurally-generated locations. Classic cooking action with permanent roguelite progression. Hire your friends - or do it all yourself!

games.name: Sackboy™: A Big Adventure
games.text: PERFECTLY CRAFTED FOR PC. PlayStation® icon ——— bursts into action on PC in a huge 3D multiplayer platforming adventure. An epic journey stuffed with platforming challenges. Deeply immersive controls. Collaborative, chaotic and joyful multiplayer fun.

games.name: Demon's Mirror
games.text: Step into the ——— and enter a fantastical, nightmarish world in this roguelike deckbuilder! Strategy meets the arcane in a unique fusion of deck-building and chain-3 mechanics. Can you face your demons and come out unscathed?

games.name: The Alters
games.text: Experience an award-winning, story-driven sci-fi survival game. Help Jan Dolski, the survivor of an ill-fated space expedition, create alternative versions of himself to escape a hostile planet and tackle personal turmoil with his unconventional crew.

games.name: Hotel Architect
games.text: Step into the shoes of a hotel owner as you design, build, and manage grand hotels around the world. Juggle demanding guests, frantic logistics, and plenty of unexpected surprises in ———; the ultimate hotel construction and tycoon management game!

games.name: Doomsday Paradise
games.text: Can you get a date before the end of the world? ——— is a goofy, multiplayer dating sim about finding love before the apocalypse. With over 130 different endings and 12 different singles to woo- no two games will ever be the same.

games.name: V Rising
games.text: Awaken as a Vampire. Hunt for blood in nearby settlements to regain your strength and evade the scorching sun to survive. Raise your castle and thrive in an ever-changing, open world full of mystery. Gain allies online and conquer the land of the living.

games.name: Sumotori Dreams Classic
games.text: Heavy headed blocky guys sumo wrestle and tumble around.

games.name: Heck Deck
games.text: ——— is a bullet hell card game where all the bullets are cards and time only progresses as you move. Explore 5 stages full of unique enemies and bosses, discover dozens of cards, and visit shops to buy and sell cards for health!

games.name: Conquest of Elysium 5
games.text: ——— is a quick turn based fantasy strategy game with a touch of rogue-like. The game is full of depth, details and monsters. There are also a huge number of factions, each with its own unique gameplay and magic rituals.

games.name: MY HERO ULTRA RUMBLE
games.text: Pick your favorite character, team up and fight to be the last ones standing in the new 24-player Battle Royale free to play game "———"!

games.name: Bread & Fred
games.text: Grab your best bud for help in this new co-op challenge to help two adorable penguins, Bread and Fred, reach the top of the snowy summit. Time your jumps, cling to walls and swing across gaps to see how far you can make it before you tumble all the way back down the mountain.

games.name: CRISIS CORE –FINAL FANTASY VII– REUNION
games.text: ——— is a remaster of ——— featuring updated graphics, combat systems and soundtrack. Follow the tale of SOLDIER operative Zack Fair, as he discovers the secrets of Shinra's dark experiments.

games.name: Planet of Lana
games.text: In a world torn between nature’s grace and cold machine invasion, one girl and her companion must rely on their bond to survive and protect what they hold dear. Their story of hope, loss, and love will stay with you long after the journey ends.

games.name: Warstride Challenges
games.text: Blast hordes of demons at lightning speed in bloody gunfights, and race against the clock to overcome everything that comes your way! Die and retry to get the highest score in increasingly intense trials. Create and share your own runs, enjoying hundreds of levels created by the community.

games.name: OTXO
games.text: Enter an inexplicable, abstract mansion to rescue a loved one in this fast-paced, brutal, and dark roguelite filled with precise but savage gunplay and time-bending slow motion. Face your inner demons and unveil the secrets of the Mansion.

games.name: Scarlet Hollow
games.text: Your aunt’s dead, your cousin hates you, and you’re stuck in the dead-end town of ———. Choose your path through a branching narrative so dense that you'll see less than 1/5 of the game on a single playthrough. You won't be able to save everyone. Good luck, and welcome home.

games.name: Aliens vs. Ghosts
games.text: Use Nukes, Electricity, Heat Rays and powerful Minions in this wave-based first person shooter providing endless hours of Ghost-slaying entertainment, solo or Co-Op. Only Ghosts stand in the way of your invasion of Earth.

games.name: Minds Beneath Us
games.text: ——— is an emotional sci-fi narrative game. Through the eyes of a humble individual, experience a mad world where humans are exploited as computing devices for AI. Listen to the concerns of those you meet and offer guidance. Together, face challenges and confront an uncertain destiny.

games.name: Monster Energy Supercross - The Official Videogame 5
games.text: Hold on fast to the handlebar of your bike because a new chapter of the series has finally arrived. Try ——— and discover the quintessence of indoor supercross!

games.name: MXGP 2021 - The Official Motocross Videogame
games.text: All the power of Motocross in your hands: the new ——— is finally here! The official MXGP videogame is ready to show you what it's made of: warm up your engines and get ready for the most realistic, exciting two-wheeled experience ever!

games.name: WARNO
games.text: Realistic, immersive, breathtaking. ——— is the ultimate World War III battle simulator from the masters of strategy, Eugen Systems. A Cold War turns decisively hot as you command hundreds of units on a beautiful and brutal battlefield. Outsmart, outfight, and lead your forces to total victory.

games.name: Astro Colony
games.text: Explore endless Universe and create the most efficient constellation of colonies. Build conveyor systems to automate production. Take care of Astronauts and their needs! Establish new colonies as part of intergalactic simulation.

games.name: The Bazaar
games.text: ——— is a fast-paced multiplayer Roguelike where every run is a new puzzle. Choose from unique heroes, uncover powerful combos, and outwit your opponents in a dynamic, ever-changing marketplace. Play at your own pace while discovering endless ways to win.

games.name: Spellmasons
games.text: ——— is a magical, tactical roguelike where you customize your spells. Play solo or team up with your friends in online multiplayer, and explore a deep magic system where clever combinations yield powerfully satisfying results!

games.name: SWAT Commander
games.text: Take charge of a SWAT unit as an elite operator. Command a specialized AI squad or team up in co-op to seize suspects, rescue civilians, and restore order. Study the briefing, kit out your team, and execute your plan with disciplined precision.

games.name: Cross Blitz
games.text: ——— is a unique RPG deckbuilder featuring fast-paced tactical combat with loads of cards to collect and synergies to wield. Explore, level up, craft new cards and build the perfect decks as you carve your own path to victory!

games.name: Death Roads: Tournament
games.text: Combine deadly racing, deckbuilding, and roguelite style to get car battles unlike anything before! Choose a driver, car, weapons, and sponsors to overcome tactical encounters. Adapt to an ever-changing race to come out on top and earn entry into the last safe haven on the Divided States of America.

games.name: Slopecrashers
games.text: ——— is an arcade snowboard racer starring a wild crew of animals on a globe-trotting quest to become champions - but someone’s out to ruin their plans! Race solo or with friends, pull off stylish tricks, and use wild power-ups to take down rivals in chaotic, fast-paced action.

games.name: Wrestling Empire
games.text: The lightweight champion of wrestling comes full circle with higher resolution visuals and a smoother frame rate - whilst still retaining the retro style that puts the fun first! Now featuring whole other booking & roaming modes at no extra cost for the biggest Triple Threat in wrestling.

games.name: Pixel Cup Soccer - Ultimate Edition
games.text: ——— is a retro-style arcade game. Play friendly matches, tournaments or create your team and lead it to glory in career mode! You can play it alone or with up to 8 friends, locally or through Steam remote, you can choose whether to play competitively, cooperatively, or even both!

games.name: Hell is Us
games.text: If war is the closest we get to hell on earth, it's because Earth harbours the worst of demons: humankind. In an isolated country ravaged by infighting, discover the secrets of your past and deal with the repercussions of a mysterious calamity.

games.name: DeadPoly
games.text: ——— is a polygon arcade zombie survival looter shooter with base building, crafting, scavenging, leveling, questing, and more, but your only goal is survival, everything else is optional.

games.name: Black One Blood Brothers
games.text: ——— is a tactical military shooter game where strategy and coordination are key. Command a squad of top operators, with unique skills, through high-risk missions around the globe. Customize your crew, plan your missions, and adjust on the fly for a vast replayability.

games.name: Core Keeper
games.text: Explore a vast cavern of creatures, relics and resources in a mining sandbox adventure for 1-8 players. Mine, build, fight, craft and farm to unravel the mystery of the ancient Core.

games.name: Wyldernook
games.text: Predict and outwit your opponent in a free-to-play TCG where every move is planned in secret and turns resolve simultaneously. By the original designer of Infinity Wars, ——— is lovingly handcrafted and built by a team committed to sharing the kind of card game we’ve always wanted to play.

games.name: Oceanhorn 2: Knights of the Lost Realm
games.text: Sequel to the critically acclaimed action adventure. Experience a gorgeous new third person 3D view and embark on an epic journey that unfolds the mysteries of what happened 1000 years ago.

games.name: Doors: Paradox
games.text: A relaxing puzzle escape game! Make your way through a variety of hand-crafted 3D dioramas, look for useful objects, find hidden clues and solve fun puzzles! Unravel this mysterious adventure about chaos, order and the surreal.

games.name: Still Wakes the Deep
games.text: 1975. Disaster strikes the Beira D oil rig off the coast of Scotland. Navigate the collapsing rig to save your crew from an otherworldly horror on the edge of all logic and reality in this 3x BAFTA Games Award-winning narrative horror experience.

games.name: Palworld
games.text: Fight, farm, build and work alongside mysterious creatures called "Pals" in this completely new multiplayer, open world survival and crafting game!

games.name: Storyteller
games.text: ——— is an award-winning puzzle game about building stories. Start with a title, settings and characters and create a story that fits the story’s description. Play with stories of love, intrigue, crime, monsters, betrayal, and more!

games.name: A Little to the Left
games.text: ——— is a cozy puzzle game that has you sort, stack, and organize household items into pleasing arrangements while you keep an eye out for a mischievous cat with an inclination for chaos. Check out this playful and intuitive puzzler with 100+ satisfying messes to tidy.

games.name: StarRupture
games.text: ——— is a first-person open world base-building game with advanced combat and tons of exploration. Play alone or in a group on this sublime and ever-changing planet, extract and manage resources, create your complex industrial system and fight off hordes of alien monsters.

games.name: EMUUROM
games.text: A creature-scanning metroidvania. Explore an ancient paradise before it's lost forever. Study the ——— creatures, document your findings in the EMUUDEX, and use what you learn to unlock new paths.

games.name: Dome Keeper
games.text: Defend against waves of alien monsters in this unique roguelike action miner. Dig for resources, collect useful gadgets, and upgrade equipment to increase odds of survival – just hurry back before your dome is destroyed!

games.name: Heading Out
games.text: Flee your fear and carve your story. Blaze a trail across mythic American highways, where choices twist your tale and danger’s always in the rearview mirror. With roguelike routes, limited resources, and breakneck chases, this isn’t just a drive—it’s your legend in the making.

games.name: Moving Out 2
games.text: Moving Out is back and wackier than ever, and now with ONLINE PLAY! Return to Packmore and use your moving skills across brand new dimensions and some old favourites. Help rebuild Smooth Moves and become an all-star F.A.R.T. (Furniture Arrangement & Relocation Technician)!

games.name: Forever Skies
games.text: A first-person survival game set on a post-apocalyptic, ecologically ruined Earth. Play solo or with up to 3 friends as you build, upgrade, and fly a high-tech airship. Scavenge resources, craft tools, and face dangers on the surface as you hunt for a cure to save humanity.

games.name: Warhammer Combat Cards
games.text: Build a powerful army of cards from your favourite faction in the Warhammer 40,000 universe and battle other players in fast-paced, turn based online combat! In the grim darkness of the far future there is only war!

games.name: Disc Golf Valley
games.text: ——— is home to some of the most beautiful and challenging disc golf courses in the world. Fill up your disc bag, sign up for tournaments and challenge every course in the Valley.

games.name: Artist Life Simulator
games.text: Live the life of a starving artist in 19th century alternative history. Survive poverty, alchoholism, madness, depression, and 67 different feelings. Paint masterpieces by combining inspirations, sell them for riches (or scraps) and create a painting that will change the world.

games.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl
games.text: Enter the Chornobyl Anomalous Zone — a vast open world where anomalies, mutants, and rivals stand in your way. Explore, scavenge, and try to survive in this brutal and dangerous land. Evolving with every update, now overhauled and crowned with UPDATE 2.0.

games.name: SurrounDead
games.text: ——— is an open world survival game. Taking place in a world ravaged by an apocalyptic catastrophe. The dead reign free and will stop at nothing to kill you.

games.name: Project Demigod
games.text: ——— is a physics-driven superhero sandbox with limitless possibilities - now with social multiplayer! Pick from a huge range of powers including flight, strength, super speed and more. Visit massive locations from cities to arenas and take on missions, fight enemies and enormous bosses.

games.name: Luminary
games.text: ——— is a solo or co-op OpenZone Action RPG that creates a balanced experience for everyone. Using a unique world and character progression system, explore vast hand-crafted lands together, uncover hidden treasures, level up your town, and push back the darkness with light.

games.name: ScooterFlow
games.text: The world’s most realistic freestyle scooter game is finally here. Ride the skatepark, hit the streets, boost the mega ramp, fully customize your scooter & throw down all of the real life trick combinations you could dream of within this physics based scooter game.

games.name: Two Point Campus
games.text: Build the university of your dreams with ———, the sim with a twist from the makers of Two Point Hospital. Build, hire staff and run an academic institution packed with wild courses.

games.name: Returnal™
games.text: BREAK THE CYCLE Fight to survive as this award-winning third-person shooter brings Selene’s story to PC. Take on roguelike challenges. Engage enemies in bullet hell-fuelled clashes. Share your journey through ———™ with another player.

games.name: News Tower
games.text: Develop your newspaper and become New York’s new media mogul! In this tycoon, build and manage your newspaper from printer to toilet. Create your editorial line and lead your journalists through unique 1930's stories and dig out the latest scoops!

games.name: RIDE 5
games.text: Rev up your engine and get ready to hit the track with ———. An adrenaline-filled gaming experience that is so authentic it will make you feel like you're truly racing at break-neck speed.

games.name: Jigsaw Puzzle Dreams
games.text: Beautiful Multiplayer Jigsaw Puzzle game where you can design the room you play in!

games.name: Mix Universe
games.text: ——— is a musical sandbox game where you play as a Mixonaut connecting nodes to create music that you can upload to the universe for everyone to play!

games.name: Mutant Football League 2
games.text: ——— is a hard-hitting, arcade-style football game that combines intense gameplay, wisecracking mutants, weapons, deep strategy, and outrageous humor. Prepare yourself for the most insanely brutal football you’ll ever experience.

games.name: Slime Rancher 2
games.text: Continue the adventures of Beatrix LeBeau as she journeys across the Slime Sea to Rainbow Island, a land brimming with ancient mysteries, and bursting with wiggly, new slimes to wrangle in this sequel to the smash-hit, Slime Rancher.

games.name: Moonstone Island
games.text: ——— is a creature-collecting life-sim set in an open world with 100 islands to explore. Make friends, brew potions, collect Spirits, and test your strength in card-based encounters to complete your Alchemy training!

games.name: HITMAN World of Assassination
games.text: Enter the world of the ultimate assassin. ——— delivers the definitive stealth action experience, putting you in the shoes of Agent 47, a master assassin. Explore immersive locations, uncover hidden secrets, and eliminate targets with complete freedom of approach.

games.name: UNCHARTED™: Legacy of Thieves Collection
games.text: Play as Nathan Drake and Chloe Frazer in their own standalone adventures as they confront their pasts and forge their own legacies. This game includes the critically acclaimed single-player stories from both ——— 4: A Thief’s End and ———: The Lost Legacy.

games.name: Aloft
games.text: Soar the skies in ———, the co-op sandbox survival game set in a world of floating islands. Build any island into a skyship, your home in the clouds. Find lost knowledge, cure the fungal corruption, and brave the hurricane to restore the ecosystem.

games.name: Trapper: Drug Dealing RPG
games.text: Drug Dealing RPG roguelite strategy crime saga with choose your own adventure elements. The police and the jackboys aren't your biggest enemy... Time is!

games.name: Amber Isle
games.text: Welcome to ——— - a quaint, friendly village of prehistoric residents who are in need of a new shopkeep... That’s you! Craft and sell items, upgrade your shop, befriend your Paleofolk neighbours and customise the island to bring the village back to life and welcome even more prehistoric pals!

games.name: Reigns Beyond
games.text: From the makers of Reigns, get ready for ———, a swipe-based adventure game through the stars!

games.name: REPLACED
games.text: Follow R.E.A.C.H., an AI trapped in a human body, on a cinematic adventure through an alternate 1980s America. Explore an atmospheric cyberpunk world full of high-stakes action wrapped in a unique 2.5D pixel art style.

games.name: Duelists of Eden
games.text: Build a deck and battle online in real-time action with rollback netcode!

games.name: TRAIL OUT
games.text: Welcome to the festival of explosive races, ———! Reckless racing around the world! Crashes, explosions, destruction, and screaming drivers!

games.name: eFootball™
games.text: Step up and experience the exhilarating soccer game that has now surpassed 1 billion downloads! Play ———™ with users around the world!

games.name: Tournament Ark
games.text: A heavily anime-inspired deck builder. You play as one of the participants in the ———, a combat tournament held on an interdimensional boat. Pick the right moves, choose the correct passive abilities for your build and combine the right cards to become the champion!

games.name: Dungeons of Aether
games.text: Delve into ———, a turn-based dungeon crawler set in the Rivals of Aether universe. Control four new heroes as they uncover the mysteries of the Julesvale Caverns in Story Mode or test your mettle in the grueling Challenge Dungeons.

games.name: Alina of the Arena
games.text: A roguelike deckbuilding tactics game that combines elements from 'Slay the Spire' and 'Into the Breach'. Play as a gladiator to survive. With roguelike deckbuilding and hex-based tactics, no longer bound by simple attack and defense. Make use of dodges and knockbacks to stay alive!

games.name: Age of Wonders 4
games.text: Rule a fantasy realm of your own design! Explore new magical realms in Age of Wonders’ signature blend of 4X strategy and turn-based tactical combat. Control a faction that grows and changes as you expand your empire with each turn!

games.name: Firefighting Simulator: Ignite
games.text: Face unpredictable dangers, fight perilous fires with your crew, and save lives in ———. Step into the boots of a U.S. firefighter and play with up to 3 friends or with the help of your NPC controlled crew members.

games.name: MADiSON
games.text: ——— is a first person psychological horror game that delivers an immersive and terrifying experience. With the help of an instant camera, connect the human world with the beyond, take pictures and develop them by yourself. Solve puzzles, explore your surroundings and most importantly, survive.

games.name: Touhou Monster TD ~ 幻想乡妖怪塔防
games.text: Easy to learn but hard to master, Touhou Monster TD is a unique Tower defense Game. Control your character, level up and unlock tower skills and character talents, use your wisdom to defeat incoming enemies. Travel the Gensokyo, find out why the “Incident” happened this time.

games.name: Paladin's Oath
games.text: Complex Strategy Fantasy card game RPG inspired by board games like Mage Knight or Gloomhaven. Combines elements of RPG, light deck-building, puzzle and strategy. Absolutely no micro-transactions, virtual currencies or any of that, ever. Text to speech support for visually impaired on Windows

games.name: Minecraft Dungeons
games.text: Fight your way through an exciting action-adventure game, inspired by classic dungeon crawlers and set in the Minecraft universe!

games.name: Nin Online
games.text: Fight and train with powerful Jutsu to rise through the ranks of your village in a ninja open-world MMORPG. Join over a hundred thousand players worldwide. Play now for free!

games.name: Alaska Gold Fever
games.text: Step into the role of a gold prospector during the Alaskan gold rush and build your own empire from scratch. Mine resources, refine different forms of gold, and upgrade your tools to increase efficiency. Explore diverse mines, survive the harsh climate, and complete engaging story and side quests!

games.name: Sovereign Syndicate
games.text: A Victorian steampunk RPG with tarot cards instead of dice. Investigate the disappearance of society’s most vulnerable to uncover a mysterious cult. Play as three characters, each with their own skills and motivations. Customize your characters with narrative choices to unlock new tarot cards.

games.name: For The King II
games.text: Battle against Fahrul's tyrannical Queen alone or as a party of four players in the sequel to For The King, the massively popular turn-based roguelite tabletop RPG. Will you unravel the once beloved Queen's terrible secret?

games.name: EA SPORTS™ PGA TOUR™
games.text: The exclusive home of the Majors, ———™ features Pure Strike for superior golf gameplay, powered by ShotLink®, and unrivaled access to the world’s most exclusive golf courses.

games.name: Stumble Guys
games.text: Ready for the chaos? ——— is a 32-player, fast-paced multiplayer party royale where players dash, jump, and fall across hilarious obstacle courses in a fun race to be the last one standing.

games.name: The Case of the Golden Idol
games.text: A new kind of detective game that allows you to think and investigate freely. Discover clues surrounding 12 strange and gruesome deaths and build your own theory. Pick your suspect, deduce the motive, unmask the awful truth.

games.name: Unmatched: Digital Edition
games.text: ——— is a fast-paced tactical dueling game where legendary heroes face off in battles across the ages. Each player controls a hero, their sidekick(s), and a unique deck of cards built around that character’s fighting style and abilities.

games.name: World of Shooting
games.text: A first-person shooting sports sim from the developers of World of Guns. Collect hundreds of realistic firearms and accessories, beat practical shooting and tactical training campaigns, set global high scores, and build your own ranges!

games.name: Heat Death
games.text: Build your deck, re-write your cards, and join in epic space battles! ——— is a single-player deckbuilder which takes card customization and power scaling to the extreme, as you battle against sentient stars and black holes.

games.name: RoboCop: Rogue City
games.text: Become the legendary part man, part machine, all cop hero and deliver justice in Old Detroit.

games.name: Abalon: Roguelike Tactics CCG
games.text: ——— is a roguelike adventure that fuses tactical turn-based combat and card strategy. Choose your summoner and explore a tabletop world to discover its secrets. Build the perfect deck, outsmart your enemies and become legend!

games.name: PropHunter
games.text: ——— - a fresh representative of the genre of hide and seek on the net! The players are divided into two teams - one team is hiding by taking the form and properties of objects, the second team is seek to find for impostors among props. The team that eliminates its rivals wins!

games.name: Warriors of the Nile 2
games.text: ——— is a fast-paced Roguelite strategy game. This time our Warriors are equipped with a more unique combat style. Freely choose the adventure route, use the skill tablets to strengthen characters, lead your squad to repel the Roman legion.

games.name: Uncrashed : FPV Drone Simulator
games.text: Amateur or experienced FPV pilot, learn or improve your skills on ———,the new ultra realistic FPV simulator. Simulate your own FPV drone with settings based on real values and you will have the same feeling as a real flight without the risk of breaking your drone !

games.name: Kayak VR: Mirage
games.text: ——— is a jaw-dropping and exhilarating journey through beautiful locations, made for Virtual Reality. Maneuver our fully physically accurate kayak around checkpoints and crown yourself the fastest, or take it easy and use the free roam mode and enjoy the scenery.

games.name: CULTIC
games.text: Death is only the beginning. Crawl from your grave and gear up to fight your way through the ranks of a mysterious and twisted cult. You, your guns, and your dynamite will have to shoot, slide, blast, duck, dodge, and maybe throw a gib or two to survive in this old-school-inspired shooter.

games.name: Capcom Fighting Collection
games.text: Ten of Capcom's most popular arcade games in one bumper collection! A wide variety of titles are included from series such as Street Fighter and Darkstalkers, Cyberbots, and the first home console port of Red Earth! And of course, all titles support online play!

games.name: Crash Time - Undercover
games.text: In ——— you will experience non-stop racing action, and embark on a high-octane manhunt, with thrilling car chases and lots of explosive missions! Are you ready? Highways are waiting for you!

games.name: Persona 5 Royal
games.text: Lead the Phantom Thieves of Hearts in this award winning, stylish turn-based RPG filled with dungeon crawling, party customization, strategic combat, and Persona fusion. Explore Tokyo, build relationships, battle Shadows, and infiltrate the minds of the corrupt to make them change their ways!

games.name: RAYZE
games.text: ——— is an AIM RACER. Hit a target to accelerate. Miss and you slow down. Hit a wall and lose. Find the fastest route. Get to the finish line. Simple? Yes. Easy? Hell no. Ready? 3... 2... 1... Let's ———!

games.name: Dune: Imperium
games.text: The award-winning board game of strategy and intrigue in the iconic universe of ———. The Spice must flow.

games.name: Incremental Epic Hero 2
games.text: A mixture of incremental/idle and roleplaying game set in fantasy world filled with monsters and things to explore, where battling is constant, almost everything can be upgraded, and with wide array of various prestige mechanics to always keep things interesting and moving forward!

games.name: Rogue Waters
games.text: ——— is a Pirate Tactical Turn-Based Rogue-lite. Play as Captain Cutter, commanding your ship and crew through procedurally generated encounters to seek revenge. Recruit, train, and upgrade crew, use powerful sea creatures, and engage in dynamic naval and melee combat to gain the upper hand.

games.name: Danganronpa S: Ultimate Summer Camp
games.text: With an all-star dream lineup of characters from each Danganronpa game, gather Hope Fragments at a tropical resort. Explore Jabberwock Island and develop your Dangan characters. Gather money through battle and upgrade your equipment, then defeat bosses and move on to the next island!

games.name: SimplePlanes VR
games.text: ——— is a flight sim with an ever-expanding collection of hand-crafted aircraft to download and fly for free. Airplanes, helicopters, cars, boats, and more are available and new crafts are added every day.

games.name: Dead Space
games.text: The sci-fi survival-horror classic returns, completely rebuilt to offer an even more immersive experience — including visual, audio, and gameplay improvements — while staying faithful to the original game’s thrilling vision.

games.name: Card Survival: Tropical Island
games.text: ——— is a card-based survival experience. Stranded on a desert island you must use your wits and skills to stay alive. Use cards and combine them together to explore, gather resources and craft useful tools.

games.name: The Matchless Kungfu
games.text: ——— is an open world sandbox RPG game based on a WuXia background. You can play any martial arts role you imagine in this wild world. Travel through the great wilderness, or be the leader of the group. The most important thing is, build your own story and live the experience!

games.name: The Mermaid Mask
games.text: An impossible locked-room murder: Captain Mortuga lies dead beside an ancient cauldron aboard the world’s strangest submarine, crewed by sketchy suspects. A handcrafted point-and-click with sharp humour and tricky puzzles. Dive into the next mystery from the creators of Tangle Tower & Crow Country.

games.name: Who's Lila?
games.text: A reverse-detective adventure, where you control your character's face

games.name: Junkyard Truck
games.text: ——— is an open-world off road driving and mechanic simulator. Build, upgrade, and maintain your old off road truck. Make money using your skills in driving, scavenging, gambling, or moonshine brewing. Try to build a truck capable of taking on the difficult challenges around the map.

games.name: KLETKA
games.text: ——— is a co-op (up to 6 players) horror game about going down in an elevator that is trying to eat you. Feed the elevator, explore deadly floors and descend deeper.

games.name: The Dream Of A Cockspur
games.text: Stranded on a desolate island with Earth's remaining researchers, you investigate a strange celestial body. The day before departure, your only means of transportation gets mysteriously damaged, leaving you stranded. Is someone sabotaging the team, or is there something more sinister going on…

games.name: Parkour Tag
games.text: ——— is a platforming PvP game that faces two-players off in a competitive game of movement. Run vertically or horizontally on any wall, jump, double jump, slide, vault and more to outmaneuver your opponent and claim victory!

games.name: Clanfolk
games.text: ——— is a colony sim set in the Scottish Highlands. Harness your environment to survive - fish, gather, hunt, and farm as you prepare for the winter. Build an inn, trade with other clans, have children and marry them off - live life and prosper across the generations.

games.name: Sengoku Dynasty
games.text: ——— is the ultimate feudal Japan experience: build villages, grow your community, and shape the open world through combat or economy. The choice is yours alone - or that of up to 4 players in multiplayer co-op!

games.name: Voor De Kroon
games.text: ——— is an immersive medieval strategy-action game with historically inspired arms and armor. Fight historical battles and command your troops from the front line or the RTS camera. Use the Warforge editor to reshape the entire game and build your own medieval campaigns.

games.name: The Stanley Parable: Ultra Deluxe
games.text: ——— is an expanded re-imagining of 2013's ———. You will play as Stanley, and you will not play as Stanley. You will make a choice, and you will become powerless. You are not here to win. ——— is a game that plays you.

games.name: Big Klondike - Classic Solitaire
games.text: Free to play classic solitaire.

games.name: Granny 3
games.text: You have to escape Granny and Grandpa...You have five days...

games.name: Swords and Sandals Immortals
games.text: Gladiator! Grab your sword, equip your sandals and take on the world in multiplayer Swords and Sandals! Brutal turn-based combat where gladiators can lose limbs, wield guitars and yell so loudly enemy heads will fall off. This is the most fun you'll ever have in the arena!

games.name: RiffTrax: The Game
games.text: ——— is a multiplayer party game where players compete to make bad movies funny. Do you have what it takes to be the next movie riffing genius? Grab your friends and make fun of some of the worst cinematic abominations ever created.

games.name: Battle Train
games.text: ——— is a run-based roguelite deck-n-track builder set in the world’s most explosive game show. Choose your cards, upgrade your train, lay down tracks, and use destructive locomotives to blast your rival Champions off the rails in a chaotic mashup of deck-building and tactical rail combat.

games.name: Nitro Kid
games.text: Synthwave roguelike deckbuilder set in the neon 80's. Pick your agent. Build your deck. Hit card combos and fight through the floors of INFINITY tower. Featuring 30+ fresh Synthwave tracks by LudoWic, Tonebox and Jules Reves.

games.name: Solitaire Expeditions
games.text: Inspired by the 1992 hit Solitaire's Journey, ——— is a modern take on a classic game. Play 200 variants, including Klondike, FreeCell, Spider, Canfield, and Golf. Embark on a expedition or play individual games. Unlock new backgrounds, card backs, and decks as you play.

games.name: Loco Motive
games.text: There's been a murder aboard the Reuss Express, and you're the suspects! Prove your innocence in this comedy 'point n' click' murder mystery - packed with twists, laughs, and larger-than-life characters!

games.name: Tower Tactics: Liberation
games.text: We fused deck-building roguelikes and tower defenses in a way never seen before - deploy your towers, collect valuable trinkets and cast powerful spells to defend yourself against the Salkoth!

games.name: MotoGP™22
games.text: Engines running: give the green light to the most immersive and authentic MotoGP™ gaming experience ever. Virtual and Real have never been so near in ———!

games.name: Dungeon 100
games.text: The dragon-slayer becomes the dragon. Create unique builds without having to grind for equipment. After defeating a dungeon boss, you will take its place. Then, defeat your past selves to descend further into the dungeon.

games.name: GWENT: Rogue Mage (Single-Player Expansion)
games.text: ———: Rogue Mage is a first single-player expansion to ———: The Witcher Card Game. It combines elements of roguelike, deckbuilding, and strategy games with ——— card battles.

games.name: Carmageddon: Rogue Shift
games.text: ——— smashes back with brutal roguelite vehicular‑combat mayhem. Adapt, upgrade, and unleash destruction on post‑apocalyptic zombie hordes. The legacy lives on, reinvented and unforgiving.

games.name: Riven
games.text: Uncover a story of intrigue, betrayal, and a civilization teetering on the brink of collapse as you solve intricate puzzles to unlock the secrets of ———. Built from the ground-up and expanded from the award-winning original game released in 1997.

games.name: Project Castaway
games.text: ——— is a survival crafting title set in the Pacific Ocean. Live the life of a stranded castaway, with only yourself - and the island's inhabitants - for company! Sail the ocean, hunt, explore unique islands and gather resources as you fight for survival.

games.name: Super Auto Pets
games.text: Build the strongest team of pets and tussle with your friends!

games.name: Buck Up And Drive!
games.text: There is time to explain, I just don't wanna.

games.name: Starfield
games.text: ——— is the first new universe in 25 years from Bethesda Game Studios, the award-winning creators of The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim and Fallout 4.

games.name: ASTLIBRA Revision
games.text: Confront time and fate in the 2D action RPG, ———. Explore meticulously crafted worlds, fight brutal boss battles, and upgrade your skills to take down enemies lurking around every corner.

games.name: Spaceflight Simulator
games.text: In ———, you will get to build your rockets, plan launches and flights, attempt landings, deploy payloads and explore new worlds.

games.name: Morsels
games.text: ——— is a fast-paced creature collecting roguelite with a rotating roster of characters to switch between at will. Overcome a clique of killer cats as you fight your way out of the sewers in this unique, action-packed journey.

games.name: Cards and Castles 2
games.text: Collectible cards spring to life in this wacky Tactical CCG. Assemble a deck to challenge your friends and rivals, and engage in glorious CARD BATTLES! Will you choose fearsome dragons, or the deadly squirrels?

games.name: Crash And Run
games.text: Race. Compete. Run. Clash head to head with your friends, ducking and weaving obstacle to obstacle until you prove yourself to be the best once and for all.

games.name: Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree
games.text: Slay your way in ———, an epic action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Battle monsters, master six unique Classes, craft hundreds of useful items, and explore the secrets of an expansive, interconnected world.

games.name: Abyssus
games.text: Choose your loadout, blast through the corrupted denizens of a sunken civilization, and wield godly powers in ——— – a fast-paced 1-to-4 players FPS and roguelite brinepunk adventure.

games.name: Poppy Playtime
games.text: You must stay alive in this horror/puzzle adventure. Try to survive the vengeful toys waiting for you in the abandoned toy factory. Use your GrabPack to hack electrical circuits or nab anything from afar. Explore the mysterious facility... and don't get caught.

games.name: Neon Sundown
games.text: ——— is an extremely challenging arena-shooter that mixes fast-paced action with roguelite elements. Take on increasingly difficult arenas as you unlock new ships, upgrades, synergies, and more! Think you have what it takes to survive?

games.name: Colossus - Eternal Blight
games.text: Your brother is corrupted. The Blight is spreading. Only you can stop it. ——— is an atmospheric pixel action-adventure where you master precise combat, explore a vast dark fantasy world, and make choices that permanently scar the kingdom of Eireos.

games.name: Everdell
games.text: Harvest resources to build a village of woodland critters in this adaptation of the award-winning tabletop board game!

games.name: Munchkin Digital
games.text: Kill the monsters & grab the loot in the classic card game!

games.name: Clank!
games.text: Burgle your way to adventure in the award-winning board game!

games.name: Eyes of Hellfire
games.text: ——— is a co-op gothic horror game inspired by tabletop games, but with a twist - the insidious Host can manipulate your sense of reality

games.name: Talespinner
games.text: Enter a captivating realm woven with the tapestry of Japanese mythology in ———, a deck-building roguelike adventure. As the storyteller, you will guide your chosen hero through an ever-changing narrative shaped by your decisions and deck construction.

games.name: YouRiding - Surfing and Bodyboarding Game
games.text: A realistic surfing and bodyboarding game. Play for the top spot of the ranking at real spots like Kirra in Australia or Supertubes in Portugal, create your own waves and share them to the community, or play against other players in 16 surfers bracket competitions.

games.name: Yamafuda! 2nd station
games.text: A fun, easy game where you climb mountains using a deck of cards and special gear you build along the way. Go and reach the summit!

games.name: THE SPIRIT LIFT
games.text: A retro horror deckbuilder roguelike set in a haunted hotel in the 1990s. Choose your teens, explore and fight! If you die rewind the night!

games.name: Rush Rally Origins
games.text: The definitive top down racer

games.name: Luto
games.text: ——— is a psychological horror experience where you take on the role of someone unable to leave their home. Every attempt to escape will lead you deeper into the unknown, where nothing is as it seems and everything will test your senses.

games.name: We Love Katamari REROLL+ Royal Reverie
games.text: The second title in the Katamari Damacy series has returned in a remastered, powered-up version! This new REROLL comes with improved graphics and gameplay enhancements. In Royal Reverie, roll up katamari as the King of All Cosmos in his boyhood!

games.name: Words Can Kill
games.text: Just another boring word game? No. ——— is a roguelike deckbuilder. Travel through the world trying to build the strongest deck from letter tiles and find the perfect gear. And remember, here your tactical decisions matter, not your vocabulary!

games.name: Mandate Order
games.text: ——— is a Warring States war city-builder set in ancient China. Build a stronghold, manage industries and logistics, recruit scholars from the Hundred Schools of Thought, raise armies, and command real-time tactical battles with thousands of soldiers.

games.name: Brutal Orchestra
games.text: ——— is a Turn-Based Roguelike Strategy Game. You died, someone killed you. You are in Purgatory and you will never escape. Make a deal with the "demon" Bosch and set off into Purgatory finding ​all manner of demented friends and foes on your quest to get petty revenge.

games.name: REKA
games.text: Channel your inner witch! Build your cozy chicken-legged hut, practice witchcraft, and forage for ingredients in autumnal woodlands. Solve quests & uncover the great mysteries of the legendary witch Baba Jaga…

games.name: Franchise Hockey Manager 8
games.text: Franchise Hockey Manager returns for the 2021-22 season with plenty of additions to the deepest, most authentic hockey strategy gaming experience you can find. Choose from teams around the globe and select a team to guide to glory, including a chance at the ultimate prize, the Stanley Cup®.

games.name: Smack Studio
games.text: A sandbox fighting game with built-in creation tools to create characters and stages. Animate pixel art characters using our 3D pixel art rotation technology, then battle with up to 8 players! Use our tools to export sprites for your own projects.

games.name: Have a Nice Death
games.text: ——— is a 2D action roguelike where you play as an overworked Death, whose employees have run rampant, completely throwing off the balance of souls - and his vacation plans. In order to restore order, you'll have to grab your trusty scythe and show your employees who's boss.

games.name: JellyCar Worlds
games.text: It's a Car, made of Jelly! Squishy Physics, Tactile, Silly & Imaginative Driving/Platforming

games.name: Lunacid
games.text: Cast into the Great Well, unwanted by the world above. You delve the dark in search of the Old One, your last salvation. ——— is a dark fantasy dungeon crawler inspired by Shadow Tower and King’s Field.

games.name: City Zoomer
games.text: A movement focused endless anime runner. Jump till you're dead.

games.name: Murders on the Yangtze River
games.text: "Murders on Yangtze River" is an Ace Attorney-like detective game that takes you on a journey through early 20th century China as you solve a series of intriguing cases. Use your logical reasoning and deduction skills to uncover clues, interrogate suspects, and solve the mysteries.

games.name: Voice of Cards: The Forsaken Maiden
games.text: The second game in the unique ——— series, where all elements are presented entirely through the medium of cards, in the tradition of tabletop RPGs and gamebooks.

games.name: Starcom: Unknown Space
games.text: ——— is an action RPG of space exploration and adventure. Build your own starship while discovering an epic story in a universe of strange mysteries, alien factions and uncharted worlds.

games.name: The Jackbox Party Starter
games.text: Get the party started with ———! Featuring three updated titles: Quiplash 3, Trivia Murder Party 2 and Tee K.O., this starter pack is sure to entertain!

games.name: Astrea: Six-Sided Oracles
games.text: ——— is a DICE-deck-building roguelike that flips the script on deckbuilders by using dice instead of cards and a unique dual “damage” system: Purification vs Corruption. Build a dice pool strong enough to purify ———'s out-of-control corruption and save the Star System.

games.name: The Monster Within
games.text: A 50's horror comic themed deck building card game with roguelike progression elements. Stop yourself from turning into a monster, or embrace your inner evil and use your new gifts. Choose from a roster of classic monsters and duke it out in ———!

games.name: Momentum
games.text: Fast-paced racing game in a retro 80's neon style.

games.name: Jump Space
games.text: ——— (formerly Jump Ship) is a mission based co-op PvE for 1-4 players, where you are the crew of a spaceship. Transition seamlessly from crewing the ship to on-foot exploration and space walks. Explore, upgrade, and survive intense encounters in deep space together.

games.name: Open Wheel Manager 2
games.text: The ultimate racing management sim - Strategize, customize, refine to create your racing edge. Hire, research, win sponsors and attract the best drivers all while managing every aspect of your 90’s race team.

games.name: Goat Simulator: Remastered
games.text: ——— is the latest in goat simulation technology. Your favorite chaotic sandbox is back and more beautiful than ever, with updated graphics, every DLC, and more bugs that you can shake a goat at. WASD to rewrite history.

games.name: SWORN
games.text: ——— is a 1-4 player co-op action rogue-like. Explore and reclaim a fallen Camelot from the reign of a corrupted Arthur and his Knights of the Round Table.

games.name: HumanitZ
games.text: ——— is an isometric, open-world sandbox survival game set in a world ended by a zombie outbreak. Survive alone or with friends by scavenging, crafting, building, and fighting to last as long as ‘humanly’ possible. You can’t change the past, but you can fight for the future of humanity.

games.name: FORWARD: Escape the Fold - Ultimate Edition
games.text: ——— was created to be the perfect bitesized roguelike dungeon crawler. Choose your champion and face a relentless crawl through the card-based dungeons, collect items to power your abilities and defeat the gruesome monsters facing you. But keep going ———!

games.name: Wonderputt Forever
games.text: Explore ever-evolving levels with three different gameplay modes in ———, an adventurous mini-golf game.

games.name: Super Bullet Break
games.text: Save the world of online multiplayer games from a rogue AI in this deck-building strategy roguelite! Collect more than 160 cute and colourful Bullets as you move through maps based on iconic game genres and defeat enemies in challenging turn-based combat.

games.name: Spikair Volleyball
games.text: Control the 4 players of your volleyball team. Recruit players, train them and win tournaments to become the best volleyball club.

games.name: As We Descend
games.text: The apocalyptic roguelike deckbuilder with squad sculpting and deep tactics. Recruit the right units and outmaneuver titanic foes on dangerous expeditions. Build up allies and resources in the feudal Vault-City. Can you survive all the perils that await the last bastion of humanity?

games.name: PAW Patrol: Grand Prix
games.text: No track is too big, no racer too small! The ——— are on their fastest mission yet – To win the Pup Cup! Race around iconic locations including Adventure Bay, Jake’s Snowboarding Resort and The Jungle in this 4-player-championship to find out who will be crowned the winner.

games.name: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II
games.text: A thrilling story-driven action RPG, with a rich open world, set in 15th century Medieval Europe. Experience the ultimate medieval adventure - through the eyes of young Henry - as you embark on a journey of epic proportions.

games.name: The Operator
games.text: Welcome to the FDI. As our newest Operator, your role is to use your detective skills to assist our field agents and investigate mysterious crimes. Use cutting-edge FDI software to dig for clues, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth.

games.name: STAR WARS Jedi: Survivor™
games.text: The story of Cal Kestis continues in ———™, a galaxy-spanning, third-person, action-adventure game.

games.name: Slice & Dice
games.text: Tactical dice-rolling roguelike combat. Take control of 5 heroes, each with their own unique dice. Fight your way through 20 levels of monsters and try to take on the final boss. If you lose a single fight you have to start over so be careful (and lucky!).

games.name: Barton Lynch Pro Surfing
games.text: ——— pits you against the world’s best surfer’s at the most exotic locations on the planet. An in-depth leader-board sports game meets free surf exploration at 12 massive worlds. Get pumped by the unique control, amazing weather & customization tools.

games.name: TEKKEN 8
games.text: ——— is the latest addition to the TEKKEN series, the pinnacle of 3D fighting games. Join the fight with over 32 characters and bear witness to the next installment in this epic saga. Get ready for the biggest and best TEKKEN game ever made!

games.name: ZERO Sievert
games.text: Now with over 600,000 copies sold, ——— is a tense top-down extraction shooter that challenges you to scavenge a procedurally-generated wasteland, loot gear, and explore what’s left of a devastated world. When the odds are stacked against you, you’ll need to do more than just survive...

games.name: Hell Clock
games.text: Forge powerful builds with endless loot in this relentless combination of Roguelike and ARPG. Blast through dungeons and unleash inhuman powers in a dark fantasy twist on Brazil’s War of Canudos.

games.name: The Last Caretaker
games.text: Explore a drowned Earth, restore lost systems, and raise the last human seeds in this first-person survival-crafting adventure. Build, scavenge, defend, and launch humanity back to the stars.

games.name: OHV
games.text: Obtain, maintain and tune your "———" car. Build your own buggy. Build your own garage. Race to win trophies. Work to earn money. A Open world game set in Poland in the 90s.

games.name: Friends vs Friends
games.text: A frantic, online PvP shooter that combines combat and deck building. Choose a character, customize your card-based loadout, and get ready for the fights of your life!

games.name: TopSpin 2K25
games.text: ——— returns as a next-level tennis sim, bringing realistic court physics and challenging skill-based gameplay. Play single or multiplayer locally or online. Build your MyPLAYER or play as icons like Roger Federer and Serena Williams with custom animations mirroring their real-life styles.

games.name: Heist Kitty: Multiplayer Cat Simulator Game
games.text: Get ready to defy rules and create paw-some chaos. Pick your cat and embrace the cuteness overload. Let the fur-tastic fun take over, as multiplayer madness unfolds in this open-world adventure.

games.name: DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO
games.text: ——— takes the legendary gameplay of the Budokai Tenkaichi series and raises it to whole new levels. Make yours the destructive power of the strongest fighters ever to appear in ———!

games.name: Astral Masters
games.text: Can you make a super mage? Play ——— and explore your strategic thinking in a wide variety of matches with sneaky mages who know secrets. Elaborately themed environments, artful murals and vignettes will surprise you!

games.name: Crisol: Theater of Idols
games.text: ——— is a survival horror adventure set in a twisted version of Spain. As a soldier captured by religious dogmatism, you must use your own blood as ammunition, without draining to the point of death. Explore the cursed island of Tormentosa, uncover dark secrets, and battle horrifying enemies.

games.name: Brew
games.text: Face the challenges of The Tower as you enroll into the Alchemy Academy in this action-packed, third-person, roguelite. ——— potions to boost yourself in the heat of battle and use multiple weapons to defeat dangerous foes and pass your exams!

games.name: Vampire Survivors
games.text: Mow down thousands of night creatures and survive until dawn! ——— is a gothic horror casual game with rogue-lite elements, where your choices can allow you to quickly snowball against the hundreds of monsters that get thrown at you. Be the bullet hell!

games.name: Sonic Origins
games.text: Experience the collected adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog in ——— Plus! With 16 legendary Sonic titles including 12 Game Gear games, new playable characters, modes, challenges, behind the scenes content, and more, this is the definitive way to play these classic games!

games.name: Speedball
games.text: A brand new entry into the legendary Bitmap Brothers series! Venture into the grim future of 2138 where mega-corporations use ——— to distract the downtrodden masses from their miserable lives.

games.name: Haste
games.text: Run fast, soar through the air, and master your landings as you speed through procedural worlds to outrun the end of the universe, by yourself and with friends!

games.name: Sorry We're Closed
games.text: ——— is an eccentric story-driven survival horror game about demons, angels and what happens when both sides collide. A mix of classic fixed-camera exploration and arcade-style shooting where Michelle must use her Third Eye to see between worlds, uncover secrets and solve puzzles.

games.name: Chef RPG
games.text: Craft your culinary adventure in a beautiful pixel art world. Manage your restaurants, forage and hunt for ingredients, befriend locals, and grow your culinary empire. What kind of chef will you be?

games.name: Barro 22
games.text: Jump!

games.name: Dance of Cards
games.text: ——— is a tactical gambling RPG where you try to survive seven days of a deadly cruise by playing poker.

games.name: Mega Man Battle Network Legacy Collection Vol. 1
games.text: The renowned Mega Man Battle Network series is back! Vol. 1 contains Mega Man Battle Network 1-3, including both versions of Mega Man Battle Network 3 for a total of four titles, plus additional features like a gallery of illustrations and music! In addition, online play is supported!

games.name: Mega Man Battle Network Legacy Collection Vol. 2
games.text: The renowned Mega Man Battle Network series, which has expanded into anime and comics, is back. Volume 2 includes six action packed games from both versions of Mega Man Battle Network 4 to both versions of Mega Man Battle Network 6, plus additional features like a gallery and online play!

games.name: Redout 2
games.text: The fastest racing game in the universe. ——— is a tribute to classic arcade racing games and the sequel to the critically acclaimed Redout. Reach impossible speeds in exhilarating futuristic races across an extensive single-player campaign and competitive multiplayer.

games.name: The Enjenir: The Engineering Physics Building Simulator
games.text: Put your engineering and problem solving skills to the test in this sandbox physics building game! Enjoy the freedom of completely gridless 3D sandbox building combined with hilarious ragdoll third person controls, offering a truly unique and hilarious "Enjeniring" experience!

games.name: BOKURA
games.text: ——— is a two-player puzzle adventure game. Play as two boys who ran away from their homes and work together to take yourselves somewhere far, far away. Relive the friendship of your childhood through the journey of two boys.

games.name: Deer & Boy
games.text: A runaway boy meets a lost fawn, and together they cross a quiet, dangerous world. Solve puzzles, climb, and slip past threats as your companion grows from a fragile newborn into a powerful deer. What you cannot do alone, you learn to do together.

games.name: Bounty: Drag Racing
games.text: ——— is the most complete online drag racing experience on the market. Race the fastest and most varied types of dragsters in the world. Customize and fine tune your cars to achieve maximum performance and hop online for the closest type of racing!

games.name: Beneath Oresa
games.text: ———, a fighting roguelike deckbuilder, takes you deep within the city to confront your foes. As a strategist, choose your cards, upgrades, and artifacts wisely, but as a fighter, turn their positioning to your advantage.

games.name: Ghost Exile
games.text: ——— - is a cooperative horror from 1 to 4 players: when hunting for ghosts, you need to determine the type of ghost, carry out a ritual of exorcism and then the ghost can no longer harm anyone. Be careful! Hasty conclusions can lead you to a sad outcome.

games.name: ARC Raiders
games.text: ——— is a multiplayer extraction adventure, set in a lethal future earth, ravaged by a mysterious mechanized threat known as ARC.

games.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley
games.text: Join ——— in this musical adventure about restoring harmony and balance to Moominvalley, protecting it from the industrious Park Keeper.

games.name: Persona 3 Portable
games.text: If I say there’s an hour “hidden” between one day and the next... would you believe me? Master the power of the heart, Persona, and uncover the tragic truth of the Dark Hour.

games.name: Fortune Avenue
games.text: A competitive board game where players vote to shape their destiny. Transform caravans into 5-star hotels, collect wonders, and earn bounties for bankrupting opponents. Use airports to outmaneuver rivals, organize World Cups to multiply your rent. Can you turn your empire into a global monopoly?

games.name: Wildfrost
games.text: Take on the elements in ———, a tactical roguelike deckbuilder! Journey across a frozen tundra, collecting cards strong enough to banish the eternal winter…

games.name: Yokai Art: Night Parade of One Hundred Demons
games.text: By accident, you broke the seal of the mysterious book, which contains an enormous magical power that allows users to control any Yokai by defeating them and recording their names. This godly power is too much which alerts all the Yokai. You must find your own way to defeat them and survive.

games.name: Escape Academy
games.text: Welcome to ———. Train to become the ultimate Escapist. Solve Puzzles. Hack Servers. Meet the Faculty. Brew the perfect cup of tea. Escape Rooms in single player or co-op with a friend - local or online!

games.name: Little Goody Two Shoes
games.text: Venture into the woods as you play ———, a phantasmagorical horror narrative adventure where all your decisions matter!

games.name: Bellwright
games.text: Establish and expand your own settlements, liberate the land and assist its villagers, and recruit others to your cause while learning more about a life you had to leave behind. Command your forces, prove your valor through combat, and cement yourself as the hero of your people.

games.name: Dice Gambit
games.text: Shape and lead your own fully customisable (and debt-ridden) family of Inquisitors in charge of hunting the chromatic monsters infesting the city. Unlock unique abilities, hang out with eccentric nobles, learn the secrets the city holds while occasionally delivering ice cream!

games.name: NAIAD
games.text: Immerse yourself in a relaxing, minimalist and colorful adventure. Flow with ——— across a mysterious river and interact with its fauna and flora to discover little secrets. Enjoy a wholesome experience with an original and dreamy visual style.

games.name: Lingo
games.text: ——— is a first person word puzzle game with a large, abstract world to explore. With its epiphany-driven gameplay and impossible geometry, ——— provides a unique and nonlinear experience.

games.name: Aces & Adventures
games.text: ——— is a deckbuilding RPG with poker-powered combat. Craft your deck, combining poker hands with powerful ability cards. Journey through 13 fully-voiced campaigns to save the Life Tree, or tackle procedurally-generated runs in this strategic deckbuilder unlike any other.

games.name: Asphalt Legends
games.text: Spark your competitive soul with ——— and feel the collective heartbeat of the road! Join forces with other players to speed through intense arcade races, perform jaw-dropping stunts, and charge towards victory while driving the finest hypercars!

games.name: Swordcery
games.text: A colossal blade has pierced the world of Armorial, unleashing a storm of enchanted swords from the heavens. Collect and wield an arsenal of these spellbound blades, turning them against the very force that summoned them. In this roguelike ARPG, you will defy the Celestial evil consuming the world!

games.name: Marvel’s Spider-Man Remastered
games.text: In ———, the worlds of Peter Parker and Spider-Man collide in an original action-packed story. Play as an experienced Peter Parker, fighting big crime and iconic villains in Marvel’s New York. Web-swing through vibrant neighborhoods and defeat villains with epic takedowns.

games.name: Marvel’s Spider-Man: Miles Morales
games.text: After the events of ——— Remastered, teenage Miles Morales is adjusting to his new home while following in the footsteps of his mentor, Peter Parker, as a new Spider-Man. When a fierce power struggle threatens to destroy his home, Miles must take up the mantle of Spider-Man and own it

games.name: The Slaverian Trucker
games.text: ——— is a Survival/Truck/Life simulator game. Make enough money to survive and expand your wealth in the harsh semi-post apocalyptic lands of Slaveria, doing legal and illegal work, while maintaining, fixing, building, repairing, tuning your trucks, cars and other vehicles.

games.name: Microcivilization
games.text: Incremental clicker strategy, where you expand, construct, research, fight, collect heroes and make choices between good and evil. Ascend through difficulty tiers by playing through challenge campaign going back and forth through history. Mammoths included.

games.name: Escape The Mad Empire
games.text: ——— is a party-based, rogue-like dungeon crawler with intense and deeply tactical combat. Overcome the challenges as a band of heroes, and preserve their lives and sanity by managing resources and growing your base. Can you ———?

games.name: Laysara: Summit Kingdom
games.text: Build and expand your very own settlements in high mountains! Carefully plan production chains and satisfy various needs of your three-caste society while dealing with mountain hazards such as weather breakdowns and avalanches. Are you skilled enough to make your town thrive?

games.name: Chivalry 2
games.text: ——— is a multiplayer first person slasher inspired by epic medieval movie battles. Players are thrust into the action of every iconic moment of the era - from clashing swords, to storms of flaming arrows, to sprawling castle sieges and more.

games.name: Dungeon Drafters
games.text: ——— is a mystery dungeon adventure set in a world where magic is cards, and cards are magic. Explore ancient ruins, loot rare cards and employ clever combos to defeat your foes and build the legendary spell deck that could save the world.

games.name: CarX Drift Racing Online 2
games.text: A drifting simulator featuring an authentic competition format and a judging system inspired by modern drift championships. Enhanced and updated physics, developed in collaboration with the CarX Motorsport team.

games.name: Overpass 2
games.text: Identify the best routes and balance of power, speed and precision to overcome obstacles at the controls of a UTV, ATV or Rock Bouncer. In both solo and multiplayer mode, your talent and choices of technique will make the difference.

games.name: The Last Flame
games.text: Recruit a party of unique heroes, fight deadly encounters, loot and craft powerful gear, discover and create thousands of synergetic builds! ——— is an endless roguelike auto-battler in which you guide a righteous party of heroes through many challenges.

games.name: One More Gate : A Wakfu Legend
games.text: ——— is a rogue-lite deck-builder that combines exploration and turn-based strategic combat. Head out to discover fantastic places, master the power of Wakfu to create destructive card combos, and defeat all those who would stand in your way!

games.name: Spiritfall
games.text: ——— is a fast-paced Action Roguelite with combat inspired by Platform Fighters. Slash, smash, launch, and wall-splat a multitude of enemies using an ever-changing arsenal of divine powers.

games.name: Polylithic
games.text: ——— is a survival game unlike any other, set in the most pivotal moment in mankind's history. Experience life as a Paleolithic hunter-gatherer, settle down as a Neolithic farmer, form tribes in co-op multiplayer, or go it alone in a world where the apex predator is still a distant aspiration.

games.name: Out Of Hands
games.text: ——— is a bizarre card-based adventure game that blends video-collage graphics with gripping psychological horror. Will you seek the truth lurking in this wicked, warped world—and can you bear its weight? Misty memories threaten to tear you apart, contorting you into a being... ———.

games.name: Dakar Desert Rally
games.text: ——— is the biggest off-road rally racing adventure ever developed. Experience the speed and excitement of the largest rally race on the planet, featuring a wide variety of licensed vehicles from motorcycles, cars, trucks, quads and SSVs.

games.name: Mechanibot
games.text: In this tactical rogue-like auto battler, you'll build your unique team of robots and keep them alive as they fight. Battle through waves of enemies as you travel from planet to planet on a mission to fix the sun. Strategize, protect, survive. A ———'s wrench never rests.

games.name: [Chilla's Art] The Closing Shift | 閉店事件
