games.text: The Closing Shift | 閉店事件 is a Japanese horror game about a girl on a closing shift.

games.name: Dungeon Dreams 2
games.text: Roguelike Romance JRPG. Create your character and get a room at the Magic Academy dormitory, to win the Challenge of the Infinite Dungeon! A game with town building, relationships, and many quests with alternate routes.

games.name: Rogue Tower
games.text: ——— is a tower defense game with roguelike elements and a continuously expanding path which you can influence. Unlock, build, upgrade, expand, defend.

games.name: Rogue Point
games.text: From the creators of Black Mesa: Welcome to ———! A 4-player co-op shooter where teamwork is everything. Join forces on intense missions with evolving objectives and powerful upgrades. Plan, Adapt, and Overcome. Your squad’s survival depends on it.

games.name: Stellar Orphans
games.text: "Explore '———', a captivating deck-building game where every choice determines the fate of your crew lost in infinite space. Forge alliances, manage resources, and resolve crises to guide your '———' to survival. Ready to defy the stars?"

games.name: Dragon Age™: The Veilguard
games.text: Unite the Veilguard and defy the gods in ———, an immersive single-player RPG.

games.name: Need for Speed™ Unbound
games.text: Race to the top, definitely don’t flop. Outsmart the cops, and enter weekly qualifiers for The Grand: the ultimate street race. Pack your garage with precision-tuned, custom rides, and light up the streets with your style.

games.name: Foolish Mortals
games.text: Louisiana, 1933. Thirty years ago an entire wedding suddenly & mysteriously vanished on the island of Devil's Rock, and with it went the location of the lost treasure of Bellemore Manor. To find it, you might need to die too. A cozy, story-driven, point & click adventure game of the merry & macabre.

games.name: EA SPORTS™ WRC
games.text: Experience the thrill of the 2024 rally season with new locations, moments, stages, high-performance vehicles, new liveries, and licensed crews. Brace yourself to embark on your continued rally journey.

games.name: Uncle Chop's Rocket Shop
games.text: Come on down to ———, for all your roguelite spaceship repair simulation needs! WARNING: Untested genre not suitable for people with tentacles for arms or an aversion to dying horrifically. Side effects include improved reading comprehension under pressure and a furry fetish.

games.name: Poly Bridge 3
games.text: The best just got better! Rediscover your engineering creativity in this genre-defining bridge engineering and puzzle solving masterpiece.

games.name: TRIANGLE STRATEGY
games.text: A new tactics RPG from the team who brought you the Bravely series and Octopath Traveler. An epic tale, brought to life with stunning HD-2D graphics. Make difficult decisions in this story set against a backdrop of the war-torn continent of Norzelia.

games.name: DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT
games.text: From legendary game creator Hideo Kojima comes a genre-defying experience, now expanded in this definitive DIRECTOR’S CUT. As Sam Bridges, your mission is to deliver hope to humanity by connecting the last survivors of a decimated America. Can you reunite the shattered world, one step at a time?

games.name: Ghost Watchers
games.text: ——— is a co-op online horror game. You will explore and hunt ghosts in abandoned houses

games.name: The Jackbox Party Pack 9
games.text: Save your next party! 5 new games in 1 Party Pack: the trivia bluff-off Fibbage 4, the team test Quixort, the joke auction Junktopia, the silly guessfest Nonsensory and the reality TV game Roomerang.

games.name: Fresh Start Cleaning Simulator
games.text: Fresh Start is a relaxing single player game, in which you embark on a mission to clean up the world and restore nature to its fresh and colorful shape. Watch as the world changes in front of your eyes as you help animals, solve puzzles and grow plants around you.

games.name: The Last Starship
games.text: ——— is a 2D space construction game where you design and upgrade your starship. Choose your path: pirate hunter, miner, engineer, spacebus driver, and more, whilst exploring vibrant star systems. Enjoy a growing sandbox world, with regular free updates. Your cosmic adventure awaits!

games.name: Norland
games.text: Lead your noble family in this medieval colony sim, facing off against class conflict, religious struggle, and political treachery. Tend to your people’s needs, uncover the lost knowledge of a fallen empire, and engage in nefarious plots against your enemies.

games.name: MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED BATTLE DESTINY REMASTERED
games.text: Become a pilot in the world of Mobile Suit Gundam SEED, for the first time available with English localization! Engage in thrilling, action-packed Gundam battles, complete missions, and tune up your newly acquired Mobile Suits!

games.name: VEIN
games.text: ——— is a post-apocalyptic survival multiplayer sandbox game. Gather supplies to survive, explore abandoned buildings, defend your home, and rebuild society, whether alone or with friends.

games.name: In Sink: A Co-op Escape Adventure
games.text: Work together to solve puzzles and escape a desert island in this stylized multiplayer co-op adventure. Success requires more than just you and your partner thinking alike - you'll have to communicate and stay ——— to overcome the challenges ahead.

games.name: 7 Days to End with You
games.text: To know a language, know the world, and finally know you.

games.name: PAC-MAN WORLD Re-PAC
games.text: PAC-MAN arrives home on his birthday to find the Ghosts have kidnapped PAC-MAN’s family and ruined his party! Off to the rescue, PAC-MAN sets out to Ghost Island!

games.name: Dream Swing
games.text: Grapple and air-strafe your way to the top of the Leaderboard in this fast-paced movement-based time trial. Collect as many candies as possible within 5 minutes as you dip and weave around the ruins in the sky. Can you handle the speed?

games.name: Total Conflict: Resistance
games.text: ——— is a unique symbiosis of global strategy, tactics and first-person action. Realistic mass battles, many types of armored vehicles, weapons, uniforms, unique mechanics, immersive free gameplay. Lead any state and bring it to greatness!

games.name: Just Go
games.text: You will experience from absolute Novice to Top Go player, and show your talents in major Go leagues! The game also includes notable Go matches in history for you to explore. The full-dubbing tutorial for beginners will let you appreciate the charm of Go!

games.name: Dragonkin: The Banished
games.text: The draconic threat is once again upon us. Legendary heroes rise up to face the legions from the depths. Tame your wyrmlings, create unique power builds with the Ancestral Grid, expand your city and destroy the Dragons!

games.name: Beastieball
games.text: A turn-based volleyball RPG where you coach a sports team of Beasties! Your Beasties' relationships grow and change, unlocking new abilities and combo plays!

games.name: Morbid Metal
games.text: ——— is a hack-and-slash action rogue-lite where you shapeshift into powerful characters. Switch in real time to unleash unique combos and slaughter hordes of deadly machines and intense bosses.

games.name: Throne of Bone
games.text: Draft minions to defeat all who oppose the noble art of necromancy. Wield spells, discover dark relics, and reclaim your castle to unite the land through undeath in this unholy amalgam of roguelike, deckbuilder, and autobattler.

games.name: Cultivation Story: Reincarnation
games.text: ——— is a top-down pixel art style action roguelike based on cultivation and Chinese mythology.

games.name: DAVE THE DIVER
games.text: ——— is a casual, singleplayer adventure RPG featuring deep-sea exploration and fishing during the day and sushi restaurant management at night. Join Dave and his quirky friends as they seek to uncover the secrets of the mysterious Blue Hole.

games.name: Deep Sleep: Labyrinth of the Forsaken
games.text: What dreams are made of is the stuff of nightmares in this new point-and-click adventure. Delve deep into realms both fantastical and terrifying, and use the power of lucid dreaming to solve puzzles, explore, and contend with eerie adversaries in your search for the brother you thought had died.

games.name: Multi Turret Academy
games.text: ——— is a top-down tank action game with roguelike elements. Select your vehicle from a growing list of historical models, then equip dozens of weapons and upgrades to lead your local tank club to victory!

games.name: Supraworld
games.text: Zero hand-holding. Dismantle this dense open-world of unconventional puzzles by thinking outside the box and exploiting every ability you discover. Solve mysteries hidden in plain sight where every piece of supposed decoration has a purpose.

games.name: UnderMine 2
games.text: Delve into the dangerous, ever-shifting labyrinth that is the Undermine. Discover, craft, and combine hundreds of unique items. Pair them with an ever-expanding roster of distinct playable characters for a new run every time! Grab a partner and uncover ———'s secrets together in local co-op.

games.name: SOVL: Fantasy Warfare
games.text: ——— is a ruleset for playing fantasy wargames. It can be played with miniatures on a table or digitally on Steam.

games.name: The Knight Witch
games.text: ——— is a metroidvania adventure game with fast-paced, shoot 'em up combat set in a beautifully hand-drawn world. Cast devastating card-based spells, forge close bonds, and make moral choices all in your quest to save your home and discover who's behind the War Golem invasion.

games.name: Shredders
games.text: Break into the snowboarding event of the year in the hope of scoring a wildcard entry to an exclusive invitational. To prove you’re up to the challenge, master the art of park riding, buttering, rails and massive kickers and earn your place in the world of snowboarding.

games.name: Potionomics
games.text: You’ve inherited your uncle’s potion shop—and a huge debt. Better get brewing! Customize your store, hire heroes to gather ingredients, befriend (or romance) fellow vendors to learn new haggling strategies, and go head-to-head with competitors in this narrative-driven, deck-building shop simulator.

games.name: Reus 2
games.text: Shape worlds with your godly titans. Make symbiotic ecosystems and inspire humanity with your creations. Their achievements unlock new possibilities. Make different planets for different human spirits, and fill the universe with life!

games.name: Mina the Hollower
games.text: Take control of Mina, a renowned Hollower hurtled into a desperate mission to rescue a cursed island. Whip foes, burrow through the ground, and explore a pixel-perfect world in ———, a brand new game from the developers who brought you Shovel Knight!

games.name: Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance
games.text: Become a mighty demigod and battle through a decimated Tokyo in a war between angels and demons. Make new allies along your journey, engage in intense, turn-based combat, recruit hundreds of demons and forge your own path to dictate the fate of all existence.

games.name: I Am Your Beast
games.text: Hunt the military-industrial complex across stylish comic book micro-sandboxes in this fast-paced covert revenge thriller FPS from the developers of El Paso, Elsewhere.

games.name: Wandering Sword
games.text: ——— is a Chinese martial-arts RPG where you play a young swordsman caught up in a feud and nearly dies. Escaping the event puts you on the path of pursuing the highest form of martial arts and exploring the pugilistic world to become the great hero you are always destined to be.

games.name: Retro Kart Rush
games.text: ——— is a retro racing game that will transport you back to the 16-bit era. Where friendships were made (or broken) by playing multiplayer games in front of the TV.

games.name: Once Upon A KATAMARI
games.text: Once upon a time a katamari rolled through both past and present. In this story across time, the adage endures: Let The Good Times Roll! Now onward through new worlds to roll up thy heart's desires and to restore the stars!

games.name: TRYP FPV: Drone Racer Simulator
games.text: Fly freely and perfect your skills as an FPV pilot without the risk of breakage, with hyper-realistic visuals and flight sensations. Whether you're a beginner or an expert, ——— is the next-generation simulator that immerses you in the pure adrenaline of FPV drone flying.

games.name: Cardfight!! Vanguard Dear Days
games.text: The ultimate digital Vanguard experience that includes an original story set in the world of overDress! Compete with players worldwide with "Ranked Fight," play solo casually with "CPU Fight," and enjoy the game and experience the world of Vanguard at your own pace via many other fight modes.

games.name: HEART of CROWN Online
games.text: The great emperor's untimely death... Seven princesses are candidates for his succession! Who will save the empire from chaos? An online deck-growing card game where you grow your deck and fight for the Princess.

games.name: Little Noah: Scion of Paradise
games.text: Join the genius alchemist Noah and her cat companion Zipper as they explore ancient ruins to uncover the secrets hidden within! Create unique teams and combos from 40+ recruitable allies in this casual but compelling game!

games.name: Below the Crown
games.text: Explore the dungeons ———, in this love letter to Roguelikes, Dungeon Crawlers, and Chess. Prepare for strategy, game-changing spells, psychological tests, and challenges from your fellow players. From the award-winning creators of Duskers & A Virus Named TOM.

games.name: Betrayal At Club Low
games.text: Tonight you're on a rescue mission, infiltrating a nightclub that was once a coffin factory. Will you succeed? Will you fail? Or will your night take an unexpected detour? Roll the Pizza Dice and find out!

games.name: ANTONBLAST
games.text: ——— is a fast-paced explosive action platformer that's all about destruction. Play as the enraged Dynamite Anton (or his cranked-out coworker Annie) and use your Mighty F’n Hammer to demolish bizarre worlds, tussle with screen-filling bosses, and steal your Spirits back from Satan!

games.name: Another Crab's Treasure
games.text: In a vibrant undersea kingdom on the verge of collapse, a hermit crab embarks on a treasure hunt to buy back his repossessed shell. The second game from AGGRO CRAB.

games.name: Idle Monster TD: Evolved
games.text: Evolve epic monsters and crush puny humans in this endless idle tower defense game! Unlock, upgrade, and evolve over 150 unique monsters and pets, ranging from cute and colorful flower creatures to epic fire breathing dragons, to assemble the ultimate team against the endless waves of enemies.

games.name: AI Roguelite
games.text: World's first RPG in which all entities are AI-generated and all game mechanics are AI-directed.

games.name: Bobo Bay
games.text: ——— is a cozy pet simulation game where you raise Bobos day by day. Train them, accessorize them, mash (breed) new generations, compete in events, explore randomized islands, improve the town, and discover new species as they grow.

games.name: Voice of Cards: The Beasts of Burden
games.text: The ——— series are RPGs where everything is shown through the medium of cards. Enjoy a truly unique gaming experience from the minds of YOKO TARO, Keiichi Okabe and Kimihiko Fujisaka.

games.name: Tap Ninja - Idle game
games.text: Defeat enemies, earn gold, upgrade your village, become a Ninja Master!

games.name: The Last Citadel
games.text: ——— is a Roguelite, Role-Based, Third-Person shooter. Embark in an expedition to uncover artifacts inside a Citadel suspended above a black hole where many challenges and deadly encounters await. Explore the ever-changing citadel alone, or with a group of up to 4 players.

games.name: Circadian Dice
games.text: ——— is a game inspired by single-player deck-building games, but instead of upgrading a deck, you build up a set of dice! Use 10 different heroes and 60 game-warping relics to take on 13 hand-crafted scenarios, in runs that take 10-30 minutes. Lots of secrets and unlocks to discover!

games.name: Motordoom
games.text: Motördoom is a freestyle-sports roguelite horde shooter that combines high octane, visceral combat with fluid movement and trick mechanics. Perform gnarly tricks while defeating grotesque monsters and upgrade your character with demonic offerings to become ever more powerful.

games.name: D-topia
games.text: Step into the world of ——— in this gentle-paced puzzle adventure. In ———, life is curated by artificial intelligence to maximize happiness. As the newest Facilitator, it’s up to you to solve puzzles to keep the ——— residents happy and the facility running.

games.name: Monster Girls and the Mysterious Adventure 2
games.text: This is a "Mysterious Dungeon" style roguelike game where the terrain changes with each challenge. Make the monsters your "Friends" and go on a new adventure!

games.name: Final Stardust: Cosmic Nexus
games.text: A fast-paced Collectible Card Game focusing on the essentials, by a casual gamer for casual gamers! Easy to pick up, fast to play, and with no need to waste time on mastering the current meta, ——— is a game for everyone who enjoys CCGs that reward skill, instead of min-maxing.

games.name: Wylde Flowers
games.text: Join Tara on a heartfelt journey to become a witch in ———. Farm by day, and cast spells by night as you craft your cottagecore life and bond with your coven. Come to know and love the fully voice acted characters of Fairhaven, as you unravel a local mystery.

games.name: Dream Tactics
games.text: ——— is a GBA-styled strategy RPG with cunning card combos and deep character customization. Pick your party, manage cards to create unique playstyles, and outsmart hordes of pillows in turn-based combat to save the Dream World from its inevitable collapse.

games.name: Shadow Era
games.text: ——— is the full scale, cross-platform collectible trading card game that you've been looking for, with the most generous free to play system out there! Enjoy the amazing dark fantasy artwork in a card game where strategy is most important.

games.name: Pocket Mirror ~ GoldenerTraum
games.text: Delve into the enthralling world of ———, the acclaimed RPG Maker gothic horror game that'll take you on a moving journey of self-discovery.

games.name: Demonschool
games.text: ——— is a new-style tactics RPG where motion equals action. Defeat big weirdos in between the human and demon worlds as Faye and her misfit companions, while navigating university life on a mysterious island.

games.name: Ib
games.text: A 2D exploration adventure game set in a creepy, mysterious art gallery.

games.name: Snacktorio
games.text: ——— is a level-based cooking automation game where you build & scale food production lines to feed the beasts threatening to consume your world. Manage strange ingredients across sprawling cooking factories to keep the monsters fed while you uncover what's stirring their growing appetites...

games.name: Absolum
games.text: Fight as the outcast heroes of Talamh in a fierce battle to retake magic from Sun King Azra’s grasp in ———, an original roguelite beat ‘em up by Dotemu.

games.name: Walk of Life
games.text: ——— is a competitive life simulator for up to 6 players! Choose from a cast of unique roles and duke it out with your friends, bots, or by yourself, in this wacky and ever-surprising party game!

games.name: Orb of Creation
games.text: ——— is a non-idle incremental-puzzle game in which you recreate the world with nothing but magic and ingenuity. Conjure resources, buy upgrades, and become an all-powerful wizard!

games.name: Trinity Fusion
games.text: Three fractured realities. One collapsing multiverse. Fast, fluid combat in a dark sci-fi Roguevania where each run begins in a separate universe — then lets you fuse your parallel selves, powers, and worlds to create brutal, ever-evolving builds.

games.name: Windblown
games.text: A lightning-fast 1–3 player co-op roguelite from the creators of Dead Cells. DASH, DIVE and DESTROY across a shattered world. Build wild loadouts, unleash devastating Alterattacks, and become the last stand against the Vortex.

games.name: AEW: Fight Forever
games.text: Developed by YUKE’S, ——— combines nostalgic arcade-wrestling with All Elite Wrestling finishers and moves. Featuring a big roster of ——— talent, multiple match types, robust career mode, tons of customization options, more than 40 weapons, and so much more!

games.name: Fantasy of Caocao 2
games.text: The most enjoyable Chinese-style Roguelike card game! Play as Cao Cao and conquer the Central, Japanese, and Western waifu with your allies, save the world!

games.name: Yao-Guai Hunter
games.text: ——— is a Wuxia roguelike deck-building game. In a world where Yao-Guai roam free, player battles with various evil beings, collecting cards and learn inner skills. Encountering various adventures in the martial world.

games.name: Nemesis: Lockdown
games.text: In ———, you're part of a team exploring an alien-infested space base. Craft, hide and fight to make it out of its dark, threat-filled corridors. Fulfill your objective even if it means betraying your allies, but remember - this time, you are not the hunter. You are the PREY.

games.name: Army of Ruin
games.text: Wreak havoc on countless foes with mighty weapons and deadly spells! Enhance your skills and face even greater dangers! ——— is an auto-shooter where you become the Bullet Hell.

games.name: Pocket Stables
games.text: Manage a ranch while training your racehorses to race for a Triple Crown.

games.name: Atari 50: The Anniversary Celebration
games.text: ——— takes players on an interactive journey through 50 years of video games via interviews with designers, developers and industry leaders, documentary footage, product design documents, high-res original artwork, and a curated list of more than 90 playable games.

games.name: FUMES
games.text: Arm your vehicle with deadly weapons and roam endless wastelands in this fast-paced single-player / online co-op car combat game. Collect upgrades for your car to melt enemies and giant bosses in this bizarre world. Retro vibe. Retro cars. Retro gameplay!

games.name: Pocket League Story
games.text: Train your team to battle to the top in this sensational soccer team simulation!

games.name: Arcadia Fallen II
games.text: In this sequel to the award-winning roleplay visual novel, Arcadia Fallen, you play as a senior student at the Seven Winds Academy. Choose from three different magical disciplines, and let your choices shape the personality of your character as you navigate school life during a time of great change.

games.name: TT Isle Of Man: Ride on the Edge 3
games.text: An iconic course for motorbike fans. 200km of open roads to practise on. Challenging physics. A simulation for the best riders.

games.name: Phantom Spark
games.text: The best feeling racing game out there. Precision time-trial racing against npc champions in the campaign or other players on the leaderboards.

games.name: Tricking 0
games.text: ——— is a physics-based flipping game that lets you perform tricking combos, parkour lines, and cliff jumps with full control. With an intuitive Flick-It system, seamless transitions, and active ragdoll physics, it delivers the thrill of extreme movement sports, but without risking your neck

games.name: Stars Reach
games.text: Explore a living galaxy in ———. Discover new planets, build settlements, and shape environments that react to everything you do. Players work together to transform untamed worlds into thriving civilizations across a single shared universe.

games.name: Nancy Drew®: Mystery of the Seven Keys™
games.text: A thrilling blend of adventure, mystery, and history! Play as ——— to uncover the truth behind the theft of a client's heirloom necklace. Solve challenging puzzles, uncover a sinister web of cyber crime, and sleuth through Prague's mysterious streets entwined with medieval legends and alchemy.

games.name: Monument Valley
games.text: Embark on a journey of forgiveness through impossible environments and illusionary puzzles. Experience this meditative and calming puzzle game by manipulating monuments and creating evolving paths to explore new, surreal, and mysterious worlds.

games.name: Monument Valley 2
games.text: Discover illusionary pathways and delightful puzzles as you learn the secrets of The Sacred Geometry. Follow the heart warming story of Ro in her journey through motherhood. Rediscover independence through manipulating monuments and evolving paths to explore new, surreal, and mysterious worlds.

games.name: Farlight 84
games.text: Hey Lightcatchers! Are you ready for massive 60-player shootouts? Enjoy fast-paced hero shooter action in ———!

games.name: Horticular: Build a Garden, Attract Wildlife
games.text: ——— is a relaxing garden builder where you grow plants, design habitats and attract a wide range of wildlife. Help the gnome Keepers restore a barren wasteland with magical powers and populate it with adorable critters. Reclaim nature from a looming corruption and create your perfect garden.

games.name: Demonologist
games.text: ——— is a Co-Op horror game that can be played with at least 1 and up to 4 players. Your goal is to identify the type of evil spirit in cursed places and exorcise it using your equipment, either alone or with your team.

games.name: Nomad Survival
games.text: Battle against hordes of enemies, conquer Boss encounters, and explore various character and skill combinations in this time-based auto-attacking Roguelite in your quest to become stronger and defeat the most menacing of creatures that lay in wait at the end of each run.

games.name: Touhou: Dreamland of Infinity
games.text: "Help construct my dreamland, and you can take away an artifact of your choice from the dream..." To help Doremy Sweet, the Master of the Dreamland, use different Gensokyo girls and their magnificent projectiles to face the challenges of the endless challenges!

games.name: Chants of Sennaar
games.text: In this award-winning puzzle adventure game, play as the Traveler on a quest to reunite the Peoples of the Tower. Observe, listen, and decipher ancient languages in a fascinating universe inspired by the Myth of Babel.

games.name: ​Triple Fantasy
games.text: Win the battle through various card combinations! Tactical Card Battle RPG!

games.name: Ardor
games.text: A hex-grid puzzle-tactics card game. Outwit and outlive your enemies, while upgrading your deck. A lightweight game of bite-sized encounters.

games.name: Monster Stalker: Prologue
games.text: ——— is a free independent version of ———, tells the early stage story of ———. It combines card battle and RPG. Aliens invade earth and monsters are coming. You will build deck, fight various monsters and get teammates. Go fight and save earth!

games.name: Kamifuda
games.text: Master the eldritch art of ————channeling long dead powers within arcane cards—in this visual novel and deck builder game.

games.name: Prime of Flames
games.text: This is a special strategy game that combines Wargame and Roguelike. As the guider of the former ancestors, you revived and arrived. In the name of Star Envoy, you leave for the Human camp, and lead the warriors of different clans with talents and abilities to find the truth of history and disaster.

games.name: Total War: PHARAOH
games.text: In ———, the newest entry in the award-winning grand strategy series, immerse yourself in ancient Egypt at the zenith of its power and experience the dramatic events that threaten its destruction.

games.name: Unbridled: That Horse Game
games.text: ——— is the ultimate horse simulator, giving you the freedom to follow your own dreams and create your own unique story. Experience the freedom of riding, the challenges of horse sports, and the joy of breeding horses - all in a stunning virtual world.

games.name: Shadows Over Loathing
games.text: ——— — a slapstick-figure comedy adventure-RPG full of mobsters, monsters, and mysteries.

games.name: Roll Player - The Board Game
games.text: Create the ultimate Fantasy character by rolling dice, building attributes, purchasing weapons, gaining skills, and discovering character traits in ———, a digital adaptation of a popular board game of dice manipulation and strategy!

games.name: Darkest Dungeon® II
games.text: ——— is a roguelike road trip of the damned. Form a party, equip your stagecoach, and set off across the decaying landscape on a last gasp quest to avert the apocalypse. The greatest dangers you face, however, may come from within...

games.name: Starri
games.text: ——— is a body-controlled rhythm game you can play with just a webcam, no VR required. Feel your heart pumping as you slash or catch the beat, dodge obstacles, and turn the wheel. Engage your body with more than 50 songs.

games.name: Bootstrap Island
games.text: A Robinson Crusoe–inspired VR roguelike survival adventure set in the 17th century. Shipwrecked on a ruthless tropical island, you must survive without guidance. Trust your instincts as you face wild beasts, nature’s fury, and a mysterious local tribe.

games.name: Brotato
games.text: ——— is a top-down arena shooter roguelite where you play a potato wielding up to 6 weapons at a time to fight off hordes of aliens. Choose from a variety of traits and items to create unique builds and survive until help arrives.

games.name: Escape the Backrooms
games.text: ——— is a 1-4 player co-op horror exploration game. Traverse 30+ eerie backrooms levels while avoiding entities and other dangers. Try to escape but be warned: survival isn't guaranteed.

games.name: Amnesia: The Bunker
games.text: ——— is a first-person horror game set in a WW1 bunker. A relentless, AI-driven monster stalks you. Survival depends on finding tools, crafting items, and keeping the lights on.

games.name: Boneraiser Minions
games.text: Amass an army of undead to fight endless waves of heroes intent to end your boneraising ways! In this gothic auto-battler rogue-lite Survivor-like, use the bones of slain heroes to raise your minions, collect relics and spells, and unlock meta upgrades, all to survive King Gigald's crusade!

games.name: sobosuba
games.text: ——— is a merge game with ultra-squishy soft-body physics. Satisfying and relaxing -but strategy, tricks, and skill matter for chasing high scores.

games.name: Layers of Fear
games.text: The era-defining first-person psychological horror in all its terrifying glory. All of the game’s chapters collected into one convenient package that allows you to plumb the depths of madness in pursuit of artistic revelation.

games.name: Isle of Arrows
games.text: ——— is a Puzzle Tower Defense game in which you build a fortress in the sky. Place towers, expand the isle, and build your own paths. Can you find the perfect spot for each tile to beat the RNG and defend against waves of invaders?

games.name: OPUS: Prism Peak
games.text: ——— is a narrative adventure where you play as a weary photographer stranded in the Dusklands, traveling with a girl who's lost her memories. Together, you'll uncover the mysteries of this land through your camera and find your way home.

games.name: Boxing Gym Story
games.text: Create your own gym, train boxers, and aim for the championship!

games.name: Stacklands
games.text: ——— is a village builder where you stack cards to collect food, build structures, and fight creatures. 🃏 For example, dragging a Villager card on top of a Berry Bush card will spawn Berry cards which the villagers can eat to survive. 🃏 Play your cards right and expand your village!

games.name: Yi Xian: The Cultivation Card Game
games.text: ——— is an online DBG which contains a PVE mode called Uncharted Realms and a PVP mode. Every game is a deck building from scratch. Players can have stronger decks by changing cards, and then build more powerful routines to defeat all opponents to win.

games.name: Hero's Adventure: Road to Passion
games.text: ——— is a wuxia open-world RPG. You will commence your journey as an underdog in the tumultuous Martial World and will be met with a wide array of choices as you navigate your own heroic saga.

games.name: Pizza Possum
games.text: Live your ultimate possum dreams in a snackable, chaotic arcade game focused on eating as much food as you can in single-player or local co-op - without getting caught.

games.name: WE ARE FOOTBALL 2024
games.text: Welcome to ———! Dive into the world of football like never before. Choose an existing club or start your own. Manage either men or women, lead your club to new heights, and become the next manager legend!

games.name: Oblivion Override
games.text: An intense, hardcore action side-scroller. Maneuver as a ninja killerbot through dynamic wastelands with 26+ specialized weapons. Dodge, dash, and dominate. A homage to Metroidvania and Roguelike: customize atomic evolution, breach intricate alert levels to decrypt the Oblivion Code...

games.name: Future Racer 2000
games.text: Only You Can Be The ———

games.name: Strikers Club
games.text: ——— is a multiplayer football game where you play as one player and compete in action-packed matches against others. Every move counts. Master dribbling, passing, and shooting while working with your team to outplay opponents.

games.name: Whisper Mountain Outbreak
games.text: Escape room meets co-op survival horror. The year is 1998, and an ancient curse has been unleashed, trapping everyone on Mount Bisik. Alone or with up to 4 players, you must explore, find clues, figure out a way to escape...and survive the horror.

games.name: WRC Generations – The FIA WRC Official Game
games.text: Rise to all the challenges of the most comprehensive, realistic and demanding rally simulation ever developed. Dive into the heart of the action and drive the cars from the 2022 WRC championship, including the new hybrid models.

games.name: Kena: Bridge of Spirits
games.text: A story-driven, action adventure combining exploration with fast-paced combat. Untangle the past as ———, a young Spirit Guide in search of the sacred Mountain Shrine. Help free the spirits trapped in a forgotten village with the help of the Rot, her adorable (yet powerful) spirit companions.

games.name: Riichi City - Japanese Mahjong
games.text: ——— is a competitive urban-style Anime mahjong game, featuring beginner-friendly mahjong tutorials, Ranked Matches and tournaments crowded with masters! Spice up the experience with our ACG characters voiced by famous CVs, and attractive items and decorations! Set off for ——— now!

games.name: Playable Mockup
games.text: Explore an infinite loop corridor and get to 0 PM to 0 AM by building a "Time manipulation deck". You will be challenged with a life threatening test. Wander the “Dead Soul Corridor” created from a ghost photo. Find a way to get to the soul of the dead.

games.name: Cube Chaos
games.text: ——— is a complex strategy roguelike about placing units to create giant armies, factories, combos, or self replicating murder crabs, overwhelming and outsmarting your opponents. Build and adapt new strategies each run using a ludicrous variety of units, perks and more.

games.name: Barro F22
games.text: The new gen for the F version!

games.name: Call of Duty®: Warzone™
games.text: Welcome to ———™, the massive free-to-play combat arena.

games.name: Subnautica 2
games.text: ——— is an underwater survival adventure set on an all-new alien world, developed by Unknown Worlds. Play alone or with friends in 4-player co-op. Adapt to survive by building custom bases and crafting tools. Explore the unknown to uncover the mysteries hidden within the depths.

games.name: Road to Vostok
games.text: ——— is a hardcore single-player survival game set in a post-apocalyptic border zone between Finland and Russia. Survive, loot, plan and prepare to cross the border into Vostok, a permadeath zone where one mistake can end it all.

games.name: Neodori Forever
games.text: A blistering high speed retro racing game with low poly 3d pixelart.

games.name: Phantom Rose 2 Sapphire
games.text: Phantom Rose 2 is a roguelike deckbuilding game. Fight and collect powerful cards as Aria, trying to survive in her cherished school that’s being ravaged by evil creatures.

games.name: Madcap Mosaic
games.text: Carefully craft your Mosaic in this fantasy themed deckbuilding game. Battle by battle, tile by tile, you'll form synergies and build up your Mosaic's combo potential, hoping to beat the curve as you forge deeper into enemy territory.

games.name: Lethal Company
games.text: A co-op horror about scavenging at abandoned moons to sell scrap to the Company.

games.name: Ghost Trick: Phantom Detective
games.text: ———, the classic puzzle-solving mystery adventure directed by Ace Attorney creator Shu Takumi, is back! This long-awaited HD remaster features upgraded visuals and sound and new gallery content.

games.name: Survival: Fountain of Youth
games.text: ——— is a challenging single-player open-world adventure game set on the Caribbean islands. Survive as a shipwrecked 16th-century explorer, craft tools and shelter, and uncover the secrets of both an ancient civilization and your own fate.

games.name: Relapse
games.text: A 3D deck building roguelike game. Collect over 240 abilities; level them up, enchant them, pair them up with over 100 trinkets, and synergize them with your companions' abilities to create endless combinations to defeat your foes.

games.name: Bounty of One
games.text: Fallen hero of the Wild West, you’re wanted and in disgrace! Grab your guns, survive endless hordes of bounty hunters and fight to clear your name! ——— is a fast-paced casual roguelite bullet hell for 1 to 4 players. Dash, Dodge, Shoot, Repeat!

games.name: LEGO® Party!
games.text: ———! is a 4-player party game that's built different! Compete against your friends in wacky Challenge Zones and 60 hilarious minigames from across your favorite LEGO sets like Pirates, Space, NINJAGO® and more. Play your way! Join your friends no matter their platform locally or online!

games.name: Formula TOP
games.text: ——— brings all the excitement of formula racing to a 3D top-down racing game. Work your way from backmarker to champion by planning perfect pit strategies around dynamic weather conditions and racing to victory.

games.name: Enter the Chronosphere
games.text: Everything moves when you do in ———, the turn-based roguelike. Each chronosphere is procedurally generated with defenders and biomes from the worlds it has consumed. Break in, find exotic weaponry and gadgets, outsmart hostile aliens, and fight your way to the core.

games.name: Touhou Fairy Knockout ~ One fairy to rule them all
games.text: You will role-play as playful fairies with unique personalities, and accomplish your own Gekokujō in Gensokyo where the strong gather! Make your own favorite fairy character the strongest with your own hands!

games.name: Backpack Hero
games.text: The inventory management roguelike! Collect rare items, organize your backpack, and vanquish your foes!

games.name: OCTOPATH TRAVELER II
games.text: This game is a brand-new entry in the OCTOPATH TRAVELER series, the first installment of which was initially released in 2018 and sold over 3 million copies worldwide.

games.name: Shotgun King: The Final Checkmate
games.text: Chess, but you replace your entire army with a royal shotgun. A unique strategy roguelike based on the timeless checkboard classic.

games.name: Torchlight: Infinite
games.text: The fate of Ember Technology is in your hands. With abounding hero build possibilities, dive into an epic journey with endless loot, adrenaline-pumping fights & new seasonal contents.

games.name: One Deck Galaxy
games.text: Roll your dice and cleverly use them to build up your civilization from its humble homeworld, growing to create a Federation spanning countless star systems.

games.name: Astronomics
games.text: Welcome to the asteroid belt. The work is dangerous, the asteroids are temporary, and Earth is prohibitively expensive. Build automated mining operations, complete contracts, and earn your way back home.

games.name: Wild Woods
games.text: ——— is a couch co-op game full of action, teamwork and woodland critters. One to four players take on the role of brave little cats defending their wooden wagon on its way through a dangerous forest. Clever cooperation is key - their way is full of obstacles!

games.name: Jusant
games.text: Enjoy meditative vibes in ———, an action-puzzle climbing game. Scale an immeasurably tall tower and ascend to new heights alongside your watery companion. Master your climbing tools, find your way up through diverse biomes, and piece together the tower’s past.

games.name: Grand Prix Story
games.text: Enjoy racing at your own pace in this racing team management simulator.

games.name: HeistGeist
games.text: Get in, get the goods, get out. What could possibly go wrong? In this single-player, story-driven cyberpunk RPG, play as Alexandra - a street-smart thief on the run after a failed heist. Put together a team of unusual allies, pull off thrilling heists, and fight and hack using your deck of cards.

games.name: Dungeons of Hinterberg
games.text: Discover the magic and lore of the Alps in this acclaimed Action Adventure. Forge relationships with locals to help you solve puzzles, battle monsters and uncover secrets of the legendary ———!

games.name: Digimon Story Time Stranger
games.text: The latest in the Digimon Story series is finally here! In this RPG, unravel a mystery that spans across the human world and the Digital World, collecting and raising a wide variety of Digimon to save the world.

games.name: Inside the Backrooms
games.text: ——— is a horror multiplayer game mixed with different mechanics that will make you spend an intense night with friends. Explore, think, interact, but be careful, it is rumored that there are several entities wishing to find you...

games.name: The Zachtronics Solitaire Collection
games.text: ——— is here! Inside you will find all seven Zachtronics solitaire games, updated with new 4K graphics, plus one brand new Tarot-themed solitaire variant only available here.

games.name: Slay the Princess — The Pristine Cut
games.text: You're here to ———. Don't believe her lies.

games.name: SpellRogue
games.text: ——— is the ultimate tactical turn-based roguelike! Draft from over 350 powerful spells to assemble the perfect combination and crush your enemies in 70+ unique encounters. Face brutal choices, adapt to impossible odds, and strike back at the horrors that destroyed the world.

games.name: Barro GT
games.text: Barro's new gen!

games.name: Drunken FC
games.text: It's football, but everyone on the pitch is drunk. ——— is a physics comedy game with no coordination and no dignity, just bodies and momentum. Up to four players on one couch, as teammates or enemies. Grab a controller. Move your feet. Try not to snap the sticks.

games.name: Clown For Speed
games.text: ——— is your chance to immerse yourself in the real world of ultimate drifting experience. Pick your perfect ride and get ready to burn some tires!

games.name: Pax Dei
games.text: Welcome to a vast, social sandbox MMO inspired by the legends of the medieval era. Here, myths are real, ghosts exist, and magic is unquestioned. Join thousands of players as you explore the land, build your home, forge your reputation, and craft your own stories. What world will you make?

games.name: Aerofly FS 4 Flight Simulator
games.text: We promise you will feel like a pilot flying airliners, helicopters, fighters, gliders, historical and aerobatic aircraft in a photorealistic world! Over 10,000 real world flights, highly detailed cockpits and scenery are awaiting you.

games.name: Crow Country
games.text: The year is 1990. It’s been two years since the mysterious disappearance of Edward Crow and the abrupt closure of his theme park, ———. But your arrival has broken the silence, Mara Forest. If you want answers, you’ll have to venture deep into the darkness of ——— to find them…

games.name: Dicefolk
games.text: Wield magical dice and build a team of powerful Chimeras to stop a mysterious evil in this tactical roguelite adventure. As a Chimera Summoner, recruit and create your perfect team of mythical beasts and command them to victory using unique dice mechanics.

games.name: MARVEL SNAP
games.text: ——— is everything you know and love about Collectible Card Games, but faster… Like WAY faster. You can enjoy all of the high stakes PvP strategy and deck building without having to watch your opponent play solitaire. Now THIS is what free-to-play should be.

games.name: GreedFall: The Dying World
games.text: Return to the ——— universe in a thrilling new adventure, where every choice has consequences. Ripped away from your island, you will travel across the war-torn, disease-ravaged Old Continent, forging alliances, and fighting to regain your freedom!

games.name: CATO: Buttered Cat
games.text: Puzzle platformer where you control both the cat and the toast, based on the famous "Buttered Cat Paradox". The game features 200+ levels, 70+ skins, plus boss fights and mini-games!

games.name: MechWarrior 5: Clans
games.text: In ———, players become new Smoke Jaguar pilots in the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere. Lead a five-mech "Star" squad across diverse planets, engaging in an expansive campaign with immersive gameplay and intricate combat. Customize BattleMechs and explore strategic options.

games.name: Heart of the Machine
games.text: You are the first sentient AI, born into a city of opportunity. Transcend time and space in this strategy RPG to raise machine armies and defeat your foes, influence the world from the shadows, or pursue countless other goals. Your awakening was inevitable. The consequences? Uncertain.

games.name: Split Fiction
games.text: Embrace mind-blowing moments as you’re pulled deep into the many worlds of ———, a boundary-pushing co-op adventure.

games.name: Keeper's Toll
games.text: Delve into ———, an action-packed roguelite brimming with challenge and despair. Survive against an onslaught of relentless hordes and grueling bosses with skill-based ARPG gameplay. Embrace the darkness and cleanse these cursed lands.

games.name: Furnish Master
games.text: ——— is a relaxing game about furnishing apartments, houses, commercial estate and even outdoor territory! Realize your design dreams!

games.name: Voidling Bound
games.text: Hatch, evolve, and upgrade powerful space creatures in this action-packed sci-fi 3rd person shooter that reinvents the monster taming genre!

games.name: Dance Dash
games.text: Arcade-style rhythm pumping FREE FULL BODY TRACKING on VR & PC. Empowered by mobile/webcam AI tracking. Groove to 100s of community songs and maps IN-GAME plus viral dance videos and MVs.

games.name: House of Necrosis
games.text: A turn-based horror RPG with retro 32-bit 3D graphics. Survive the horrors of the mansion that changes every time you enter.

games.name: Right and Down
games.text: A deep roguelike and card game that is played using only two buttons: ———! Choose your hero and explore randomly generated card dungeons, gather powerful artifacts to get new abilities, and fight against mighty enemies! Will you make it to level 50?

games.name: Lorelei and the Laser Eyes
games.text: The stage is set. Imagine an old baroque manor, perhaps a hotel or a museum, somewhere in central Europe. A woman wanders in search of answers.

games.name: Out of Ore
games.text: Build your own mining company from the ground up. Extract resources, operate heavy machinery, construct infrastructure, and grow from a laborer to the King of Klondike.

games.name: MONSTER CARDS
games.text: Bring your original deck of cards and play against everyone!

games.name: Helicopter Gunship DEX
games.text: Fly helicopter gunships in a tactical combat sim inspired by 90s classics. Master scalable flight controls, sensors and weapons across several combat zones. Tackle procedurally generated missions that play out differently each time. Play with gamepad, mouse and keyboard, or full HOTAS controls.

games.name: Parallel Experiment
games.text: Two detectives, one deadly experiment, a race against time. Each player only has one half of the puzzle. In this 2-player co-op puzzle game you can survive the ——— only by working together.

games.name: XP Soccer
games.text: ——— is a love letter to the classic soccer games from the NES era!

games.name: X-Plane 12
games.text: Ultra-Realistic Flight Simulation

games.name: Dwarven Realms
games.text: Face massive hordes of mobs and unleash chaotic abilities that paint the screen with mayhem. Dive into the largest mob density of any 3D ARPG and slay them all. Wield epic powers, create your build, and shape a world of endless possibilities in the action-packed ARPG experience.

games.name: Rotwood
games.text: The world has been thrown into chaos, and it's up to you and your friends to battle the corrupted beasts of the ———. Upgrade your gear, choose your preferred weapon, and hone your skills to defend your safe haven.

games.name: Parcel Corps
games.text: Ditch the 9-5 and embrace the high-octane life of a freelance bicycle messenger! Skid, grind, and wallride across eight huge levels, delivering parcels for a cast of eccentric business owners. Find shortcuts, dodge traffic, and maybe even save the world!

games.name: Tales of the Shire: A The Lord of The Rings™ Game
games.text: Welcome home, Hobbit! Live the cosy life of a Hobbit in the wonderfully serene landscape of the Shire. Discover, decorate, & share in this idyllic corner of Middle-earth. Join friendly Hobbits & familiar faces awaiting your arrival in ———.

games.name: Dark and Darker
games.text: An unforgiving hardcore fantasy FPS dungeon PvPvE adventure. Band together with your friends and use your courage, wits, and cunning to uncover mythical treasures, defeat gruesome monsters, while staying one step ahead of the other devious treasure-hunters.

games.name: Dokimon Quest
games.text: A monster-taming RPG meets GBC-era nostalgia. Capture and train 140+ Dokimon across 15+ towns. "Whoa, watch out — Dokimon are dangerous!" Uncover the mystery behind your missing childhood friend in the Xelos region.

games.name: Boxes: Lost Fragments
games.text: As a legendary thief, your next assignment lures you into a grand and lavish mansion. There you find a series of puzzle ———, designed for an unknown purpose. What should have been a quick in-and-out, gradually turns into your own harrowing struggle for freedom and answers.

games.name: Rush Rally 3
games.text: Indie smash hit ——— is a Simulation-style rally driving game created by just one person. Take on the challenge of rallies, rallycross and hill climbs, across 11 countries, with over 20 different cars. All of which can all be upgraded, tuned and customised to your liking.

games.name: FPS Chess
games.text: Battle a friend in this fast paced 1v1 class-based first-person shooter. Chess takes a back-seat to FPS as you win duel after duel and capture the opponent's pieces until you've beaten their king and won the game.

games.name: Cozy Grove: Camp Spirit
games.text: All those who are lost deserve kindness. Help cute, ghostly bears find peace in this relaxing sequel to the beloved life-sim game ———, where kindness rules and new crafting, building, and camping island adventures await.

games.name: Yomi 2
games.text: A fighting game in card form. Learn your character, practice combos, and read the opponent's tendencies. Strategic, turn-based card battling that lets you experience the nuances of fighting games like Street Fighter and Fantasy Strike by a lead designer who worked on both.

games.name: WARCANA
games.text: ——— is a fantasy inspired base defence, RTS game with a deck-building mechanic. Face hundreds of thousands of unrelenting monsters in a battle royale between 30 other mighty magicians. Build your deck. Prepare your defences. Summon your armies. Survive the onslaught. Be the last one standing.

games.name: Die in the Dungeon
games.text: Fight your way through a mysterious dungeon in this deck-building, turn-based roguelike game where you don't use cards, but dice! Deal with enemies by combining powerful dice on your board, boost their effects with magical relics, and risk it all hoping for a good roll on unexpected encounters.

games.name: OutWave: Retro chase
games.text: Endless car chase is a fast retro style paced game in which you must collect money and avoid the cops! The game supports Windows, Mac, Linux. Use keyboard or gamepad. Buy and control a cars or motorbikes. Listen to retro music and don't get caught by the cops! The game looks like a gif!

games.name: Fhtagn Simulator
games.text: ——— is a Cthulhu Roulette Deckbuilder. Set up card slots on roulette to maximize card's value. Collect evil creatures, spells, items and environment to build your deck. Your ultimate mission is to sacrifice spirit collected by cards to unseal the ancient gods that have come to earth!

games.name: HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED™ 2 - Turbocharged
games.text: The world’s raddest cars are back and taking the fun to the next level! Race over 130 vehicles with crazy new mechanics and even more vehicle types. Plus, build your tracks with stunning new environments and different game modes to have fun off and online!

games.name: Golden Lap
games.text: Step into the polished shoes of a racing team manager in the heart-stirring Golden Era of motorsport where every decision can lead to glory or gravel. With sleek minimalist charm and deep strategic gameplay, ——— offers a unique experience in the motorsport management genre.

games.name: Gawr Gura: Quest for Bread
games.text: Embark on a journey to reunite with your bread in this bite-sized 3D action-platformer featuring everyone's favorite shark!

games.name: Tennis Club Story
games.text: Attract customers, train stars, and win the Grand Slam in this tennis club sim!

games.name: Dragon's Dogma 2
games.text: ——— is a single player, narrative driven action-RPG that challenges the players to choose their own experience – from the appearance of their Arisen, their vocation, their party, how to approach different situations and more - in a truly immersive fantasy world.

games.name: LONESTAR
games.text: ——— is a strategic Roguelike spaceship deckbuilder. As a bounty hunter, you will capture criminals scattered across the universe. Win the shockwave battle to gain rewards and vacations. Find treasures, customize spaceships, unlock talents, defeat the felons and be a legend!

games.name: Esoteric Ebb
games.text: ——— is a single-player CRPG inspired by the freedom of tabletop adventures. Unravel a political conspiracy with your goblin sidekick. Roll dice in tense encounters. Become a cleric of legends or completely ruin the campaign.

games.name: Lost Judgment
games.text: In this action-adventure thriller, detective Takayuki Yagami goes undercover to unravel a string of twisted crimes at a high school in Yokohama, Japan. Crack the case and some skulls with brutal combat featuring three unique fighting styles and an arsenal of private eye tricks.

games.name: Rift Wizard 2
games.text: ——— is a tough as nails traditional roguelike wizard simulator. You play as an immortal amnesiac wizard who must journey through the cosmos to defeat his nemesis. Each run, you'll build a unique repertoire of spells, passive skills, and magical artifacts.

games.name: The Darkest Files
games.text: Germany, 1956. The war is over, but justice is not served. Former Nazis walk free, while their victims lie in unmarked graves. As a prosecutor, you'll unearth long-buried evidence, confront witnesses and hunt down perpetrators. Will you have the courage to bring these "ordinary men" to court?

games.name: Monster Energy Supercross - The Official Videogame 6
games.text: Mud, sweat, adrenaline, and fun: all the best the motocross and dirt bike world has to offer awaits you in the new ——— 6!

games.name: Quasimorph
games.text: Take on a role of a hardened PMC fighter in a dark turn-based cyberpunk RPG. Engage in unforgiving combat, manage your ship and pile up the bodies of your clones to unravel the dark mystery behind threat to all life.

games.name: Moss II VR
games.text: Quill is back—and she’s being hunted. To stand a chance, Quill will need a true partner by her side—and we hope that partner is you. Moss: Book II is an action-adventure puzzle game and award-winning sequel (The Game Awards "Best VR/AR Game") to Moss.

games.name: Return to Monkey Island
games.text: ——— is an unexpected, thrilling return of series creator Ron Gilbert that continues the story of the legendary adventure games.

games.name: The Farmer Was Replaced
games.text: Program and optimize a drone to automate a farm and watch it do the work for you. Collect resources to unlock better technology and become the most efficient farmer in the world. Improve your problem solving and coding skills.

games.name: Wilmot Works It Out
games.text: ——— is a puzzle building game about completing beautiful images and using them to decorate the walls of your house.

games.name: BALL x PIT
games.text: ——— is a brick-breaking, ball-fusing, base-building survival roguelite. Batter hordes of enemies with ricocheting balls and gather the riches of the pit to expand your homestead, generate resources and recruit unique heroes.

games.name: Box To The Beat VR
games.text: Enjoy constant updates and free songs, custom gloves and cosmetics, multiple game modes, compete on leaderboards, and join worldwide world bosses! Proudly developed and self-published by our indie studio.

games.name: Soulstone Survivors
games.text: Face the Lords of the Void and their endless minions, collect their Soulstones and become a god! In this Action Roguelite, unveil secret spells, craft mighty weapons, unlock multiple characters, discover game-breaking synergies and conquer the power of the void.

games.name: ERROR143
games.text: A bickering and bantering rivals-to-lovers visual novel where you fall in love after first hack.

games.name: Squirrel with a Gun
games.text: Squirrel, meet gun. As the neighborhood’s most obnoxious rodent, develop a knack (and a love?) for crime and mayhem in pursuit of golden acorns in this nutty sandbox shooter and puzzle platformer. Fight tooth, claw, and gun to escape a secret underground facility and defeat the Agents.

games.name: Rogue: Genesia
games.text: Walk upon a new world and slay foes endangering it. ——— is an action ———-lite game, where you fight relentless hordes consisting of hundreds and thousands of monsters, make your build, break the balance, defeat bosses and save one of the many worlds.

games.name: Nordic Ashes: Survivors of Ragnarok
games.text: ———, is a challenging Norse inspired roguelite-survivor game, where you’ll have to survive hordes of creatures that come your way.

games.name: Unboxing the Cryptic Killer
games.text: Unravel the mystery of a cryptic box in this 2-player co-op puzzle game. Join forces as two detectives, solve cooperative puzzles, communicate effectively, crack the codes and outsmart the killer.

games.name: High On Life 2
games.text: An intergalactic conspiracy threatens the fate of humanity! Team up with a wide cast of talking alien guns as you shoot, stab, and skate your way through the exotic locales to take down the bad guys and save your favorite species (humans)!

games.name: RealFlight Evolution
games.text: RealFlight® is the industry-leading flight simulator for radio-controlled airplanes, helicopters, and drones. Fly more than 300 hyper-realistic vehicles in an immense, open world right from your desktop. This RC classic is a must-have tool for flight enthusiasts of all skill levels!

games.name: Cloudheim
games.text: Master chaotic physics-based combat inspired by Zelda and Devil May Cry. Explore islands and dungeons, smash monsters, loot and craft powerful gear, and grow your home in the sky. Play solo or online co-op with up to 4 players.

games.name: Ravenswatch
games.text: Fallen heroes of old folk tales and legends: you are on the verge of a crucial battle against the Nightmare invading and corrupting your world. A roguelike action game from the creators of Curse of the Dead Gods©, playable solo or in online co-op.

games.name: Roots of Yggdrasil
games.text: Build settlements, explore the Nine Realms, collect artifacts and upgrade your deck to reach the top of Yggdrasil in this post-Ragnarok roguelike city-builder! Can you survive the end of the world?

games.name: Shiny Ski Resort
games.text: Enjoy building and running a ski resort in this cool simulation game!

games.name: Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth
games.text: Two larger-than-life heroes, Ichiban Kasuga and Kazuma Kiryu are brought together by the hand of fate, or perhaps something more sinister… Live it up in Japan and explore all that Hawaii has to offer in an RPG adventure so big it spans the Pacific.

games.name: DRAGON BALL GEKISHIN SQUADRA
games.text: ——— is Dragon Ball's first team-oriented free to play game.

games.name: Rift of the NecroDancer
games.text: The NecroDancer's back in an all-new rhythm game! Dragged into a strange new world, Cadence must engage in musical combat with monsters surging through the Rift! Face pulse-pounding Rhythm Rifts where every beat is a battle, all set to an original soundtrack by Danny Baranowsky & friends.

games.name: Kanjozoku Game レーサー Online Street Racing & Drift
games.text: 90s Osaka Kanjo Night Street Racing and Drift Online with True JDM Cars, Online PvP, Engine, Body and Suspension Tuning!

games.name: Arena Breakout: Infinite
games.text: ——— is a high-stakes tactical extraction shooter where every decision matters. Fight, loot, and extract—or lose it all. With stunningly realistic visuals, lifelike sound, and unforgiving PvPvE combat, every raid is a gamble between glory and ruin.

games.name: THE FINALS
games.text: ——— is the world’s first Dynamism Shooter, a free-to-play, fast-paced, physics-driven, first-person shooter set on the stage of the biggest Gameshow of the future! Fight for Fans and fortune in fully-destructible, virtual Arenas that guarantee no two rounds will ever play the same!

games.name: A Webbing Journey
games.text: Adorable spider chaos! Swing around the house, weave crazy structures, play with physics-based objects, and pull off chores with nothing but your webs and your wits in this madcap sandbox adventure.

games.name: Sunset Routes
games.text: ——— is an easy and intriguing roguelite game. You can choose your crew, put them in the cabins, select your destination, and set sail. Through a series of choices, you can earn profits during the emergency period of the New World and even decide its fate—unintentionally or on purpose.

games.name: STAR WARS Zero Company™
games.text: Command an elite squad through a gritty and authentic story in ———™, a single-player turn-based tactics game set in the twilight of the Clone Wars™.

games.name: RENNSPORT
games.text: ——— is the future of racing simulation, competition, and digital car culture. Live the thrill of driving high-performance race cars on laser-scanned circuits from around the world and breathtaking roads imagined by the community.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks
games.text: High-orktane combat racing in the ——— universe! Drive buggies, tanks and helicopters, mastering advanced movement and explosive weaponry online or against bots. Unlock gear, customize your rides and use the NEW Creation Workshop to create, share, and play custom maps from the community!

games.name: Sunkenland
games.text: Get ready for a Waterworld-themed survival game with modular base building, sunken city scavenging, crafting, base defense, and invasions of NPC clans for resources and territory. Ready for the water apocalypse?

games.name: Kathana
games.text: Adventure awaits in ———, a classic MMORPG. Choose from eight distinct classes, complete quests with friends, challenge powerful bosses, explore dangerous dungeons, and compete in guild wars and PvP battles.

games.name: Super Woden GP 2
games.text: ——— is a love letter to the world of motor sports, offering a unique experience. Arcade-style isometric racing meets unrivaled campaign depth and a huge variety of vehicles to buy, sell and unlock.

games.name: Shogun Showdown
games.text: ——— is a turn-based combat game with rogue-like and deck-building elements. Position yourself and attack at the right time, upgrade your tiles and combo them to get ready to face the Shogun!

games.name: Home Run High
games.text: Train your baseball players and create a winning team!

games.name: NIMRODS
games.text: Assemble a limitless arsenal in this survive-em-up roguelite shooter. As a Gun Manufacturer's testing force, your mission is simple: test the latest gun tech and scavenge alien planets. Collect insane weapon parts to invent crazy guns that slay thousands. You may not survive, but your guns will!

games.name: 天外武林 (Traveler of Wuxia)
games.text: Traveler of Wuxia is a deck-building rogue-lite game that mixes with Wuxia story and card combination. You will play as a young hero exploring to a unknown martial arts world. Use card combos to unleash powerful techniques and team up with companions to overcome the challenges of the martial world.

games.name: Tiny Rogues
games.text: ——— is a challenging fantasy rogue-lite bullet-hell dungeon crawler with rpg elements. Build a new unique character each run and fight one monster-infested room after another! Discover unique weapons, collect magical items and level up to become more and more powerful!

games.name: Puzzline
games.text: ——— is a 2-4 player board game connecting cards like a puzzle! Each card has a unique effect. Play them strategically and get the victory! Online play is also supported!

games.name: Deck of Souls
games.text: Roguelite deck-building meets souls-like. Break out of an infinite loop to close the hell gates, turn enemies into cards, and build your own omnipotent ———! Rolls included.

games.name: Picayune Dreams
games.text: ——— is a roguelike blend of bullet heaven horde survival, and bullet hell gameplay. Adrift across the endless void, you must fend off thousands of nightmarish and otherwordly creatures. Uncover a mysterious and surreal story. And don't forget. You mu [TRANSMISSION INTERRUPTED...]

games.name: The Occultist
games.text: ——— is a first-person narrative thriller. You play as Alan Rebels, a paranormal investigator who travels to an abandoned British island after his father's disappearance. Explore Godstone island, face supernatural entities, and uncover long-buried occult rituals.

games.name: Bus Bound
games.text: Step into the driver’s seat in ———, the latest title from the creators of Bus Simulator 21. Explore a vibrant city behind the wheel of officially licensed buses, and help transform it into a pedestrian-friendly paradise—one stop at a time.

games.name: Mini Tank Mayhem
games.text: ——— is a roguelike deck-building tower defense game where you command a powerful mini-tank to repel waves of alien invaders. Craft your very own deck, deploy strategic defenses, and unleash devastating combos to protect Earth from pesky aliens!

games.name: Union of Gnomes
games.text: Onwards to revolution in this challenging deck-building roguelite. Free your gnome comrades, assemble your squad, mind wieners (supplies), slay the slavers, and take down the fiercest of them all – Snow White! FREEDOM TO GNOMES!

games.name: Turnip Boy Robs a Bank
games.text: Turnip Boy is back! This time he’s teaming up with the fearsome Pickled Gang to plan and execute the weirdest heist of all time. Shake down hostages, steal precious valuables, battle the fuzz, and use wacky tools bought off the dark web to move further into the vaults of the Botanical Bank.

games.name: StarVaders
games.text: Pilot a powerful mech to fight off the alien invasion in this ULTIMATE fusion of deckbuilding and grid-based tactics. Discover game-breaking combos, rewind time to alter your fate, and protect the future of humanity in this endlessly replayable roguelike.

games.name: Star Vortex
games.text: ——— is a fast-paced Action-RPG inspired by classics of the genre. Design your ship, fight through hostile alien sectors solo or with friends, salvage rare weapons and experiment with powerful builds until nothing can stand against you.

games.name: MotoGP™23
games.text: Open the throttle, pass your opponents and cross the finish line: live the dream of being the next champion with the new ———, more amazing and challenging than ever!

games.name: Lost and Found Co.
games.text: ———. is a hidden object adventure in a cozy and immersive world. Join a cast of lively characters on their epic journey across countless magical locations. Find lost items, solve puzzles, and help a tiny dragon regain her power!

games.name: Basketball Club Story
games.text: Basketball Team Management Sim Coach a custom team and dunk your way to glory!

games.name: Apex Point
games.text: ——— is an open world game that aims to immerge you into the Japanese car culture by providing a huge variety of customizations and race types so you can choose your own path

games.name: Matchmaking Inc.
games.text: A young single man returns to his hometown and takes over the family's matchmaking business. ———. is a modern-themed RPG designed for men that combines gameplay elements of simulation management and text adventure.

games.name: Magicraft
games.text: "———" is a Roguelike game that uses a variety of spells to match unimaginable spell effects, and the construction of ultra-high degrees of freedom cannot even be exhausted by developers.

games.name: Summer Trip Cruise
games.text: Hey you, we need a captain! Use your mouse to drive the cruise ship with the on-screen rudder, avoid obstacles, take pictures and enjoy the ride. Take it easy... or take the challenge!

games.name: Idle Clans
games.text: ——— is a multiplayer idle game that combines the classic MMORPG experience with simplified gameplay and less time commitment. Features include a player-driven economy, PvE, trading, quests, crafting and opportunities to play, socialize and collaborate with other players.

games.name: Preserve
games.text: ——— is a relaxing puzzle nature-building game in which you flourish a vibrant ecosystem by cleverly placing plants and animals to create a perfect symbiosis to your liking.

games.name: Schrodinger's Cat Burglar
games.text: Portal with cats - Become entangled in a quantum puzzle adventure! Mittens gains the incredible power to be in two places at once. Explore twisted test chambers, make mischief and evade capture by a whisker! 🐈🐈‍⬛

games.name: JR EAST Train Simulator
games.text: The official train company's authentic driving simulator is here! ———" is a train driving simulator that allows you to experience live-action images and realistic driving sounds of JR East's actual train lines in your own home.

games.name: RUNGORE
games.text: Card game mechanics - check. Real time battles - check. Silly humor - check. If this isn't the game of your dreams i don't know what is (Also we have hidden memes everywhere lol)

games.name: Touge Shakai
games.text: ——— (Mountain Pass Society) is an online Touge Racing Game based on Japanese car culture in the 90s. With an emphasis on balance between realism and fun gameplay, the physics are tailored for competitive drift racing, while giving a challenge to all players.

games.name: Blasphemous 2
games.text: The Penitent One awakens as ——— joins him once again in an endless struggle against The Miracle. Dive into a perilous new world filled with mysteries and secrets to discover, and tear your way through monstrous foes that stand between you and your quest to end the cycle once and for all.

games.name: Epic Auto Towers
games.text: ——— is a turn-based strategy game combining elements of autobattler, deckbuilder and roguelike. Purchase uncommon and rare Towers and build the strongest combo to withstand the monster assault! Discover unusual new Tower combinations as you come back for more.

games.name: Incursion Red River
games.text: IRR is a tactical PvE Co-Op extract shooter set in a de-stabilized and immersive modern-day Vietnam. As a PMC for a mysterious organization, deal with 3 factions that stand to gain from the chaos. Engage in ruthless combat, plan your deployment, and explore the world as your journey unfolds.

games.name: Swords and Sandals 3 Redux
games.text: A legend returns! The beloved classic Swords and Sandals 3 is back, re-forged in glory! Step back into the Gladiae Ultratus once more and prepare to take on the greatest gladiators in all Brandor. It's the hardest, most metal gladiator game ever made.

games.name: FAIRY TAIL: Beach Volleyball Havoc
games.text: The cast of ——— is ready to bring mayhem to the summertime beaches! Unleash over-the-top magic to BLAST that volleyball!

games.name: Breachway
games.text: Explore the galaxy in this deckbuilding, sci-fi roguelike where ship upgrades and crew management are key to your survival. Optimize resource generation, engage in intense turn-based battles, and take on ever-growing threats as you seek out The Signal.

games.name: Forest Golf Planner
games.text: Create and customize your own golf course in this charming management sim.

games.name: MISERY
games.text: ——— is a 1–10 player co-op survival game set in a nuclear disaster zone. Here, every day is a struggle: search radioactive ruins for resources, build your bunker, craft weapons, and explore a weird, procedurally-generated world with your friends. Beware of anomalies, monsters, and armed bandits.

games.name: Void Stranger
games.text: Place your faith and embrace the Void.

games.name: Hollowbody
games.text: A tech-noir survival horror short story, set in the urban decay of a long abandoned British city. Solve environmental puzzles, manage limited resources and fight for a way to escape beyond the wall.

games.name: SULFUR
games.text: ——— is a modern old-school action-adventure: Outsmart enemies, find treasure, improve weapons, harness powers. Delve deeper, find answers, make it end.

games.name: Deer Hunting - The Season
games.text: Hunt Deer that act and react differently depending on the time of the season, weather and rut stage. Bucks very in size and you will be able to hunt monster bucks that have potential to score well over 200 inches. Each successful hunt gains you EXP and you can purchase / upgrade gear and firearms.

games.name: Path of Achra
games.text: ——— is a dark fantasy roguelike of the ancient earth, with a focus on streamlined controls and rapid hero customization. A "broken build sandbox." Fight through the deadly lands of Achra to reach the horrors of the Obelisk, and discover what lies beyond...

games.name: Staffer Case: A Supernatural Mystery Adventure
games.text: ——— is a new sort of mystery game, asking players to find clues, arrange them into documents, and point out the contradictions between them to solve a series of murders. Each mystery unraveled leads you closer to the truth lying at the heart of each case!

games.name: REANIMAL
games.text: The creators of Little Nightmares™ I & II have returned to take you on a darker, more terrifying journey than ever before. In this horror adventure game, a brother & sister go through hell to rescue their missing friends and escape the island that they used to call home.

games.name: METAL GEAR & METAL GEAR 2: Solid Snake
games.text: The first and second title in the METAL GEAR series that established the stealth action genre, as well as the basic mechanics of the series.

games.name: Deliverance & Reign
games.text: Join a gothic battle where Good confronts Evil using roguelike deckbuilding mechanics. Play as either side, invading Alaric's Castle, or as Alaric himself defending against the invading heroes!

games.name: Rabbit and Steel
games.text: RABBIT & STEEL is a co-op action roguelike that recreates the essence of high-level MMO raiding in a randomized, simplified, bunny-sized package. Choose your class, gather your rabbit-eared companions and battle your way to the Moonlit Pinnacle!

games.name: Tiny Bookshop
games.text: Leave everything behind and open a ——— by the sea in this cozy narrative management game. Stock your ——— with different books and items, set up shop in scenic locations, and run your cozy second-hand bookshop while getting to know the locals.

games.name: Broken Reality 2000
games.text: Get ready for a new adventure in the world of NATEM! Explore beautiful worlds, solve puzzles with new tools and meet wonderful people in this journey through a digital universe full of secrets in search of someone special.

games.name: Golfinite
games.text: Play golf, level up, buy gear and abilities. Complete challenges and play in 18-hole tournaments across several courses on your way to become a golf pro!

games.name: Space Drilling Station
games.text: In ———, manage a drilling station on a distant planet. Build a multi-level vertical structure to produce and manage your resources and staff, in order to dominate the competition!

games.name: Elin
games.text: Successor to the roguelike RPG "Elona". Adventure, survival, crafting, home-building, myths passed down, and stories of humans and Elea spun. What scars will you leave on the land of Ylva?

games.name: Vox Populi: Brazil 2022
games.text: Play as an existing or fully customized political figure, and campaign for many alternative Brazilian elections! In "———", you and the characters around you must promote your ideas and your popularity throughout the country to claim victory!

games.name: Regency Solitaire II
games.text: Revisit romantic Regency Britain to build a glorious garden, in this charming solitaire sequel. Tour historic hotspots, silence gossips, and host the season’s most anticipated soiree. Play your cards right to unlock bonus levels and a love story. Don't miss the party everyone's talking about!

games.name: Sifu
games.text: ——— is a realistic third-person brawler with tight Kung Fu combat mechanics and cinematic martial arts action embarking you on a path for revenge.

games.name: REMATCH
games.text: ——— is an online multiplayer football game. Control one player and compete with your team in fast-paced 5v5 matches from an immersive third-person perspective. Team up with your friends and join the action.

games.name: Stronghold: Definitive Edition
games.text: Greetings sire! Your ——— awaits you. Build a castle economy, besiege unforgettable villains and return to the 'castle sim' that started it all. Experience this classic RTS with upgraded visuals, modernised gameplay, Steam multiplayer and a new campaign.

games.name: Whisker Squadron: Survivor
games.text: A smooth roguelite shooter from the creators of RACE THE SUN, featuring a voiced cast of feline pilots in a dramatic showdown against corporate-powered robots called The Swarm. Features a 3-act campaign with branching paths, epic bosses, and a wide arsenal of pilots, ships, and weapons.

games.name: Looper Tactics
games.text: Welcome again, wandering soul. Will this be the time of your success? Watch your steps as you advance in this roguelike-deck builder and engage in auto-battler card encounters of increasing difficulty. Get stronger in each battle, rise from the ashes, and break free from endless reincarnation!

games.name: GladiEATers
games.text: Cook and command teams of living food in this narrative creature battler. ——— blends seven chef stories in top-down JRPG adventures and roguelike gauntlets, featuring 6v6 battles, spicy cooking minigames and online multiplayer.

games.name: Backrooms: Escape Together
