games.text: ——— is a tactical FPS that allows you to approach each mission in your own way. Select equipment, decide the time of day, then move methodically to complete your mission. Enjoy the modern mechanics and old school graphics as you fight across a variety of missions and environments.

games.name: World War Armies
games.text: ——— is the ultimate PvP real-time strategy game. Command advanced war machines and compete for free against other players worldwide. Revolutionary mechanics reduce downtime and focus on direct engagement with the enemy, you get to the fun parts of RTS faster.

games.name: Tiny Kingdom
games.text: ——— is a minimalist city-building strategy game where every placement matters. Start with a single hut and grow a thriving kingdom by combining buildings, unlocking synergies, and creating efficient layouts.

games.name: Megaloot
games.text: ——— is an addictive Inventory Management Roguelike RPG, where meticulous loot management lets you create diverse and powerful builds for each run. With every new attempt, start from scratch and loot strategically to craft dominating setups and become the ultimate power hunter.

games.name: Forza Motorsport
games.text: Compete in over 500 cars on 30 world-famous tracks – now featuring the legendary Fujimi Kaido! Play the new 20th Anniversary Tour and obtain special rewards.

games.name: UNDERDOGS
games.text: UNDERGROUND MECH FIGHTS! Wrap yourself in 5 tons of metal & go smashing through a dark scene of full-on metal-on-metal violence!

games.name: Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector
games.text: A dice-driven RPG, in a human and heartfelt sci-fi world. You are an escaped android, with a malfunctioning body, a price on your head and no memory of your past. Get a ship, find a crew, and take on contracts while you navigate across the Starward Belt.

games.name: Will You Wheel?
games.text: You inherit your dad’s beaten up car and rebuild it piece by piece, swapping engine parts, upgrading the suspension, fitting new wheels and more until it becomes a high performance race car. Beat your opponents and earn revenge for your dad.

games.name: Shape of Dreams
games.text: ——— delivers fast-paced top-down roguelite action with chaotic projectile-filled battles, fluid combat, and high-stakes co-op. Play solo or with up to three friends as you dodge overwhelming attacks and unleash devastating builds.

games.name: Late Night Drive
games.text: Explore various maps with your friends or play solo and relax. Whether you prefer a relaxing drive or a fast-paced, action-packed race, the choice is yours. Get ready to unforgettable journey through the city streets under the moonlit sky!

games.name: Lost Castle 2
games.text: "———" is a 2D Beat'em up Rogue-Lite game. Explore abundant treasures and items to enhance yourself, master various weapons to showcase your skills, and challenge powerful monsters to demonstrate your strength. A new adventure is calling for treasure hunters!

games.name: Annulus
games.text: ——— is a unique dark fantasy tactical game! You will play the role of the head of a mercenary regiment, constantly collect and cultivate resources such as mercenaries and weapons with unique attributes, and create their own mercenary regiment. Survival and glory, the battle is endless！

games.name: G-Rebels
games.text: ———: An action-packed combat flight sim in a dystopian open world full of intrigue, free exploration and dangerous missions. As part of an elite unit, it is your job to ensure law and order. A secret mission calls everything into question: are you on the right side or part of a conspiracy?

games.name: Drive Me to Hell
games.text: As the night darkens and you set out for home, an unsettling occurrence takes place on the road. Will this lead you to hell? Unveil the truth in a bone-chilling driving horror game that will keep you on the edge of your seat!

games.name: Knight Overloaded
games.text: ——— is a roguelight survival game that reinforced strategic choices. Beat enemies falling from the sky endlessly, and expand your inventory!

games.name: Crown Gambit
games.text: Play as three intrepid paladins through a terrible war of succession to save a sinister medieval kingdom from political turmoil. Pick a side amongst noble families to choose the future monarch and crush those who stand in your way through board-shattering tactical card combat!

games.name: Yooka-Replaylee
games.text: Embark on an epic 3D platforming collectathon adventure with Yooka and Laylee! ——— is packed with new moves, more story, exciting challenges, hidden secrets, and more than double the collectibles to uncover. Can you help them rescue the world’s biggest treasure?

games.name: Vegangsters
games.text: Embark into a deck-building roguelike where real-time action will challenge your reaction and strategy skills. Face the deadliest criminals in intense turn-based combat, where each card defines the pace of the battle and save the city from the ———!

games.name: Clonizer
games.text: ——— combines Hex-based tactics and roguelike deckbuilding! Play cards, manage clones, explore unique charming planets and outsmart aliens. Craft a powerful deck through your expedition and Clonize the universe to become employee of the month of CLONPO!

games.name: Skogdal
games.text: A deckbuilding adventure card game set in a rustic Norwegian town during the 90's. Recruit followers, draft cards and build powerful combos. Explore a hand-crafted world across multiple runs and uncover an unsettling mystery…

games.name: Dreamcore
games.text: Experience backrooms like never before. ——— is the ultimate psychological exploration game, set in the largest liminal world ever made. No guides, no path—only intuition. Will you keep your bearings in a world designed to make you lose them?

games.name: Cluckmech Oasis
games.text: ———, a top-down shooting Roguelike tower defense game. Play as the Warcluck and lead your team of animal heroes in a fight for survival. Collect, build and upgrade defenses, and engage in intense battle against waves of plant enemies.

games.name: Towerful Defense: A Rogue TD
games.text: A roguelike tower defense where you control a single tower to fight against hordes of aliens coming from all directions. Pick your tower, equip up to 4 skills, and choose from a variety of traits and unique effect items to craft powerful builds that lead you to victory.

games.name: Hoop Land
games.text: Experience the ultimate hoops sim in ———, a retro-inspired basketball manager with modernized gameplay and fully customizable leagues. Build your legacy, lead a dynasty, or simulate endless seasons from college tournaments to championship trophies!

games.name: REDLINE CROOKS
games.text: ——— is a fast-paced roguelite combat racing game in which you destroy cops, walls and possibly yourself in a chaotic pursuit of freedom and riches. Upgrade, Slam, Taunt and Boost your way out of imprisonment through the lawless roads that lie ahead, and you may find personal absolution.

games.name: DEATH IN UNISON
games.text: Survive the world's deadliest psychopaths. Experience a unique 2-player co-op experience that puts your teamwork and communication to the test. Complete your duties alone or with a partner in a prison like no other.

games.name: Yokai Art: Survival Prologue
games.text: Strategically position units on a chess-based battlefield, defending territories while earning roguelike upgrade-items for leveling up. Discover over 30 unique equipment pieces that modify units, allowing for exciting customization and ensuring endless excitement and replayability.

games.name: Cooking Simulator 2: Better Together
games.text: Cook, create, and run your dream restaurant. Master realistic cooking mechanics, invent original recipes, satisfy demanding guests, and build your culinary reputation. Play solo or team up with friends in optional co-op. Become the Chef Everyone Talks About!

games.name: Mimic Logic
games.text: "———" is an automatically generated logic puzzle roguelike. Listen to the statements of the treasure chests, find the lying mimics, and open the rest of the treasure chests! Opening a mimic results in a game over.

games.name: Claw Machine Sim
games.text: Physically simulated claw machine! Win over 200 unique prizes in the Fun or Realistic difficulty mode.

games.name: inZOI
games.text: "Every life becomes a story" Create your unique story by controlling and observing the lives of 'Zois'. Customize characters and build houses using ———'s easy-to-use tools to live the life of your dreams and experience the different emotions of life created by its deep and detailed simulation.

games.name: GT Manager
games.text: Take charge as the ultimate racing manager, leading your GT racing team to victory. Build your team, improve your car, and deploy winning race strategies across 5 official GT leagues, including the pinnacle of endurance racing: the hypercar category! Are you ready to dominate the world of GT racing?

games.name: Avowed
games.text: ——— is a first-person fantasy RPG set in the world of Eora, where your choices carve a path through war, intrigue, and ancient mysteries. Navigate a land in turmoil, forge powerful alliances or deadly rivalries, and wield magic and steel to shape the fate of the Living Lands—and your own destiny.

games.name: Cardfight!! Vanguard Dear Days 2
games.text: "Cardfight!! Vanguard," has newly come to digital game! Over 3,000 cards for the Standard format! A brand-new original story shares the world of anime series unfolds! Enjoy your own cardfight experience!!

games.name: Farm Keeper
games.text: A tile-based farming game where success means maximizing yields to survive the rent, expanding your farm through random tile choices.

games.name: Dimhaven - The Lost Source
games.text: Are you ready for an adventure? Challenges, exploration and puzzles in a narrative driven experience, pick up your camera and test your wits in this first-person mystery by the team behind Quern!

games.name: Emberward
games.text: Build twisting mazes with tetromino blocks and deploy unique towers in this strategic roguelite tower defense adventure!

games.name: Yohane the Parhelion - NUMAZU in the MIRAGE -
games.text: ——— is an official spin-off of "Love Live! Sunshine". 『——— -』 is a deckbuilding roguelite set in that world! A mysterious mirror world that changes each time it's entered. After countless choices, Yohane chooses...

games.name: SPGP Super Polygon Grand Prix
games.text: It's all about speed, it’s all about the competition. Choose a car that suites you and race highly competitive AI at break neck speeds over a vast variety of locations. Unlock 48 tracks and 20 cars in Progress Mode. Check your ranking with Online Leaderboards.

games.name: Tormented Souls 2
games.text: Caroline Walker returns in the sequel to the award-winning survival horror classic. Explore the decaying remains of the secluded Villa Hess, use improvised weapons to confront terrifying creatures, and bend the fabric of reality to save your sister from a twisted cult.

games.name: VOIN
games.text: Crafted by a solo developer, ——— is a first-person hack-and-slash. Cleave through hordes of enemies in fast-paced combat. Explore dark fantasy realms filled with secrets and dangers. Discover powerful gear and weapons, and face menacing bosses in your quest to cleanse a broken world.

games.name: Terracards
games.text: Farm, sell, learn, repeat. ——— is a tactical roguelike-deckbuilder where you manage your own farm, You'll utilize animals, crops, and structures through cards, transforming them into valuable resources and wealth with each turn. But beware - deplete your funds, and it's game over.

games.name: CosmoPirates
games.text: Build your deck using cards, ships, items and crew! Explore a generated galaxy roguelike style. Fight gruesome battles against the medley of space scum!

games.name: Pyrene
games.text: Defeat hellish monsters and rebuild your home in ———, a fast paced roguelike dungeon-crawler. Play with different heroes & spells, collect powerful relics to upgrade your deck while uncovering the mysteries behind your village’s destruction.

games.name: Vivid World
games.text: A follow-up to the hit game Vivid Knight, ——— is a completely new party-building, roguelike strategy game! Our story takes place in the Underworld, a land ruled by demons. Utilize and master our protagonist, Lemuria's new Jewel Magic to conquer strange dungeons.

games.name: Magic Inn
games.text: Reclaim glory in ———, a charming tavern life simulator. Take on the role of an exiled wizard-turned-innkeeper, overseeing everything from menus, rooms, guests, and staff in a fully magical customizable inn. Engage in card battles to spark conversations and foster relationships with guests.

games.name: Unnamed Space Idle
games.text: Destroy endless waves of alien ships that have all but wiped out humanity in this long form, unfolding, sci-fi idle game. Customize your ship with different weapons and defenses to defeat specific enemy types and utilize a ton of different systems to increase your overall power.

games.name: Ducks Can Drive
games.text: Ducks like to race, even in their own cars! Earn money by delivering food to fellow ducks in the city, then use this money to upgrade your vehicle. The better the vehicle, the better chance you have to win the race at the end of the day!

games.name: HUNTDOWN: OVERTIME
games.text: Corporations turned crime-infested streets into profit margins for bounty hunters and John Sawyer is going to make a killing. Hunt, die, upgrade, repeat in this explosive roguelite prequel where every strategic upgrade strips away more flesh and builds a cybernetic fighter one chrome limb at a time.

games.name: Momento
games.text: ——— is a cozy room decorator with a twist: the choices you make play out over the course of a lifetime! Decorate your room, choose which items are important to you, and discover how the objects you choose will alter the course of the story, in a winding ode to the power of everyday things.

games.name: SOS OPS!
games.text: ———! is more than a game. Your task is to save the city. You will find yourself in the epicenter of madness, where co-op missions with friends will raise the adrenaline to the limit!

games.name: Mouthwashing
games.text: The five crew members of the Tulpar are stranded in the empty reaches of space, shrouded in perpetual sunset. God is not watching.

games.name: Ticket to Ride®
games.text: Discover a fresh adaptation of the iconic, multi-award-winning board game. Play against fellow fans around the world, or take on state-of-the-art AI opponents. Build a railway empire, claim routes and dominate your competitors on the leaderboards in this fan-favourite modern classic!

games.name: Mosa Lina
games.text: a hostile interpretation of the immersive sim, where nothing is planned, and everything works

games.name: Expeditions: A MudRunner Game
games.text: Embark on scientific ——— with this new off-road adventure game. Lead research missions as you drive a variety of all-terrain vehicles, using high-tech tools and managing your camp and crew to ensure your success in the wild.

games.name: Nimbit Frontier
games.text: In this cozy creature collector, your creatures aren't for battling. Restore lost species, build habitats around their needs, teach them the skills to thrive, and release them into the wild. Explore town life and dive into shifting roguelite dungeons to discover the next Nimbit.

games.name: Tomb Raider I-III Remastered Starring Lara Croft
games.text: Discover Lara Croft’s Original Adventures, Lovingly Restored – Now with New Challenge Mode

games.name: Prelude Dark Pain
games.text: ——— is a Tactical RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Assume the role of a local blacksmith named Soren, lead an uprising against the Order of the Ashen Crusade and save a world ravaged by war.

games.name: SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide
games.text: Prepare to be scared! A clash between the Flying Dutchman and King Neptune has unleashed ghostly mayhem all over Bikini Bottom. Switch seamlessly between SpongeBob and Patrick, combine their unique skills and save Bikini Bottom from total ghostification!

games.name: Gray Zone Warfare
games.text: Enter a high-stakes PvE-first open-world tactical shooter set on a quarantined Southeast Asian island torn apart by faction warfare. Deploy as an elite operator, fight solo or with your squad to carry out missions, earn reputation, and explore the truth behind the Event igniting the conflict.

games.name: Dino Ramen Express
games.text: From RAMEN to RIFLES! This is an immersive first-person simulation game where players can run their own restaurant empire. The game allows players to devise their own business strategies, from hands-on "guns & blazing" food delivery in the open world to staff management at stores.

games.name: Mage and Monsters II
games.text: Recruit a hero to lead your army, and use spells while they fight for you. Mage & Monsters 2 is an active auto battler, where you choose to either enhance the strength of your hero, reinforce the might of your army, or increase the power of your spells.

games.name: Forza Horizon 6
games.text: Discover the breathtaking landscapes of Japan in over 550 real-world cars and become a racing Legend in Forza Horizon's biggest open world driving adventure yet.

games.name: Magical Girl Dash
games.text: ——— is a retro arcade where you fight against the forces of evil in a runner style game. Protect the city and, most important of all, recover the stolen cakes from your favorite bakery!

games.name: Sledders
games.text: Deep snow snowmobiling with real physics. Ride licensed sleds from Lynx, Polaris, and Ski-Doo across massive open backcountry maps. Find your own lines, climb steep mountains, ride with friends online, and chase the perfect run in untouched powder.

games.name: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds
games.text: Race across land, sea, air, space, and time in ———! Warp through Travel Rings into new dimensions where something new awaits around every twist and turn.

games.name: Cash Cleaner Simulator
games.text: Check it, clean it, sort it, ship it. Welcome to the life of a cash cleaner. Take jobs from underworld contacts and clean some cash. Just don't try to leave...

games.name: Dungeons of Blood and Dream
games.text: Play as a mighty Blood Wizard on a quest to escape a death-loop of psychedelic dungeons. Slay disgusting creatures using a large array of bladed weapons and unnerving spells, harness the power of cursed rings, find mysterious treasures, and learn the secrets of the universe you are trapped in.

games.name: F1® 24
games.text: Join the grid and Be One of the 20. Drive like the greatest in EA SPORTS™ ———, the official video game of the 2024 FIA Formula One World Championship™.

games.name: Whiskerwood
games.text: Establish a home for your industrious mice under the oppressive paw of your cat overlords in this city builder featuring complex simulations, intricate production chains, and the age-old rivalry between cat and mouse.

games.name: METAL GEAR SOLID: Peace Walker - Master Collection Version
games.text: From Naked Snake to Big Boss. Ten years after Operation Snake Eater. While commanding a private military force in Colombia, guests from Costa Rica visit Snake. Accepting their request, Snake leads his men into confronting the conspiracy behind the East-West Cold War.

games.name: Pro Cycling Manager 2024
games.text: Become a sports director, take part in the world's top cycling races and lead your riders to victory. Set race objectives, negotiate contracts, find new sponsors and build your team season after season.

games.name: #DRIVE Rally
games.text: #——— is an arcade-inspired rally-driving experience set in the golden racing era of the ‘90s. Grab your co-driver and burn some rubber on iconic race-winning cars across a variety of terrains in some of the most iconic rallying locations in the world!

games.name: Hello Kitty Island Adventure
games.text: Embark on a cozy, open-world adventure with Hello Kitty and Friends. Befriend beloved characters as you explore and restore a mysterious island, solve ancient puzzles, cook delicious dishes, customize yourself and your cabins, and so much more.

games.name: Ghost Town
games.text: ——— is a single player VR puzzle-adventure from the makers of The Room. London, 1983. Edith Penrose is a ghost hunter, busy exorcising her way through the city's restless spirits. But after her brother goes missing Edith must draw upon her wits & supernatural talents to unravel the mystery.

games.name: Be My Horde
games.text: ——— is a roguelite survivor where your minions fight for you. Become a formidable necromancer and turn your enemies into a resource! Raise fallen foes, build massive undead hordes, enhance your skills with devoured souls, and conquer the world – you’re the villain in this story.

games.name: Inventorix
games.text: ——— is an inventory-management money-making roguelike deckbuilder. Creatively pack and synergize items and alien perks to create astronomical wealth and pay a mysterious space debt!

games.name: DICEOMANCER
games.text: ——— is a roguelike deck-building game. Though you long for a peaceful life, you're forced to embark on an adventure. In this world of swords, magic, and guns, make good use of your dice and deck to find a way back to tranquility! What can the dice be used for? To change... anything.

games.name: Wolvesville
games.text: ——— is a multiplayer game for up to 16 players. Each game has different teams such as villagers or werewolves all fighting to be the last team standing. Use special abilities to uncover the roles of other players and convince your fellow players to work with you.

games.name: Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator
games.text: Begin your ranger journey in ———. Maintain trails, assist visitors, track wildlife, rescue injured or trapped animals, and explore diverse biomes filled with varied species.

games.name: Karting Superstars
games.text: A kart racing game without weapons! This is a pure motorsport arcade racer. Compete vs very challenging AI, get on the global leaderboards and play with others online.

games.name: House of Legacy
games.text: Step into the shoes of a fallen clan leader, starting with nothing but a crumbling estate and a handful of hopes, rising through careful planning, trade, and diplomacy to become one of the most powerful families in the land. Now it’s time to forge a legendary dynasty that leaves its mark on history.

games.name: Fears to Fathom - Ironbark Lookout
games.text: Jack Nelson, a 24-year-old fire lookout, transferred to a new outpost. As he settled into his new home, he couldn't shake the feeling that something was off, little did he know what was transpiring down in Ironbark State Park.

games.name: Clue/Cluedo
games.text: Experience a fresh take on the classic crime-solving board game. Step into new mysteries and use your skills of deduction to find out whodunit, with what weapon and where.

games.name: It Has My Face
games.text: IT HAS YOUR FACE. Now it wants your life. Hide, seek, and try to kill your clone in this deceptively simple first-person horror roguelite.

games.name: Bloodgrounds
games.text: ——— merges tactical turn-based combat with strategic management, RPG and roguelite elements. Forged in the pits of the arena, you fought your way out and now as a wealthy patron you recruit, train, and command your team of hardened Gladiators to glory - or death.

games.name: Delta Force
games.text: Play for free in operator-based extraction and full-scale combined arms warfare. Become elite Operators, customize an ever-expanding arsenal of weapons, and deploy into thrill-packed missions across multiple modes.

games.name: Meta Ghost: Breaking Show
games.text: Immerse yourself in the reality show — "Breaking Show", where you engage in real-time battles with various intelligent machines using cybernetic enhancements and weapons. Whether for personal gain or lofty ideals. Fight! Until you reach the final victory on this Rogue-lite journey.

games.name: ERA ONE
games.text: ——— is an innovative space game that combines elements of real-time strategy, base building, space survival, and tactical battles. Players can create and customize their bases from scratch, construct various types of structures and warships, manage fleets, and engage in tactical space battles.

games.name: Placid Plastic Deck - A Quiet Quest
games.text: A story-driven adventure with multiple-choice dialogue, funny characters, and a light sprinkle of card battles. A friendship to mend, a world to explore, and a few opponents to beat. Not a deep card battler, just an adventure where decks can be evil. But you're in luck… yours is all ducks!

games.name: Temtem: Swarm
games.text: Can you Survive the Swarm? Unlock mighty abilities and upgrades, find and collect Tems to evolve and become stronger, discover overpowered strategies, and battle massive bosses in this survivor-like bullet heaven! Play solo or online co-op with up to 3 players, building the wildest synergies.

games.name: Pro Cycling Manager 25
games.text: New graphics for an even more realistic simulation. Become a team manager and lead your riders to the top. Choosing sponsors, recruiting riders, managing the race, it's all up to you.

games.name: Dominions 6 - Rise of the Pantokrator
games.text: In ——— you take control of a powerful being that rules a nation and aspires to godhood. The type of Pretender Gods can vary from magically powerful arch mages to old dragons or an enormous tree. Dominions is a deep 4x turn based strategy game with a very large variety of spells and units.

games.name: FINAL FANTASY XVI
games.text: An epic dark fantasy where fates are decided by mighty Eikons and the Dominants who wield them. This is the tale of Clive Rosfield, a tragic warrior who swears revenge on the Dark Eikon Ifrit, a mysterious entity that leaves naught but calamity in its wake.

games.name: LuckLand
games.text: ——— is a strategy casual game that combines elements such as card building and Roguelike. To achieve ultimate victory, all you need to do is rotate the chessboard. This game does not include any real world currency gambling or micro trading.

games.name: None Shall Intrude
games.text: Venture into ———, a roguelite deck-builder with tile-based combat where you become a powerful Raid Boss. Epic battles, intricate strategies, and the ever-present threat of heroic challengers seeking to vanquish your reign. Will you conquer all or fall to valiant heroes?

games.name: Looking For Fael
games.text: Hello, this is Fael... Listen, this is going to sound strange, but... I think I'm lost in the apartment. Right now... I... I don't know where I am. Can you come and help me?

games.name: BREAK ARTS III
games.text: With your uniquely crafted mech, dominate both the track and the battlefield. Fight your way through countless battles and aim for ever greater heights! This installment of BREAK ARTS is the ultimate Comprehensive Mech-Customizing Competitive Sport.

games.name: The Lord of the Rings: War in the North™ - Legacy Edition
games.text: Step into a darker, grittier Middle-earth. ——— expands Tolkien’s epic legendarium, delving into the brutal, untold story of Agandaûr, a Black Númenórean and servant of Sauron who has rallied an immense force in the ruins of Fornost.

games.name: Whispers of the Eyeless
games.text: Become a cult leader and unleash divine power in this dark fantasy strategy RPG. You are the villain - you command disciples, outwit enemies in combat, and shape the fate of the fallen city as you awaken the Dead Gods — Wrath, Desire, and Madness.

games.name: Drop Duchy
games.text: Build your duchy piece by piece in this refreshing hybrid rogue-lite game. Use block-dropping mechanics to collect resources, recruit troops to fight against belligerent armies, and let every block shape your realm, leading your path to victory!

games.name: Tomb Raider IV-VI Remastered
games.text: Her legacy lives on! Play the next series of Tomb Raider adventures in this remastered collection of Lara Croft's darkest adventures.

games.name: Desktop Explorer
games.text: Rummage through the abandoned profiles of an old PC to unravel an inherited mystery. What secrets hide in this eerie adventure of cryptic games and outdated software? Who was using this computer? And what happened to them?

games.name: Fatermyth
games.text: "———" is an RPG game that combines tabletop role-playing and adventure. The storylines of seven characters from different eras intertwine, depicting an epic of human heroes. The strategic battles with dice + skills add more challenges to the adventure.

games.name: Garden of Witches
games.text: ——— is a cute roguelike action game full of danger. Help the protagonist, Sil, as she tries to round up her unruly fellow witches and save the Garden.

games.name: Lost Eidolons: Veil of the Witch
games.text: Veil of the Witch is a roguelite strategy RPG with turn-based combat and branching progression. Set in the world of “———,” build a nimble squad of five, pick your skills as you level, and adapt to each unique run. May the gods favor the bold and the wise.

games.name: The Last of Us™ Part II Remastered
games.text: Experience the winner of over 300 Game of the Year awards, now on PC. Discover Ellie and Abby’s story with graphical enhancements, gameplay modes like the roguelike survival experience No Return, and more.

games.name: Stray Path
games.text: ——— is an innovative adventure and strategy game that blends FreeCell mechanics with roguelike gameplay. Choose from colourful characters and explore a randomly generated world. Drag cards, optimize your choices, select equipment, and uncover the mysteries of this mysterious stray world!

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Mechanicus II
games.text: Fast-paced tactical combat meets strategic management in this sequel to the acclaimed ———: Mechanicus. Take control of either the ancient and deathless Necron legions or the techno-religious acolytes of the Omnissiah, with the fate of a world in your hands.

games.name: Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes
games.text: In ———, take command of a fleet escaping the annihilation of the Twelve Colonies. Manage crises on board as you prepare for the next encounter with the Cylon Fleet. Times are dire, and hard choices must be made. Your only hope: rejoin the ———.

games.name: Diablo II: Resurrected – Infernal Edition
games.text: Rediscover the dark fantasy classic that defined the modern ARPG genre; fully remastered with a new class, fresh content, quality‑of‑life upgrades, and an overhauled endgame. Chain brutal skill and item synergies, rise in power, and carve through Hell’s armies with up to eight players.

games.name: U.V.S. Nirmana
games.text: ——— is a engineering puzzle game from Coincidence, the creators of Kaizen: A Factory Story and the inventors of the Zach-like. Set off on the Unreturning Void Ship Nirmana as it continues a journey of uncountable eons toward the edge of the universe.

games.name: Shadowveil: Legend of The Five Rings
games.text: Train unique samurai, embark on missions, and play the cards dealt each run on an epic roguelite adventure in the Legend of the Five Rings universe. Each defeat opens new strategic skill tree options and more powerful cards to face the growing threat in the Shadowlands.

games.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024
games.text: Explore the world with our largest fleet of aircraft and take simulation to new heights while pursuing your aviation career within ———.

games.name: XF Extreme Formula
games.text: Race at the speed of sound and beyond in the great ——— championship! Taking place in the year 3000, you will tour trough the solar system proving you’re worthy of the title of champion.

games.name: POPUCOM
games.text: Venture together with your friends on an unknown planet. Use color switching, match-3 shooting, and artifact powers to overcome challenges and keep advancing. What lies ahead of you is an adventure filled with wonder, hope, and much more to discover!

games.name: Way of the Hunter 2
games.text: Experience the most advanced, realistic, and visually stunning hunting adventure across vast wilderness in North America and Africa. Encounter lifelike animal behavior, dynamic ecosystems, and dangerous wildlife while building a collection of trophies in your lodge.

games.name: Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders
games.text: Crash over and over until you master the mountain in the snowy followup to ———: Downhill. Now also including 2-8 person crossplatform multiplayer - work your way down the slopes together as a group, or risk it all in a breakneck race to the base!

games.name: Tony Hawk's™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4
games.text: Get hyped for the legendary franchise to return with ———. Everything you loved is back, but revamped with more skaters, new parks, gnarlier tricks, eardrum shattering music, plus a whole lot more.

games.name: KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX-
games.text: ———- is an HD remastered collection of 6 unforgettable KINGDOM HEARTS experiences. Take up your Keyblade to save the Disney worlds from darkness.

games.name: KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue
games.text: ——— features 3 magical experiences, all leading up to KINGDOM HEARTS III.

games.name: KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC)
games.text: ———) brings one chapter of the series to a close. Travel to exciting new Disney and Pixar worlds, and prepare for the final showdown.

games.name: Nested Lands
games.text: ——— is a ruthless medieval RPG game featuring in-depth village building, large-scale social management and combats. Gather survivors, build a settlement, craft, master your skills, survive, and endure alone or in online co-op.

games.name: Gym Simulator 24
games.text: ———: Build Your Fitness Empire! Embark on a journey to create your dream fitness haven in ———, the ultimate simulation game where you'll ascend the ranks and craft your very own fitness empire.

games.name: The Local
games.text: A fast-paced movement game, loosely inspired by Surf and B-Hop. Featuring 5 gamemodes, multiplayer, and a large, playground-like world. Master the movement, and conquer the leaderboards.

games.name: Biped 2
games.text: ——— is a coop action adventure game with a strong focus on moment-to-moment collaboration alone or between 2 or 4 players.

games.name: Horizon Zero Dawn™ Remastered
games.text: Experience the critically acclaimed Horizon Zero Dawn™ with stunning new visuals and upgraded features. In a far future where colossal machines roam the Earth, pockets of humanity survive in unique tribes among the lush, overgrown ruins of our long-lost civilization.

games.name: BMX Bastards
games.text: Customize your BMX and dive into a giant open world wich include Bike Parks from all around the world waiting for you. Can't find your favorite spot? Create it by yourself in our park editor. Don't wait any longer and come to prove you're a true Rider!

games.name: Lost in Random: The Eternal Die
games.text: Plunge into a living nightmare where every roll counts. Chain fluid combat with dice-fueled attacks, stack relics into ferocious synergies, and build unstoppable momentum. Slash through fate, bend chance to your will, and defeat the Black Die in this board-game inspired roguelite dungeon crawler.

games.name: Frontline 1942: Battles of the World War 2
games.text: Immerse yourself in the times of the Second World War II and become a real hero! Shoot, capture, win – the path to glory is paved with shells!

games.name: CRYO
games.text: ——— is a multiplayer co-op survival horror for 1-4 players. You have been deployed by your company to various locations around the Antarctic due to communication issues. What awaits you in these dark, remote regions is far more sinister than a technical fault...

games.name: I'm on Observation Duty 8
games.text: As an employee of a mysterious organization your job is to monitor live surveillance camera footage and spot anomalies using your sharp eyes and good memory. Can you survive the entire night shift or will you succumb into paranoia?

games.name: Gedonia 2
games.text: ——— is an online coop RPG, which allows up to 4 players to freely explore living open world and build absolutely unique characters. An expanded and improved sequel for RPG Gedonia.

games.name: Chained Together
games.text: Climb up from the depths of Hell. Scale various worlds solo or ——— with your friends in the 1-4 player platforming sensation.

games.name: MLB 9 Innings Rivals 26
games.text: Take your rivalries to the next level in ———!

games.name: Farmer's Dynasty 2
games.text: Build your dream farm and secure your family’s future. Cultivate your fields, raise animals, and shape your dynasty across generations in this beautifully crafted life and farming simulation. Start your dynasty today!

games.name: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu
games.text: In up to four player co-op, form a group of explorers searching for treasure. In this cursed jungle, danger is everywhere and monstrous creatures alter reality. Stay clear-headed and tame the jungle before it devours you…

games.name: Into The Grid
games.text: Become a master hacker in this Cyberpunk Roguelike Deckbuilder. Explore the dangers of cyberspace and fight evil corporations. Build and upgrade a deck of powerful programs. Unlock perks and skills, and unleash digital hell on your enemies. Dive ———!

games.name: Salvo Shuffle
games.text: ——— is a bullet-hell roguelike that mixes turn-based and action-based combat.

games.name: Monster Energy Supercross 25 - The Official Video Game
games.text: Get ready for a new beginning with the upcoming 2025 season, official riders and tracks, a renewed gameplay thanks to Unreal Engine 5, and much more!

games.name: MotoGP™24
games.text: Rev up your engines, ——— is back! Dive into the heart-pounding action of the 2024 season and immerse yourself in the thrills of unexplored landscapes, all thanks to the revolutionary Riders market!

games.name: Seafarer: The Ship Sim
games.text: Build your maritime career solo or with up to 4 players. Take on contracts across diverse harbors, command different ships, and tackle cargo runs, patrols, rescues, firefighting, and unexpected events in a vast Northern European open world.

games.name: Mortal Shell II
games.text: Their Flesh Is Your Weapon. ——— is a standalone sequel action-RPG with adrenaline-charged, high-stakes combat. Possess warrior Shells, dethrone false gods, redeem a ravaged world.

games.name: Shadowverse: Worlds Beyond
games.text: ——— is a brand-new strategy card game from the popular ——— CCG. With the newly added super-evolution mechanic and ——— Park, among other brand-new content, there is lots to enjoy for both seasoned and brand-new players.

games.name: Whisper of the House
games.text: ——— is a cozy game about organizing and decorating. You'll take on various tasks from the townspeople—helping them move, organize, and clean their spaces. In the process, your gentle touch might make a difference in their lives, and perhaps uncover some hidden stories...

games.name: Faaast Penguin
games.text: A 40-player survival action race. Stomp rivals, boost speed, chain attacks, and take shortcuts! Master the courses and make split-second decisions to win. The more you play, the deeper the gameplay becomes. It's free to play and cross-platform compatible! Dive in now with players worldwide!

games.name: F1® Manager 2024
games.text: Lead your team to glory in ———. A new Formula 1® season has arrived, and with it, the most comprehensive F1® management experience to date. Build a legacy with one of 10 official F1® constructors or create your own team for the very first time.

games.name: Pure Badminton
games.text: ——— is the most realistic Badminton simulation game. Experience the sensations of badminton, in a fast, technical and strategical game.

games.name: Dispatch
games.text: ——— is a superhero workplace comedy where choices matter. Manage a dysfunctional team of misfit heroes and strategize who to send to emergencies around the city, all while balancing office politics, personal relationships, and your own quest to become a hero. All episodes out now!

games.name: Wonderia
games.text: ———'s an open-world, manga-art adventure just waiting to be explored. It's got sci-fi sim elements, deep dungeons, and you can even morph into alien form! Grab up to 7 friends to mine, craft, battle, and level—or farm and fish the day away, if that's more your tempo. There's so much to do!

games.name: Realm of Ink
games.text: ——— is an Ink-style action Roguelite game. While pursuing the Fox Demon, the swordswoman Red, unexpectedly finds that her life is dictated by the 'destiny' within the world of the book. Only by breaking free can she unveil the truth of her existence and challenge the constraints of fate.

games.name: Gem Defender: Soyjak Survivors
games.text: Follow Chud on his fight against Dr Soystein's 'jak army in this spine-tingling survival shooter. NOW FEATURING BADLANDSCHUGS

games.name: Dead Signal
games.text: Monitor camera feeds, report valuable info, and hand-deliver shady packages. An hourly quota of reports will test your keen eye to spot the differences, while timed deliveries will force you outside unexpectedly. Until you clock out for the night almost nowhere is safe.

games.name: EarthKart: Google Maps Driving Simulator
games.text: 3D Google Earth Driving Simulator

games.name: Better Than Dead
games.text: A brutal bodycam revenge FPS set in Hong Kong. Slide into bullet time, fight up close, learn each environment's rhythm, and turn every run into a faster, bloodier revenge scene.

games.name: Flawed Tactics
games.text: The autobattler where the market IS the balance patch. Build your team, cast your spells, create powerful relics, optimize synergies - but watch the ticker. Every minion you buy raises its price for every player. No permanent metas. No overpowered favorites. Just tactics, and flawed ones at that

games.name: Pinball Spire
games.text: Action adventure meets pinball in this one-of-a-kind pinballvania adventure. When a mysterious spire appears from thin air, it's up to an intrepid pinball to bump, spin, shoot, and flip its way to the top and solve the tower’s mysteries!

games.name: Entropy Survivors
games.text: ——— is a bullet hell roguelike where you simultaneously control a powerful mech and a sharpshooting space frog, featuring outrageously creative abilities and powerful weapon customization. Save the universe in single player or 2-4 player online co-op!

games.name: Once Upon a Rogue's Tale
games.text: Embark on a journey through your favorite fairytales in this charming roguelike deckbuilder. Trade dice in battle to play lots of different cards or to use powerful character abilities. Encounter story events and make tough decisions that shape your journey as it unfolds in your personal storybook.

games.name: Facehand
games.text: ——— is a synergy-driven roguelike deckbuilder with autobattling mechanics. Craft the perfect deck and chain card abilities to create wild combos!

games.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core
games.text: ——— is a 1-4 player co-op shooter with sci-fi dwarves, procedurally-generated caves and random roguelike upgrades. Explore maze-like mines and blast through hordes of alien abominations — no two runs are the same. Move quickly, work together and shoot first to survive.

games.name: From Glory To Goo
games.text: ——— is a Sci-Fi survival RTS set on an alien world. Serve as humanity's bulwark by establishing a colony and supporting your colonists still in orbit. But beware, for The Goo, a relentless and shape-shifting force approaches from all sides, even above and below.

games.name: Intravenous 2
games.text: ——— is the ultimate blend of tactical gameplay and immersive storytelling. Will you embrace the shadows or confront your foes head-on? The choice is yours. Experience a new era of tactical stealth action. Save lives. Uncover secrets. Take vengeance.

games.name: Snezhinka:Sentinel Girls2
games.text: A fast-paced shooter with simple controls. Enhance your character by purchasing cards and hold the line against waves of hostile mechs as an employee of a private military company.

games.name: CONVRGENCE
games.text: ——— is an atmospheric VR extraction shooter set in the procedurally generated, ever-changing Chernokamensk Anomaly Zone. Scavenge loot, fight bandits and hunt for mystical artifacts — all with your loyal dog companion by your side. But extract before nightfall, or face what lurks in the dark.

games.name: Roots Devour
games.text: Extend your roots, imbibe fresh blood, and expand without end. ——— is a strategic exploration game centered around a card-connecting mechanism. Drive your frenzied roots through swamps and over frozen mountains, invading human cities until the darkness... descends.

games.name: Bloody Knuckles Street Boxing
games.text: The Sweet Science Meets The STREETS!

games.name: VOID/BREAKER
games.text: Fast paced Bullet hell Roguelite FPS 🔴 Fight relentless machines driven by a hostile AI. Escape an endless cycle. Craft infinite weapon variants with deep gun modding. Forge deadly synergies. Carve your way out through enviro destruction /BREAK THE SYSTEM /BREAK FREE

games.name: Tinkerlands
games.text: Explore, craft, and fight your way through uncharted islands — solo or with up to 4 players in co-op! ——— is an exciting survival adventure where you will build your settlement, craft useful tools to survive, and even use magic!

games.name: ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN
games.text: ——— is a standalone adventure within the ELDEN RING universe, crafted to offer players a new gaming experience by reimagining the game’s core design.

games.name: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered
games.text: Explore Cyrodiil like never before with stunning new visuals and refined gameplay in ———.

games.name: Find Matt's Cats
games.text: Go on a scavenger-hunt adventure that spans 84 hand-crafted levels, while getting to know the four friends who struggle to keep their video game studio together.

games.name: Life is Strange: Reunion
games.text: The saga of Max and Chloe, and the fate of Caledon, is yours to decide! Play as both Max and Chloe as an all-new story builds towards an epic climax. The fire will force Max and Chloe to make devastating decisions. Can they find a future together… Before everything burns?

games.name: Drive Beyond Horizons
games.text: Explore, survive, and push the boundaries of the horizon in a vast, procedurally generated world. Customize your vehicle, face unpredictable events, gather resources, and embark on a unique adventure, alone or with up to 4 players.

games.name: Star Racer
games.text: Soar through concrete and cosmos in ———, a retro-infused combat racer. Defy gravity, conquer wild Event Races, master the course editor, and crush the competition by any means necessary!

games.name: Dragon Eclipse
games.text: ——— is a roguelite deck-builder with a unique auto-battler twist. Choose your Tamer, team up with powerful Mystlings, and battle fierce foes. Grow and evolve your Mystlings, craft a winning deck, and unleash epic combos to dominate the battlefield. But beware—the Eclipse is close!

games.name: NINJA GAIDEN 4
games.text: The definitive ninja action-adventure franchise returns with ———! Embark on a cutting-edge adventure where legacy meets innovation in a high-octane blend of style and no-holds-barred combat.

games.name: Goofy Gorillas
games.text: Relive your childhood nostalgia at ———, the largest virtual jungle gym! Battle it out with your friends in a wide range of casual but intense PvP gamemodes, or chill out and take part in some extra activities around the venue! Make the Goofy experience your own!

games.name: Sailaway III
games.text: Sailing simulation. Explore the world's oceans or compete in races in the most realistic sailing simulator available. The sailing waters are as big as the real world and circumnavigation will take several months. Using true weather, true conditions and true sail trim.

games.name: Front Office Football Nine
games.text: Put yourself in the Front Office with Front Office Football, the professional football simulation from Solecismic Software. Manage your roster through trading, free agency and the amateur draft. Create game plans, organize depth charts and watch your franchise thrive for decades.

games.name: Tokyo Xtreme Racer
games.text: The title of “fastest” never fades. Race through the sealed future Tokyo night highways in your customized car. Defeat rivals in “SP Battle,” where drivers clash by draining Spirit Points. A unique racing game where only the rules for victory matter.

games.name: City Defense Z
games.text: ——— combines base-building and base defense in a roguelite progression loop. Build by day, defend by night, and face a growing zombie threat. Every defeat unlocks permanent upgrades, helping you rebuild smarter and push further each time. See how many days you can last.

games.name: Used Cars Simulator
games.text: ——— - trade used or stolen cars, fix and customize them, drive around, and explore the open world! Grow your business, complete quests, and have fun with a physics-based sandbox!

games.name: Duck Detective: The Secret Salami
games.text: Solving crime is no walk in the pond. You are a down-on-his-luck detective who also happens to be a duck. Use your powers of de-duck-tion to inspect evidence, fill in the blanks, and bust the case wide open! This is a short but twisty detective case.

games.name: Lost For Swords
games.text: ——— is a Roguelike Deckbuilder, where the cards in your deck shape the rooms you’re exploring. Make your way up the tower, equip weapons and armor, cast spells and scrolls, activate auras, collect loot and defeat monsters in tactical turn-based combat.

games.name: Apex Rush
games.text: A physics-driven arcade racer where racing, drifting, and stunting come together. Compete on global leaderboards, build and share your own tracks, customize your cars & more!

games.name: Fairytale Fables
games.text: Dive into a fantastical autobattler where fairytales and legends collide! Choose your hero and assemble your team of characters, items and treasures to outwit opponents in strategic battles where positioning matters. Will you be the last one standing in this enchanted PvP arena?

games.name: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown
games.text: ——— is a story-driven survival strategy game in which the fate of the iconic starship is in your hands. Take the helm, manage the ship and resources, and make difficult decisions. Will you be able to bring home the ship and its crew?

games.name: PICO PARK 2
games.text: PICO PARK is back with all new levels! Play with 2-8 players locally or online in this co-op action-puzzle game!

games.name: Menace from the Deep
games.text: ——— is an enthralling Roguelike Deckbuilding card game that unfolds in a dark world, drawing inspiration from Howard Lovecraft and the Cthulhu Mythos. Set against the backdrop of 1920s USA, the narrative revolves around a clandestine occult society.

games.name: Soulmask
games.text: Don the Ancient Mask. Wield the power of gods. Possess any of your tribespeople, recruit followers, and build a thriving automated civilization. Survive, expand, and forge your own legacy across a vast ancient open world — together with friends.

games.name: Dead Weight
games.text: Face the Ancient Gods! Set the sails of your flying pirate ship and embark on a roguelite adventure in the steampunk world of ———. Explore floating islands in search of loot. Choose a class and enjoy turn-based tactical combat on tiny battlefields where every step matters.

games.name: Sam & Max: The Devil's Playhouse
games.text: The last game in the episodic ——— trilogy, beautifully remastered! As the intergalactic villains who seek the Devil’s Toybox close in and Max’s psychic abilities grow beyond his control, the Freelance Police will come up against their most frightening adversary yet: the power of Max’s mind.

games.name: Marvel's Spider-Man 2
games.text: Be Greater. Together. The incredible power of the symbiote forces Peter Parker and Miles Morales into a desperate fight as they balance their lives, friendships, and their duty to protect in an exciting chapter of the critically acclaimed Spider-Man franchise on PC.

games.name: Slip & Skid
games.text: Race against your friends and alter the track by placing obstacles after each lap. Change the rules mid-game with roguelike modifiers. Shove your opponents off the track, drift, boost and jump. Up to 4 players online and local split-screen.

games.name: SealChain: Call of Blood
games.text: ——— is a roguelike game where items can link together to form chain reactions. Items can also be arranged into specific formations to create seals, granting special effects.

games.name: Little Problems: A Cozy Detective Game
games.text: ——— is a Cozy Detective game about solving minor inconveniences, everyday misunderstandings, and of course, ———. This game is not about saving the world; it's about enriching it, one case at a time.

games.name: The Exit 8
games.text: You are trapped in an endless underground passageway. Observe your surroundings carefully to reach "———".

games.name: Kingdom's Deck
games.text: Build by day, defend by night! ——— is a card-based city builder where you build and protect your Kingdom from the enemy siege. Build your deck, deploy your cards wisely, defend your walls, manage your resources, and respond to various events that will shape your Kingdom!

games.name: ANTHEM#9
games.text: Combine gems to form combos! In the Strategic Gem Match roguelite "———", you’ll fight thrilling and puzzle-like combo battles. Assume the role of an agent of the secret organization known as ——— and confront powerful foes! Strategic deck construction is the key to unleashing lots of combos

games.name: Cricket Through the Ages
games.text: Swing bats and throw balls through the intertwined histories of humankind and cricket in this one button, physics-driven game.

games.name: LOLLIPOP CHAINSAW RePOP
games.text: The chainsaw-wielding cheerleader Juliet Starling returns in ———!

games.name: Is this Game Trying to Kill Me?
games.text: An old shack deep in a dense forest, a strange computer and a game that's trying to kill you!

games.name: Animal Shelter 2
games.text: Welcome back to the heartwarming world of ———! Provide a loving home for every four-legged friend in need – play with them, pet them, even dress them up! Get to know them and find them a loving family. Play with your friends and manage your shelter together in co-op!

games.name: Kill The Shadow
games.text: ——— is a detective game with multiple endings, featuring 2.5D pixel art and semi-open exploration and investigation. Play as Lucas, a former police officer, alongside a mysterious Shadow who can see the “past.” Remember—every choice you make will change the fate of countless characters!

games.name: Aviassembly
games.text: Build and fly your own airplane! Complete missions to earn money, upgrade your plane, and discover new locations in an open world.

games.name: Grounded 2
games.text: Shrunk again, but the world is much larger. In this open-world, single-player or co-op survival adventure, craft weapons and armor, build your base, and traverse the playground on your buggy. But something else is out there—and it hasn’t forgotten you.

games.name: POOLS
games.text: Walking simulator. Explore, admire and listen. Uncanny. Relaxing. Unnerving. Eerie. Immersive. No monsters chasing you or jumping at your screen, but can feel oppressive at times by invoking fears of getting lost, the dark, tight spaces and liminal space architecture. Inspired by backrooms.

games.name: Tower of Babel: Survivors of Chaos
games.text: Bullet Heaven x Endless Loot! Create Your Own Build in this Roguelite Action RPG.

games.name: Dog And Goblin
games.text: ——— is an auto-battler Roguelike deck-building strategy game where you assemble a mixed army to stand against humans. With nearly 150 units across 19 different types, build your ultimate army and conquer their castles!

games.name: Ballionaire
games.text: ——— is a fast-paced, kinetic roguelike where strategy meets physics to create outrageous wealth! Find and exploit game-breaking synergies as you theorycraft your way to victory. Welcome to the autobonker genre!

games.name: Heroes Wanted
games.text: "———" immerses you in a world of endless deck-building possibilities. Over a hundred of heroes and items, combined with elements, unleash powerful synergies. SIMPLE, FUN, and ADDICTIVE! Heroes await your call to deliver the ultimate blow to the Demon Lord.

games.name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak II
games.text: Return to the Calvard Republic and unravel the mystery of the crimson beast! One day, a shocking series of murders set the wheels of fate into motion once again. Chaos looming on the horizon, the spriggan Van Arkride receives an unexpected visitor. Who is behind the murders, and what is their goal?

games.name: Red Dead Redemption
games.text: Experience the story of former outlaw John Marston as he tracks down the last remaining members of the notorious Van der Linde Gang in the PC debut of the critically acclaimed predecessor to ——— 2.

games.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 25
games.text: ——— gives you more ways to win for the club. Team up with friends in your favourite modes with the new 5v5 Rush, and manage your club to victory as FC IQ delivers more tactical control than ever before.

games.name: BRUTALISTICK VR
games.text: The golden age of violent flash games now in your VR headset. Fully physics based combat with melee and firearms featuring copious amounts of blood, gore and destruction.

games.name: Supermarket Simulator
games.text: Run your own supermarket! Stock shelves, set your prices, take payments, hire staff, expand your store, handle shoplifters, and design your layout. Purchase goods from online or local markets around town, and personally deliver online orders to your customers.

games.name: UnLoop
games.text: ⚠️VR-only. Your mic is recording. Your actions too.⚠️ Infiltrate a retro space station. Get trapped in a time loop. Your past copies will replay every word you said and every mistake you made. You're the team. You're also the problem.

games.name: Kings Call
games.text: Collect an array of creature and skill cards through quests, upgrades and trading, and craft your ultimate deck by choosing your favorite cards and prepare for epic battles. Dive into the exhilaration of strategic gameplay and let your inner tactician shine to outsmart your opponents!

games.name: Runehaven
games.text: ——— is an atmospheric roguelike dungeon crawler with an immersive magic system where you craft your own spells. Explore a mysterious procedurally generated world.

games.name: No Case Should Remain Unsolved
games.text: Twelve years after Senior Inspector Jeon Gyeong's retirement, she is visited by a young police officer: a woman who pleads with her to reexamine Seowon's case. But with each uncovered memory, only one thing becomes clear: everyone in Seowon's vicinity was lying.

games.name: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle
games.text: Uncover one of history’s greatest mysteries in a first-person, single-player adventure. The year is 1937, sinister forces are scouring the globe for the secret to an ancient power connected to the Great Circle, and only one person can stop them - Indiana Jones™.

games.name: Witchspire
games.text: Step into the ultimate open-world witch adventure. Befriend and battle creatures, and conjure up a sanctuary alongside other witches in co-op or single-player.

games.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio
games.text: After his assassination, the will of the late king decrees the next monarch to be elected by the people. Forge bonds and win over a kingdom divided in this award-winning fantasy RPG with turn-based and action combat, party customization with powerful Archetypes, and hours of exploration.

games.name: Outbound
games.text: Explore a colorful world and build your own cozy home on wheels. Craft workstations, and source energy from the sun, wind, or water. Upgrade and customize your vehicle, grow crops, and live sustainably off-grid with up to 4 players.

games.name: Late Night Drift
games.text: Are you ready to embark on the drift adventure of a lifetime? Gather your crew, rev up your engines, and become the Drift Masters.

games.name: Ale & Tale Tavern
games.text: Get ready for a thrilling mix of genres: a cooperative, first-person, open-world fantasy tavern simulator, action, fishing, hunting, exploration, and completing fun and diverse quests. And, of course, COOKING! Play with friends, feed and quench the thirst of the entire world!

games.name: Endacopia
games.text: ——— is a Point-and-Click Puzzle Adventure that is visually reminiscent of early computer edutainment games... with underlying horrors.

games.name: CHAIRS
games.text: A fast-paced action platformer doubling as the most realistic chair simulator money can buy! Have you ever wondered what your chair thinks? What it believes? What it desires? Learn the answers and destroy some dimensions along the way!

games.name: Faith in Despair
games.text: Forge your own cards with triggers, actions and modifiers. Shape your deck and gamble against Death itself. Make one mistake and you will descend into despair.

games.name: Voyagers of Nera
games.text: ——— is a cooperative survival-crafting game where you must survive a magical ocean world brimming with lost spirits and deadly monsters. Sail to distant islands, build beautiful villages and surf across the waves with up to 10 players.

games.name: GODBREAKERS
games.text: Fast, Fluid, Frenetic! Break gods, steal powers, and chain abilities in a hectic combat loop. This 1-4 player co-op action roguelite is built for fast pick-up sessions and endlessly replayable chaos. Experience tough battles and maximum expression where every run feels rewarding!

games.name: Super Algebrawl
games.text: Add up, multiply, clone, and divide your party members to beat the monsters on your path!

games.name: Planet Coaster 2
games.text: Build and customise thrilling roller coasters and incredible water slides, manage the ultimate theme park experience, and share your epic creations. Are you ready to ride the wave?

games.name: CRUEL
games.text: A fast run and gun horror shooter with roguelike elements

games.name: Garten of Banban 7
games.text: Explore the monster-occupied levels of Banban’s Kindergarten. Survive the dreads that reside below as you are now completely on your own. Uncover the truth behind the place, and find the whereabouts of your missing child…

games.name: Witching Stone
games.text: ——— is a puzzle game matched with a deckbuilder! Customise your spellbook and weave spells with coloured stones.

games.name: Dice & Fold
games.text: A turn-based dungeon crawler where your only way of attacking the enemy is by rolling dice. Roll dice to damage enemy cards to FOLD. Inspired by classic Solitaire, in a top-down table and enemies made out of cards, try to beat the dungeon with 35 unique classes. Build your deck, kill monsters.

games.name: NEODUEL: Backpack Monsters
games.text: ——— is an inventory auto-battler with a monster-trainer twist! Collect Cosmions and items, and strategically manage your backpack to create unbeatable combos in tactical duels. Rise through the leagues to become the ultimate Cosmion master!

games.name: Path of Exile 2
games.text: ——— is a next generation Action RPG from Grinding Gear Games, featuring co-op for up to six players. Set years after the original Path of Exile, you will return to the dark world of Wraeclast and seek to end the corruption that is spreading.

games.name: Kindergarten 3
games.text: ——— is the long awaited threequel to the Kindergarten series! Explore a new school with old and new friends...and new ways to get ruthlessly murdered.

games.name: PANICORE
games.text: ——— is a survival horror game that mixes permadeath, AI monsters and a co-op experience up to 5 players (4 players in demo). Try to escape and don't get caught, but beware: they don't only hear your steps, but also your voice.

games.name: The Legend of Khiimori
games.text: Take on the role of a brave courier rider in ———! Bond with your horse and tame the open wilds of 13th century Mongolia. Breed and train horses with specialized abilities to explore every aspect of this diverse and fascinating landscape.

games.name: Commander Quest
games.text: Congratulations! You just found a 'one of a kind' roguelike that combines deck-building card game and auto battle strategy game! Consider unit counters, then create powerful synergy by breaking down the boundaries between the battlefield and cards, then lead your army to victory!

games.name: Ascend to ZERO
games.text: Have you ever wondered what it feels like to stop time? ——— is a time-bending action-roguelike where you can use your unique ability to freeze time and fight your way to the top.

games.name: Restore Your Island
games.text: Heal a scarred island, rebuild habitats, play with your dog, design your sanctuary, and relax by the fire. Turn this broken, trash-filled island into a thriving sanctuary — one clean sweep at a time.

games.name: The Crew Motorfest
games.text: Welcome to Motorfest, the ultimate open-world driving experience. Explore the Hawaiian islands of O'ahu and Maui. Celebrate the best of car culture through 20+ themed campaigns (street racing, offroad, drift...) and collect hundreds of iconic vehicles. Enjoy the game free for five hours!

games.name: Intoxicated Driver
games.text: Get ready to drink and drive (safely). Challenge friends in multiple drinking and driving game modes, like drunk cop chases, pedestrians, races, capture the flag, hot potato, and more! With options to change the style of play, there is so much drunk driving fun!

games.name: Wagotabi: A Japanese Journey
games.text: ——— is an educational RPG teaching Japanese from the ground up. Immerse yourself in the language through interactive dialogues, quest-solving, and puzzles, all while exploring Japan and its rich culture. Will you become a Japanese master?

games.name: Strange Jigsaws
games.text: A game of ———.

games.name: Map Map - A Game About Maps
games.text: In this game YOU make the maps! Become the cartographer of a small adventure crew and use proper navigation tools like a real explorer. Map the environment to turn unknown islands into a hand-drawn journey toward a legendary treasure.

games.name: Chernobyl: Simulator
games.text: ——— puts you in the control room of the most infamous nuclear power plant in history. Step into the shoes of a reactor operator, where every switch, gauge, and decision matters. Experience the pressure, responsibility, and unforgiving complexity of Soviet-era nuclear operations.

games.name: Rooftops & Alleys: The Parkour Game
games.text: In solo or with your friends, explore in total freedom massive-parkour-ready maps. Uncover hidden spots, time trials, trick challenges, and more! In multiplayer, dive into game modes like TAG, Capture The Flag, and Trick Battles!

games.name: Stoneguard
games.text: To protect the magical Lifestone, you must strategise, manage and build a fortified settlement. Lead your fellow survivors into battle against waves of nocturnal monsters who wish to take this precious Lifestone from your world.

games.name: ALL WILL FALL
games.text: Build massive ocean cities and lead your people to prosperity in this post-apocalyptic survival colony sim. Featuring a physics-based 3D construction system, complex resource management, exploration, difficult political decisions, supply chains, and a robust sandbox mode.

games.name: Tower Factory
games.text: ——— is a tower defense and automation game with roguelite elements. Optimize resource production using conveyor systems while defending against monster waves. Can you find and destroy the enemy tower before it's too late?

games.name: Streetdog BMX
games.text: Get ready for massive tricks, high scores, and gnarly slams in ———. Carve your way through six huge maps featuring hidden spots, handcrafted challenges, and flowing lines!

games.name: Palia
games.text: Discover a welcoming world in ———, a free-to-play fantasy life sim adventure where you can craft, explore, and create the life and home of your dreams. With nearly endless ways to make ——— your home, you’ll find relaxation and joy in every corner of this vibrant, heartwarming world.

games.name: FPV Kamikaze Drone
games.text: ——— is a tactical game focused on FPV drones in modern warfare. Control drones in first-person in single-player and co-op, and in multiplayer play as a third-person soldier who finds and uses FPV drones during combat.

games.name: Oh Deer
games.text: One Hunter, and up to four more friends disguised as deer, in this thrilling game of hide-and-seek where every move could be the last. Will you blend in with the herd or stand out? ———...

games.name: Supermarket Together
games.text: The multiplayer supermarket has arrived to your neighbourhood for free! Stock your shop space, unlock perks and franchises, hire employees or chase those pesky shoplifters. The more players, the more action!

games.name: Hyperspace Deck Command
games.text: ——— is a complex deck building roguelite. Command a massive space fleet that operates on individual turn timers, combine a wide variety of cards into powerful decks and master the dual-use status effects to defeat the hegemonising swarm.

games.name: DUNGEON SLASHER
games.text: Navigate maps filled with enemies, destroying all who get in your way! Use a variety of character, artifact, and skill synergies to defeat the dungeon!

games.name: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy
games.text: Embark on an original story, prequel to the award-winning games: A Plague Tale. As Sophia, journey to the Minotaur’s Island, outsmart deadly foes, unravel ancient secrets, and confront a mythical creature at the heart of a devastating curse.

games.name: Duck Detective: The Ghost of Glamping
games.text: You are the one and only ———, a depressed and recently divorced duck who must quack the case. Inspect evidence, make de-duck-tions, and solve this no-murder mystery!

games.name: The Rise of the Golden Idol
games.text: The Award-winning detective saga returns in this standalone sequel to The Case of the Golden Idol. Uncover the truth behind 20 strange cases of crime, death and depravity in the 1970s. The world has changed dramatically - the sins of humanity have not.

games.name: KALPA: Cosmic Symphony
games.text: A next-generation rhythm game where story and music intertwine. Enjoy a tracklist filled with famous licensed songs and exclusive original songs made by renowned composers Discover an immersive story, and face endless challenges. Your performance will dictate the fate of the world.

games.name: The Rogue Prince of Persia
games.text: In this challenging, fast-paced roguelite, every death is a unique chance to rewrite fate, save Persia or die trying. Master fluid, acrobatic combat and parkour as you explore your kingdom to right your wrongs!

games.name: Star Birds
games.text: ——— is a chill factory building and resource management game. Mine asteroids and create brain-twisting production networks. Level by level, you guide your feathered crew to new interstellar horizons!

games.name: Grunn
games.text: A gardener gets hired for maintenance work over the weekend. A simple task, but strangely some tools are missing… The owner of the garden isn't around, and their house is off-limits. Perhaps new tools can be found in the mysterious town, or maybe some of the reserved townsfolk have seen them?

games.name: Öoo
games.text: A Bomb Caterpillar's Big Adventure! "———" is a charming yet mysterious exploration puzzle platformer where you discover creative ways to use bombs!

games.name: HER TREES : THE PUZZLE HOUSE
games.text: ——— is a unique point-and-click puzzle game where you move and combine objects to solve puzzles. Uncover the mysteries of this peculiar room.

games.name: ENDER MAGNOLIA: Bloom in the Mist
games.text: Decades after the events of ENDER LILIES, Homunculi — sorrowful, artificial life forms — roam the land. In this dark fantasy Metroidvania, face formidable enemies and explore a bewitching post-apocalyptic world. Humans and Homunculi — what awaits at the end of the quest for their salvation?

games.name: Pro Show Jumping
games.text: Experience the world of professional show jumping with this simulation-based game! Ride through realistic jumping courses with a variety of horses, refine your eye for strides, design your very own courses and share them with friends.

games.name: Suck Up!
games.text: Ready for a vampire adventure in a quiet little town? ———! is a comedic game where you survive as a bloodsucking vampire in the human world. Talk to real AI characters, fool them into trusting you, and find a way into their homes to feed without getting caught.

games.name: Hamster Hunter
games.text: You come home for an annual family reunion, only to find your family missing with an eerie note left by your father. After you discover what has happened you SEEK REVENGE!

games.name: Deathless. The Hero Quest
games.text: In Deathless, elements of a collectible card game, roguelike, and turn-based strategy combine seamlessly. Build a unique deck of cards, discover unusual relics, and defeat legendary bosses. No two journeys will ever be the same with endless Path. Crush the Evil and save the world!

games.name: WHAT THE CAR?
games.text: Race through hundreds of silly levels as a shapeshifting car in strange worlds populated by …bears? Run, roll, jump, fly and sneeze your way to victory! Join the community and make your own chaotic levels!

games.name: Card-en-Ciel
games.text: ——— is a roguelite card-battling RPG featuring over 300 different cards and 50 unique vocal songs! Play as Neon, the "Gaming Chair Detective" famous for solving net-crimes, as he encounters a strange new case when he dives into an in-development game world.

games.name: EVERYBODY'S GOLF HOT SHOTS
games.text: Everybody’s favorite golf game series finally returns to the fairway! Hit the green with a variety of unique characters and courses in online and offline AND single and multiplayer modes!

games.name: Frostrain
games.text: Be the last train conductor roaming the postapocalyptic frozen world! Expand, strengthen, and build synergies on your train. The promised land beyond the toxic zone awaits you and your passengers.

games.name: Battle RC
games.text: Immerse yourself in this new robot combat game, battling others and building your own bots to prove who's best. Fight in single matches, rumbles, and tournaments, each testing your skills and strategy. Are you ready to dominate the arena and claim victory in ———?

games.name: Parking Garage Rally Circuit
games.text: Retro Arcade Rally Racing... in Parking Garages?!? Precision driving with tight simple controls and arcade physics, all in a Sega Saturn style presentation

games.name: The House of Tesla: Definitive Edition
games.text: Solve intricate puzzles to activate Nikola Tesla's creations, restore Wardenclyffe Tower, and unlock hidden devices in his New York lab. Explore the Chicago World's Fair in this mind-bending puzzle adventure.

games.name: Sol Cesto
games.text: ——— is a tactical and frantic roguelite where mastering your luck is key. Choose a hero, upgrade them using cursed teeth and magical items, and descend to the bottom of an ever-changing dungeon. In this dark world, every action has consequences…

games.name: Node Farm
games.text: ——— is a game about building a fully automated farm using nodes. Connect nodes, harvest and sell veggies, buy new islands, discover new nodes, and automate the process - all in a cozy farm simulation formula!

games.name: Horse Racing Manager
games.text: Manage your own horse racing stables, breed and train future champions. Compete across diverse tracks, balance finances, manage staff, and expand your reach in the world of horse racing. Turn ambition into legacy, one choice at a time.

games.name: Tactic Boxing
games.text: ——— is a boxing game with ragdoll physics, local multiplayer, career mode and manager mode.

games.name: Cozy Cleaner
games.text: ——— is a relaxing cleaning game where you tidy and organize rooms messed up by playful cats. Pick up clutter, wipe away dirt, and bring order back to every space for a calming, refreshing experience with cozy soundtracks.

games.name: Monster Train 2
games.text: Monster Train returns with all new clans, new enemy factions, new challenges, new modes and more! Defend your Pyre in the classic three-tiered, vertical gameplay that made the original roguelike deckbuilder a hit.

games.name: Tricky Madness
games.text: ——— is an upcoming arcade snowboarding game with a focus on speed and big air inspired by classics like SSX and 1080. Race down the mountain, explore secret areas, catch big air and perform Wicked tricks.

games.name: Three Kingdoms: The Blood Moon
games.text: ——— is a turn-based Roguelike card game where you assume the role of a Shu general. Explore dungeons, gather relics, and amass a collection of cards. In each round, you can assemble a unique combination of cards and treasures to defeat your enemies and rewrite history!

games.name: Species: Unknown
games.text: ——— is a 1 to 4 players co-op survival horror. Complete high-risk missions aboard an abandoned ship while being hunted by an unknown creature. Survive and upgrade your gear to face each new threat that lurks in the dark.

games.name: Dawnmaker
games.text: ——— is a turn-based city building and deckbuilding game, made by 2 strategy fans. It feels like playing a solo board game. Build luminous cities, optimize your deck and create powerful combinations between buildings and cards to bring life back to a dead world. Play the demo now!

games.name: Esports Manager 2026
games.text: Build and lead your own professional esports organization. Scout players, manage contracts, develop talent, hire staff, grow your brand, and compete for championship titles in a deep and realistic management simulation.

games.name: Dice Player One
games.text: "———" is a roguelike strategy game where dice reign supreme! Roll your dice, seize pivotal moments, and transform limited chances into boundless opportunities. Conquer challenges, unearth hidden secrets, and master the art of dice manipulation!

games.name: The King is Watching
games.text: ——— is a roguelite kingdom builder. Rule by the power of your royal gaze! Decide between producing resources, training armies, or balancing both, while adapting to unique events every run

games.name: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion
games.text: A cosmic battle awaits! Choose between 15 Marvel Super Heroes in this frenetic action beat ‘em up to fight against the deadly Annihilation Wave threatening the galaxy. From New York City to the depths of the Negative Zone, the future of the Marvel Universe will be fought for across the stars!

games.name: The Roottrees are Dead
games.text: A genealogical mystery straight out of 1998. Scour the early Internet for clues, uncover hidden connections, and piece together the family tree behind the secretive Roottree Corporation.

games.name: Keep Driving
games.text: An atmospheric management RPG about life on the open road. Pick up hitchhikers, work odd jobs, customize and repair your car, and map your route across the country. Use upgrades, skills and items to overcome challenges. And remember to take it easy. You’re young. You have time.

games.name: PUMP IT UP RISE
