games.text: ——— is the official PC version of the PUMP IT UP series, the arcade rhythm game franchise loved for over 25 years. Optimized for keyboard, gamepad, Steam Deck, and more, it brings the excitement of arcade-style rhythm action back to you on Steam.

games.name: Kumitantei: Old-School Slaughter
games.text: Kill each other...for science! The class of '89 is trapped in an elite school killing game. Investigate, solve, and expose your classmates in ———, an episodic murder-mystery ADV card-battler inspired by retro anime.

games.name: Another Farm Roguelike: Rebirth
games.text: Discover the ultimate farming roguelike experience! Build, craft, and grow your farm to pay off the increasing rent. No slow-paced walking or social distractions—just click! Reclaim the joy of strategic farming in diverse maps and let your cursor guide you to success. Play your way, rent won’t wait!

games.name: Revolution Idle
games.text: ——— is a free idle incremental game with offline progress, prestige layers, and endless automation. Start simple, reach infinity and go further.

games.name: Sandustry
games.text: Explore and mine fully destructible worlds. Automate increasingly complex production chains. Delve deep to uncover an ancient civilization’s powerful secrets and learn to love the sand in this factory game where every pixel is a valuable resource.

games.name: Monster: Titan's Playground
games.text: Devastate a fully-destructible city in VR as a giant ———. Battle mechs using your various breath, ranged, and melee weapons—including fire breath, gravity cannon, and lock-on missile pods.

games.name: The Other Side
games.text: ——— is a co-op psychological thriller for up to 6 players. Your goal is to investigate haunted locations using modern ghost hunting equipment, gather evidence, identify entities, and cleanse them from the location. Customize your character, headquarters, and more.

games.name: PengPong
games.text: ——— is a bullet-hell roguelike where pinball meets gambling. Bounce your way through chaos and bet it all to survive.

games.name: LurkBait Twitch Fishing
games.text: A Twitch powered interactive cozy fishing idle game. Add as an overlay for your stream and let your viewers fish with commands, points, bits or subs. Reel in the lurkers and boost viewer engagement passively with a fun interactive game that runs itself while you focus on your content.

games.name: Wicked Seed
games.text: A modern-day horror RPG with tactical combat and survival horror roots. Customize your loadout, manage limited resources, and exploit enemy weaknesses in tense, strategic encounters.

games.name: ATLYSS
games.text: Enter the world of ———, a Singleplayer/Online RPG where you can fight with or against friends in a surreal world filled with creatures beyond comprehension. Customize and progress your character(s), complete quests, and discover strange locations.

games.name: Wax Heads
games.text: ——— is a cozy-punk narrative sim about working in a struggling record store. Chat to quirky customers with unique tastes, explore a handcrafted record collection, fall in love with bands (and their drama!), or just slack off with your colleagues - whatever gets everyone’s groove back!

games.name: CleanFall
games.text: ——— is a survival rogue-like that prizes player freedom and creativity. Build mobile death machines to fight off ravenous hordes, craft and alchemize gun turrets, and tunnel through subterranean ecosystems crawling with nameless horrors.

games.name: Ghost Janitors
games.text: ——— is a multiplayer psychological horror game for 1-4 players. Your job? Cleaning haunted houses while avoiding terrifying monsters. Ready to face the spine-tingling challenge with your team?

games.name: Disillusion ST
games.text: A strange journey throughout an elaborate labyrinth awaits, featuring hundreds of characters and happenings as you try to gather items that once brought happiness to others.

games.name: Lay of the Land
games.text: ——— is a sandbox adventure game set in a fantasy world where everything is physically simulated. Use the environment to your advantage and Explore, Fight, Loot and Build your way through mysterious lands.

games.name: The Eminence in Shadow: Master of Garden
games.text: Enter the world of ———, a multiplayer, narrative driven, action-RPG where players form their own party from a deep roster of unique characters, voiced by the actors from the anime, and engage in new stories, to take down the world-threatening Cult of Diabolos.

games.name: Modulus: Factory Automation
games.text: Build, automate, & optimize production lines across sky islands with real spatial constraints. Every production line is an open-ended puzzle: which operators to use, how to route your belts and how to fit your factory into the landscape. Your solutions, like your factories, are uniquely your own.

games.name: Archons
games.text: ——— is a Roguelite/Survivor game where you control two characters, the ———- simultaneously! Customize your build and abilities to fit your own unique playstyle and blast your way through enemy parasites and bosses!

games.name: Asgard's Fall — Viking Survivors
games.text: Embark on an epic saga in ———, a norse Survivors-like Roguelite. Fight your way through hordes of creatures and let the gods feel your relentless wrath. How will your saga unfold?

games.name: LOCKDOWN Protocol
games.text: A first person social deduction game, combining real time action and communication, playable up to 16 players. While most players will cooperate to complete objectives to ensure victory, a small portion of dissidents will try their best to stop them at all cost, without being caught.

games.name: The Killing Stone
games.text: Beat the Devil at his own game. ——— is a deckbuilding card battler wrapped in a 17th century occult horror narrative. Clean the sins of a cursed family by bargaining against a series of demons - and outwitting the Devil himself.

games.name: Age of Empires Mobile: PC Edition
games.text: Build empires, forge alliances and conquer hundreds of players in real time.

games.name: 9 Kings
games.text: A fast-paced roguelike kingdom builder. Grow your empire and fight massive battles against powerful rival kings. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to become the King of Kings.

games.name: Arrogue
games.text: Collect, upgrade and unlock powerful arrows and relics to protect your village. For that you’ll have to fight against procedurally generated hordes of enemies in this turn-per-turn, physics-based, roguelike! Explore the map, find the right path and make decisive choices in random events.

games.name: Revenge of the Savage Planet
games.text: ——— is an upbeat, satirical action adventure Sci-Fi. Jump, shoot and collect your way across vibrant alien worlds, uncovering new gear and upgrades, while discovering various hidden secrets.

games.name: Bingle Bingle
games.text: "———" is a "roulette-building" game where you create your own roulette wheel and build strategies around it. Combine balls, bets, tokens, pockets, and badges to trigger adrenaline-pumping synergies, win millions or billions of chips, and beat the casino.

games.name: Scam Line
games.text: ——— is a 4–8 player social deception game where your party will face different challenges. Become a liar, a manipulator, a cheater, or find your own path to victory

games.name: SILENT BREATH
games.text: Unpredictable horrors lurk around every corner, forcing you to find the missing people while desperately clinging to survival. In this experience even your own mind can become your enemy. Stay vigilant and keep your voice hushed, or risk becoming another victim of the forest's darkness

games.name: Cat God Ranch
games.text: Lead hundreds of "wise" little animals to pay tribute to the Cat God!! 7 animal families, 100+ animals, 10+ Cat Gods, 100+ items, and various animal combinations waiting for you to explore!

games.name: Pip My Dice
games.text: ——— is a Yahtzee Roguelike experience. Score enough to make it to the next level, customize your dice to score more and collect relics to create unlimited combos! Collect money through the rounds to buy new dice, relics, and customizers to upgrade your dice. Enjoy a different run every time!

games.name: Confidential Killings - A Detective Game
games.text: A series of murders is shocking Hollywood! Use your detective skills: search the crime scene, find clues, solve the mystery. Who is pulling the strings behind these ———?

games.name: INAZUMA ELEVEN: Victory Road
games.text: The latest entry in the character collection and football simulation RPG series, "———!" With an original story featuring new main characters, over 5,400 players from across the series' history to collect and train, as well as exciting online tournaments, you can play the game your way!

games.name: Quantum Odyssey
games.text: Design, optimize, and reverse-engineer real quantum algorithms in an open-ended Zachlike puzzle game. Solve 500+ optimization challenges, hack player creations, and master quantum logic without coding.

games.name: Atomcraft
games.text: A sandbox adventure where every pixel is physically and chemically simulated! Build intricate, fully functional machines from the pixels around you. Harvest, react, and manipulate all 118 elements to craft everything from simple tools to complex systems.

games.name: Halo: Campaign Evolved
games.text: ——— is a faithful yet modernized remake of ———: Combat Evolved’s campaign, rebuilt from the ground up.

games.name: Bio Goddess : Doomsday Begins
games.text: ——— is a third-person shooter survival game where players assume the role of a female high school student surviving in a school struck by a biochemical crisis. They investigate the events, uncover their connection to their father, and explore their own identity.

games.name: The Talos Principle: Reawakened
games.text: Step back into a world of thought-provoking puzzles, philosophical intrigue, and breathtaking visuals with ——— - a first-person puzzle masterpiece for both new players and long-time fans alike.

games.name: Battlefield™ 6
games.text: The ultimate all-out warfare experience. In a war of tanks, fighter jets, and massive combat arsenals, your squad is the deadliest weapon.

games.name: Forsaken Frontiers
games.text: Step into the frozen unknown in ———, a cooperative analog horror adventure set in the unforgiving embrace of an everlasting winter.

games.name: Clock Rogue
games.text: ——— is an Action Roguelike game which you attack with your stopwatch timing. Build your own time clock and protect the hedgehog from viruses attack!

games.name: Curtain Call
games.text: ———: the latest game from the Noobs Want to Live devs. A strategic roguelite combining auto-battling and deck-building mechanics—recruit performers, take to the stage, and prepare for battle! Win glory and the rapturous applause of the audience. Take that ———!

games.name: Screamer
games.text: High-octane action and anime aesthetics collide in this arcade racing game, featuring fighting mechanics and a storyline that hits hard. In this world, some race for glory while others seek power or revenge. Every race is a fight and every battle is personal.

games.name: RIDE 6
games.text: Live the thrill of asphalt and dirt with ———: affirm your biker identity by joining RIDE Fest, race with 250+ bikes from different categories and prove you're the best by challenging real motorcycling legends.

games.name: Disc Golf Masters
games.text: The disc golf game built for people who actually play disc golf. Throw real licensed discs, pick your angles, play online, and chase the leaderboards. Made by disc golfers. Updated constantly.

games.name: Aquapark Tycoon
games.text: Build the ultimate waterpark paradise in this classic tycoon simulation game! Design & customize water slides, pools, and saunas to fulfill your guests' needs. Combine creativity, strategy, and management to make a splash in the world of water parks and become the ultimate ———!

games.name: Viking Rise
games.text: Race against other players to explore Valhalla and conquer Midgard!

games.name: A Gentlemen's Dispute
games.text: A fancy party brawler for proper scoundrels! Sling traps, swing bats, and fire cannons in destructible arenas as you scramble for absurd perks and weapons. Outlast your so-called peers by any gentlemanly means necessary - all in the name of good sport, of course.

games.name: Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel
games.text: Hordes of Hel is a gripping roguelike horde-survivor game set in the dark realms of Norse Mythology. Fight waves of enemies to earn divine blessings of ancient Viking Deities, explore hostile worlds and face powerful bosses. Become a god-like warrior in this ultimate showdown.

games.name: Revelatio
games.text: "———" is a turn-based strategy game that combines tile-based combat and elements of roguelike. Strategically summon and control units to claim victory. Stain the world with your darkness by corrupting various units, bosses and even NPCs.

games.name: Drill Core
games.text: Corporate greed meets strategic planet-mining in ———! Drill to the heart of planets while managing workers, researching cutting-edge tech, and fortifying against alien attacks. Will you prioritize efficiency and risk your workers' safety, or focus on defense for survival?

games.name: Sketchy's Contract
games.text: A 1-8 player co-op sci-fi looter horror game that takes place on a mysterious asteroid belt where players must complete contracts by traveling to exotic planets to kill creatures, find loot, and/or farm planetary materials that they must return to an ominous figure named Sketchy.

games.name: Lucky Hunter
games.text: ——— is a deck-building auto battler Roguelike game. Your pieces are automatically played on the board, and players will focus on building unique decks and artifacts, making the best of the synergies between pieces to defeat increasingly powerful prey.

games.name: Exotica 2: Pet Shop Simulator
games.text: ——— is a cozy management game where you design and run your own exotic pet shop. Care for over 70 animals, raise babies, breed rare color variants, customize your store, and manage customers and staff.

games.name: He is Coming
games.text: Deep in the forgotten corners of the world, a dark force stirs – the Demon King rises once more. Sharpen your wits, seek out powerful artifacts, and stand firm in the face of the apocalypse in this roguelite RPG auto battler.

games.name: Old School Rally
games.text: A nostalgic racing game that combines the charm of classic retro style visuals with the thrill of international rally competitions.

games.name: Technotopia
games.text: Welcome to ———, a city-builder card game. Take on the role of an AI designed to build a perfect city. Build districts, meet the needs of diverse communities and maintain the delicate balance between factions vying for control over you!

games.name: Beholder: Conductor
games.text: A ——— series spin-off. Become a conductor of the Determination Bringer train: monitor passengers, report incidents, and carry out important Ministry assignments — whose level of secrecy depends only on your loyalty. And remember: mission success is very important to you!

games.name: The Sinking City 2
games.text: Set in the Roaring '20s, ——— is a survival horror steeped in Lovecraftian dread. Defy an eldritch deity and explore the drowned alleys of Arkham, stalked by the dead, as you weigh one life against an entire city.

games.name: Death Howl
games.text: Master the grid, defy death. Enter a grim Spirit Realm in this open-world deck builder. Craft lethal decks from 160+ cards, claim powerful Totems, and defeat foes in tactical grid combat. Fight as the desperate hunter Ro to bring her son back from beyond the veil.

games.name: Amanda the Adventurer 2
games.text: In ———, the story continues as Riley encounters a mysterious masked figure after destroying the TV in the attic. Travel to the Kensdale Public Library and dig deeper into the mystery of Amanda the Adventurer.

games.name: MIMESIS
games.text: 4 Player co-op survival horror game. When the cursed rain falls, '———' appear, perfectly imitating your teammates, bringing a new level of tension you've never experienced before.

games.name: Fatal Claw
games.text: Dive into ———, a Metroidvania game in vibrant 2D artwork. Explore the arcane underworld your way with Kisha. Your ultimate goal is to find the key to the surface world alongside other survivors, while vanquishing infected enemies and absorbing their power. Start your clawsome adventure now!

games.name: Chess Infinity
games.text: Whether you're new to chess or a seasoned master, welcome to ————the art of timeless strategy. Immerse yourself in serene environments, sharpen your skills with an adaptive AI mentor, and connect with players worldwide. Embrace endless challenges that transcend eras and borders.

games.name: BRAVELY DEFAULT FLYING FAIRY HD Remaster
games.text: BRAVELY DEFAULT returns in HD! Relive the tale of the warriors of light. Enjoy strategic battles and over 20 different jobs. Plus modern gameplay enhancements and all-new minigames. The story of light and shadow that never fades is reborn.

games.name: Backrooms: Extractions
games.text: Co-op horror for 1 to 6 players. Anyone can try to escape the ———. You are going back in: locate the lost agents, solve the puzzles, film the entities, and hold out until extraction. Everything you carry can be lost. Your ranks, gear and storage are built to last.

games.name: Buckshot Roulette
games.text: Play Russian roulette with a 12-gauge shotgun. Four enter. One leaves. Roll the dice with your life. Good luck!

games.name: Gemporium: A Cute Mining Sim
games.text: Mine, refine, and sell gemstones in ———, a cute, fast-paced shop management game. Upgrade your tools, expand your store, and master the daily rhythm of digging, polishing, and turning a profit to pay off your debt, one gem at a time.

games.name: Cozy Marbles
games.text: Engineer the marble run of your dreams. No need to get it perfect – just release your marbles and let the good times roll.

games.name: The Horror at Highrook
games.text: ——— is an occult card crafting narrative RPG. Explore a haunted mansion with your team of investigators, summon dark entities, craft powerful protections, uncover the fate of the missing family, and choose your own path through the darkness.

games.name: Drunken Rogue
games.text: The rowdy adventures of drunk-as-a-skunk Rogue Lita and Vampire of Demise Endo! Stagger around traps and stumble through demon assaults. Make your way to the dungeon's deepest depths—rumored to contain the most precious of booze!

games.name: Rally Arcade Classics
games.text: Rev up your engines, it’s almost time to race back to the past with ———! Including 44 iconic cars from the 70’s, 80’s, 90’s and 00’s, and 48 thrilling tracks to rev up their engines to the max while drifting every close turn, you will never run out of challenges to take upon.

games.name: The Alto Collection
games.text: Across the endless desert and atop an alpine expanse two journeys full of wonder await. Choose your path and set off on a thrilling snowboarding or sandboarding adventure with Alto & friends in both critically acclaimed titles: Alto’s Adventure and Alto’s Odyssey.

games.name: Spinny Dungeon
games.text: The slot machine roguelike. Each time you hit the SPIN button monsters creep closer. KILL 'em! LOOT 'em! EAT 'em! Focus on spells or synergies between symbols. Spin to DIE or spin to SURVIVE!

games.name: Great God Grove
games.text: THE WORLD IS ENDING AND THE GODS ARE SQUABBLING! Suck up and launch dialogue in a world of puzzles, puppets, and weird gods… or THE RIFT WILL CONSUME US ALL!

games.name: SimplePlanes 2
games.text: SimplePlanes is back! Build planes, cars, or anything else using powerful procedural parts! Explore detailed environments with friends in multiplayer, cause chaos, or download 1,000,000 community crafts for free.

games.name: Dream of Corpse Lady
games.text: Cards, battle! Someone woke up the sleeping Corpse Lady... Perhaps, the world needs to pay a price for the awakening... In this game, you will play the role of the awakened Corpse Lady, try various strange construction combinations, discover powerful opponents, and then knock them all down!

games.name: Camper Van: Make it Home
games.text: Decorate and organize the ——— of your dreams! Embark on a journey of self-discovery as you build your own home-on-wheels, using a combination of creative block organization puzzles and relaxing interior design. Make your heart feel at ease and your ——— feel like home.

games.name: Pup Champs
games.text: Lead a team of puppy soccer players, solve 170+ challenges and score goals in this cozy tactical puzzle game!

games.name: Kingdom Rush 5: Alliance TD
games.text: While a formidable evil emerges, an unexpected alliance is taking shape! It will take the finest warriors of Linirea and the relentless Dark Army to stop it. Beware! Though they may journey side by side the ever-changing winds of fate could swiftly alter their course.

games.name: The Girl's Moving Castle
games.text: Girl's Moving Castle is a turn-based RPG where you collect and nurture companions, engage in strategic battles, and experience idle growth with light interactions. Enjoy a no grind, no pay game with free daily rewards rivaling big-spender perks.

games.name: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection
games.text: The third entry in the Monster Hunter Stories RPG series is here! Twin Rathalos, born in a twist of fate. Monster Hunter Stories is an RPG series set in the Monster Hunter world, where you can become a Rider, raising and bonding with your favorite monsters.

games.name: Necroking
games.text: ——— is a turn-based tactics roguelite with vast deckbuilding. You play as a Master of Necromancy. Build your skulls deck, raise skeletons and other scum to defeat settlements desecrated by life.

games.name: Void War
games.text: Command an ancient starship and fight your way to the heart of a dying Empire. Fend off attacks from demented cultists, craven space pirates, and xenophobic Imperial soldiers. Discover powerful artifacts and use them to build your ship into a fearsome war engine.

games.name: Skull and Bones
games.text: ——— is an open world naval action RPG where ship combat, build choice, and sailing skill define your pirate legend. Conquer rival ships and mythical beasts in a vast ocean of up to 20 players.

games.name: Ukrainian Fight Drone Simulator (UFDS) - FPV drone simulator
games.text: Ukrainian Fight Drone Simulator – Starter Edition is a public version of a leading ultra-realistic FPV drone trainer built on lessons from the Ukrainian frontline. Fly combat drones in true-to-life conditions, take on challenges, and feel the adrenaline of modern warfare.

games.name: Become the Moon
games.text: ——— is a challenging, deckbuilding auto battler. Choose from 10 unique characters, each with their own distinct playstyles. Assemble a team of powerful minions & cast cosmic spells where every run takes you one step closer to the moon.

games.name: NBA THE RUN
games.text: Take your favorite NBA stars to iconic streetball courts around the world, in this fast-paced, online 3v3 basketball game. Stack wins, earn cred and become the GOAT of THE RUN. Who's Got Next?

games.name: Slay the Spire 2
games.text: The iconic roguelike deckbuilder returns. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, and discover relics of immense power in ———!

games.name: Card Survival: Fantasy Forest
games.text: ——— is a card-based deep survival simulator and the next installment in the ——— Series. Carve yourself a home in a primordial forest that has a will of its own. A day-to-day life simulator in a world where nature reigns with mystery, beauty and sometimes cruelty.

games.name: Monster Prom 4: Monster Con
games.text: Can you find love at the nerdiest convention ever? "Monster Con" goes back to the multiplayer dating sim formula: go through absurd and funny situations as you find love among six sexy monsters! Who will you romance? The mimic who cosplays? The idol clown? Or the eldritch cutie? (There's also Liam)

games.name: Tuggowar
games.text: ——— is the big-brain deckbuilding duel. Engage in tense combat on a solarpunk frontier. Assemble your deck turn by turn, discover powerful card combos, disrupt the enemy strategy, and pilot your well-oiled war machine to victory!

games.name: Decktamer
games.text: Deck-building meets monster catching in this turn-based roguelike. Recruit enemy cards to your party as you dive into the depths of the abyss. Will you kill them or will you tame them?

games.name: Godslayer Arena
games.text: ——— is a roguelike fusion of autobattlers and action-rpgs. Combat is performed completely automatically. Understanding complex interactions between the spells, gems, and items you draft will be key to success. Break the game. Become overpowered.

games.name: Battle Suit Aces
games.text: ——— is a tactical deckbuilder that can be played as a clever roguelite or epic campaign full of tender moments, cosmic quests, and charming characters.

games.name: Poly TD
games.text: Classic Warcraft III TD customs meet roguelike strategy. Summon and merge units to evolve them into legendary figures like Joan of Arc, Guan Yu, and Lovecraft—Legendary heroes from across time and space await! Prove your ultimate synergy against endless waves of enemies.

games.name: Squeakross: Home Squeak Home
games.text: In ———, solve and transform puzzles into furniture to decorate the perfect home for your rodent friend. Collect hundreds of decorations, accessories and stickers in this cozy game full of charm!

games.name: Global Rescue
games.text: Build your own base and take command of firefighting, police, EMS, and SWAT operations. Thanks to real map data, you can play right in your hometown - or anywhere in the world! Manage your fleet, hire staff, and take on a variety of authentic operations. In which city are you taking command?

games.name: Bloons Card Storm
games.text: Collectible card game set in the Bloons universe, featuring unique play mechanics, distinct hero abilities, PvP and PvE modes. Download now and join the Card Storm!

games.name: Heretical
games.text: Die. Adapt. Strike back. Climb Sanctora in this brutal Rogue-lite where every death unlocks powers, heroes, and paths to vengeance.

games.name: Into the Restless Ruins
games.text: A roguelike deckbuilder where you create the dungeon you fight through. Each night use your cards to expand the ruins then battle through them, harvesting Glimour from the lost souls and improving your deck. Can you reach The Warden and defeat it, so The Maiden will grant your heart’s desire?

games.name: Master of Command
games.text: Take command in Europe's greatest 18th-century war. Equip & customize regiments, manage supplies, and engage in brutal real-time battles across procedural campaigns. Resources and replacements are scarce, and keeping your best men alive may matter more than any single victory.

games.name: Harry Potter: Quidditch Champions
games.text: Your next chapter takes flight! Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Quidditch by playing solo or sharing the magic with friends and family.

games.name: WWE 2K25
games.text: Celebrate The Bloodline in Showcase. Compete online in MyGM. Expanded gameplay includes intergender wrestling, chain wrestling, barricade diving, the return of Promos + much more!

games.name: NBA 2K25
games.text: Command every court with authenticity and realism Powered by ProPLAY™, giving you ultimate control over how you play in ———. Define your legacy in MyCAREER, MyTEAM, MyNBA, and The W.

games.name: Escape Simulator 2
games.text: Sequel to the best-selling escape room game, brings a fresh take on first-person puzzles with a variety of new rooms to explore solo or with friends. Solve intricate puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, or craft your own escape rooms with Room Editor 2.0.

games.name: Din's Champion
games.text: The evil goddess seeks to devour and remake the world… and you are what stands in her way. Fight and kill, expand your skill tree, craft and build, and lead the world’s people to victory in ———, a multiplayer fantasy action-RPG where every choice matters, and the choices are endless.

games.name: AI2U: With You 'Til The End
games.text: Kidnapped by a cute yandere catgirl, your only way out is to persuade her to let you leave! Engage with thematic stories, solve puzzles, and interact with best yandere AI NPCs in this top-rated AI game loved by millions of fans. Bask in sweet meet-cutes, or brace for chaos if you dare to escape! :3

games.name: Holy Shoot
games.text: ——— is a fast-paced roguelite action FPS set in a satirical version of Hell, packed with chaos, blessed heroes, and demonic bosses. Pick your hero, dive into hell, upgrade your build, and shoot your way through sin.

games.name: SuperTaxCity
games.text: A new sensation!? City-building × Roguelike game *Super Tax City*. Choose and place your favorite facilities from randomly drawn options! The combinations are endless! Create a profitable city that's uniquely yours!

games.name: OMG Words
games.text: Bringing roguelike mechanics to classic word games. Use relics to create powerful combos, play boons to craft your tiles and board, use your powers to defeat a host of tricky opponents.

games.name: Strange Antiquities
games.text: Become the custodian of a store dealing in occult antiquities. Explore the quaint and gloomy town of Undermere, where strange goings-on and dark mysteries abound. Find and identify arcane artefacts, use your collection to aid the townsfolk with their unusual problems — and remember to pet your cat!

games.name: Hive Blight
games.text: ——— is a roguelite autobattler where you lead a team of insect warriors against a corrupting Fungal Threat. Build powerful synergies, uncover the source of the plague, and destroy it to save your world!

games.name: Streamer Life Simulator 2
games.text: In the second game of the series, competition has increased and now everyone wants to be a streamer. Are you ready to stream until your cpu burns out?

games.name: Undusted: Letters from the Past
games.text: ——— is a casual game in which you clean and restore dirty items. What is her story as she returns to a long-neglected house? Enjoy the satisfying audiovisuals featuring sensually designed sounds and graphics.

games.name: Genome Guardian
games.text: COMBINE WEAPONS in the microscopic roguelite turret shooter with macroscopic depth. Survive 6 modes using an astounding array of turrets, perks, mutations and power-ups on this psychedelic journey to the heart of the abyss. Shmup Mode turns it into a vertical shoot 'em up!

games.name: DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake
games.text: ——— is a stunning reimagination of the first two legendary adventures in The Erdrick Trilogy, brought together in one package.

games.name: Below, Rusted Gods
games.text: You are the lifeline supporting an expedition into the unknown. Keep both yourself and your squad alive by interpreting instrument readings, explore the facilities, and uncover something ancient and eager to be born.

games.name: Beyond the Map
games.text: Isometric survival ARPG set in a procedurally generated fantasy world. Build your base, gear up, and venture out, chasing stronger enemies and better loot.

games.name: Idle Hero TD - Tower Defense RPG
games.text: Endless Idle Tower Defense with deep strategy and RPG progression and combat mechanics. Recruit, upgrade, and position powerful fantasy heroes, discover game-changing synergies, and survive infinite monster waves. Grow stronger every run with literally millions of upgrades and endless auto battles.

games.name: Casino Simulator
games.text: ——— Expand Your Casino From Scratch, Hire Employees, Customize It, Gamble, Enjoy Your Own Casino

games.name: Yuma Nest
games.text: Destroy massive swarms of monsters to grind and grow stronger in this Open-World Sandbox RPG. Build automated systems that farm monster drops for you, defeat bosses, and descend deeper into an interconnected underworld.

games.name: Steve's Warehouse: Physics. Roguelike. Chaos.
games.text: ——— is a melting pot of Suika game, rogue-like and deckbuiling. Purchase objects, combine them but don't make any falls!

games.name: Platform 8
games.text: You are trapped on a train that runs forever. Keep an eye out for anomalies and find a way out.

games.name: The Spell Brigade
games.text: Survivors-like with ONLINE CO-OP for 1-4 players. Team up with your wizard friends to slay hordes of dark creatures. Complete team-based objectives, unlock new upgrades and create overpowered spell synergies. Friend nor foe is safe in this friendly fire bullet hell!

games.name: Cheap Car Repair
games.text: ——— - go back in time to Poland of the 90's. Run your own ——— shop. Look for savings wherever you can. Make lots of money and avoid angry customers!

games.name: Tunnel Escape
games.text: Embark on a daring journey with Beatrice as you kick, shoot, and loot through a secret underground lab. In this rogue-lite RPG/ADV, engage in strategic combat and face intense encounters and unspeakable dangers!

games.name: Nuclear Nightmare
games.text: Venture forth as part of a specialized team of fellow players tasked with retrieving classified materials, evading the black goo virus, and the nightmarish entities it has spawned. With time running out before the US government initiates a devastating nuclear strike to contain the spreading menace.

games.name: Extreme Climbing
games.text: Unarmed climbing of world famous buildings: Eiffel Tower, Statue of Liberty, Tokyo Sky Tree Tower, Dubai Tower, Pyramid, Guangzhou Tower, Oriental Pearl TV Tower Tower, CCTV Tower, etc.

games.name: FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH
games.text: The Unknown Journey Continues... After escaping the city of Midgar, Cloud and his friends set out on a journey across the planet. New adventures await in a vibrant, expansive world in this standalone entry of the FFVII remake trilogy.

games.name: Viractal: Will You Trust Your Party?
games.text: Embark on a strategic board game adventure through a charming miniature world! Roll the dice, collect cards, and build your own deck to overcome enemies and events. Every move counts, and every run is unique. Your journey begins now—crafted by your choices and a bit of luck.

games.name: Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis
games.text: “———” is a rhythm adventure game about a psychotic hikikomori girl - also an avid anonymous poster - who corrupts the world with her severe brain rot from listening to too many denpa songs. Yunyun all over this ♡♡♡♡ world with your degen otaku-posting.

games.name: Ways of Alchemy
games.text: Become a medieval alchemist in this card game. Brew deadly potions, discover ancient recipes, hire adventurers, and outwit the Inquisition. Transform your humble shack into an alchemical empire. No wands are required — just knowledge and wit.

games.name: OneShot: World Machine Edition
games.text: A completely self-contained portable version of one of the highest user-rated games. Built on an entirely new engine with new UI, support for Steam Deck, & more. Features world-bending puzzles, intriguing denizens, surreal environments, and a captivating story about the truth of the game's reality.

games.name: Fast Food Simulator
games.text: Welcome to the world's most chaotic place! Play solo or co-op with up to 6 players. Run a fast-food restaurant, and work with your friends to expand your business. Take orders, make burgers, and increase your earnings by dealing with customers.

games.name: Neon Village
games.text: This game is a fusion of a "roguelike deck-builder" and "match-3 puzzle". Collect unique residents to create explosive synergies and develop a village glittering with neon!

games.name: Echocalypse: The Scarlet Covenant
games.text: Kemono Girl RPG has topped the free download list on App Store and Google Play in multiple countries or regions! Embark on a journey with 10 million players worldwide in a post-apocalyptic exploration, and stand alongside charming Kemono girls! Enjoy a time-saving and relaxing card battle!

games.name: Garten of Banban 8: Anti Devil
games.text: Explore the most obscure levels of Banban’s Kindergarten. Survive the new deceives and mysteries that await you. Uncover the truth behind the place, and find the whereabouts of your missing child…

games.name: Spin Hero
games.text: ——— is a roguelike deckbuilder, where you spin the reels to decide your fate. Collect powerful symbols for your inventory, adapt and evolve your strategy, learning from defeats to unlock new possibilities and synergies.

games.name: ONE PIECE Bounty Rush
games.text: Take the loot, pirates! Bounty Rush is a 4 vs 4 multiplayer team action game. Work with your team to capture the other teams' berries!

games.name: JudgeSim
games.text: Things were worse than ever in Banana Republic, a somber island country. While anarchists roamed the streets, corruption was running deeper due to economic crisis and rising crime rates. Bearing these burdens were "judges" who tried to make things right with honesty...

games.name: Dale & Dawson Stationery Supplies
games.text: In "———," play as a Manager, Specialist, or Slacker in an office setting. Slackers blend in, mimicking Specialists to avoid the Manager's suspicion. Uncover or cause deception to win.

games.name: Achilles: Survivor
games.text: Thousands of enemies. One survivor. Fight like a demigod, build deadly defenses, and grow stronger after every run in this fast-paced bullet heaven set in mythic Greece.

games.name: Ultimate Sheep Raccoon
games.text: ——— is a bike-racing party game where you and your friends build the course together. Add obstacles and dangerous traps, take the lead with power-ups, and race to the finish!

games.name: Inkborn
games.text: ——— is a roguelike deckbuilder with a card system built around chaining Glyph-based combos. Sequence your cards in tactical combat to unleash impactful effects. Customize your Skill Tree before each run, evolve new abilities and uncover the hidden story of a world folded in ink, metal and paper.

games.name: MAVRIX by Matt Jones
games.text: The ultimate multiplayer open world designed by Pro riders. Discover mountains and trails with limitless control and build your own career. Pull huge tricks or race through the global rankings! Nail challenges to secure sponsorship deals with real world brands. Are you ready?!

games.name: KilaFlow
games.text: ——— is a challenging and fast paced Precision 3d Platformer featuring a Robot Antivirus who switches gears to speed up and save Datyte from the infection of an evil and mysterious Virus! Flow and bounce between programs and worlds to generate Keygems and cure the cute critters in your path!

games.name: Under Par Golf Architect
games.text: Step into the shoes of a golf architect as you build and manage your own golfing paradise! Sharpen your strategy by designing incredible courses to challenge the most demanding golfers and watch your club flourish as you attract VIP players, hire quirky staff and hold prestigious tournaments.

games.name: Recycling Center Simulator
games.text: ——— is a business simulator game with a first person view. Make money from garbage, collect raw materials for your recycling center from different locations, recycle them, make money by producing new products and improve your factory.

games.name: Nightmare Kart
games.text: Zoom through gothic streets in this horror themed vehicular combat racing game!

games.name: The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria™
games.text: A survival crafting adventure set in the Fourth Age of Middle-earth. Lead the Dwarves to reclaim Moria - mine, build, and battle through procedurally generated depths alone or with up to 8 players in co-op. It is time to return to Moria!

games.name: Monsters are Coming!
games.text: Beware, ———! In this Tower-Survivor rogue-lite, you protect an ever-moving city from unrelenting hordes. Gather resources, fortify defences, and survive for as long as you can. Will you reach the Ark?

games.name: Tower Networking Inc.
games.text: An internet service provider simulation game. Design and build network connectivity and services to clients in an ever-expanding randomly generated tower. Configure and maintain equipment to ensure you meet the requirements of tower dwellers. Manage your spending for expansion and daily operations.

games.name: Journey of Wrestling
games.text: A wrestling management sim that's easy to pick up and play. Book fantasy matches, create epic stories and develop your wrestlers as you grow to dominate the industry. With extensive customization and depth, you can bring your wrestling dreams to life.

games.name: SNØ: Ultimate Freeriding
games.text: ——— is a minimalistic freeriding game. Push your limits for the high score, or simply enjoy the unforgiving procedural wilderness.

games.name: The Jackbox Survey Scramble
games.text: Discover how people across the country think! ——— is a collection of hilarious survey-based game modes, using real one-word answers from real people. Really! Grab some friends and start guessing!

games.name: Drifto: Infinite Touge
games.text: No campaign, no cutscenes, just beautifully simple scenery and a whole lot of tyre smoke. How far can you get?

games.name: Ratatan
games.text: ——— is a rhythm roguelike action game that combines rhythm games and side-scrolling action, with online co-op gameplay supporting up to 4 players. An intense battle unfolds with over 100 characters fighting in a massive melee. Let's defeat the enemies together!

games.name: LEGO® Harry Potter™ Collection
games.text: The ——— brings LEGO® Harry Potter™: Years 1-4 and LEGO® Harry Potter™: Years 5-7 together in one game, now remastered with enhanced graphics.

games.name: Dragon Front: Adventures
games.text: A single player card battler without limits: every hand playable, every battle unique. Where champions grow their armies through promotion and the spoils of battle. With no mana system to hold you back, success depends on how you place your forces and outthink your enemies.

games.name: Lunar Eclipse
games.text: Explore dark locations, solve puzzles, and uncover a gripping story. Fight or evade bloodthirsty zombies using wit and agility. Immerse yourself in a tense adventure with a charming blonde heroine in a chilling, atmospheric world.

games.name: LORT
games.text: ——— is a 1–8 player co-op action roguelite. Team up with your friends to battle, loot, and stack ridiculous power-ups across a cursed fantasy world. Fight toward escape, revive your homies, and get absolutely chadded as you evolve from goblin tickler to god slapper.

games.name: Jurassic World Evolution 3
games.text: Build your own Jurassic World. Nurture generations of dinosaurs with the series debut of juveniles, create and manage sprawling prehistoric parks around the globe, and let your imagination roar with powerful new creative options.

games.name: Cyclopean: The Great Abyss
games.text: ——— is a small scale, mechanics driven CRPG/Roguelike in a retro, monochromatic style, that takes place in the underworld of H.P. Lovecraft's Dreamlands.

games.name: The Anomaly Project
games.text: Your goal is simple, spot anomalies to escape. Play alone or together with up to 8 players in online co-op. Make the right decisions to advance to the next level, or risk being reset to the beginning!

games.name: Fears to Fathom - Woodbury Getaway
games.text: Sydney Harper, a 23-year-old working at a consulting firm plans a weekend getaway to a Woodbury rental with her college friends. Little did she know what was about to unfold during their stay.

games.name: Galaxy Idle Clicker
games.text: Embark on an interstellar journey with ———! Conquer galaxies, upgrade your spaceship, and face off against a myriad of enemy ships. With engaging minigames, powerful upgrades, GIC delivers an unparalleled idle space adventure. Join the cosmic conquest today and dominate the universe!

games.name: Card Cultivation
games.text: ——— is a card management game that visualizes the process of cultivating immortality through cards. In the game, you will play as a cultivation practitioner: cultivate techniques, explore treasures, and craft weapons, Throughout re-cultivation, you will recover memory.

games.name: DrainSim
games.text: Dive into ——— and seize control of the floods! Clear the city's submerged streets, with a huge range of different tools from rakes to submersible pumps. Embrace the satisfaction of restoring the water flow. Become the city's hero, one drain at a time.

games.name: Starsand Island
games.text: Tired of the city grind? Escape to ——— and embrace the simple joys of country life! Live alongside capybaras, cats, and dogs, reel in a big catch, and explore the enchanting Moonlit Forest. Leave the hustle behind and experience the charm of this seaside paradise.

games.name: Cupiclaw
games.text: ——— is a cute & frantic claw machine roguelike deckbuilder. Grab unique prizes, build powerful combos, face chaotic machines… and claw back your relationship!

games.name: PowerWash Simulator 2
games.text: PowerWash Simulator is back, bubbling with fresh locations, soap-erior equipment and splashy features. Effortlessly transform soiled surroundings into clean, serene scenes, solo or with pals. Satisfaction is a spray away!

games.name: Solasta II
games.text: In a Mana-infused land, a dark force led by the enigmatic Shadwyn threatens Neokos. Bring your party of adventurers together across perilous realms in this Turn-Based Tactical RPG based on the SRD 5.2 ruleset. You make the choices, dice decide your destiny.

games.name: HackHub - Ultimate Hacker Simulator
games.text: Unravel cyber secrets and foil mass surveillance as a skilled hacker in ———. Challenge authority, rewrite the rules, and emerge as the ultimate digital rebel.

games.name: Arcane Trigger
games.text: ——— is a bullet-building roguelike where every shot is crafted before it's fired. Forge over 220 bullets, shape their effects with 150+ magical seals, and master infinite synergies in this endlessly replayable strategic shooter.

games.name: LUNARiA -Virtualized Moonchild-
games.text: Genius gamer T-Bit rakes in the prize money in VR races day after day. One day, after experiencing a network error mid-race, he ends up in Lunar World, a moon-based server. There, he meets an AI avatar by the name of Lunar-Q. A love story spanning the 384,400 km between the Earth and moon begins!

games.name: Rita
games.text: ——— is a cozy adventure where a little chicklet solves word-based puzzles to transform the world around her. Follow her story across generations, meet her grandchicklet, and be a part of her legacy.

games.name: Food Delivery Simulator
games.text: Live the life of a food delivery driver. Deliver orders, earn money, upgrade your vehicle, explore a vast city, and make way to your success. Dive into a realistic daily adventure and level up to become the best delivery driver.

games.name: Metro Gravity
games.text: Explore, fight, solve puzzles and bend gravity to escape the dream-like world of the Halls! ——— is a mind-boggling musical adventure with rhythmic combat and compelling lore.

games.name: Madoka Magica Magia Exedra
games.text: Characters from the hit anime series "Puella Magi Madoka Magica" come together! Featuring an all-new story setting and characters from the original ideas of Gekidan Inu Curry (Doroinu), experience the action alongside Magical Girl memories in this battle RPG!

games.name: Yakuza 0 Director's Cut
games.text: Discover the decadence and danger of 1980's Japan as you fight like hell through its neon-lit entertainment districts in the definitive edition of the action-adventure crime drama that created yakuza legends.

games.name: Darwin's Paradox!
games.text: Step into a cinematic adventure as Darwin, a brilliant octopus trapped in a mysterious industrial world. Use his unique abilities - swimming, wall-climbing, shooting ink, camouflage, and more - to overcome traps and escape.

games.name: FANTASY LIFE i: The Girl Who Steals Time
games.text: Step into this Slow-Life RPG where you can freely switch between 14 unique jobs, so called "Lives," and enjoy a carefree life in a fantasy world. Fish, cook, shape the island to your liking, or team up with friends to battle monsters across the vast world.

games.name: Goblin Auto Club Manager
games.text: Imagine building fantastic cars out of junk and letting idiots drive them. ——— is a casual and wacky motorsport management simulation. Buy parts from the junkyard, build cars with them, and choose your racing strategy. Your goblins do the driving.

games.name: Puck
games.text: Fast-paced physics-based hockey simulation where precision, strategy, and chaos collide. Control every move, pass, and shot with realistic ——— physics, dynamic player movement, and thrilling gameplay. Master the rink with friends or team up with other ——— players for ultimate hockey dominance!

games.name: Gods vs Horrors
games.text: A drafting roguelike focused on synergies and scaling, with short enjoyable runs. Recruit Gods from different mythologies, buff and upgrade them, arrange them in perfect formation, and fight cosmic Horrors in no-RNG autobattler combat to defend the Earth!

games.name: Clutchtime™: Basketball Deckbuilder
games.text: Build your perfect deck and become a Champion.

games.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate
games.text: TMNT Splintered Fate - Unleash the Turtles in a roguelike quest to rescue Splinter from the Foot Clan! Master ninja skills, unite in bodacious co-op gameplay, and conquer iconic NYC locales.

games.name: デュエホロ (DUEHOLO)
games.text: Rogue-like card RPG where you build your deck with cards of hololive members! Fight against holomem to strengthen your deck and defeat boss holomem!

games.name: Exploding Kittens® 2
games.text: Download ——— and live your best and most chaotic kitty life! Take a deep whiff of burning furballs, draw a card and pray for victory (and look stylish all the while, thanks to oodles of customisation options for your own adorable avatar).

games.name: Forest Heroes
games.text: ——— combines defense gameplay with roguelike deck-building. Enjoy intense battles and diverse strategies with simple controls!

games.name: Football Referee Simulator
games.text: ————the groundbreaking game that puts you in the referee's shoes! Are you ready to kickstart your career in the lower divisions and ascend to legendary status by overseeing thrilling finals?

games.name: Zombiehood
games.text: Quirky yet brutal run-and-gun roguelite: scavenge weapons, equipment, and artifacts, unlock powerful upgrades, and blast through procedurally generated biomes with witty dialogue and explosively satisfying combat.

games.name: Drop Pockets
games.text: The billiards roguelike. Strategic, physics based combat against Pool Sharks who don't play by the rules. Pocket your balls and clear out your opposition in this chaotic game of pool!

games.name: Dying Light: The Beast
games.text: BECOME THE BEAST. SURVIVE THE NIGHT. A terrifying new chapter in the ——— universe begins. As Kyle Crane, explore the vast and unpredictable wilderness, uncover a deadly evolution of the infected, and learn to control the beastly powers awakening inside you.

games.name: Teamfight Manager 2
games.text: Teamfight Manager returns with more detailed tactics and management, a new MOBA-style match format, and a Deathmatch mode reminiscent of the previous title. Take charge of a fictional esports team, build the strongest roster, and become the best manager!

games.name: Master of Piece
games.text: Recruit mercenaries, combine their traits, and forge endless synergies. Venture through the mysterious medieval realm, facing powerful foes and mighty bosses. Simple turn-based rules hide deep strategic depth—build your ultimate team, master the pieces, and uncover the secrets of the Black fog.

games.name: Primordialis
games.text: ——— is a physics-based roguelike fish builder. Unleash your creativity to defeat creatures using venomous tentacles, electrical shocks, or exploding children. The possibilities are endless. Explore the primordial depths to reveal its secrets and discover what lies beyond.

games.name: Moorhuhn Kart 4
games.text: The world's craziest chicken is heading back to the racetrack! Wacky characters, cool tracks and karts, and zany items await in a worldwide online battle for first place!

games.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! EARLY DAYS COLLECTION
games.text: ——— is packed with classic Yu-Gi-Oh! games from the very early days of Dueling — bursting with retro RPGs and strategic card games with beloved anime characters!

games.name: Five Hearts Under One Roof
games.text: Yuman’s, the player, once solitary home and routine are now invaded by five beautiful women! Each has her unique charm – the 'childhood friend of 20 years,' the 'first love and former idol,' the 'demanding boss,' the 'bold younger girl,' and the 'shy recluse.' Who will you choose?

games.name: Abra-Cooking-Dabra
games.text: ——— is a cooking card game. Manage ingredients and make British dishes to keep toves, borogoves, and mome raths fed. Meet timers and fulfill puzzling orders despite the angry wacky Cat being your boss. You are Wonderland's new chef.

games.name: Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition
games.text: Gird your loins and sharpen your steel! Besiege 20 unique enemy lords and battle friends online, in this expanded remaster of the classic 'castle sim'. Relive history with new units, opponents, visuals, audio, campaigns, skirmish trails, co-op and larger maps.

games.name: astragali
games.text: A die (sg.: die or dice; pl.: dice) is a small, throwable object with marked sides that can rest in multiple positions. Dice are used for generating random values, commonly as part of tabletop games, including dice games, board games, role-playing games, and games of chance.

games.name: Deadly Days: Roadtrip
games.text: Loot, shoot, and mow down zombie hordes in this bullet heaven fever dream. Embark on a deadly roadtrip, fuel your bus, decide when to extract – and get that sweet inventory management kick when that new slot in your backpack fits just right.

games.name: Nordhold
games.text: Enemies are coming! Every decision matters: build your city, grow the economy, and prepare for enemy waves. Strengthen your defenses, adapt your strategy, and unleash your hero’s full potential. This unique Tower Defense will test your skills – are you worthy to claim a place at Valhalla?

games.name: Pandora's Toybox
games.text: Become a God, build a civilization. In this dynamic Roguelite God Simulator, guide human civilization on a procedurally generated pixel world. Watch your people grow, defend them against heretics, and build an immortal legacy.

games.name: FATE: Reawakened
games.text: Reawaken the critically acclaimed ——— games like never before! Play all 4 classic dungeon crawler titles with enhanced graphics as you battle through challenging procedurally generated dungeons, learn powerful spells, and fish to your heart’s content. Are you up to the task? Your ——— awaits!

games.name: Raceborn
games.text: ——— is a racing game featuring miniature cars in diverse locations with extensive vehicle customization options. Win races, earn upgrades, and showcase your creativity to become a racing legend.

games.name: Katanaut
games.text: ——— is a fast-paced, Metroidvania-inspired action roguelite blending fluid combat and cosmic horror. Slash, dodge, and wield powerful abilities as you battle through a station sprawling with twisted, once-human horrors. Adapt, survive, and descend into the shadows to uncover dark secrets.

games.name: Is This Seat Taken?
games.text: ———? is a logic puzzle game where you play matchmaker for groups of hilariously particular people. Each character has pet peeves that make seating them a delightful challenge. Find the perfect spot for each person to unlock new levels in this cozy, silly, and relatable experience.

games.name: Dicealot
games.text: Discover a high-stakes roguelike dice-builder where every roll is a risk, every risk is a thrill, and every thrill teeters between triumph and disaster. Set in charmingly chaotic Camelot, chance collides with strategy, mastery dances with madness, and one single roll can rewrite your fate.

games.name: Fantasy Map Simulator
games.text: ———: Create and watch imaginary worlds evolve over centuries. Design maps, simulate nations and their politics, and control destinies. See empires rise and fall on your desktop wallpaper. A unique simulation for history buffs and creative minds.

games.name: Assassin's Creed Mirage
games.text: Become a deadly Master Assassin in this action-adventure game. Explore the streets of ninth-century Baghdad through the eyes of Basim. Take down your targets while seeking justice as part of the Hidden Ones.

games.name: A Case of Fraud
games.text: A short non-linear detective adventure where every clue is hidden in plain sight. Carefully read and cross-reference documents to unravel a CEO’s disappearance and expose ———.

games.name: Arcane Rush
games.text: ———: Epic Card Battles. Clash, strategize, dominate!

games.name: Demon Hunt
games.text: Battle through demon-infested lands in this fast-paced rogue-lite bullet-heaven. Pick unique weapons with powerful evolutions, and hunt down ancient demons in intense boss fights. Loot, upgrade, and unlock new ways to grow stronger after every hunt!

games.name: Race Max Pro
games.text: Race through Street, Drift, and Drag with real licensed cars. Master every turn, upgrade your ride, and dominate solo or online. The mobile racing hit, now free-to-play on PC.

games.name: Keeper
games.text: From Lee Petty and Double Fine Productions, ——— is an atmospheric puzzle adventure in which a long-forgotten lighthouse is awakened and, joined by a spirited seabird, it embarks upon a heartening tale of unlikely companionship, and an unexpected journey into realms beyond understanding

games.name: Calculate It
games.text: We've made a calculator roguelike! Yes, it's not a joke. A boring device has turned into an interesting strategy, where each calculator you collect sets its own style of play. Can you count all the numbers and prove who's the king of calculations here?

games.name: Hungry Horrors
games.text: Feed legendary Horrors before they feed on the princess. ——— is a roguelite card-based adventure through British and Irish mythology where you cook traditional dishes, build flavour synergies and serve the perfect meal. No prince. No servants. Just a recipe book and a talking cat.

games.name: Kaya's Prophecy
games.text: ——— is a unique card based village builder! establish your village, gather resources, and craft tools and buildings in a vibrant world. Explore and combat various challenges and other groups in this colourful, deck-builder while appeasing your god to earn his favour.

games.name: Morimens
games.text: ——— is a roguelite card-battler inspired by the Lovecraftian mythos. Bond with a diverse cast of Awakeners, build your perfect deck, and battle through the mists of Kadath—facing wild events and uncovering maddening truths at every turn.

games.name: Volleyborne: Unbound Horizons
games.text: ——— redefines sports gaming with its groundbreaking first-person volleyball experience. Offering realism and immersion, it brings every aspect of real-life volleyball to your screen with unmatched precision. From powerful spikes to insane digs, it mirrors every court move.

games.name: Pluto
games.text: A roguelike deckbuilder where you cast elemental spells, outwit monstrous foes, and escape prison on your way to your niece’s birthday party.

games.name: CROPS!
games.text: ———! is an async autobattler in which your fruits and vegetables come alive! Craft a deck with awesome synergies, plant your ——— in specific patterns and place them strategically on the battlefield to defeat your opponent.

games.name: Assetto Corsa EVO
games.text: ——— redefines the realism and features of one of the most popular multiplatform driving simulations ever developed. Featuring cars and tracks from different classes spanning across years of motoring history.

games.name: The Headliners
games.text: Co-op horror game where you play in teams of 1 to 8 reckless journalists, ready to explore a city overrun by deadly creatures to snap spectacular footage. Your only goal: make the headlines without becoming one.

games.name: Night Drive: คืนหลอน ซ่อนทาง
games.text: Welcome to "———," a driving simulator that challenges you to navigate a seemingly endless night in search of anomalies to break a mysterious loop.

games.name: F1® 25
games.text: Rewrite The Grid with the ultimate evolution in racing: EA SPORTS™ ———: 2026 Season Edition. Get ——— and the 2026 Season Pack in one bundle for the most complete Formula One® experience.

games.name: Inkwellers
games.text: In this online 2-player co-op puzzle adventure, you and a friend become ——— and dive into Celiphia’s magical journal. Work together, communicate clearly, and solve puzzles hidden within its pages.

games.name: Persona5: The Phantom X
games.text: “We’re the Phantom Thieves, and we’re here to steal your heart!” The beloved RPG series with over 27 million copies sold finally arrives on PC and mobile!

games.name: Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii
games.text: Embark on an over-the-top, modern-day pirate adventure with an ex-yakuza, now pirate captain & his crew. Engage in exhilarating combat on land and sea in the hunt for lost memories and treasure.

games.name: The Adventurers
games.text: ——— is a turn-based tactical RPG where every decision shapes your legacy. Lead your party of heroes in an open world filled with random events that affect your story. Survive a high fantasy landscape where your epic saga is waiting to be written.

games.name: Resultare
games.text: Drop into the chaotic thrill of ———, a pachinko rouguelike where precision and chaos collide! Smash through colorful boards, build powerful combos, and chase high scores as you fight your way to victory one bounce at a time.

games.name: Once Upon a Galaxy
games.text: ——— is an easy to learn Card Battler with incredible strategic depth and near infinite fun! Which of your favorite characters from myth and fairy tale will you choose?

games.name: Pixel Dungeon VR
games.text: Pixel Dungeon is a fast-paced, multiplayer social VR adventure where dungeon-crawling action, physics-based combat, and chaos with friends collide.

games.name: Trizon
games.text: ——— is a roguelike deck-building game. Fuse any two cards together to play crazy combos. The game combines auto-battler mechanics, where creatures attack on their own, with instant-effect spell cards. Battles are fast-paced and dynamic, set against a simple and restrained art style.

games.name: The Caribou Trail
games.text: The WWI story where your goal isn’t to kill, but to survive. In the still trenches, three soldiers learn the harsh truth of war: reckless missions, digging trenches, collecting dog tags and ghostly whispers in the dark. Home before the leaves fall, they thought.

games.name: Gallipoli
games.text: Land on the beaches of ——— and fight intense 50-player objective-based battles on the Ottoman Fronts! Experience WW1 trench warfare and desert expeditions as one of 10 historic classes, armed with authentic weaponry. ——— brings the most immersive WW1 FPS battles yet.

games.name: Aotenjo: Infinite Hands
games.text: The Mahjong Roguelike. ——— is an deckbuilder where you will use Mahjong styles all over the world to beat innate threats, play different Patterns and combos, reach the "bottom" of ———, and discover ancient secrets....

games.name: Star Fire: Eternal Cycle
games.text: ——— is a love letter to classic arcade side-scrollers, reimagined with roguelite progression, modern action polish, and that “just one more run” itch. It’s fast, punchy, and all about no-pressure fun with tight combat, slick movement, and endless ways to cause chaos.

games.name: Anode Heart: Layer Null
games.text: Isometric card battler RPG with a touch of virtual creatures, set in a futuristic, digital world, with over-the-top villains and a very shadowy plot.

games.name: Serpent's Gaze
games.text: ——— is a punishing 1-4 player co-op third-person action game where you fight tough enemies and relentless bosses, all while uncovering the secrets of an ancient desert.

games.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator
games.text: Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

games.name: Granny: Escape Together
games.text: This is a creepy co-op horror game. In which you find yourself locked in a crazy ———'s house. But ——— is not the only danger that awaits you in the house, someone else creepy lives in the basement. You have five days to get out of the house!

games.name: Guidus Zero
games.text: ——— is a real-time grid-based action roguelike game. Explore the sinkhole known as the "Scar" to search for spirits and treasure chests, and defeat the corrupted enemies and bosses as you strive to reach the deepest floor of the Scar, where the source of chaos awaits.

games.name: Runeborn
games.text: ——— is a dark fantasy roguelike that merges deckbuilding with a slot-machine-like mechanic. Forge your Runebook, crush enemies, and combine Trinkets of boundless power to destroy the forces of Malakar!

games.name: Hand of Fate: Hordes
games.text: ——— is a new fantasy adventure beyond the 13th Gate. Control powerful heroes and carve your way through dungeons, quests, and endless monsters and bosses. Grow your powers every run with new weapons and enchantments. Choose your cards wisely and thrive in chaos.

games.name: MotoGP™25
games.text: Rev up your engines for the 2025 season! Feel the authentic MotoGP™ thrills with refined sound design and exciting challenges. Train with new disciplines in Race Off mode and choose the Arcade or Pro Experience for ultimate fun or realism!

games.name: Don't Lose Aggro
games.text: Protect your team by forcing enemies to attack you in this single-player action roguelite inspired by MMO raids. Create unique builds, unlock powerful talents and master the art of tanking to command the chaos!

games.name: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam
games.text: Step into the explosive fury of war with ———. Play a decisive role in one of the most iconic conflicts in history with expansive 50v50 player battles, where teamwork, tactics and an arsenal of destructive weapons combine to shape the battlefield in your favour.

games.name: Proverbs
games.text: ——— is a picross/minesweeper hybrid featuring a single ENORMOUS puzzle, inspired by Bruegel the Elder's 1559 painting "Netherlandish ———"

games.name: Ricochet Abyss
games.text: Dive into ———, a unique blend of tactical backpack management, hero-building, and pinball-style combat. Organize your inventory, equip powerful gear, and send your heroes ricocheting through perilous dungeons—every shot and item choice could be your key to survival!

games.name: Command Deck
games.text: A retro sci-fi deckbuilder where enemies play by the same rules as you. Command your ship, build powerful deck combinations, and watch your decisions unfold in fast-paced, satisfying space combat.

games.name: Recesses
games.text: It's recess. Time to play cards, find your missing friend, discover the meaning of life. The usual 5th grade playground stuff.

games.name: Pebble Knights
games.text: Chew on weapons, chomp on poop, and devour your friends' graves in this chaotic co-op action roguelike! Eat shiny items to ascend your traits and stack team synergies as your squad snowballs into an unstoppable force. Play solo or team up with up to 5 players!

games.name: Dark Light: Survivor
games.text: ——— is a dark sci-fi action roguelike with ARPG loot and third-person shooter combat. Switch anytime between top-down view and TPS aiming as you build weapons, skills, and classes across brutal multiverse runs.

games.name: Lootbound
games.text: ——— is a tactical roguelite with turn-based combat, loot management and D&D elements set in a dark fantasy world. Fight dangerous enemies, collect epic loot, recruit allies and lead them on a path of adventure.

games.name: Circle Empires 2
games.text: CIRCLE EMPIRES returns! Expand your empire, circle by circle, in this fast-paced follow-up to the hit RTS. Gather resources, build armies, and defeat bosses (or your friends) in a world that changes with every game. With unique units and biomes, it's an addictive battle of wits and tactics.

games.name: Knightica
games.text: Recruit powerful units, place them strategically and find the best synergies in this Roguelike Autobattler! ——— lets you guide a warband through many challenges to free the Kingdoms. Discover optimal combinations, weave powerful enchants, face dangerous monsters and lead your army to victory!

games.name: Legacy of Defense - Prologue
games.text: Become the hero of a fantasy world and defend against monsters! '———' is the intro to the innovative game '———' combining side-scrolling action and deck-building. Collect cards, use skills, gain experience, upgrade, and defeat the final boss!

games.name: Creature Kitchen
games.text: A creepy-cozy cooking simulator where you befriend local wildlife and feed them their favorite snacks! With a strange house to search and forest to explore, the witching hour has only begun.

games.name: Liar's Bar
games.text: Dive into this multiplayer online experience set in a sketchy bar where the games are as dangerous as the patrons. Join a table of 4 and test your skills in Liar's Dice and Liar's Deck, where lying and bluffing are key to victory. Ready for a night at ———?

games.name: Anomaly Company
games.text: You and your crew are sent in to assess reality in this 4-player co-op horror game. Memorize the environment. Spot disturbing anomalies. Decide if the timeline is safe. One bad call—and you’re forced to start over.

games.name: Black Jacket
games.text: Gamble your way out of hell in this blackjack-inspired rogue-lite deckbuilder. Play powerful card combos or cheat to outwit your opponents and earn your freedom. Win their Soul coins! Bribe the ferryman! And uncover the story of those who stand in your way.

games.name: DRAPLINE
games.text: "———" is a roguelite training game where you raise a dragon girl who eats anything and train her to become the strongest in one year. Feed her a variety of things to increase her abilities, combine various skills to build your own strategy, and defeat the impending catastrophe!

games.name: Auto Battle Girl
games.text: “———” is an auto chess game on Goll Continent where powerful female creatures battle. Strategic gameplay, upgrade maidens, activate faction bonuses, and use leader assistance to conquer this mystical land.

games.name: Backyard Baseball '01
games.text: Backyard Baseball 2001 is the second Backyard Baseball game, and the fourth overall game, in the Backyard Sports franchise. Build your roster from iconic Backyard athletes and legendary MLB players. Strike out opponents, hit homers, and earn hilarious Power-ups. Play ball!

games.name: Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era
games.text: ——— is the official prequel hailing back to the origins of the genre-defining, critically acclaimed series of turn-based strategy games. Raise grand armies and wield devastating spells to overcome your foes in both solo and multiplayer.

games.name: Pantheon: Rise of the Fallen
games.text: ——— is a deeply social high fantasy MMORPG that challenges its players and rewards effort. Join the denizens of Terminus to uncover the mysteries of a world divided by Celestial loyalty… and betrayal.

games.name: I Am Legion: Stand Survivors
games.text: Summon your stands and brawl it out! Dive into the thrill of mowing down enemies, synthesizing and upgrading, mining, forging gear, unlocking new characters and equipment. Discover unique stands combos and craft your own battle style to break through the chaos!

games.name: Fever Meme
games.text: This game is a cross between The Stanley Parable, Undertale, and rage games like I Wanna Be the Guy. And the deeper you get, the less the fourth wall is respected. This game is a parody of game design and laughs on the surface, but there is a deeper and darker story to this game's origin to unravel.

games.name: Alabaster Dawn
games.text: Break Nyx’s curse and guide humanity's rebirth in this top-down 2.5D Action RPG from the creators of CrossCode. Battle enemies with stylish combos, wield multiple divine weapons, solve intriguing puzzles and explore a changing world.

games.name: Dice Legends
games.text: ——— is a roguelike deckbuilder with RPG elements in which you become one of 3 heroes, use unique dice to activate cards, and unleash lethal combos to defeat hordes of enemies. Explore the world, collect epic loot, and uncover the mystery of the Last Human — the mage who changed the world!

games.name: CAPTURED
games.text: Trapped in what appears to be an endless hallway in your home, rooms begin to feel unfamiliar. Capture anomalies on camera and stay away from any sinister entities.

games.name: Skill Legends Royale
games.text: This is a free multiplayer PvP strategy game that incorporates rogue-like and auto chess elements, players need to equip their auto-battling heroes with the right treasures and skills to ultimately defeat all other players and become the champion.

games.name: Town to City
games.text: Build an idyllic 19th century Mediterranean town and help it flourish into a prosperous city. Freely place and customise each element to create the perfect home for your growing population in this cozy city builder from the creators of Station to Station.

games.name: Reap and Rush
games.text: ——— is an absurdly addictive action roguelike. Step into the role of an underworld envoy thrust into a chaotic underworld. Fight through hordes of Yaoguai, leveling-up skills to become a soul-harvesting reaper and unravel a shocking conspiracy across endless cycles...

games.name: Out of the Park Baseball 26
games.text: 26 years of sports gaming excellence! ——— is here - officially licensed by MLB, the MLB Players Inc. and KBO! This year's brand new version puts you firmly in charge of your favorite baseball franchise. Your team, your way, your rules.

games.name: Sultan's Game
games.text: Survive a mad Sultan's reign in this brutal resource management RPG. Draw a card every seven days and complete its challenge. Make dreadful choices to stay alive: will you die a loyal servant, become a kingslayer, or call down the gods' judgement?

games.name: Scriptorium: Master of Manuscripts
games.text: Make and share the most beautiful and bizarre medieval art imaginable! Manage and grow your manuscript workshop by illustrating manuscripts, using friendly tools and a massive range of drag-and-drop artworks from the deepest reaches of history. Welcome to your very own ———!

games.name: Kill the Brickman
games.text: A brick breaking, turn-based rogue-like bullet-builder - Blast bricks to break the bank.

games.name: Cardaire
games.text: Explore, collect, and build sweet decks. ——— is a single-player collectible card RPG. Adventure awaits in the Duelist Frontier, so crack some packs and bring your best deck to take on the challenge.

games.name: Demeo x Dungeons & Dragons: Battlemarked
games.text: A cooperative tactical RPG set in the D&D universe. Embark on a fantasy tabletop adventure. Your quest, on your schedule.

games.name: Far Far West
games.text: Yee-haw, Cowboys! Team up in this chaotic 1-4 player co-op shooter. Journey to the ——— to blast monsters, sling spells, complete missions, and collect bounties. Work as a team to get in, get paid and get out (mostly) alive.

games.name: Liquor Store Simulator
games.text: Open your own Liquor Store! Buy goods, manage your store, hire staff. Who knows, maybe you will be able to make a real alcohol empire out of a small store.

games.name: STORROR Parkour Pro
games.text: The city is your playground. The risk is real. The path is yours. A physics-driven experience that will immerse you in an authentic urban environment. Master your movement, challenge your instincts, and traverse a city designed for limitless creative potential.

games.name: Mineral Defense
games.text: ——— combines tower defense with roguelite elements and procedural generation. Build paths, unlock upgrades, and unleash powerful synergies to conquer evolving challenges in an ever-expanding world.

games.name: States of Power
games.text: Command your nation's armies, economy, and diplomacy in this WWII Grand Strategy Wargame. Easy to start, hard to master and a full match fits in one session. Play singleplayer and multiplayer, or create, play and share your own custom scenarios with the built-in Scenario Editor.

games.name: Jupiter Hell Classic
games.text: ——— is a old-school true Roguelike shooter with turn-based tactics, permadeath, procedural levels, and 90s sci-fi carnage in its purest form. Rip and Tear!

games.name: Campus Legends College Basketball
games.text: Experience the ultimate college basketball management game. Take charge as a coach, recruit top talent, develop your team, and compete for national championships. Manage one of 192 teams (or up to 384 when using custom leagues), making strategic decisions to build your basketball dynasty

games.name: PBA Pro Bowling 2026
games.text: Rise from amateur to PBA legend in the most realistic bowling simulation ever made, featuring advanced physics, realistic oil pattern transition, licensed PBA pros, deep career progression, and multiple competitive game modes.

games.name: Marvel Contest of Champions
games.text: The ultimate Super Hero fighting game is now on Steam! Collect and upgrade iconic Super Heroes and Villains from the Marvel Universe, engage in fast-paced 1v1 battles, and unleash powerful abilities in ———!

games.name: ACE Strategy: Mecha Nova
games.text: A tactical roguelike deck building game. Recruit elite mecha pilots, deploy drones and cast commands. Master your ACE mechas while collecting unique cards and chips in battles, and form your own build for total battlefield dominance.

games.name: 天月麻雀 (Amatsuki Mahjong)
games.text: Amatsuki Mahjong is a ACG style mahjong game that offers real-time multiplayer online matches. It features four styles of mahjong: Japanese, Sichuan, Taiwanese, and Hong Kong Mahjong. Enjoy a variety of play styles tailored to your preferences.

games.name: Monument Valley 3
games.text: Set sail for a world-changing adventure as you guide Noor in their quest through a series of mind-bending illusions and atmospheric puzzles. Can you unlock the secrets of the mysterious world – and the meaning behind the Sacred Light?

games.name: Gnomes
games.text: ——— is a turn-based tower defense with deep roguelike progression, set in ever-expanding, procedurally generated biomes. Build, farm and defend your village as you push deeper into goblin-infested territory. Unlock powerful upgrades and craft your environment to survive the endless goblin horde

games.name: Gold Gold Adventure Gold
games.text: In this world, it’s all about the gold! Use it to build up a fantasy town, recruit heroes, give quests, raise a Godbeast, cast powerful spells, and expand your influence—all one gold coin at a time.

games.name: Legacy of Defense
