games.text: Become the hero who protects the fantasy world and stop the monster invasion! '———' combines defense with deck-building. Build your deck, use powerful skills, gain experience, upgrade, clear stages, and defeat the final boss. Ready to test your strategy and luck?

games.name: My Infamous Dungeon
games.text: Be evil. Build your dungeon and grow your empire in this roguelite dungeon builder. Hire monsters, set traps, battle heroes, and conquer the overworld with an ever expanding legion of evil.

games.name: Tiny Terraces
games.text: A cozy idle farming game, watch tiny guys do tasks around the terrace, expand, progress, and decorate your Tiny Terrace.

games.name: Motion Soccer PRO
games.text: Play, coach, or referee an 11v11 football match from any perspective. Experience the game as a player, coach, referee, or assistant referee. Includes full seasons, 1v1 to 11v11 multiplayer, and play with or without VR.

games.name: Do No Harm
games.text: Lovecraftian Doctor Simulator. Diagnose patients by analyzing unsettling symptoms and treat them using your Book of Medicine. Make moral choices — decide who to save or kill, discover whom to trust, and unlock multiple endings! Can you endure 30 days of perilous decisions?

games.name: GunZ: The Duel
games.text: Master the legendary K-Style combat that redefined action shooters. Wall-run, dash, and unleash breathtaking combos in fast-paced PvP and co-op PvE. Customize your fighter and experience the remastered classic—for free.

games.name: Wordatro!
games.text: ———! fuses addictive word game with thrilling roguelite strategy! Spell high-scoring words, chain massive combos, and unlock game-changing bonuses. With 50+ unique upgrades and daily challenges, endless linguistic adventures await!

games.name: THYSIASTERY
games.text: ——— is a dungeon crawler RPG featuring traditional roguelike and turn-based gameplay. Command a party of bearers of the Brand, drawn into a vast Labyrinth. Recruit while exploring the Labyrinth in hope of finding a way out, and its secrets will be revealed as you delve deeper.

games.name: Inkshade
games.text: ——— is a turn-based tactics game carved out of strange wooden miniatures, wrapped in a web of locked rooms, and orchestrated by an otherworldly game master. Victory is not guaranteed, and the only constant is the cruel black ink that flows within the pieces.

games.name: Montabi
games.text: Tame, collect, fight! Assemble an unstoppable team of unique ——— in this Creature-Collector Roguelike Deckbuilder. Master their awesome abilities, synergize their strategic strengths and save the city in tactical turn-based combat!

games.name: Modern Warships
games.text: ——— is an online action game about contemporary military vehicles. Join now and detect the enemy with recon aircraft, launch volleys of guided missiles from cruisers, sneak up to surface vessels with submarines, and provide cover to the allied fleet with jet fighters and helicopters.

games.name: Cult of PiN
games.text: Flip, nudge, and destroy in this roguelike pinball deckbuilder. Select from 100+ upgrades to create game-breaking builds and smash through the cursed playfields. Complete missions to trigger explosive special attacks and tear the tables apart, one bumper at a time.

games.name: WILL: Follow The Light
games.text: Dive into a realistic, single-player, first-person journey through the harsh northern latitudes as you sail endless waters, searching for a way back to your loved ones. ——— you follow the light?

games.name: Elements and build
games.text: Form your own genre with skills in different elements, use building rewards to build your own unique maze in randomly generated levels, and fight to survive waves of monsters to win

games.name: SPORTAL
games.text: Sport meets slaughter in this roguelite arena FPS. Use lethal sports equipment to crush B-movie monsters. Combine upgrades, perfect your build, perfect your skills, and face the ultimate evil bosses. Play ball... or die trying.

games.name: WEBFISHING
games.text: ——— a multiplayer chatroom-focused fishing game! Relax and fish (on the web!)

games.name: Penelope Pendrick and the Art of Deceit
games.text: Pick up your magnifying glass as writer-turned-detective Penelope Pendrick in this first-person point and click mystery adventure! Three people have suddenly vanished from the sleepy town of Carlisle. Follow the clues, interrogate suspects, and solve puzzles to end this case - before it ends you.

games.name: ROGUE LIGHT DECK BUILDER
games.text: Your house needs a deck. You have a hammer. Freedom is $1,000,000.

games.name: Laundry Store Simulator
games.text: In ———, you'll start small and work your way up, upgrading your equipment, designing a stylish store, and expanding your services! Are you ready to own the best Laundry Store in the world?

games.name: One Turn Kill
games.text: ——— is a PvE card game where card drawing and deck control are the keys to victory. Engage in battles limited to a single turn for an exhilarating, suspenseful experience.Join the protagonist in a pixel art wasteland to face off with the strongest of enemies and see what story awaits.

games.name: Small Spaces
games.text: Design and decorate beautiful apartments you’d love to live in! Relax and let your creativity flow — organize a simplistic flat in Tokyo, fill a cozy place with flowers in Berlin, or unpack an industrial loft in New York.

games.name: Roboquest VR
games.text: The future is in flames, overrun by ruthless machines—but you’re built to fight back. ——— is a lightning-fast roguelite FPS where speed, firepower, and reflexes are your best weapons. Adapt, survive, and reboot the future!

games.name: Anomaly President
games.text: In this presidential rogue-like action game, gather votes and run for presidency by day, then transform into a warrior to take down your enemies by night! Master unique skills to become a swordmaster, a cyber mage, or anything in between, and overthrow the ruthless president!

games.name: Witchfire
games.text: ——— is a first-person dark fantasy RPG shooter in which you play as a wicked sinner turned witch hunter on his final mission to reach salvation.

games.name: Assassin’s Creed Shadows
games.text: Experience an epic action-adventure story set in feudal Japan! Become a lethal shinobi assassin and powerful legendary samurai as you explore a beautiful open world in a time of chaos.

games.name: Slot & Dungeons
games.text: A deck-building roguelite where the reels decide your fate! Enemies and items appear based on the spin of the slot. Master luck and strategy to conquer the dungeon!

games.name: Coffee Talk Tokyo
games.text: ——— is the newest entry in the beloved series, set in a late-night café in Tokyo. Brew drinks, meet humans and yōkai, and experience heartfelt stories in a cozy, story-rich world.

games.name: Infinity Sweeper
games.text: Think you know Minesweeper? Think again. ——— brings roguelite elements to the classic puzzle - upgrades, boss fights and a constantly evolving grid that demands both logic and instinct. One wrong click could end it all.

games.name: Infinity Nikki
games.text: Embark on a cozy open-world adventure filled with vast landscape, mystical puzzles and unexpected platforming challenges. Dress up not just for style, but to unravel hidden mysteries, interact with a vibrant environment, and experience the freedom to explore at your own pace.

games.name: Schedule I
games.text: From small-time dope pusher to kingpin - manufacture and distribute a range of drugs throughout the grungy city of Hyland Point. Expand your empire with properties, businesses, employees and more.

games.name: Hold The Mine
games.text: Explore and defend your mine against waves of monsters in this innovative roguelike survival game! Collect and manage your resources, discover buildings with unique effects and unleash mighty heroes to hold monsters out of the mine until the sun rises.

games.name: Grime&Gold
games.text: Fancy some cards, alchemist? ——— is a small game about stacking and mixing cards to craft strange recipes. Open boosters, delve into dungeons to find rare resources, hire goblins to help you to craft the Holy Grail and save the city, and don't forget to serve your shady clients!

games.name: Gemblades
games.text: ——— is a single-player deckbuilder where you play heroes to earn resources, recruit stronger ———, and combine powerful synergies into your deck to defeat your enemies.

games.name: Masters of Albion
games.text: A bold reimagining of the God Game genre from the creator who defined it. Shape a living world as a god - or step into it and experience it through your people. Build, guide and defend your town by day, then survive the night when everything is under threat. There is no single solution. Only yours.

games.name: Avakin Life
games.text: ——— is an endless social world waiting for you. Live your dream life, from unique and customizable avatars to stylish fashion outfits and personalized dream homes. Hang out with friends, join parties, and embark on adventures in a world where you are in control of everything.

games.name: Insider Trading
games.text: ——— is a roguelike deckbuilder where you bend the market to your will. Synergize perks, manipulate stock prices, and trade wisely or risk pricing yourself out.

games.name: Escape From Duckov
games.text: ——— is a PVE indie survival RPG — in a duck's world!. Scavenge for resources, build your hideout, and upgrade your gear in the world of Duckov. Start from nothing and rise to the top. Outwit hostile ducks, survive, or make it out alive.

games.name: Tiny Pasture
games.text: Meet your new little desk buddies! They’ll snooze, scratch, and scamper around while you work or study (don’t worry, they’ve been trained not to invade your workspace). If you’re good at animal management, they will occupy the bottom of your screen with different kinds and colors!

games.name: Low-Budget Repairs
games.text: Manage renovations in 90s apartment blocks! Focus on quick profit and cut costs wherever possible. Client notices defects? Tough luck, the money's already in your pocket. Every day brings new challenges and decisions that can lead to fortune... or trouble!

games.name: Starless Abyss
games.text: Earth has fallen. Science and the Occult have united forces to brace for the arrival of the Eldritch. But will the efforts against this strange, alien race be enough? Play as one of many Proximae used to help defend humanity in this turn-based, roguelike, intergalactic deck builder.

games.name: Among Us 3D
games.text: The definitive social deduction party game in three dimensions! Can the Crewmates survive, or will Impostors take over? Roles, Emergency Meetings, deception, sabotages, tasks: enjoy your favorite brand of chaos from the original Among Us with a 3D twist.

games.name: Backyard Soccer '98
games.text: Return to the soccer field with your favorite Backyard athletes! The original Backyard Soccer 1998 is back and now enhanced to run on Steam. Build your roster from among the iconic Backyard Kids. Kick, pass, and score in this classic game that made soccer fun for everyone!

games.name: Backyard Baseball '97
games.text: Rediscover the joy of the original Backyard Baseball 1997, now updated for modern systems! Build your roster from among the iconic Backyard Kids, aim for those home runs, and various game modes. Relive the magic of this classic baseball game!

games.name: Backyard Football '99
games.text: Backyard Football 1999 is back and now enhanced to run on modern systems. Whether you're picking Jerry Rice or Barry Sanders for your dream team, scoring TDs with Pablo Sanchez, or enjoying the witty banter between Sunny Day and Chuck Downfield, simple controls let anyone pick up and play football!

games.name: Texas Hold'em Poker: Pokerist
games.text: Try the legendary Texas Poker! Enjoy a real casino atmosphere and superior 3D graphics. Jump into a world of excitement, challenge other players, and show you're a true winner!

games.name: Emissary Zero
games.text: Co-op horror (1-4 players). You are sent to explore a mysterious building at night. Find the Moon and try to return alive.

games.name: Second Stellar
games.text: Join the enigmatic Starfarers as they traverse the cosmos in this unique dual-character action roguelite, unraveling the mysteries of their galaxy and beyond in pursuit of the Voyager.

games.name: Rana Card
games.text: ——— is a roguelike deck-builder where you play as a farm manager chasing TimeTech's KPI targets. Draw cards in high-stakes moments, survive Time Explosions, and unlock powerful cards. Build your deck, chart your own path, and face branching events and cataclysmic years on the road to success.

games.name: Bioweaver
games.text: ——— is an RPG game with the main content of treasure hunting and character building. You can use basic programming logic to deeply customize your skill sets, and you can also create organs with different attributes and functions with the special crafting system.

games.name: WARRIORS: Abyss
games.text: Through victory and defeat, traverse the merciless trials of hell.

games.name: Long Drive North: Co-Op RV Simulator
games.text: Join the Early Access journey with this immersive driving-survival game. Explore the harsh American wilderness in the ———. Drive & repair your trusty RV, scavenge for parts, upgrade your vehicle, hunt & cook to survive; alone or with up to 4 players. SHARED RV MULTIPLAYER NOW AVAILABLE.

games.name: Deck of Haunts
games.text: ——— invites you to become a malevolent Haunted House. Lure humans into your cursed halls, manipulate their fears, and drain their essence to grow your power. Use strategy to build your mansion and expand your dark influence, turning your home into a terrifying, inescapable nightmare.

games.name: Pairs & Perils
games.text: ——— is a memory-game roguelike and dungeon crawler. Match cards to attack enemies, avoid traps, shop for relics and consumables. Sharpen your mind as you journey through the depths of the dungeon in search of The Dealer.

games.name: No, I'm not a Human
games.text: WARNING. Stay inside. Lock your doors. Close the blinds. Only let humans in. Eliminate all Visitors. An anxiety horror about paranoia in the End of Times.

games.name: Mall Simulator
games.text: Turn your building from a small shopping center into a huge city mall! To avoid going bankrupt, you’ll need to build new stores and restaurants, set smart prices, and keep up with trends. 15+ stores, dozens of machines & services, and hundreds of brands waiting for you!

games.name: Tetris® Forever
games.text: Celebrate 40 years of Tetris® with 15+ games, a new game, and documentary videos

games.name: A la Card
games.text: Buckle up for a food truck deckbuilder boiling over with card mutation mischief, questionable recipes, and limitless synergies.

games.name: MINOS
games.text: ——— is a maze-building roguelite where you, the fabled Minotaur, must defend your sanctuary from bloodthirsty adventurers. Design and re-design deadly labyrinths, set traps, and turn every brave fool into your next victim.

games.name: The Fable: Manga Build Roguelike
games.text: ——— combines manga, tactical puzzles, and roguelike gameplay into one thrilling experience. Enjoy stylish pixel-art action while testing your flexible thinking and precise strategy!

games.name: MudRunner VR
games.text: Take the wheel in this ultimate off-road automotive experience designed for VR, with all-new vehicles and tools to navigate harsh landscapes.

games.name: Trainee Death Simulator
games.text: You will play as a Trainee Death, harvesting Souls to pay off your debt. Random choice events offer you various options: Lie in bed and slack off since the debt is endless anyway, Or follow your senior to earn some extra Souls, collecting outfits to switch up your style.

games.name: Dungeons of Eternity
games.text: Endless fantasy action and adventure await you and your friends in ———. Hack-n-slash takes on a new meaning in VR: swing swords, throw axes, use bows, wield magic staffs, and more to make it out alive. Become the most powerful adventurer in this blockbuster VR experience!

games.name: Nubby's Number Factory
games.text: A plinko-style roguelike where you work at a number factory. Launch your spherical friend, Nubby, down a pegboard to make bigger and bigger numbers! But beware, if you fail to meet your number quota, the sun will explode.

games.name: Formula Legends
games.text: From the golden age to the modern era, race through time in ———. Master reimagined circuits, command legendary cars, and chase glory across decades of motorsport history. A love letter to Formula racing, where speed, skill, and strategy define the champion.

games.name: White Knuckle
games.text: ——— is a first-person roguelite speed-climbing game. Ascend through the guts of SUB-STRUCTURE 17 using precision movement mechanics. Sharp reflexes and resource management will bring you out from under ten thousand meters of concrete and decay.

games.name: Vacation Cafe Simulator
games.text: Cozy Italian Vacation Cafe 🏖️ No timers, No stress 😌 cook traditional dishes 🍝 upgrade and customize 🏠 just drink Prosecco 🥂 relax and grow your dream cafe ✨

games.name: Puttler
games.text: ——— is a mini-golf puzzle game featuring wacky obstacles and a charming backstory. Build contraptions to score the golf ball under par across 15 courses and over 250 unique holes to solve.

games.name: Scale the Depths
games.text: Fish, scale, sell, repeat. ——— is a casual fishing game built around this simple but satisfying loop. Feed hungry customers, upgrade your gear, and uncover the many secrets hidden beneath the surface.

games.name: Blood Strike
games.text: Gather your friends and dive into the action-packed Battle Royale, Squad Fight, or Hot Zone like there's no tomorrow! ——— offers a wide range of playable Strikers, each with a unique active and passive ability letting you deploy drones, shield walls and everything in between.

games.name: Skull Horde
games.text: ——— is an auto battler dungeon crawler where you play as a flying skull necromancer. Find powerful loot and create overpowered builds. Summon a horde of skeletons in a battle of bone versus flesh!

games.name: Shadowhand Solitaire
games.text: Ride with Lady Cornelia Darkmoor - aristocrat by day, highwaywoman by night. Play your cards right to untangle a web of corruption, smuggling and blackmail in this swashbuckling solitaire adventure. Your fortune and freedom are at stake!

games.name: Red Rogue Sea
games.text: ——— is a roguelike strategy game that puts you in the shoes of a pirate captain and their crew. Manage your vessel as you sail through the treacherous waters of the archipelago, interact with the scum that inhabit it, and engage in battle using a tactical deck-building system.

games.name: Gigantes Ex Machina
games.text: Fast paced Top-down shooter! Smartly use IRCM to evade the constant barrage of bullets and missiles and destroy everything that stands in your way.

games.name: VR Sailing
games.text: It allows players to transform into sailboat navigators, sailing their beloved ships in the endless sea and enjoying the thrill of 360 degree immersive sailing and waves! Feel the forward momentum brought by the wind.

games.name: Maestro's Cold War 2
games.text: Addictive yet chill. An immersive Cold War sandbox. Revive the Cold War in this classic strategy game—easy to pick up, yet challenging and deep, offering endless replayability.

games.name: Lost But Found
games.text: Organize and give out lost items! ——— is a job simulator game where you are an officer who oversees the lost items in an airport. Organize those items and distribute them to people who lost their belongings. Upgrade your office, manage requests, collect stickers, and more.

games.name: Omelet You Cook
games.text: The cozy chaotic cooking roguelike. Assemble omelets for quirky students using ingredients from a conveyor belt. Discover wacky combinations to satisfy the ever-demanding Principal Clucker.

games.name: Luck & Loot
games.text: ——— is a dice-building roguelike where you’ll craft and customize powerful dice, collect game-changing relics, and battle corrupted foes in brutal, turn-based combat across procedurally generated dungeons. Victory is earned in this unforgiving fight for survival.

games.name: The Good Dog: Chasing Shadows
games.text: In ———, play as a dog defending your family from paranormal creatures. Explore the world and solve environmental puzzles to save your loved ones and uncover the mystery.

games.name: Last Report
games.text: ——— is a dark horror game where you play as a night shift park ranger. While monitoring the camera footage, you start noticing strange events. Uncover the terrifying secret of the National Park. Something moved in the window, but don’t worry it’s probably just another deer, right?

games.name: BRIGANDINE ABYSS
games.text: Play as one of six factions to confront the Abyssloa Empire. Command your troops, develop your bases, and take control of the continent of Meltitea in this tactical strategy RPG!

games.name: Neongarten
games.text: A minimalist cyberpunk city builder inspired by Islanders and Luck Be a Landlord.

games.name: Calyx
games.text: A strategy game with a new kind of enemy, ——— puts you in charge of a space mining outpost, locked in battle against powerful plant-aliens. Build your base, gather resources, assemble your forces, and take on the ———. With only an out-of-date AI for company, can you survive?

games.name: Machinefall
games.text: ——— is a post-apocalyptic real time strategy game set on a fully playable global map. Lead humanity’s last survivors as they build bases, gather resources, and wage massive battles against an overwhelming machine swarm. Progress through technological eras from Stone Age to Atomic Age.

games.name: gogh: Focus with Your Avatar
games.text: A cozy multiplayer co-working sandbox with character customization, room building, and productivity tools. Focus, study, work, and relax together with friends and players around the world.

games.name: Prime Monster
games.text: A card-based political roguelike about surviving in a parliament of literal monsters. Fight for votes, break rules, weather scandals and force through absurd laws to keep the top job in this democratic dystopia of truly monstrous proportions.

games.name: Cinderia
games.text: A fast, brutal action roguelite with razor-sharp controls and insane build freedom. Fuse embers, magic cards, and gear into wildly overpowered combat styles — and break each run in a world consumed by the Ash Witch.

games.name: Surviving Mars: Relaunched
games.text: The award-winning sci-fi city builder is back - remastered, expanded and even more stunning. Colonize Mars and survive the process, from exploration and infrastructure to welcoming colonists and achieving long-term stability. Are you ready? Mars is waiting.

games.name: SHUTEN ORDER
games.text: "168 remaining until the end of the world..." Humanity is approaching its end. A sudden dismemberment murder of the leader of a religious nation that advocates an apocalyptic ideology... Five adventure games are combined into one, centered around a suspenseful story full of mystery and intrigue.

games.name: Soccer Manager 2026
games.text: Manage elite football clubs and lead your dream team as a football manager!

games.name: Super Woden: Rally Edge
games.text: The spin-off of the acclaimed ——— saga, blending classic arcade essence with great depth and a genuine love for car culture. With a unique personality, Rally Edge takes you back to an era where fun goes beyond realism.

games.name: Fogpiercer
games.text: Fight through the fog in this sci-fi roguelike deckbuilder where clever positioning, explosive chain-reactions, and the environment itself can make the difference between life and death.

games.name: Cursemark
games.text: Hack, slash, and cast your way through a haunted kingdom brimming with secrets where no two builds are ever the same. As a cursed mage-knight you will unlock devastating spells, equip ability transforming runes, and reforge your curse on the path to victory or death in this fantasy action roguelite.

games.name: Axis Football 2026
games.text: ——— is a complete American Football Simulation featuring fluid gameplay, endless customization, and the industry's best franchise mode.

games.name: Apocalypse Express
games.text: Conduct, upgrade and repair your train through endless waves of enemies in a post-apocalyptic setting. In this action management roguelike, the player decides to embark on a journey through the wasteland looking to fulfill the dream of seeing the remains of the outside world.

games.name: Umamusume: Pretty Derby
games.text: ———, winner of Best Mobile Game at The Game Awards 2025, is ready to race! Scout featured trainees and supporters as you navigate the immersive sports life simulation through the game's in-depth training system and top-of-the-line 3D graphics!

games.name: Recharge: Room Games
games.text: ——— is a sim-cade RC racing game with realistic graphics and physics. Customize your RC car and race on tracks inspired by real-world locations!

games.name: Rotate or Die
games.text: ——— throws you into a heart-pounding, high-speed adventure, where danger lurks around every corner.

games.name: DreamEcho
games.text: "Dream Echoes" is an atypical top-down RogueLite ARPG centered on loot grinding and meta-progression. Explore the dream world, collect "Concepts", and enjoy highly free combinative combat. Upon waking, gather "Memories" to carry some "Concepts" into your next adventure…

games.name: iRacing Arcade
games.text: Race across global licensed series and build your own racing team to secure your motorsport legacy in this third person arcade racer.

games.name: Tower Dominion
games.text: Build and design the terrain while defending your stronghold against alien invasion in this unique Roguelike tower defense. Choose from 30 heroes, survive enemy waves, and upgrade a variety of destructive towers to hold the line!

games.name: MineGeon: Renegades
games.text: Descend into the dangerous depths of PAIMO in this co-op sci-fi roguelite bullet-hell focused on resource gathering. Play solo or with friends as you fight, gather resources, and upgrade together. The deeper you go, the greater the risks, rewards, and secrets waiting beneath the surface.

games.name: Stolen Realm Survivors
games.text: An online co-op survivor-like auto-shooter set in the world of Stolen Realm. Battle relentless hordes of enemies, discover powerful artifacts, modify unique skills, and build unstoppable combos to survive. Play solo or with friends and unleash the full power of the Realm.

games.name: TypInc.
games.text: ———. is a roguelike deckbuilding typing game. Type the paragraphs presented to you and maintain your streak to survive and win the game.

games.name: EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 26
games.text: ——— leverages a new AI-powered machine learning system to convert thousands of plays from nearly a decade of real NFL data into more explosive gameplay.

games.name: The Bleakest Keep
games.text: ——— is a challenging action horror roguelike. Survive the horrors of the Keep, upgrade your gear, and earn ranks as you ascend the tower and save the world!

games.name: FROGGY HATES SNOW
games.text: A survival roguelike where a frog digs through freezing snow, uncovers treasures, unlocks upgrades, and battles mystical creatures. Find the escape door — or defeat the final boss to survive.

games.name: Bendy: Lone Wolf
games.text: ———® tests your ability to survive against ever increasing odds. Monsters and obstacles emerge from every direction as you journey into the rubberhose halls of the world's most evil animation studio, set during the events of ——— and the Dark Revival®. Every day is a challenge.

games.name: Break Siege
games.text: ——— is a train-themed deck-building rougelike game in which you constantly construct your own deck and breakthrough forces of the Imperial in intense, real-time battles.

games.name: Conquest Dark
games.text: Experience an ARPG's rapid ascension to power in minutes, packed with savage, survivors-like action and devastating sword & sorcery combat. Perfect your builds through Dark Ritual runs that will decide humanity's future as you battle endless hordes across haunting ruins and cursed kingdoms.

games.name: Garfield Kart 2 - All You Can Drift
games.text: Fire Up Your Engines, Because Garfield Is Waiting for You at the Starting Line! Play as one of the eight cult characters from the Garfield universe, fill up your karts, customize your look, and race away at breakneck speeds.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced
games.text: Experience entertainment blockbusters Grand Theft Auto V and Grand Theft Auto Online — now upgraded for a new generation with stunning visuals, faster loading, 3D audio, and more, plus exclusive content for GTA Online players.

games.name: R.E.P.O.
games.text: An online co-op horror game with up to 6 players. Locate valuable, fully physics-based objects and handle them with care as you retrieve and extract to satisfy your creator's desires.

games.name: A Game About Digging A Hole™
games.text: A minimalist game about digging a hole in the garden of a newly purchased house. Collect resources, sell them, upgrade your equipment and discover a mysterious secret. Costs you only one coffee!

games.name: UNLIGHT:Revive
games.text: This is a story-centered competitive training card game.

games.name: Mycopunk
games.text: Cut through fungal aliens in this hyper-customizable, mission based looter shooter. Hundreds of hand-crafted upgrades, 4-player co-op, and a little roach man. What’s not to love?

games.name: LUNAR Remastered Collection
games.text: Dive into the enchanting worlds of LUNAR: Silver Star Story Complete and LUNAR 2: Eternal Blue Complete! Tag along on Alex and Hiro's quests and challenge enemies like the Magic Emperor and God of Destruction to save the world from dire peril in two adventures set 1000 years apart from each other!

games.name: Moomintroll: Winter's Warmth
games.text: From the creators of Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley comes a heartwarming new adventure inspired by the beloved Moomin stories by Tove Jansson. This time, join ——— himself on a charming but cold winter journey.

games.name: 10S FOREVER
games.text: TENNIS HELL ARCADE

games.name: I'm No Demonlord
games.text: "———" is a Roguelike shooter bullet hell game. High freedom in mechanics leads to unique playthroughs. As a demon-possessed hero, battle enemies, grow, and unveil dark schemes. Can he accept his new role? Save "kinds" or destroy "outsiders"? Good or evil? The choice is yours.

games.name: Papa's Pizzeria Deluxe
games.text: Top, bake, and serve delicious pizzas in ———! Craft pizzas for Papa Louie's loyal customers while earning tips, points, and Special Recipes. Unlock holiday ingredients for seasonal pies, and take a trip in the Food Truck to serve your own unique creations!

games.name: The Spire of Mech Zero
games.text: A lite roguelike card deck building game inspired by Slay the Spire. You can experience battles of robots with cards and components! Try to conquer the spire with one perfect run, every choice matters!

games.name: Landmine Princess
games.text: Meet Mina! She's a landmine girl! That means she's cute on the outside, but dangerous on the inside! But maybe she's the kind of danger you've always been looking for. This is a rogue fast-love dating sim. And the only sim that teaches you to be nice to girls. Or else.

games.name: Birdigo - bird word game
games.text: A word game about migrating birds - inspired by Wordle and Balatro. Play cards, build your deck, trigger combos and guide your flock. From John August (Corpse Bride) and Corey Martin (Bonfire Peaks).

games.name: Cardburners
games.text: ——— is a chaotic fast-paced, solo or online versus card game. You must play your cards quickly before they burn in your hand! Mix and match completely different sets of cards and rules to create unique action packed games.

games.name: Touhou Dystopian
games.text: Touhou Project's Brand New Action Roguelite Fan Game! Strange incidents erupt in the Animal Realm and Primate Spirit Garden. Embark on an unknown journey, uncover the truth behind the anomalies, and break through this '———'!

games.name: Cursed Companions
games.text: If we say the wrong words... WE DIE! This game kills you with your own voices! Online co-op where everyone gets a forbidden word, say it and you kill your friends. Explore spooky dungeons, cast spells and defeat monsters with your voices. 8-player Co-op Mode. 16-player Traitor Mode

games.name: MindsEye
games.text: ——— is an ever-expanding gameplay experience with a story campaign, endless stream of new playable content delivered regularly, and the power to create your own games with our simple to use building tool.

games.name: Pic-Me!
games.text: ———! is a card game about deception, where players use wonderous images to spark creativity and imagination. Each round becomes an intricate mindgame against the other players at the table. Will you be able to outsmart your friends or will you be tricked by them? 4-8 players only.

games.name: Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors
games.text: From the creators of Vampire Survivors comes a turbo-charged, turn-based roguelite deckbuilder! Deal world-ending combos, blitz through infested dungeons, and master the Turboturn to obliterate hordes of familiar foes with a chaotic hand of cards.

games.name: IT Specialist Simulator
games.text: Step into the world of IT! Diagnose network issues, manage servers, and repair devices while handling tasks under strict SLAs. Choose your career path, from HelpDesk to IT Project Manager. Develop real IT knowledge and climb the ranks in this realistic IT simulation!

games.name: Anno 117: Pax Romana
games.text: Shape the Roman Empire in this genre-defining strategic builder game. Build cities while expanding your influence through Roman provinces. Govern using your economic prowess, diplomatic skills, or military might.

games.name: SpaceCraft
games.text: The Universe is yours. ——— is an online space exploration and building game. Explore a vast galaxy of solar systems and planets, mine and craft resources, design and build ships, automate planetary bases and interplanetary logistics, trade and cooperate.

games.name: Feed The Pit
games.text: JOIN THE SOCIETY in this story-driven, investigative horror game. Hunt down wealthy humans in a deadly forest in order to ———. Act 1 is available at launch. Acts 2 & 3 will release as free updates in the coming months!

games.name: LANESPLIT
games.text: Push performance bikes to the absolute limit, and weave through traffic where one wrong move can spell disaster.

games.name: Drone Sector
games.text: ——— is a futuristic gunship game. Provide close air support by firing variety of weapons at the enemies and guide your allied troops via commands. Keep your troops alive, complete objectives, collect resources and recruit engineers. Research better weaponry for the gunship and the troops.

games.name: DEATH STRANDING 2: ON THE BEACH
games.text: Sam – with companions by his side – sets out on a new journey to save humanity from extinction. Join them as they traverse a world beset by otherworldly enemies, obstacles and a haunting question: should we have connected?

games.name: World of Outlaws: Dirt Racing 24 Gold Edition
games.text: iRacing presents the Official Game of The ———, featuring the ——— Sprint Car, Late Models and Super DIRTcar Big Block Modifieds, as well as 8 additional series including the all-new Micro Sprints, and many others.

games.name: Mistfall Hunter
games.text: ——— is a dark fantasy extraction ARPG. Combine skills, talents, and gear for each class in thrilling combat! Whether you team up or go solo, one thing remains certain—only by fighting your way through can you return with a full haul. Good luck, Gyldhunter.

games.name: Zoominoes
games.text: Build the ultimate Zoo in this number-go-up roguelike deckbuilder. Find powerful mythical animals, boost them with snacks, and even manipulate the board itself. Break the game by scoring millions (and more) with insane combos.

games.name: Moonsigil Atlas
games.text: The deckbuilding roguelike with no energy – play cards using physical space! Slot cards together, manipulate the shape of your cards, and create overpowered combos to break the game!

games.name: Heretic + Hexen
games.text: Step into the definitive re-release of two dark spell-casting shooters that shaped the genre. This enhanced restoration makes ———™ available to new audiences and long-time fans with expanded accessibility across more platforms and languages than ever before.

games.name: Dark Fairy Tale: Dreamland Survivors
games.text: This is a top-down, auto-shooting roguelike that can be played entirely one-handed. Players take on the role of Pinocchio, fallen into a nightmare, collecting forbidden Dream Eggs that grant ever-changing offensive and survival abilities. Slay twisted fairy tale creatures in endless nightmares!

games.name: Easy Delivery Co.
games.text: ———. is a relaxing driving game with strange secrets. Chill out, make deliveries and get to know the mysterious residents of this scenic mountain town, all while earning well below minimum wage.

games.name: Remote Reaper: FPV Combat Drone Simulator
games.text: Realistic Ukrainian FPV combat drone simulator built with frontline pilots. Train like a real pilot: fight through enemy jamming, watch your battery, find armor weak spots, and finish the strike before the signal dies. Supports RadioMaster, DJI FPV, TBS and gamepads. Online co-op, mission editor.

games.name: Finity
games.text: Fuse monsters, build strategic decks, catch wild beasts, and battle players worldwide in the ultimate monster MMO!

games.name: Flaregate Network
games.text: A sci-fi deckbuilder with RTS-style fleet battles. Discover an epic space opera through a full story campaign, then pursue mastery in a separate roguelike mode.

games.name: HER TREES : PUZZLE DREAM
games.text: ——— is a unique point-and-click puzzle game where you move and combine objects to solve puzzles. Unravel the strange puzzles hidden in your dreams.

games.name: 868-BACK
games.text: ——— is a computer-hacking strategy roguelike game where your mission is to dismantle capitalism one server at a time! Use hacking powers to fight enemies, steal the servers' data, and face increasingly nasty situations before being disconnected (again!) by the richest corporations on earth.

games.name: Nightmare Frontier
games.text: Behold! The first-ever Tactical Extraction Looter where you pit your courage and leadership against fears made manifest: the Dreadweavers. Lead a band of Scavengers into a devastated West Coast City of the alternative 1900s. Get in, face the monsters, grab the loot you can carry and get out. Alive.

games.name: AI Learns To Drive
games.text: Train AI to drive! Create your own neural network and watch it evolve from chaos to mastery with the power of evolutionary algorithms and natural selection. Fine-tune the learning process to craft the ultimate AI driver, and test your creation in campaign challenges or on custom-built tracks.

games.name: Factory Town 2: Paradise
games.text: A Town Builder + Factory Sim where you fully automate a tropical village and feed a giant volcano. Use conveyor belts, trains, boats, zip lines, pipes, water wheels and more to produce massive amounts of items and keep everyone happy!

games.name: The Sims™ Legacy Collection
games.text: The original game you know and love. For Windows 10/11. Create a neighborhood of Sims and guide their lives through careers and romance. Or create chaos with open-ended gameplay that lets you shape their destinies.

games.name: Burgie's Cozy Kitchen
games.text: A tiny active desktop companion you can play at your own pace. Serve cute, picky customers between your daily tasks and enjoy little breaks that brighten your day. ✨ With a built-in Pomodoro mode to help you stay focused while you work, plus stream integration where your chat can place orders!

games.name: CloverPit
games.text: A rogue-lite slot machine nightmare. Gamble for your life in a never-ending debt simulator!

games.name: Ledgerbound
games.text: Deny an insurance claim, save the world. ——— is a hilarious, narrative-driven tactical RPG/dating sim filled with all your favorite epic fantasy activities: battling evil enemies, filling out paperwork, rescuing your company from financial ruin, pursuing HR-approved relationships, and more!

games.name: Big Winner
games.text: In a future where the financial system has collapsed, the lottery becomes a lifeline for survival, with luck as the only currency. As an ordinary person in this predestined world, can you leverage the "Luck System" with courage and wit to rise from obscurity and attain the wealth others covet?

games.name: Kaamos: Puzzle Roguelike
games.text: ——— is a bite-sized turn-based puzzle roguelike where battles are fought by matching tiles on a grid with looping rows and columns. Build your character and deck of tiles by looting equipment from your foes. Traverse a dark medieval world where the Sun went down and never rose again.

games.name: Hozy
games.text: Restore a forgotten neighbourhood through your favourite hobby, one cozy room at a time. In ———, clean, paint, and decorate abandoned homes with satisfying mechanics and intuitive controls. Enjoy the little details as you interact with tools, items and furniture to bring each space back to life.

games.name: hololive Holo's Hanafuda
games.text: Holo's Hanafuda is a banter-filled card game battler fully voiced by and featuring hololive talent! Join Nakiri Ayame, Shirakami Fubuki, Ookami Mio, and Sakura Miko on a wild adventure through a strange land filled with card games and chaos!

games.name: TETRIS® THE GRAND MASTER 4 -ABSOLUTE EYE-
games.text: The latest title in the "TGM" series, "———-" offers the ultimate Tetris game that no one has ever experienced before. Challenge yourself in new modes such as ASUKA and SHIRANUI.

games.name: Kinny and the Cosmic Cauldron
games.text: Cook or be cooked! In this cosmic deck-building roguelike, ingredients crash, merge, and react in chaotic ways. As the witch chef of Stewpendous Spoons, craft the perfect stew, master strategic combos, and satisfy bizarre patrons, before you end up in the cauldron yourself!

games.name: Free Solitaire
games.text: ——— collection, no ads. 120+ variants. Highly customizable. Card editor.

games.name: Retrowave 2
games.text: Neon lights, palm trees, synthwave, '80s supercars speeding down an endless highway... Welcome to the world of Retrowave!

games.name: Feng Shui Meowjong
games.text: Looks matter? Fun doesn’t?When cat memes collide with roguelike mahjong, a brand-new Meowjong is born! ——— is a fresh, lightweight roguelike puzzle game that blends classic mahjong strategy with quirky cat memes and feng shui elements.

games.name: Cubic Cosmos
games.text: ——— is a thrilling fast-paced roguelike card game. You have been trapped in a deadly game. One wrong move could see you reduced to a plaything of the goddess. Can you free yourself from the endless cycle and escape your fate?

games.name: Mr. President
games.text: Can you face the challenges of the Oval Office? Find out in ———, a sandbox simulation of the U.S. presidency. Pursue your legislative agenda. Compete with rivals Russia and China. Deal with crises from 9/11 to COVID-19; and direct the U.S. military against terror groups and rogue states.

games.name: The Royal Writ
games.text: Sacrifice creates stories in this medieval roguelike deckbuilder. Watch your cards march to glory or permanent death as they battle toward the enemy. Each fallen hero becomes part of your kingdom's legend. Command wisely... some sacrifices are necessary.

games.name: Pro Wrestler Story
games.text: Pro Wrestling Team Management Sim, Face off with fearsome foes!

games.name: Dinotica
games.text: Welcome to ———! Stomp into a mysterious and dangerous world filled with action, adventure, and companionship! Together, you'll fight, build, farm, and more as you work toward creating a unique home that is truly your own.

games.name: After Inc: Revival
games.text: Can you rebuild civilization after a zombie apocalypse? From the creator of Plague Inc. comes a unique blend of strategic simulation, survival city builder and ‘mini 4X’. Build post-apocalyptic settlements, harvest resources and shape society as you lead humanity out of the darkness.

games.name: Tabletop Tavern
games.text: ——— is a roguelike RTS where you build an army from scratch and command them across a brutal campaign. Recruit diverse units, create devastating synergies, and make tactical choices that shape the fate of every run.

games.name: OFF
games.text: “I’m the Batter. I’ve been entrusted with a sacred mission.” -- One of the most influential RPGs of the last 20 years is finally coming to Steam. Take control of the Batter as he seeks to purify an uncanny and hopeless world haunted by specters, guided by a cryptic, grinning cat called The Judge.

games.name: Kungfu Card
games.text: Kung Fu Cards combines the depth of Chinese martial arts with familiar playing card and mahjong mechanics, making it easy to learn yet deeply strategic. Read your opponent, counter every move, select your martial school and moves, and fight to claim the title of the world's greatest martial artist!

games.name: PIGFACE
games.text: You wake up with an explosive headache in a pool of your own blood. You're Exit, a terrible woman whose awful past has finally caught up to her. Fulfill contracts for the people who drilled into your skull — guns-blazing, slow and tactical — it doesn’t matter. They know you’ll do whatever it takes.

games.name: Capote
games.text: Play cards with your friends or meet new opponents at a local bar where every match is a brand-new challenge! Test your strategy across 3 different game modes, each with their own unique rules and systems! Victory is never guaranteed, and there's always one card that can flip everything.

games.name: Progress Racer RPG
games.text: An incremental game with meta-unveiling secrets and a bangin' soundtrack. Race along an obstacle-ridden track to gain resources, then spend them to level up and purchase upgrades. Drive to reunite with your true love- if the entire world doesn't fall apart before then...

games.name: Raiders of Blackveil
games.text: Join the rebellion against the evil corporation Blackveil in this action-packed roguelite for 1-3 players. Select your MOBA-like champion, collect RPG-style loot and infiltrate Blackveil’s massive factory. Wreak havoc, and smuggle out loot to get INSANELY powerful!

games.name: Passant: A Chess Roguelike
games.text: ——— is a chess roguelike that changes all the rules. Progress through challenging rounds while collecting powerful pieces and game-changing items to seize victory.

games.name: Starforged Legacy
games.text: Outlast the onslaught in a sci-fi survivors-like where your decisions matter as much as your firepower. Command customizable starships, enhance your arsenal with 100+ strategy-defining upgrades, and annihilate endless fleets of cosmic combatants! Carve your legacy among the stars or die trying!

games.name: TCG Multiplayer Card Shop Simulator
games.text: Multiplayer TCG Card Shop Simulator. Dive into the world of TCG Card Shop multiplayer gaming by opening your own local game store! Stock your TCG Card shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them open to collect the cards yourself.

games.name: skate.
games.text: Experience improved Flick-It controls, the rich physics based skateboarding gameplay that provides those “only in ———.™“ moments and off-board exploration for full freedom in the online multiplayer world of San Vansterdam.

games.name: A Planet Full of Cats
games.text: ——— is a hidden object adventure with metroidvania-style exploration in true Devcats fashion. Explore diverse biomes, unlock new powers and uncover ancient secrets!

games.name: KuloNiku: Bowl Up!
games.text: Prep your stations for a cozy cooking game with attitude! Prepare unique meals for quirky small-town locals, upgrade and customize your shop, compete in thrilling cooking battles to become top chef, and protect your family’s long-running restaurant alongside a cast of curious companions!

games.name: All Aboard! The Train Defense Express
games.text: Protect the Infinite Power Generator by looping around the train tracks! Battle endless waves of enemies in this unique hybrid of auto-battler, survivor, tower defense, idle/clicker gameplay. How long can you survive?

games.name: Project Afterfall
games.text: Wake to a brutal world of Thea, bent on destroying your colony. Rebuild, Explore the Wastelands, and Gather scarce resources. Will you strike a deal with the ruthless Baba Yaga - or hack a rogue Cyber-Rat to turn it into an ally? A dark strategy-survival RPG with card-based tactical combat.

games.name: Coal LLC
games.text: Fill your quota or die. Mine increasingly absurd amounts of coal using some dubious, but effective, mining techniques. Or relax and mine at your own pace in peaceful mode.

games.name: Flan's BN
games.text: 《———》is the prequel to 《Flan's MS》, which combines JRPG and deckbuilder mechanics. Experience Flan's story of self-discovery

games.name: Shard Squad
games.text: Form a squad of elemental creatures and face hordes of challenging enemies! Choose your Shards according to their synergies to gain new abilities, and equip relics that will make the winds blow in your favor! Survive through different environments and save your lands!

games.name: EverSiege: Untold Ages
games.text: Retreating ends here. Defend Bastion against evil hordes, reclaim lost powers, rebuild ancient ruins, and adapt your tactics to reverse the siege. Shape your playstyle in this hero-strategy rogue-lite solo or co-op up to 3 players.

games.name: Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout DX
games.text: This DX edition includes new stories, playable characters(Agatha, Kilo, and Romy), and features that have been added to "———: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout.

games.name: Atelier Ryza 2: Lost Legends & the Secret Fairy DX
games.text: This edition includes new stories, playable characters (Empel, Lila), and features that have been added to "———: Lost Legends & the Secret Fairy."

games.name: Atelier Ryza 3: Alchemist of the End & the Secret Key DX
games.text: This edition includes new stories, playable characters (Clifford, Serri, and Kilo), and features that have been added to "———: Alchemist of the End & the Secret Key."

games.name: Firehawk: FPV Drone Shooter
games.text: Weave through gunfire, master aerial combat, and rain destruction from above in this high-stakes FPV drone roguelike shooter. Take to the skies and rise from amateur to pro to unlock an arsenal of weapons, against endless enemies with real drone physics and controls.

games.name: Synthwave Driver
games.text: A nostalgic road trip on an endless highway, driving iconic '80s cars through a neon-filled paradise. Let the synthwave soundtrack guide you toward the horizon, leading you into a world of nostalgic vibes.

games.name: Battleship Command
games.text: Command the mighty Scharnhorst in this immersive WWII naval simulation. Walk her decks in first-person, control gunnery, radar, and navigation, and lead your fleet through the Atlantic, Arctic, and Mediterranean. Battle convoys, outwit enemies, and survive the stormy seas of war.

games.name: Roulette Hero
games.text: ——— is a strategic roguelike deckbuilder where you assemble animal companions to defeat towering mechanical beasts. Line up the perfect squad on your roulette wheel, spin to activate your animals' abilities, trigger game-changing synergies, and turn the tide of battle!

games.name: Funguys Swarm
games.text: ——— is a cartoony survivor bullet hell where the forest is on fire. Become a Funguy, arm yourself with forest-crafted weapons, and unleash some bonkers powers on the Fireking’s army. And maybe... just maybe, save the day if you’re skilled (or lucky) enough.

games.name: Hell Maiden
games.text: Traverse the depths of Hell and beat its toughest demons on your way to Heaven in this horde survival deck-building game inspired by Dante's Divine Comedy.

games.name: Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter
games.text: ——— reimagines the first chapter of a beloved series, infusing it with enhanced visuals and refined gameplay. Join Estelle and Joshua, partners bound by fate, as they unravel dark conspiracies threatening the peace of the Liberl Kingdom.

games.name: Nine-Ball Roulette
games.text: This will be the most thrilling pool game you have ever played. Join up to 3 of your friends in this exciting pool roulette game! Eliminate each other with pool until only one person is left.

games.name: Little Chef: Cozy Cooking
games.text: ——— is a short physics-based cooking game full of discovery and playful chaos. Experiment with everything in the kitchen and unlock over 300 recipes on your way to becoming a master chef!

games.name: Kabuto Park
games.text: Enjoy summer in ———! Catch the cutest bugs, train them and win the Summer Beetle Battles Championship in this tiny bug collection game! Upgrade your equipment to find rarer, stronger and shinier little friends.

games.name: DISCOPUP
games.text: ——— is a mystery game about a seal who wants to sneak inside a dogs-only party. Explore the city and meet shady characters as your search for the perfect dog costume.

games.name: Call of Clans
games.text: ——— is an online turn-based strategy card game set in a magical world. Build a versatile deck with minion and skill cards to challenge equally matched opponents in a world of swords and magic. Team up with others to conquer challenging co-op dungeons

games.name: World of Goo 2
games.text: Build bridges, grow towers, terraform terrain, and fuel flying machines in the stunning followup to the multi-award winning World of Goo. The world is beautiful, dangerous, and evolving.

games.name: Pay 2 Win: The World is Mine
games.text: The combo based incremental! Play crazy builds and pump those numbers! Find legendary items, cast wacky magical spells, and unlock hundreds of upgrades. Decide the fate of your studio and go INFINITE!

games.name: CAPTURED 2
games.text: You're trapped in an apartment with ever-changing rooms. Capture anomalies on camera, survive deadly entities and escape an endless nightmare.

games.name: KAIJU NO. 8 THE GAME
games.text: Crush colossal Kaiju with a game-changing blow! Experience exhilarating attacks with intuitive controls! Explore the world of Kaiju No. 8, recreated with stunning visuals!

games.name: Menherarium: Deadly Dice
games.text: "Let's play together… forever, okay?" ——— is a deck-building roguelite where you survive 7 days of blood-staked Chinchiro against a clingy menhera girl. Trapped and forced to gamble your blood daily in twisted dice games, use cheat items and overcome her changing rules to survive.

games.name: Clawed
games.text: Embark on a covert mission to the dinosaur theme park Prehistoria, where you must explore the park's grounds to scavenge resources, solve puzzles, and fight your way through diverse biomes, underground tunnels and deadly enclosures. But beware, you are not the apex predator here.

games.name: Third Person Basketball Court
games.text: Rise to the top of basketball with your aim and movement skills! “TPBC” is a third-person, online multiplayer basketball game that brings the familiar controls of FPS/TPS titles straight to the court. Take on skilled players from around the world and prove your mastery!

games.name: Settler's Domain
games.text: ——— is a strategy game about building a new settlement in unknown lands. Grow your population, explore the map, and contend with other settlements while keeping your settlers alive.

games.name: Infinite Rails
games.text: A railway-building adventure in an endless, procedurally generated world. Lay tracks, transport passengers and goods, mine resources, and buy unique locomotives. Play solo or with friends and create your ultimate railway network!

games.name: Guilty as Sock!
games.text: Enter a chaotic courtroom where socks play lawyers, prosecutors, and judges! Use absurd evidence, craft wild arguments, and deliver verdicts in this hilarious online party game. Improvise, strategize, and shout "Objection!"—because in ———!, chaos always wins!

games.name: Oaken Tower
games.text: ——— is a synergy-heavy PvP auto battler where your tower of items fights other players. Build deadly combos and scale exponentially. Every decision matters.

games.name: Yokai Art 2: Tales of the Nine-Tails
games.text: After defeating Fujin and Raijin, Hiro and his allies found peace at his grandfather’s house. One day, Sanbi sensed a distant summon. After tracing the energy, they discovered it came from her true form—the nine-tailed fox. Determined to help, Hiro and his friends set off on a new journey.

games.name: Tiny Auto Knights
games.text: A chill PvP auto battler where you build your team on a 3x3 grid. Recruit and upgrade unique heroes, strategically place them on the battlefield and find the best synergies.

games.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 26
games.text: Experience The World's Game like never before in ———. Go for glory in a 48-team international tournament mode, take on themed Manager Live Challenges, and step into Player Career with new international ICONs and Heroes.

games.name: ENDLESS Legend™ 2
games.text: Lead your people to victory on an ever-evolving world in this strategy game featuring asymmetric factions led by powerful heroes. Build your empire, wield political influence, and raise grand armies to wage war in a race to uncover dark secrets buried within the planet.

games.name: Exorcism Agency
games.text: Raise Your Own Ghost Girl+Deckbuilding+Zuma-Style Match-3!——— is an innovative roguelike that finds joy in thrills.Ghosts are back,the human world is like hell,and you,as a top-tier exorcist,will venture into ghost-infested zones,using all kinds of mystical techniques to capture ghosts

games.name: Overlooting
games.text: Adapt your strategy to a skill tree that changes every run, combine pieces of equipment to form powerful synergies and create a game-changing build capable of defeating the bosses that will try to stop you. In this Inventory Management Roguelike two games never feel the same!

games.name: Villages & Dungeons
games.text: A hardcore roguelite card game where deck-building strategies are at the core of everything! With a vast array of cards, random dungeons, a wealth of encounter events, and diverse enemies, it awaits your exploration and challenge.

games.name: Cards, the Universe and Everything
games.text: ——— is a unique trading card game with almost limitless possibilities: Dinosaurs, Norse gods, blue-footed boobies, Samurai, volcanoes, even the god particle. With the universe’s thingamabobs and endless strategies, are you ready for this gloriously bonkers game?

games.name: The House Always Wins
games.text: Build a top-tier business solo or in co-op (1–6 players). Start from scratch, keep the slot machines spinning and deal with chaotic events like vandals and alien invasions. Grow your fortune and show everyone why ———.

games.name: Forbidden Solitaire
games.text: ——— is a card-slashing horror game about unearthing the contents of a cryptic 1995 CD-ROM that should have never existed. From the creators of Ancient Enemy and Home Safety Hotline.

games.name: Supercat Survivors
games.text: Meow! This is a cat-themed Survivor-like game where you control an adorable Supercat! Battle monsters to level up, collect items, upgrade weapons, and experiment with strategic builds to fight off invading creatures threatening Meow Star.

games.name: Die For The Lich
games.text: Gather magical dice, adapt your gear and venture through a land haunted by folklore creatures.

games.name: Storebound
games.text: A 1-3 player co-op puzzle horror game set in an accursed megastore. Work together to decode the store's twisted logic, and find a way out before the lurking horrors doom you to shop forever.

games.name: CS Manager
games.text: ——— is a deep and tactical esports manager game. Make key decisions on rosters, strategies, and practice, and take on your opponents in real time matches. Rise to the top of the circuit in a simulation where every decision has impact

games.name: Terra Firma 2
games.text: Shape breathtaking worlds in ———, a vast simulation where your creations evolve through the forces of nature. Sculpt the land, then watch as weather, erosion, and life itself transform your world into a dynamic, living ecosystem- right down to every plant and creature.

games.name: Cribbish
games.text: Shuffle chaos. Brew victory. A roguelike deckbuilder where relics, potions, and risky hands rule the table. An arcane twist on Cribbage where potions and relics supercharge your cards and the deck always has an attitude. Choose your build wisely, the cards show no mercy!

games.name: Frozen Ship
games.text: ——— is an open-world survival game where you manage an entire city on wheels. Building, crafting, research, medicine, resource gathering, and hunting — you decide what your people will do and how your city will develop.

games.name: Dice A Million
games.text: Have you ever tried to roll 1,000,000 on a set of dice? No? Build the right bag of die, and you might just pull it off.

games.name: That's not my Neighbor
games.text: It's 1955, and for unknown reasons, doppelgangers are more common than usual. Therefore, the Department of Doppelganger Detection (D.D.D.) has taken action. You are the doorman of an apartment complex, and you must decide whether to let in those who claim to be your neighbors.

games.name: Shards of Order
games.text: A grim RPG with card-based combat where nothing stays dead. Lead a party of survivors through a world undone by shattered Laws. Restore them and reshape the rules of the game, but be ready to face the consequences.

games.name: Dice With Death
games.text: ——— is a Dicebuilding Roguelike – Unfortunately you have already died. Fortunately, Death is up for some friendly competition. Collect new dice and relics, create damage stacking combos, and even cheat Death himself to emerge victorious.

games.name: Exark
games.text: ——— is a run-based engine builder where you command a gigantic ark-ship. Construct buildings, hire crew with unique skills, and exploit powerful synergies to survive your voyage to the rim of the world.

games.name: Doodle Empires
games.text: ——— is an alternate history sandbox game all about drawing your own nations with your own histories and stories in a variety of maps. Watch your world take shape and evolve over time, and decide which nations will rise and which nations will fall.

games.name: Princess Maker: Children of Revelation
games.text: ——— is a raising simulation game that returns after nearly 18 years as part of the ——— package series, where you raise a young girl into adulthood. Become a parent in the game and help fulfill your daughter's dreams!

games.name: Dinoblade
games.text: ——— is an intense action RPG set in a prehistoric world forever changed by a cataclysmic event. Step into the role of a young Spinosaurus, wielding a colossal Great Sword. Confront rival dinosaurs, some armed with weapons of their own, all in a desperate fight to prevent a looming extinction.

games.name: Phantomancer
games.text: ——— is a deck-building roguelike where you summon phantoms to fight. Defeat the monsters threatening humanity and uncover the story of two sisters.

games.name: Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S+
games.text: Solve over a 1000 new puzzles while chilling to a great soundtrack and receive costumes, furniture and more with which to customize your Piapro Characters' world like never before!

games.name: Mecharashi
games.text: ——— is a mecha-themed tactical turn-based game. The game adopts a unique part-destruction combat system, where you can assemble mechas however you want, equip a wide selection of weapons, and choose your favorite pilots to engage in battle.

games.name: Frog Jump
games.text: 🐸👑 Jump, climb, push others with your tongue, and reach the top to win the princess’s kiss! 🏰 (Up to 8 Players)

games.name: Touhou Rinrinki ~ Crafts of the Lucky Beast
games.text: Touhou Rinrinki ~ Crafts of the Luck Beast is a Touhou Doujin Card-Strategy Game. Using cards across different seasons, join forces with duelists of unique abilities, face various opponents from all over Gensoukyo, and uncover the truth behind the Card Duel Incident!

games.name: Soul's Remnant
games.text: ——— is a 2D platformer MMORPG focused on social gameplay and exploration! Customize your character, and conquer dungeons and bosses in this mysterious world. Play with friends or make new ones - just watch out when night falls!

games.name: Supercar Collection Simulator
games.text: Start your own diecast store! Unbox surprise car packs, expand your collection, oin exciting races with customers on the tracks, and play online trading games. A world full of speed and excitement is waiting for you in your store!

games.name: Gnaughty Gnomes
games.text: Crush your friends in combat by embodying these adorable yet ———! Throw everything you find along the way, choose cards to upgrade your build, change the rules of the game... whatever it takes to win.

games.name: SurfsUp
games.text: ——— is a free-to-play, standalone recreation of Counter-Strike Surf where precision movement and air-surfing are the keys to setting a new personal best or even breaking a world record. Surf, bhop, and climb across 125+ maps, all for free, with unique leaderboards for every way to play.

games.name: Pure Pool Pro
games.text: This is cue sports: redefined. Master 8-Ball, 9-Ball and more in solo, local or online with crossplay. Tackle a huge pool career mode, with 8K visuals, immersive venues, lifelike physics, precise controls and deep customisation, delivering the definitive pool sim experience.

games.name: Holder of Place
games.text: ——— is a Roguelike Auto-Battler Card game. Recruit different follower cards, arrange them, watch them fight ever-stronger enemies. Along the way, unfold a dark science-fantasy tale of a ruined kingdom, meet strange characters, and visit exotic locations.

games.name: Bookshop Simulator
games.text: Open your own bookshop! Order books, stock your shelves, and earn revenue. Use your profits to decorate, expand, and hire staff. Collect rare books that give powerful abilities. Adopt a cat to keep you and your customers company along the way!

games.name: Wall World 2
games.text: The adventure in the mysterious world of the Wall continues! Pilot your robospider into its depths, uncover lost artifacts and technologies, upgrade your exosuit and spider, and battle the horrors lurking in the dark. Unravel the mysteries buried in the depths of the Wall!

games.name: AFL 26
games.text: Get ready for the future of footy with ———. Feel every hit, hear every roar, and live every moment with unmatched authenticity and intensity.

games.name: Cricket 26 - The Official Game of the Ashes
games.text: Featuring the all-new Management Career, a bigger and better Pro Team, in-depth Ashes mode, and expanded control on and off the field from enhanced gameplay and in-depth strategies - ——— is The Ultimate Showdown.

games.name: Baki Hanma: Blood Arena
games.text: Step into the shoes of ——— in this action-packed 2D anime game. With explosive special moves and original music, fight your way to become the god of combat in the ultimate test of strength.

games.name: Rainbow Legends
games.text: A territory-control roguelike deck builder where the side with more tiles at round’s end deals damage. Seize ground, place structures, shield your core, and unlock builds with card shapes, factions, and relics

games.name: We, Junk Artists
games.text: A "collage-and-guess" multiplayer game for up to 6 players. Enjoy collaging ordinary items into outside-the-box "masterpieces," guess each other's creations, and unleash your wild imagination around the campfire. Here, everyone is an artist!

games.name: BroomSweeper
games.text: Minesweeper gone Rogue(like). Stock your cart with 150+ powerful items while avoiding impish Dust Bunnies. Dare yourself to climb all 16 floors of the ominous Tentateq Tower—but beware, 7 logic-twisting Hazardous Materials stand between you and janitorial glory. Can you keep your job until morning?

games.name: Meta Card Backpack Legend
games.text: The third installment of the MetaCard series, ———, is a backpack management Roguelike card game! Before Battle: Manage your artifact backpack to build and synergize your playstyle. During Battle: Drag and drop cards to unleash skills on key enemies at the right moment.

games.name: Road to Empress I
games.text: You've never played a game like this before. ——— is a cinematic palace adventure where your choices decide everyone's fate. Tackle multiple story branches and a high mortality rate with charm, wisdom and courage? First...survive.

games.name: GeoGuessr Steam Edition
games.text: Explore the world with ———! Compete against others, climb divisions, and prove your geography skills. Travel to stunning locations, analyze clues, and make your best guess. Quickplay Duels is unlimited Free-to-play.

games.name: There Are No Orcs
games.text: An RTS-Roguelike hybrid with auto-battling troops. Master building placement, swarm your enemies, and smash their defenses with unit-commander combos!

games.name: Apokerlypse
games.text: A card-strategy roguelike inspired by a variety of poker games. You play as a highly skilled card shark in the Tavern at the End of the World, combining all kinds of demon chips to rewrite the rules of play, compete with players from across the globe, and ultimately rise to the top.

games.name: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales
games.text: A brand-new action RPG from the creators of OCTOPATH TRAVELER and BRAVELY DEFAULT – ——— combines stunning HD-2D visuals and exciting action-adventure gameplay for the first time!

games.name: Cast n Chill
games.text: ——— is a relaxing fishing game where you explore serene lakes, rivers, and oceans. Catch rare fish, upgrade your gear and reel in legendary catches - all with your loyal companion by your side.

games.name: ReCharge RC: High Voltage
games.text: ——— is the long awaited sequel to ———, an RC racing title loved by millions! Customize your vehicle, Create your very own race tracks, Share them online and race your friends on multiplayer and global online leaderboards! Created by an RC enthusiast, for RC enthusiasts!

games.name: LES MILLS XR BODYCOMBAT
games.text: Workout at home with an award-winning fitness app by Odders Lab and Les Mills! Discover the ultimate BODYCOMBAT experience from the world's leading fitness company in your headset, with an extensive workout portfolio, top-quality coaching, innovative mechanics and different intensities.

games.name: Tailor Simulator
games.text: Build your workshop and turn it into a fashion business. Interact with your customers and design unique collections to sell in your store. Upgrade your workshop until you rule the fashion industry.

games.name: Youtubers Life 3
games.text: Live the experience of becoming the best content creator of the moment. Start from scratch, create epic VODs, share your best moments on Instalife, build your dream house, and overcome challenges as you forge your path to fame. Welcome to the Youtuber life!

games.name: Bearly Brave
games.text: ——— is a 2D roguelike deck-building game set in a deceptively charming toy shop, where the cutest teddy bears come to life each night to fight in a no-holds-barred tournament that determines their placement on the shelves, and thus their likeness to be taken to their forever home.

games.name: Monster Girls and the Mysterious Adventure Remastered Edition
games.text: Turn monster girls into your "Friends" and embark on an adventure together! This is a rogue-like game inspired by "Mystery Dungeon," where the terrain changes every time you challenge it.

games.name: The Zone - FPV Drone Simulator
games.text: Learn new tricks, improve your freestyle flow, get inspiration by spectating other pilots, or learn to fly in the first place. The drone setup and physics are already dialed in by Pro pilots, so no need to mess with complicated settings.

games.name: lovebyte.exe
games.text: A chat dating sim game inspired by Mystic Messenger, VTuber communities, and internet spam

games.name: BLOODLETTER
games.text: A grim medieval deckbuilder where you use your dubious healing methods to protect bizarre villagers from the corrupting influence of ancient evils.

games.name: Lucid Blocks
games.text: Explore, build, and survive in a cryptic expanse oozing with dreamlike oddities and esoteric critters.

games.name: Slot or Not
games.text: ——— is a turn-based slot machine battling adventure. Fight evil fruits alongside your battle buddy slot machine to save your village. Spin your destiny and grab the precious loot in a fast-paced, colorful adventure.

games.name: Bonehold
games.text: Dungeon Crawler with elements of rogue-like and ARPG games. Kill hordes of enemies, duel mighty bosses, and acquire legendary loot!

games.name: Better Mart Simulator
games.text: EARLY ACCESS - Solo or with up to 6 players, build, manage, and grow your supermarket. Stock your shelves, manage inventory, deliveries, staff, and machines. Customize your store and grow it from a small grocery shop into a full-fledged superstore.

games.name: Piano Glow
games.text: Piano in online multiplayer lobbies, with leaderboards, gamified training modes (ear, sheet, rhythm and falling notes). Play any song using either a QWERTY computer/laptop keyboard or a piano.

games.name: Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection
games.text: The Mega Man Star Force series, which expanded into an anime, is back in the ———! This collection includes seven games and additional features like a gallery of illustrations and music! Online play is also supported!

games.name: Cropdeck
games.text: Plant, grow, and harvest in this farming roguelite deckbuilder. Craft a powerful deck of plants and combine quirky scarecrows with passive effects for wild synergies. Pay taxes. Strategic, satisfying, and delightfully wholesome.

games.name: Car Service Together
games.text: ——— is a 1-4 co-op & single player simulation game where you and/or with your friends start from scratch and build your way up. Work together to successfully run your own service center. Team up, manage your business, and create the ultimate car service !

games.name: 4Wheel Challenge
games.text: Play solo or with friends in chaotic modes, master the physics… or just blow everyone up!

games.name: Kin and Quarry
games.text: An incremental mining adventure where you must dig into the earth to recover essence for your sacred Evertree. Mine, drill, and blast your way to the deepest depths, discovering rare artifacts and recruiting more kin to your cause along the way. Dig. Upgrade. Repeat.

games.name: Haydee 3
games.text: Haydee III is a hardcore metroidvania with third-person shooter mechanics, platforming, puzzles, a sexy heroine and cake!

games.name: Gambonanza
games.text: ——— is a tactical roguelike that sets chess pieces on a tiny board. Forget traditional chess and embrace the chaos of breaking the balance! Spend your money on rule-bending upgrades, board tiles and pieces. Experiment with illegal combinations and face off against iconic bosses!

games.name: Replicat
games.text: A roguelike memory deckbuilder where you bend the rules of card matching with wild combos, strategy-defining items and cards featuring some personality-packed cats.

games.name: Roach Post
games.text: Restore an abandoned post office by order of the Royal Postal Academy! Welcome customers, send packages, hire cute little roach-workers and pass Inspectors’ checks in an incredibly addictive roguelite puzzle ———!

games.name: Allumeria
games.text: A classic voxel sandbox combined with in-depth progression through exploration, dungeon crawling and boss battles. Spend every minute discovering new weapons, abilities, resources, enemies, structures, mechanics and tools. With a strong focus on discovery, variety and creativity, the world is yours.

games.name: Merge Maestro
games.text: Combine 100's of unique emoji based tokens in this roguelike merge-builder! Find ever more creative combinations of Tokens and Powers to fuse unique strategies and beat this ever more challenging twist on rogue-likes, puzzlers and arcadey games!

games.name: Boeckham's Football Manager
games.text: An old-school football manager in the style of the management games of the 90s. Lead your team through the seasons, shaped by dynamic story events. Develop your club and yourself to gain reputation and conquer your league and the world.

games.name: Down with the Ship
games.text: Strategic auto battler where you design a heavily-armed spaceship. Draft 200+ items, outfit your hull, and unleash it in async PvP. Blend captains and factions for absurd combos and galactic domination. Roll, buy, place, pray.

games.name: Tabletop Game Shop Simulator
games.text: Run your own tabletop game shop! Stock shelves, glue & paint minis, battle customers on game night, and grow your store into the ultimate nerd paradise.

games.name: Wall Street Raider
games.text: ——— offers the deepest stock market simulations in gaming history. Control publicly traded corporations, futures, options, and even crypto. Whether you want to make billions in equities, short-sell overvalued stocks, or hedge risk using derivatives, the market is yours to conquer!

games.name: Horripilant
games.text: KILL YOUR GOD. BECOME WORTHY. ——— is a chilling idle incremental dungeon crawl through the horrors of a forgotten underworld.

games.name: Everything is Crab: The Animal Evolution Roguelite
games.text: The Animal Evolution Roguelite. Hunt, Flee, Scavenge and Thrive in a living ecosystem. Choose from 125+ Evolutions and Specialisations for unique creature combinations in every run. Adapt to survive the natural curve in order to beat carcinisation... or get Darwin'd trying!

games.name: RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business
games.text: Unfinished Business is a new standalone adventure of ———: Rogue City. OmniTower is their fortress, violence their language. Face elite mercenaries all the way to the top of the tower and enforce the law amidst the chaos!

games.name: Tomb of the Bloodletter
games.text: ——— is a strategic word roguelike where your keyboard becomes your arsenal. Use your wit to unleash deadly words through tactical combinations of your letters to defeat the denizens of this dingy tomb and claim the Bloodletter for yourself...

games.name: Pirate's Gambit
games.text: ——— takes you on an unpredictable voyage, blending deck-building with Yacht Dice mechanics. Roll the dice in the dimly lit cabin, where fate shifts with every turn. Are you closing in on treasure or something far more sinister?

games.name: Wrap House Simulator🌯
games.text: Welcome to ———! Run your own wrap shop, chop, grill, and serve in this cooking adventure. Customize your shop, master the grill, and survive the rush solo or co-op with up to 6 players. Keep up with orders, satisfy customers, and build your dream restaurant!

games.name: STICKER/BALL
games.text: ——— is a pool game roguelike from the future. Fire balls. Hit dice. Earn points. Add stickers. Trigger crazy combos. Enjoy the chaos, it’s on purpose.

games.name: Tabulo
