games.text: Position your pieces carefully to max out your score in this Balatro-inspired chess roguelike. Enhance your pieces, purchase powers, and win bonuses from optional challenges, but be careful - your board only has so much room.

games.name: Metal Garden
games.text: Travel through an overgrown megastructure, and discover what lies beyond it. ——— is a short, atmospheric singleplayer FPS game.

games.name: Rune Dice
games.text: Tactical deckbuilding in bite-sized sessions. Launch dice to create magical chain reactions. Choose from distinct hero classes with unique abilities. Build synergies between dice, relics, and runes to defeat challenging bosses.

games.name: Boat Together
games.text: Hop on kayaks and boats for a fun adventure with up to 8 friends! Work together to paddle through cool waters, overcome obstacles and bosses, and reach new islands. If the legend is true, a hidden treasure awaits on the final island. Can you make it without sinking?

games.name: Rentlord
games.text: ——— is a combo-making roguelike real estate game where you buy properties, manage your income, and overcome unique weekly challenges. Strategic property upgrades and plugins with high combo potential, each run offers new opportunities to maximize rent, while avoiding taxes!

games.name: Occlude
games.text: ——— is a ritual disguised as Solitaire; a cosmic-horror card game where the rules are obscured and reality is at stake. Play through cryptic challenges to reveal forbidden lore in this singleplayer narrative puzzle game for the terminally curious. Don’t worry; you can always start over.

games.name: FeeBay Simulator
games.text: Flip fake trading cards for real profit in ———, a comedic marketplace tycoon game. Snipe underpriced cards from clueless and scammy sellers, grade your best pulls, open mystery lots, rip packs and run your own storefront to build a reselling empire.

games.name: DOG WITCH
games.text: ——— is a roguelike deckbuilder where your spells are fueled by enchanted dice. Combine over 150 unique items to forge ever-evolving strategies, perfect synergy combos, summon minions, and tackle an endless range of foes so bizarre, they’ll leave your tail wagging in disbelief!

games.name: Football Manager 26
games.text: Step into the dugout and experience the future of football management.

games.name: Retro Rewind - Video Store Simulator
games.text: Manage your very own video store in the early 90s! Rent, sell, decorate and expand your business from the ground up and relive the golden ages of video rentals!

games.name: Holey
games.text: A co-op horror game where you are part of a crew sheltering in a collapsed tunnel, scavenging loot across maps filled with deadly creatures born from a biological war. Feed the creature, convert its waste into fuel, and reach the radio tower

games.name: VMX
games.text: Ride BMX, Scooters and MTB in a multiplayer VR skatepark while doing gesture-based tricks. Take on challenges in carefully crafted skateparks and dirt tracks, customize your bike with a realistic spray-painting system, and express your style through a variety of outfits.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition
games.text: ——— is the ultimate Dawn of War experience, featuring the original Dawn of War and all its expansions, along with enhanced visuals, an improved camera, and 64-bit platform support.

games.name: Backseat Drivers
games.text: A punishing 2-4 player driving test of your relationships. Gramma can't see and you can't drive. Together, you'll navigate the world's worst detour in an ancient car that handles even worse than it looks.

games.name: Leafy Corner
games.text: Run a cute little plant shop in this cozy and relaxing game. Grow, sell, and care for a variety of real-life plants, help customers find their dream plants, complete orders, and customize your cozy shop just the way you like!

games.name: Pass the Fear
games.text: ——— is a roguelite bullet-hell shooter. A catastrophic Witch’s Disaster strikes without warning, and chaotic magic forms the ancient Wall of Storms. Its corruption spreads relentlessly across the island. As a demon hunter trapped within, you must find a way to escape before dawn breaks.

games.name: Detective Sherlock: Shadow Stalker
games.text: Every character remembers, watches, tests, and may deceive you like a living person. They have emotions, voices, expressions, and buried secrets. Break them with words or evidence — or realize too late that you were only a pawn in their game. A detective game built around truly lifelike NPCs.

games.name: Magical Princess
games.text: Raise your daughter while she attends a magical academy. Choose which classes she attends, jobs she does, training she undergoes, and more in a character raising sim packed full of story and over 50 endings to reach. How she grows up to be the world's cutest princess depends on you!

games.name: Agefield High: Rock the School
games.text: Relive your High School days in the town of Agefield. It’s the early 2000s, and graduation is on the horizon. REBEL with your friends, win over your dream girl and ROCK the school! A coming-of-age adventure about friendship, love, and rebellion inspired by the raunchy teen comedies of the era.

games.name: Where Winds Meet
games.text: Step into an open-world action-adventure RPG set in ancient China. Uncover the secrets of your own identity as you rise from a humble village wanderer to the sword master of the imperial capital. Learn martial arts and build your reputation as a hero or a bringer of chaos in this free wuxia world.

games.name: Card Shop Simulator Multiplayer
games.text: Open a card shop with your friends, you can cooperate in a shop or compete with individual shops on the same street! Collect nice cards with different elements and play card dual with your friends to win their cards from their collection!

games.name: The Ember Guardian
games.text: Defend the embers of hope in this roguelike strategy game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Recruit and command workers to gather resources, build your camp and set up your defenses during the day. When night falls, fend off waves of deadly creatures with powerful, upgradable weapons.

games.name: Paddle Paddle Paddle
games.text: Paddle through pain. Solo or co-op. One paddle each. Lava everywhere. You’ll fall. You’ll scream. You might cry. Good luck and embrace the salt.

games.name: Summoner's Gambit
games.text: ——— is an innovative duel game that blends strategy roguelike with auto-battler positioning. As a powerful summoner, you'll forge a dominant formation and clash against other players on the ever-shifting battlefield, where wit and luck collide.

games.name: CARIMARA: Beneath the forlorn limbs
games.text: A mute little thing with borrowed magic. A house that murmurs back. Ask wrong, and you might wake something that remembers your name.

games.name: Toy Smash Kaboom!
games.text: Toy mayhem unleashed! Arrange, combine, and craft the wildest toy army inside your desk, then crash into chaotic cartoon brawls across the tabletop!

games.name: Climb The Backrooms
games.text: Ascend through the twisted levels of the Backrooms using physics-based object manipulation to overcome obstacles, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover unsettling secrets. Play solo or team up in online co-op with up to 4 players as you climb higher, think smarter, and survive the unknown.

games.name: Fate War
games.text: 2025's latest epic strategy simulation game! Lead your Tribe in a vast world with dynamic seasons. Survive using your wit and uncover the secrets of a lost god.

games.name: Virtual Skate
games.text: Experience next level board control, skate with friends, and film insane tricks in the most immersive skateboarding game ever made.

games.name: From The Top
games.text: Fusing Battling tops and Roguelike Deckbuilding together to create an unlimited source of battling tops fun! Collect new tops, combine them together, pair 'em up with synergistic relic and go on a short adventure, ———!

games.name: Pro Basketball Manager 2026
games.text: Lead your club to greatness in ———! The Basketball Champions League arrives with 53 licensed teams, putting you in charge of every decision as you aim to dominate both domestic and continental basketball.

games.name: Galactic Vault
games.text: Build devastating weapons on the fly in this blend of movement shooter and roguelike action. Sprint, slide, and dash to plunder high-tech vaults. Stack gun upgrades, abilities, and grenades for wild synergies as you survive a spreading infestation.

games.name: Word Play
games.text: Spell words, pick perks, score points, and survive until the end. Every round is different. How far can you make it?

games.name: Bogos Binted?
games.text: Welcome to a sinful night with the galaxy’s wackiest aliens. Play twisted tabletop games with up to 4 players, devise brilliant strategies, bluff your way to victory, and try not to lose your head - literally.

games.name: Returns Outlet Simulator
games.text: ——— is a relaxed first-person simulation where every aspect of operating your own shop springs to life.

games.name: DIVE or DIE - Children of Rain
games.text: Every descent is a deadly gamble. ——— in the cursed abyss, face Eldritch horrors to uncover the mystery of the black rain. Scavenge and upgrade, recruit and sacrifice. Save your camp... The Flood is coming.

games.name: NUTMEG! A Nostalgic Deckbuilding Football Manager
games.text: NUTMEG! is a nostalgic football manager game with a deckbuilding twist, set in the '80s and '90s. Relive the days when the tackles were as hard as the mullets were long and football was about football.

games.name: Blackjack 21: Blackjackist
games.text: Blackjack is an exciting game that any player is sure to enjoy. Place your bet, get more points than the dealer and win chips. Feel the risk as you dive into the casino atmosphere and hit the big time!

games.name: TerraTech Legion
games.text: ———, a chaotic Bullet Heaven Builder. Build the ultimate battle vehicle block by block and survive waves of robotic foes, ramming them at speed and shooting infinite projectiles.

games.name: Funi Raccoon Game
games.text: Explore a series of whimsical, interconnected worlds to steal everything not nailed down. Make a garbage bin a garbage home :)

games.name: e-Racer
games.text: Feel the rush in ———! A stylish GT arcade racer with dynamic tracks, weather challenges, and intense competition. Dominate championships, unlock upgrades, and race through unique locales. Master tight courses, leave rivals in the dust, and rise to the top!

games.name: Skating Rink Story
games.text: Make your wildest ice dreams come true with this skating rink management game.

games.name: Casino Roulette: Roulettist
games.text: Test your luck! Play ——— with stunning, realistic 3D graphics! Feel the risk as you dive into the casino atmosphere and hit the big time!

games.name: Vegas Craps by Pokerist
games.text: Play real casino craps in 3D and enjoy realistic physics and multiplayer mode. Feel the thrill of competition, immerse yourself in the casino atmosphere and try your luck!

games.name: Meltopia
games.text: A minimalist game where you melt snow with a heat cannon to explore a mysterious frozen world. Uncover glacial secrets, collect valuable resources and ancient artifacts — and ultimately find and assemble the remains of an ancient Mammoth.

games.name: Horsey Game
games.text: Collect Horses. Breed Horses. Race Horses. Genetically Modify Horses. Create a Horse paradise or just get rich!

games.name: StarSavior
games.text: Guide your star-kissed Saviors.

games.name: Organized Inside
games.text: A slow-paced life simulation and tidying up game about a cat, passion, transformation and growth. Categorizing cluttered everyday household items, navigating ever-changing life experiences, while gradually uncovering the joys and meaning of life through methodical space organization.

games.name: Yes, My Queen
games.text: The chess roguelite. Play game-changing cards, bend the rules, save your Queen, and escape from the dungeon.

games.name: Shelves and Sorcery: Tidy Up the Enchanted Shop
games.text: Restore order to three ransacked fantasy shops! Organize thousands of items, master helpful sorceries and enchantments, relax at your own pace, race the global leaderboards, and unlock new ways to play. Every item has a shelf. Can you find them all?

games.name: Hypermarket Simulator
games.text: Build any retail store you can imagine — from grocery stores to furniture, electronics, and garden centers. Customize your layout with 258+ fixtures, stock 573 unique products, manage up to 36 employees, and grow your retail empire.

games.name: Car Dealership Simulator 2
games.text: Take charge of the car trade with ———! Buy, modify, and grow your dealership with strategic sales. Every opportunity will take you closer to the top of the automotive market!

games.name: My Card Is Better Than Your Card!
games.text: Become the coolest kid of the playground in this playful roguelike deckbuilder. Craft every card yourself with adorable stickers and wow your rivals in tug-of-war card battles full of wonder!

games.name: Flock Around
games.text: ——— is a multiplayer bird watching game. Explore a nature sanctuary with friends, snap pictures of birds, and fill out the guide book!

games.name: Gamblers Table
games.text: ——— is an incremental game where you toss coins to earn money. Buy bigger and better coins, unlock upgrades and hire little helpers to automate the process and take care of all the busy flipping work for you. Simple. Satisfying. Strangely compelling...

games.name: Pronoun Palace
games.text: ——— is a word-spelling roguelike set in a dystopian future where the government has taken your pronouns. Use spells to manipulate letter tiles, catch fish, and abuse amphetamines to defeat the Party and get your pronouns back!

games.name: Pimbolas
games.text: Chaotic foosball matches for up to 4 players! Use crazy power-ups, battle through unique arenas and opponents, and turn every friendly match into a chaotic showdown with friends.

games.name: Pro Jank Footy
games.text: ——— is an over-the-top arcade comedy-sports game. Score goals to unleash game-changing power-ups, build a deck of absurd abilities, and tackle a season where no two matches are ever the same—solo or with your mates.

games.name: Deified
games.text: Forge your strategy around powerful relics in this turn-based tactical roguelite. Choose your slots, manage their constraints, and face formidable bosses.

games.name: Letter Lost
games.text: You’re the sole employee at the Kharnym Isle post office, stamping, sorting, and delivering mail. But the job hides secrets, and the office itself holds mysteries you must uncover. This will be the only job you’ll ever need to work… unless you can escape.

games.name: Barro F25
games.text: ——— is pure speed! The fastest version ever created promises to push you to the limit with extraordinary performance and adrenaline at its peak. Get ready to dominate the tracks! 🏁

games.name: Slots & Daggers
games.text: A retro mini-roguelike inside a slot machine. Steady your blade - and spin!

games.name: KAZ
games.text: Dopamine-fueled minimalist grid-based game that pushes the boundaries of psychedelic visuals and fast reaction time. ——— is an action roguelike arcade game where choice of items, buffs, and maluses allows you to unlock cool visuals and themes while showing everybody your skill on the leaderboards

games.name: Islantiles
games.text: ——— is a cozy but compulsive roguelike deckbuilder. Unlock powerful technology cards, shape your deck to craft game-breaking combos, and grow your settlements to glory in this ultra-satisfying roguelike!

games.name: Samson
games.text: ——— returns to Tyndalston, a city that shaped him hard, where every fight is close and every escape is earned. He owes dangerous people more than he can pay, and they’re using his sister to force his hand. The clock is ticking. The only way out is through anyone who stands in his way.

games.name: Zynga Poker ™ – Texas Holdem
games.text: Join one of the world's most popular free-to-play poker games! Featuring more tables, tournaments, jackpots, mini-games and players than ever! Whether you enjoy casual Texas Hold'em, Omaha or competitive tournaments, ——— is your go-to for exciting, authentic gameplay.

games.name: RogueDiceR
games.text: ——— is a Roguelite Dice-builder. Buy randomly generated dice and modify their values. Attach stickers to grant special effects or strengthen your dice deck with powerful artifacts. Fight your way through randomly generated dungeons filled with monsters, events and bosses.

games.name: Servant of the Lake
games.text: Begin your new job as a servant at the mysterious Vanderboom estate. Solve puzzles, serve the family and uncover their dark alchemical secrets in ———, a new upcoming single-player point-and-click adventure in the Rusty Lake series.

games.name: Kotama and Academy Citadel
games.text: In the Academy Citadel, strength reigns supreme: only the most powerful survive and thrive. Fight your way through the high-tech Academy in your quest to get the highest of honors for a student, and uncover secrets that can save it in its direst crisis in this 2.5D side-scrolling Metroidvania.

games.name: Worlds Upon The Wind
games.text: Resettle the shards of a shattered world in this peaceful roguelite deckbuilder, covering centuries of classical Japanese art. Nurture communities, befriend animal spirits, and shape a new civilization through choices that echo across generations.

games.name: The Incident at Galley House
games.text: In 1936, something terrible happened at Galley House. Decades later, with a strange contraption that reveals echoes of the past, you must uncover the truth behind this grisly mystery.

games.name: Magecraft: Spellbuilding
games.text: Craft spell cards, collect new effects, and build the perfect deck as you fight through rounds of turn-based combat. Survive randomly-generated dungeon layouts by countering enemy attacks with your own spells, and make the most of the powers and scrolls you pick up along the way.

games.name: Space Warlord Baby Trading Simulator
games.text: Buy low, sell high, and short an entire universe of babies in this arcade stock market sim set in the world of Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator.

games.name: Truck-kun is Supporting Me from Another World?!
games.text: Your truck is magic and you now owe a soul debt to the buff isekai elf girl living in your head. Run over pedestrians as Truck-kun in a chaotic OVA-sized campaign, make deliveries, and defeat the Skeleton King across two worlds in this anime driving game with heart!

games.name: GONE Fishing
games.text: ——— is a 1-8 player survival horror game where you and your friends must work together to stay alive, by fishing. The only way to survive is to keep feeding the lake’s insatiable hunger before it feeds on you. Can you satisfy the hunger... or will you become the next offering?

games.name: Devil Spire Falls
games.text: The open-world action-RPG, where you can do anything, of your dreams… as if it came out 30 years ago!

games.name: Blood Vial
games.text: ——— is a retro-inspired micro-FPS with a leaking health bar. Swim through the spilled blood of your fallen enemies to keep your vial full. Grow increasingly powerful with new upgrades and weapons. Navigate an ever-shifting labyrinth of crypts, catacombs and cathedrals.

games.name: FrostBound
games.text: ——— is a roguelike deck-building tower defense set in an endless winter. Build your base, master 500+ cards, and withstand relentless waves to end the eternal frost.

games.name: Graphic Tower Defense
games.text: This is a minimalist-style tower defense game that is easy-going and relaxing, with a moderate level of difficulty. Build your tower formations to fend off enemies. It also supports online multiplayer, allowing you to team up and experience an unprecedented level of tower defense fun!

games.name: Sporting Goods Shop
games.text: Run your ———. Sign contracts with leading brands, order products, hire workers, expand your store, and run little contests to entertain your customers. Play with friends or go solo, and enjoy the growth of your shop.

games.name: Plants vs. Zombies™: Replanted
games.text: The classic ——— returns in glorious HD! The original battle between Plants and Zombies is back — bigger, brighter, and crazier than ever before! Experience the game that started it all, now remastered with stunning HD graphics and packed with new secrets and content to uncover.

games.name: Runeveil
games.text: Sequencer Roguelike. Enter the Arena as an elemental wizard, craft powerful rune chains, and break the game with wild artifact synergies. Beat all trials, defeat the Sin Kings, and ascend to godhood. Magic is chaos, order is power!

games.name: Gold and Graves
games.text: ——— is a roguelike extraction game where you bribe enemies to recruit them as allies, escape the dungeon, and bring back cards, relics, and mercenaries to your village to accumulate resources. Strengthen your deck and forces with the resources you gather and challenge deeper dungeons.

games.name: Train Sim World® 6
games.text: Embark on your next journey and discover the joy of train simulation. Be ready for anything as you master formidable trains across 3 new routes. Unlock new skills and expand your hobby - Expect the Unexpected in ———!

games.name: Amanda the Adventurer 3
games.text: In the thrilling conclusion of the Amanda the Adventurer trilogy, follow Riley as they uncover the ultimate secrets behind Amanda, Hameln, and mysteries that have plagued Kensdale for decades.

games.name: Drift Legends 2
games.text: Arcade drifting with 50+ dream cars, from JDM icons to American Muscle. Master the art of the drift in a huge career, then dominate the competition in cross-platform online battles. Your legend begins now—no high-end PC required.

games.name: The Deadseat
games.text: A horror game where you play a hand-held console in the backseat during a long drive home.

games.name: Heroes Against Time
games.text: ——— is the ally-drafting game where you build a team and power up in a dangerous enchanted forest. Navigate events, fight enemies and dig through ruins while trying to avoid the creeping magical fog… Will your team endure… or be lost to the mist?

games.name: Alchemy Factory
games.text: Craft your workshop as an alchemist!‌ Harness arcane devices to automate crafting. Sell alchemical goods, fulfill commissions, and rise to become a renowned alchemy magnate. ‌Multiplayer Supported!‌ Invite master designers to (ahem) contribute their expertise—let them optimize your production lines!

games.name: Noir Lords
games.text: A fast-paced single-player card battler with tactical choices, quick rounds, and upgradeable cards. Build your deck and outsmart the city’s crime lords.

games.name: Farever
games.text: Forge your legend in a forgotten realm! ——— is an online multiplayer action RPG set in a vast fantasy open world. Alone or with friends, embark on an epic journey together! Explore wild lands and dangerous dungeons, craft powerful gear, and carve your path through dynamic combat and platforming.

games.name: Prison Escape Simulator: Dig Out
games.text: Too long in this prison, time to get out of here. Pull the carpet and start digging with a teaspoon. Watch out for the guard, sell him the junk you find. Trade toilet paper with the prisoners. Get better items and improve your stats. Expand the tunnel, use glow sticks and dynamite. Will you escape?

games.name: Vegas Casino & Slots: Slottist
games.text: Discover the world's best Casino Slots Games! Play slots with unique game mechanics, explore amazing mini-games and master your casino skills!

games.name: Baccarat Online: Baccarist
games.text: Favored by the highest of high rollers, baccarat is one of the world's oldest and most popular card games. The aim of the game is to guess who will hit the highest hand value, which in this game is 9. Feel the risk as you dive into the casino atmosphere and hit the big time!

games.name: TBH: Task Bar Hero
games.text: The ultimate tiny idle RPG! Adorable pixel heroes are waiting to join your adventure — from your taskbar. Fight off the boredom of work and daily life with diverse classes, skills, items, and builds!

games.name: The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin
games.text: is an open-world anime RPG set in the universe of [———]. Step into the role of Prince Tristan of Liones and explore an open-world Britannia, as you embark on a journey to restore order to a world thrown into chaos by the collision of time and space.

games.name: Factory Planner
games.text: ——— is a card-based simulation/strategy game that lets you build a factory using cards. The main goal of the game is to make combinations with different cards so that each player can build different factories and feel the sandbox experience to the fullest.

games.name: Nioh 3
games.text: In the third game in the dark samurai action RPG series Nioh, you will need to use both Samurai and Ninja combat styles in your battles against formidable yokai as you explore a thrilling open field.

games.name: Observe
games.text: A world that plays itself. Watch nations battle for domination across a 3,400-region map, build infinite alternate histories, meddle with god-like powers, or program your own AI countries and climb the global ranked ladder.

games.name: Blue Protocol: Star Resonance
games.text: ——— expands the ——— universe with a vibrant MMORPG experience. Create your own hero, team up for strategic raids, or simply relax and have fun with friends fishing, crafting, and endless exploration. Adventure awaits!

games.name: Boba Cafe Simulator
games.text: You’re reborn—back at the beginning of your startup journey. In your last life, poor management led to your shop being crushed by competitors. This time, the sweet scent of condensed milk runs through your veins, and you’re set on one goal: turn “Sugarville” into the top name in the industry.

games.name: Magical Runes
games.text: Three ruthless kings have declared war on your lands!

games.name: s.p.l.i.t
games.text: A short psychological horror game, where you attempt to gain root access into an unethical superstructure.

games.name: Cards and Castles Ultimate
games.text: Collectible cards meets tactical strategy! Collect cards, build decks, and challenge players head to head on a Tactical Game Board. Play as Vikings, Pirates, Ninjas and more!

games.name: Moldwasher
games.text: Clean moldy messes as a brave food hero! Equip your high-pressure spray, choose the right nozzle, and clear away sticky messes in this cozy, arcade-style fridge-cleaning adventure.

games.name: Art of Solitaire
games.text: Level up your chill time with ———. Forget boring card decks – we’re teaming up with real indie artists to design every card, bringing you gorgeous, original artwork. Build your ultimate card collection as you flick through Patience, Pyramid, and Spider. De-stress with a good FLICK!

games.name: Frostrain 2
games.text: Become the last conductor and rule over the final train society in a frozen world. Gather, expand, and forge your train while building powerful synergies with mighty artifacts. Your position—and the safety of your passengers—now rests in your hands.

games.name: A Game About Feeding A Black Hole
games.text: A short incremental game about feeding a Black Hole matter by destroying Asteroids, Planets, and Stars.

games.name: How to Make an Atomic Bomb in Your Garden
games.text: An absurd backyard bomb-building simulator. Raise funds, plan your approach, hunt down rare parts, and assemble your atomic masterpiece while staying calm and avoiding suspicion from nosy neighbors and federal agents.

games.name: On-Together: Virtual Co-Working
games.text: Virtual co-working with friends or strangers all over the world! Digital pals hang out at the bottom of the screen while you work, study, and get stuff done. Includes productivity tools, hangout spots, breaktime games, and more!

games.name: Campsite Hustle! - Management Simulator
games.text: Build your own Outdoor Store and Camping Business in the heart of Red Shore Valley! Arrange your shelves, manage your stock, construct facilities on your campsite, and take care of every guest. Grow from humble beginnings into a thriving business surrounded by nature!

games.name: Numeral Strike
games.text: A turn-based roguelite where battles take place on a field of numbers. Find pairs — either matching numbers or those that add up to 10 — to attack, defend, and overcome enemies in a world of magical medieval fantasy!

games.name: Witch's Apocalyptic Journey
games.text: Abyss decayed, witches awaken. As their guide, you will weave their destinies. Craft unique cards, schedule their days, shape endless possibilities through deckbuilding. Each choice will lead to different Ending...

games.name: House Flipper Remastered Collection
games.text: Guess who's back – and shinier than ever! ——— lets you become a one-person renovation crew. Clean, build, decorate, and sell for profit! Now with better graphics, voice acting, all expansions in one toolbox, and some more heartfelt addition. It’s flipping time!

games.name: Funnel Runners
games.text: Trapped in a doomed city, you and up to 7 friends must scavenge parts, fix your van, and escape the brutal tornado that approaches. A first-person co-op survival game with escalating disasters and total environmental destruction.

games.name: Mage Arena
games.text: A co-op PvP experience about using your voice to cast spells in the ——— to settle an ages-old feud between sorcerers and warlocks.

games.name: Yakuza Kiwami
games.text: Unwind a 10 billion yen conspiracy in Tokyo's red-light district, fueled by your fists and unyielding resolve that will make you a legend.

games.name: Yakuza Kiwami 2
games.text: Face off against the most powerful yakuza in the Kansai region of Japan in an explosive conflict between rival clans, loaded with brutal brawling action, immersive exploration, and unforgettable experiences.

games.name: Demon Lord: Just a Block
games.text: Who dares reduce you, a mighty ———, to just a block? Uncover your secret nemesis and take your revenge in this action roguelite where the world only moves when you do. Plan your moves step by step or dodge, parry, and collide with enemies for powerful attacks!

games.name: KEEP GAMBLING
games.text: ——— is a hostile friendslop gamble-em-up featuring LOTTO TICKET, CASE OPENING, SLOTS, and SUBSTANCE ABUSE simulations. Work with or against your friends to repay your debt.

games.name: Trading Card Inspector
games.text: Inspect your way through dozens of unique, hilarious cards in this chilled-out papers-please-em-up! Identify and appraise cards from The World's Most Coolest TCG! Start your new job as an official Habubis ——— and uncover a tale of friendship, corporate espionage and murder?!

games.name: WISE GUYS
games.text: ——— is a ruthless, high-stakes social deduction game where trust is a weapon and betrayal is just survival. Up to 12 players race against time to clean up their criminal operation and get out before the raid hits. Meanwhile, a Rat is quietly sabotaging the crew at every turn.

games.name: Dreamcards
games.text: A roguelike deckbuilder about dreams. Choose cards, by combining 6 different strategies during the day, and at night build your deck while facing the nightmare, to uncover a great mystery.

games.name: Stackmon
games.text: Stack, train and collect 100+ powerful ——— in this creature-collector with a card-stacking twist! Build your camp, challenge rival Scouts in combat and face the mysterious corruption spreading throughout your land.

games.name: Aestheta
games.text: A roguelike royalelike about warriors from across space and time, fighting to claim a wish from the Star of ———. Strategize your tactics, enhance your troops, and outwit your opponents to rise to the top!

games.name: Q-UP
games.text: Sick of long queues, unfair matchups, and arbitrary reflex tests? Try ———, the coin flipping eSport. It's one part clicker, one part multiplayer strategy game, one part demented capitalism simulator, and 100% completely random.

games.name: Five Hearts Under One Roof season2
games.text: Boarding house owner Yuman is back! Alongside Mal-sook, Gran, and Min-jung, a wealthy heiress, a girl burdened by childhood scars, and a sweet nurse move in. In this house of old memories and new emotions, who will you fall in love with?

games.name: Rest Area Simulator
games.text: Take over the gas station and convenience store at a roadside rest area and expand by purchasing new businesses. Manage a living world shaped by dynamic economy and random events. Upgrade your facilities, satisfy your customers, and play solo or with friends.

games.name: Super Cabbage Kabumi
games.text: The roguelike all about bonking cabbages! Make incredible builds with a vast array of items, wield powerful weapons, change the game entirely with pets, fight fantastical bosses, and so much more!

games.name: Goblin Sushi
games.text: A goblin as a sushi chef? Why not! But hurry up rent is due in minutes! Upgrade the restaurant, the menu and your ingredients to feed your fellow goblins the best and most expensive sushi any goblin can find in the cave!

games.name: 2 Fights in 2 Tight Spaces
games.text: Agent 11 is back. The iconic tactical deck-builder returns, with new tricks up its impeccably tailored sleeves… and this time it’s with friends. Improvise within the space, adapt your deck to the challenges ahead, and overcome a roster of new enemies in stylish, animated, fight sequences.

games.name: Franchise Hockey Manager 12
games.text: Franchise Hockey Manager returns for the 2025-26 season with plenty of additions to the deepest, most authentic hockey strategy gaming experience you can find. Choose from teams around the globe and select a team to guide to glory, including a chance at the ultimate prize, the Stanley Cup®.

games.name: Vital Shell
games.text: ——— is a single player top-down arena shooter that puts you in control of mechs inspired by classic fantasy archetypes. Unlock powerful synergies with unique weapons, traits, and abilities as you take on increasingly challenging waves of enemies in a shattered realm.

games.name: A Solitaire Mystery
games.text: A collection of mysterious solitaires. The solitaires included vary from fairly standard cardgames to funky reimplementations of other games in solitaire form.

games.name: Together: Moon Escape
games.text: A handcrafted two player adventure set in low gravity. Solve intricate asymmetric puzzles and escape Moontella’s extremely profitable slime empire through chaos, laughter, and unforgettable true co-op moments with your partner.

games.name: DEADLINE DELIVERY
games.text: Strap in, floor it, and deliver the goods... before the bomb goes off. Play as Carl, a monkey driving a wildly unstable mail truck through a difficult race against the clock.

games.name: Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered
games.text: Play as the vampire Kain and his betrayed lieutenant Raziel. Wield legendary blades, use supernatural abilities, and battle through a world of conflict, intrigue, and prophecy as their paths collide across the dark world of Nosgoth.

games.name: The Division Resurgence
games.text: Jump into this free‑to‑play looter‑shooter RPG featuring tactical combat, deep progression, and an exclusive canon storyline, playable solo or with friends.

games.name: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced
games.text: The iconic solo pirate adventure returns. Sail the Caribbean as Edward Kenway during the Golden Age of Piracy in this faithfully enhanced remake featuring stunning visuals, upgraded gameplay, and new content.

games.name: The Severed Gods
games.text: A fantasy roguelite RPG where heroes reincarnate to stop the mystic dragon Umbra. Master turn-based combat, sever giant bosses, and shape your Karma through a journey filled with relics and evolving NPC interactions.

games.name: SUPER BOMBERMAN COLLECTION
games.text: Party battle game "SUPER BOMBERMAN" is now available as a collection featuring a total of 8 titles with 13 versions across JP, EUR and USA, including the long-awaited localised versions of the unreleased SUPER BOMBERMAN 4 and 5! Including Boss Rush mode, support functions, libraries and more!

games.name: Nitroglycerine!
games.text: A challenging arcade simulator of transporting dangerous cargo on heavy trucks along a complex and unpredictable route. A short but extendable adventure.

games.name: 8 Ball by Pokerist™
games.text: Play the most realistic pool game with amazing graphics! Play for free with millions of players from all over the world!

games.name: Sherlock: Hidden Object & Match-3 Mystery
games.text: Explore familiar stories with ——— Holmes! Solve mysteries, find hidden objects, and play match-3 puzzles to restore classic tales. Join clans, take part in events, and uncover secrets across hundreds of detailed levels — the magnifying glass is in your hands!

games.name: YGGDRA REFRAIN
games.text: *Genre girl collectible turn RPG *High-quality cel-animation with over 50 beautiful girls that will make you feel the charm of beautiful girls *A variety of mechanics and fun to capture content for turn-based RPGs *Sub-stories that allow you to feel the hidden charm of alliances and characters

games.name: Trials Survivors
games.text: Fight through endless hordes in trials bestowed by constellation patrons. Upgrade skills, collect relics, and craft broken builds in true roguelite fashion! Rediscover the fantasy behind the words hack and slash and bullet heaven. Will you survive the densest monster Survivor-like ever created?

games.name: Forensics: Crime Scene Detective
games.text: Become a forensic specialist in a realistic crime lab simulator. Investigate crime scenes, collect microscopic evidence, and identify perpetrators in the lab using DNA and digital analysis. Based on the experience and insights of experts from the State Criminal Police Office Rhineland-Palatinate.

games.name: Outhold
games.text: ——— is a short, strategic incremental game that blends tower defense with a deep meta-progression. Experiment with builds and find overpowered synergies to defend the dwindling fires of ———.

games.name: SpiritVale
games.text: A class-based action MMO inspired by classic RPGs. Explore a fractured world of monsters and ruins, build your own playstyle, and fight alongside friends in real-time, cooperative combat.

games.name: 007 First Light
games.text: Earn the Number. ——— is a thrilling espionage action-adventure game from IO Interactive. Follow James Bond as a young, resourceful and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training programme, and discover an origin story of the world’s most famous spy.

games.name: Void Miner – Incremental Asteroids Roguelite
games.text: Blast. Collect. Upgrade. Repeat. ——— is a retro-inspired roguelite asteroid shooter where you pilot a space ship and manage an automated tower to destroy endless fields of chaos. Dodge, blast, and harvest your way through waves of asteroids in a fast-paced loop of destruction and progression.

games.name: Desktop Defender
games.text: An idle auto-battler that sits in the corner of your screen while you do other things.

games.name: RACCOIN: Coin Pusher Roguelike
games.text: A coin-pushing dopamine machine. ——— is a roguelike deckbuilder where you combine special coins with powerful items to trigger wildly satisfying combos. Stack shiny towers, spin the lucky wheel, and shake the machine until all the coins drop.

games.name: MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls
games.text: Assemble your team of legendary Marvel characters in the ultimate 4v4 tag team fighter.

games.name: Trials of Valor
games.text: Fight, block, and evade through the deadly ———. Your timing and reflexes decide survival in this real-time roguelike fighter. Master diverse classes, and experience the character progression of an entire RPG in each run as you perfect your build or die trying.

games.name: Goblin Vyke: The Thief Tycoon
games.text: By night, you’re a thief, sneaking into dungeons to steal valuable items. By day, you’re a merchant, haggling to sell your loot at high prices. Master stealth, steal the Demon Lord’s hidden treasures, recruit employees, and expand your business. Rise from a penniless goblin to a black-market tycoon!

games.name: FRONT MISSION 3: Remake
games.text: The Tactical RPG classic returns! ——— is the third chapter in the iconic series beloved by fans worldwide.

games.name: SIDE EFFECTS
games.text: A twisted trial of pill roulette for up to 4 players (solo or online). Pick your poison. Use experimental items to shift the odds. And remember: only one of you can survive.

games.name: ScootX
games.text: The world’s first 100% physics-driven scooter simulation. From the wheels to the rider’s head, everything is powered by physics. Session tricks, grinds, and community-made parks with support.

games.name: Turnbound
games.text: ——— is an auto battler, where you manage a hero's inventory to escape a haunted boardgame. Each run is different from the last, with unique upgrades, combos and synergies. Async PvP lets you battle the ghosts of other players at your own pace in this unique new inventory battler.

games.name: ReStory: Chill Electronics Repairs
games.text: Run a quaint electronics repair shop in mid-2000s Tokyo. Grow your business by carefully restoring iconic video game consoles, cell phones, music players, and other nostalgic devices. Talk to customers, hear their stories, and see how your decisions impact both their lives and your shop.

games.name: Tankenstein
games.text: ——— is a 3rd person ARPG where the player controls a dishevelled tank in a post apocalyptic wasteland looking for new parts to survive and upgrade itself. All of the other tanks in the scrapyard have the same goal, which makes them hostile in this survival of the fittest arena.

games.name: Flowers and Deities
games.text: ——— is a strategy deckbuilder roguelite where you command a blood-soaked lizardkin army through escalating arena battles, spending every drop of spilled blood to cast spells, summon creatures, and survive long enough to claim the favor of the Gods

games.name: BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE
games.text: Three EVOLUTIONS have been unleashed in the "BEYBLADE ACTION" game that faithfully recreates the BEYBLADE X series (distributed by TOMY Company, Ltd.) that is popular among fans of all ages! Witness the power of EVOBATTLE, EVOSTORY, and EVOCUSTOMIZE!

games.name: Megastore Simulator
games.text: ——— is a first-person management & tycoon game. Start small and grow into a massive two-floor megastore with forklifts, pallet jacks, and staff. Unlock and manage departments like Bakery, Clothing, Electronics, Sports, Music, Toys, Grocery, Seafood, and Vending Machines

games.name: Dice Dice Baby
games.text: The House always wins! Except here... ——— is a roguelike dice game about cheating and rolling the craziest numbers to beat the House. Twist a classic game thanks to illegal special dice and create epic combos with lucky charms, all in the world most permissive casino.

games.name: Beyond Words
games.text: From the creators of GoldenEye & TimeSplitters comes ——— the genre-defining fusion of roguelike strategy and word-crafting. Build powerful combos, unlock upgrades, and master a challenge where victory is spelled one letter at a time.

games.name: Speedway Club Manager 25
games.text: Take on the role of a speedway club manager and lead your team to championship glory! Sign your dream riders, secure sponsorship deals, upgrade your facilities, and develop young speedway talents!

games.name: BLUE REFLECTION Quartet
games.text: Cosmos converge, into one light. The emotional stories of magical Reflectors and the bonds they form. The entire BLUE REFLECTION series combined into one!

games.name: Culdcept The First
games.text: The pinnacle of board game and card game fusion is back.

games.name: Dominion Of The Forgotten
games.text: ——— is a build-crafting Roguelike. As an explorer of the United Expedition, venture into a mist-shrouded ancient continent in search of lost Dominions. Explore, battle, collect Relics, and extract safely during time-limited expeditions.

games.name: Deckstination
games.text: ——— is a real-time combat and deck-building hybrid. In this action roguelike, players use customized skill decks to overcome enemies in battles. Combine randomly drawn skills to survive intense encounters and take control of the battlefield with your own actions and strategy.

games.name: Infinite Cards
games.text: Discover ——— in this roguelike deckbuilder. Every card is unique, every run a new experience. Craft, combine, and build your deck completely freely to defeat enemies and bosses, or take on cleverly designed puzzle challenges!

games.name: Staffer Retro : A Supernatural Mystery Quest
games.text: ——— is a mystery adventure game where you uncover past incidents related to ‘Mana’, the source of supernatural powers. Gather information through dialogue and exploration, and piece together clues found in documents to guide the choices of Verita Retro, the protagonist.

games.name: Mind Lure
games.text: A Lovecraftian deck-building roguelike. Collect eerie cards and twisted creatures. Strengthen your deck while battling sanity loss in waters haunted by unspeakable entities.

games.name: TR-49
games.text: A World War II computer. An archive of lost books. A world-changing secret. Narrative deduction meets audio drama, from the creators of Overboard!, Heaven's Vault and A Highland Song.

games.name: Soulforge Lost Path
games.text: In ’——— ‘, become a legendary hunter slaughtering endless Corrupted Souls. Scavenge Sacred Remains to forge Exorcist Artefacts, manage limited inventory strategically, and uncover the world's festering corruption truth.

games.name: Dogpile
games.text: ——— is a roguelike deck builder about merging cute dogs into bigger dogs. Play dogs, get money, customize your dogs with special Traits, refine your deck, PLAY MORE DOGS! DOGS!

games.name: Heroes of Magic & Cards
games.text: Build the perfect deck, draw the perfect hand, and strike down your enemies with pairs and straights. ——— is a roguelike deckbuilder with a poker twist, sending you and your fifty-two into a mystical fantasy world of monsters and magecraft!

games.name: Flux Empyrean
games.text: The Flux is not keen on giving away its secrets, and you’re one of them. Sail a vast planet under a blanket of stars and use your tools and wits to remind yourself of what was lost and what could come next. An open world mystery about understanding the end of the world.

games.name: FlatOut 4: Total Insanity VR
games.text: ——— is destructive arcade racing at windshield distance. Trade paint, lose control, recover hard, and survive as rivals, debris, and pileups close in from every side.

games.name: Burglin' Gnomes
games.text: An online Co-op game about breaking into houses and causing havoc as a tiny gnome. Avoid danger, repurpose stolen household items, and complete tasks to meet the High-Gnome’s demands. Craft equipment and upgrade your home to make your missions easier and more successful.

games.name: Gladiator Command
games.text: A gladiator management sim. Recruit unique gladiators, train them, equip them, hire staff, manage finances, build prestige, develop traits and stat-based skills, and let real-time arena battles decide your rise.

games.name: MineMogul
games.text: Design and build a factory deep underground in this physics-based automation sandbox. Mine resources, buy machines and master the chaos as you become the ultimate Mine Mogul!

games.name: The Lantern of the Laughless Saint
games.text: A solo or co-op RPG inspired by Morrowind. Drawn by a shared dream, you awaken on an isolated island crowned by a silent Tower. Unravel the mystery of the Laughless Saint, confront the weight of human desire, and decide what deserves to be saved when the light beneath the world finally stirs.

games.name: Football Academy Manager
games.text: Run your own football academy. Scout and discover young talents, evaluate their potential, manage their development through training, and negotiate transfers with clubs to grow your prestige and influence.

games.name: BLACK SOULS II
games.text: Despair. Fear, Madness, once again. An original work based on "Alice in Wonderland" and "Through the Looking-Glass." Dark Fairy Tale Fantasy x Psychological Horror RPG focusing on the themes of "Exploration of a Mad World" and "Life or Death Combat against Demonbeasts".

games.name: Cursed Words: The Word Game That Isn't
games.text: From letters to lunacy, ——— is a roguelike chasing ever-stronger synergies. Start with simple words like BUY or THIS or GAME, then use game-altering combos to break the rules. Before long you’ll be ¼♖♙K5XNG the ⅗H♗4 out of these 83VK??7?!

games.name: Crushed In Time
games.text: Embark on an adventure with Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson on this surprising and elastic point-and-click game. Grab, pull, and release to help them solve a bizarre investigation full of humor and meta-time travel!

games.name: Barrel Roll
games.text: ——— is a roguelike deckbuilder, turn based, taking place in a futuristic far west. The deck ? A 6 slot revolver barrel. Gather bullets with special effects, customize your revolver's barrel to create strong synergies and take down as much criminals as you can.

games.name: Hangtime!
games.text: ———! is a high-stakes volleyball roguelite where every rally hits like a boss fight. Chain explosive abilities, shut down evolving teams, and spike your way to the top — or lose it all in one play.

games.name: Class of '09: Puzzle Showdown
games.text: The ——— cast is back to bring you the most out of pocket puzzle game ever made. Featuring a story rich campaign, an absurd multi-ending side quest, and online PvP... All requiring quick skills to outlast your opponent! Still wrapped in late 2000's nostalgia!

games.name: Shelldiver
games.text: Take a deep breath and dive right into this cozy incremental game about a senior turtle trying to start a business selling jellyfish. Upgrade your equipment, explore biomes, and help your turtly village!

games.name: My Wife Threw Out My Card Collection (So I Bought a Dump to Find Them All) ⭐
games.text: A cozy garbage-cleaning simulator. Dig through the dump, find ultra-rare collectible cards, rescue tangled birds, and relax.

games.name: Forage Wizard
games.text: Click, craft and collect your way to alchemical mastery. Progress through a branching skill tree and explore the forbidden woods. Collect resources and build machines of magic. Slay monsters, farm crops and automate your production to become the all-powerful ———!

games.name: Welcome to the Game III
games.text: Navigate the internet's dark net, searching for pieces of a puzzle that once combined will clear your outstanding debt. Scan strange websites for info, hack into PCs while defending your own, and buy/sell goods & services, all while avoiding threats in this strategic, suspenseful horror game.

games.name: Deadline Escape
games.text: ——— is a Low Poly Extraction Looter Shooter that throws you into a Post-Apocalyptic World. Scavenge for valuable resources, face deadly enemies and fight for your survival as the clock ticks down toward the deadline.

games.name: NASCAR 25
games.text: iRacing is proud to present ———, the official game of NASCAR featuring ALL FOUR National Series, the ARCA Menards Series, NASCAR Xfinity Series, NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series, and NASCAR Cup Series.

games.name: Fortune Seller
games.text: A gothic roguelike shopkeeping game where you sell antiques, read the tarot, and manage your inventory to survive crushing rent increases. Match strange customers with the relics they crave, unlock powerful cards, and gamble your way out of debt, one deal at a time.

games.name: Duck Life 4 Classic
games.text: The Flash-era classic returns! ——— is the original, now in HD with modern quality-of-life polish. Grind training mini-games, crush races and tournaments, and build, name, and style a custom duck team. No browser needed, just pure nostalgia on PC

games.name: MotoGP™26
games.text: Live the real MotoGP™ experience with all the thrills of the Official 2026 Season, renewed physics built around a new rider-based handling system, a more complete Career mode, dynamic Riders Ratings and much more.

games.name: Hunter's Moon: A Sovereign Syndicate Adventure
games.text: A Victorian Steampunk Roguelite Deckbuilder. Choose from four characters with unique cards and abilities. Customize your deck and character as you investigate a mysterious plague. Battle corrupted beasts and bosses in turn-based combat to unlock powerful relics and enchanted tarot cards.

games.name: Catharage
games.text: A space tactics roguelite with naval combat and extraction elements. Explore space, pick fights, collect loot, then escape. Upgrade and unlock new ships to strengthen your fleet and face tougher foes. Play with up to 4 friends in online coop.

games.name: Resonance Solstice
games.text: Resonance is a real-time trading RPG built around rail travel, blending train travel, route planning, commerce, and real-time card battles. Take the helm as a conductor of the COLUMBA Chamber of Commerce, haul goods between cities, cross a fractured continent, and reconnect a post-apocalyptic world.

games.name: Drift Gang
games.text: Drift with up to 8 friends in a fun and physics-based cart game! Drift, bump, and overtake on competitive tracks or just relax and drive on chill maps. Whether you're here to win or to have fun, Crazy Cart offers a smooth and exciting driving experience!

games.name: Dice of Kalma
games.text: Welcome to the Underworld’s deadliest game of Dice Poker! Build a deck of deathly skulls, find powerful synergies, and turn the dice to your favor to escape back to the world of the living.

games.name: Airport Baggage Simulator
games.text: Inspect and sort baggage at the airport! Check suitcases for illegal contents, weight, and destination airport. Build your own fully automated baggage handling system and optimize your terminal's efficiency for maximum profit!

games.name: Girls' Frontline
games.text: As a Commander for Griffin & Kryuger PMC. Navigate faction power struggles, deploy forces strategically, and work to restore order in a war-torn world.

games.name: Gamble With Your Friends
games.text: An online 1-6 player co-op "casino crawler" where you and your friends share one bank account and one massive debt. Gamble, buy sketchy items, make terrible decisions, and climb an ominous casino tower to hit your loan shark’s daily quota in 5 minutes - or face the consequences.

games.name: SkyShard: City Battler
games.text: City Building Auto Battler! Build your kingdom with powerful weapons, walls, houses, and endless synergies, then battle other players in asynchronous multiplayer, or overcome various solo challenges.

games.name: NO BACKUP
games.text: Escape together or die alone. A relentless creature is hunting you in this intense co-op bodycam horror experience. Communicate. Stay quiet. Survive. Every move matters. Every sound could be your last. Made by one developer.

games.name: Nothing To Declare
games.text: Live the thrill of working as airport security! 🛃 Weigh and scan bags, ask passengers questions, and if you are not convinced, search their luggage for dangerous items. It could be a bomb or an oddly shaped electronic device! Earn money and upgrade your workstation.

games.name: Poker Night at the Inventory
games.text: Seven years after the Inventory closed its doors, this underground social club has reopened for business. Play No Limit Texas Hold’em with four video game icons in a high-stakes battle of cards, bets, and trash talk.

games.name: Spider Roulette
games.text: ——— is a tense online party game where 2-4 friends take turns flipping cups, trying to avoid finding each other's spiders..

games.name: Approximately Up
games.text: Build, crash, rebuild! Explore new planets in co-op multiplayer with your fully modular spaceship made from whatever bolts together long enough to fly. Mount giant thrusters, annoying cables, and everything in between. Complete wild missions, face the dangers of space and argue with your crew!

games.name: Yoko no Hanashi
games.text: ——— is a first-person survival horror game where you need to survive in an abandoned college with one of your chosen yandere: Yoto (male version) and Yoko (female version)

games.name: Thunder Spikes Volleyball
games.text: Control every move of your players on a 2D volleyball court. Spike, block, defend and use every open space. Face national teams in Arcade mode or challenge a friend in local multiplayer.

games.name: Stackflow
games.text: ——— is a hypnotically addictive strategic roguelike about the pure pleasure of fitting pieces perfectly. Discover unique blocks, create satisfying connections, and trigger explosive combos that release pure dopamine.

games.name: Inferno Protocol
games.text: A survival horror set in a massive maze. Play solo or 6-player co-op. Scavenge resources to craft gear and survive against terrifying enemies. Unlock unique abilities and find the exit.

games.name: Hockey Legacy Manager 26
games.text: Build the ultimate legacy as the general manager of a professional hockey team!

games.name: Moss: The Forgotten Relic
games.text: ——— is an emotional and atmospheric adventure set in the pages of a living storybook, brimming with myth and ancient magic. Guide a tiny but determined hero on a heartfelt journey of challenge, courage, and connection.

games.name: Transport Legion
games.text: A unique roguelike card-based tower defense game. Strategically place cards, manage resource transport, balance production with combat, and craft distinctive decks to claim victory.

games.name: BBY DON'T HURT ME
games.text: ——— is a rude furry desktop companion in Early Access. Use voice commands, play furry minigames, and procrastinate at work!

games.name: Assetto Corsa Rally
games.text: ——— is a high-fidelity rally sim built for precision and challenge. With 3D laser-scanned stages and cars, professional co-driver support, and dynamic conditions, it delivers a demanding, immersive experience where every second behind the wheel counts.

games.name: Shaolin vs Wutang Legends
games.text: The continuation of the Shaolin vs Wutang series, this game is yet another indie love letter to martial arts and classic Kung Fu films. Designed for casual gaming fans, it’s not aimed at hardcore fighting game players.

games.name: Might & Magic Fates - Heroes TCG
games.text: ——— TCG is an original card battle game where you command Heroes, summon iconic creatures, cast devastating spells, and build tactical structures. Collect tons of cards, build unique decks and crush rivals in epic duels to become a legend of the Sea of Fates.

games.name: Golemworks
games.text: Assemble a factory, manufacture golems, and defend yourself from ruin in this strategic automation roguelike.

games.name: Dig Island
games.text: ——— is a 4-player co-op digging game. As you dig deeper, discover new resources, upgrade your equipment, and work with your friends to repair the plane and escape the island.

games.name: FATAL FRAME II: Crimson Butterfly REMAKE
games.text: Together, always.

games.name: Chosen Garden
games.text: In this unique roguelike deck-builder, tend your garden and harvest plants for high scores! 100+ plants, 5 gardens, and a wealth of unique weather, animals, and tools — countless builds await!

games.name: Eternal Afternoon
games.text: Spend one last afternoon exploring your childhood neighborhood before the world ends at 6:38 PM.

games.name: Unfair Flips
games.text: A non-idle clicker game about flipping a coin that hates you. Starting with just a 20% chance of getting heads, can you get ten heads in a row?

games.name: Sun Halo
games.text: ——— is a real-time combat game blending roguelike progression with strategic deck-building. Recruit and develop a roster of distinctive characters, build your own unique deck, and adapt your tactics on the battlefield. Uncover the world’s unfolding story, all the way to its final chapter.

games.name: Food Processing Simulator
games.text: Build and manage your own food processing factory. Automate production with machines, work together with skilled employees to keep operations running smoothly, expand your facility, and keep inventory under control as you grow from a small workshop into a large scale production facility.

games.name: BULT: Hunting simulator
games.text: A realistic waterfowl hunting simulator set in the wild landscapes of Yakutia. Hunt ducks and grouse with birds driven by realistic AI instincts: flocking, feeding, hiding, and reacting to the environment. Use decoys, calls, wind conditions, and strategy. Created by hunters for hunters.

games.name: Relief
games.text: ——— is a deckbuilding roguelike featuring a post-Journey to the West urban legend setting! In a bizarre world of corrupted deities, harness overpowered tech to enhance your deck and forge custom affixes onto your cards. Combine over 1,000 cards and 300 artifacts to create your ultimate OP build!

games.name: ploink
games.text: A chaotic plinko inspired roguelike with a focus on wacky items and creative setups. Design a board of random crap and fill the screen with balls and numbers. There are no bad items you just gotta figure out how to use them.

games.name: Warhounds
games.text: ——— is a turn-based tactical game about an elite mercenary squad with an old-school action movie vibe, inspired by XCOM and Jagged Alliance. Recruit unique fighters, upgrade your base, and fight for Africa’s future. Less fake RNG, more true ballistics and lethal tactics.

games.name: Terrinoth®: Heroes of Descent
games.text: Step into the epic world of Descent with the first fantasy co-op tactical RPG forged from the legendary dungeon crawling board game. Lead a company of fearless heroes across ———®, survive against epic boss battles in turn-based combat, and settle the fate of a world facing unending darkness.

games.name: Don't Let It Starve
games.text: A horror roguelike bento-builder. You're trapped in an underground kitchen, forced to feed a half-chef monster. Gamble with your life, assemble meals, and master your multipliers. Whatever you do, ———.

games.name: Escape from Tarkov
games.text: ——— is the original extraction FPS where every raid is a gamble with death. Prep your raid, bleed, endure and fight through ruthless PMC players and Scavs, gain tactical advantage and cling to your loot — only extraction decides if you live or lose it all.

games.name: CiniCross
games.text: ——— is a dark fantasy roguelite where nonogram puzzles meet dungeon crawling. Solve increasingly complex puzzles, choose your path through a branching dungeon, and bend the rules using powerful artifacts. Each room is a puzzle. Each boss, a deadly challenge.

games.name: My Car My Life
games.text: Build the car of your dreams to compete in intense drag races, featuring detailed mechanics, advanced customization, and realistic physics. Tune every part of the engine, control the revs with precision, and win through reaction and skill.

games.name: How Many Dudes?
games.text: ——— does it take to beat up a gorilla? A thousand toddlers? A horse-sized duck? A GOD? Enter the Dude Ranch and find out in this roguelike dudebuilder where you recruit an army of dudes to fight ridiculous battles.

games.name: Backyard Baseball
games.text: The arcade-style classic is back - and it's leveling up. With enhanced gameplay, new game modes, and all the humor & charm of the original, this is ——— like it was always meant to be played. Are you ready to play like a kid again?

games.name: Tour de France 2026
games.text: Take on the best international cyclists with one goal in mind: winning the 2026 Tour de France. Conquer legendary mountain passes, launch your sprints at the perfect moment and emerge triumphant on the Champs-Élysées wearing the Yellow Jersey.

games.name: Pro Cycling Manager 26
games.text: Dive into the heart of cycling management with an ever more realistic simulation. From recruitment and staff, to season planning and race strategy, make every decision and lead your team to victory in the sport’s biggest competitions.

games.name: HoloSeeker
games.text: A deckbuilding roguelite RPG featuring hololive members.

games.name: Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties
games.text: YAKUZA KIWAMI 3 is an extreme remake of the action-adventure beat 'em up Yakuza 3 featuring ex-yakuza Kazuma Kiryu's fight to protect those he loves. DARK TIES is a brand-new game featuring Yoshitaka Mine from Yakuza 3 included as a separate action-packed experience.

games.name: Ugoku Sushi Bar
games.text: Become a sushi chef in a cozy Japanese conveyor belt sushi bar! 🍣 Prepare sushi on your crafting table, serve quirky customers, learn new recipes, unlock fresh ingredients, upgrade your kitchen, and build relationships with your regular customers.

games.name: EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 27
games.text: Run the league one decision at a time. ———, powered by the all-new Persona Engine.

games.name: Fly Over! 100KM! Mountains!
games.text: This is an easy-to-learn yet incredibly challenging endless flight game. Control your little plane through the ever-changing sky, nimbly avoiding obstacles and desperately trying to escape the ever-approaching tornado behind you. Every advance is a test of skill and perseverance.

games.name: Pegfinity
games.text: Launch balls, hit pegs, make numbers go wild. A short pachinko-inspired physics incremental about chaotic upgrades, combos, and ridiculous score-chasing chaos!

games.name: Scritchy Scratchy
games.text: ——— is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game. Buy stacks of scratch-offs, unlock auto-scratching, and chase massive jackpots. Will you play it safe or go all-in?

games.name: Plinbo: Roguelike Plinko
games.text: UPGRADE YOUR BALLS! Roguelike meets Plinko! Every choice is a strategy; every run is a unique challenge. Build your deck to tame the balls to your will. Take your chance, craft your fate, and cash in!

games.name: Find My Frogs: Branches
games.text: ——— is a cozy hidden object game where you search for frogs and toads in a hand-drawn village nestled high in the branches of an ancient tree. Explore charming corners, discover tiny secrets, and help Uncle Froger find his missing hat.

games.name: RV There Yet?
games.text: A co-op adventure about driving your Recreational Vehicle home.

games.name: 1666: Amsterdam
games.text: Every 333 years, something stirs. ——— is a 3rd person Dark, Story-Led, Action-Adventure where Noa, the Collector, wields witchcraft to uncover demonic entities hiding behind human faces. Investigate by day. Face your demons at night.

games.name: Duet Night Abyss
games.text: A Thrilling Hybrid Action RPG, featuring a Dual Narrative All Characters & Weapons Free to Unlock —— New Version [Silver Torrent, Rising Star] Now Available Limited-Time Giveaway: Up to free 60 Skin Pulls + Self-Pick Character & Weapon!

games.name: Database Detective: Minor Crimes Division
games.text: Solve criminal cases through the power of SQL queries! Help out the city of Los Zorangeles by becoming a ——— in this new (unpaid) work from home opportunity.

games.name: Cheater's Table
games.text: At this table, cheating is the game. Hide your power cards up your sleeve or down your pant leg, then strike when the time is right. But stay sharp - a scratch isn't always a cheat. This table is full of traps...

games.name: MU: Dark Epoch
games.text: ——— is a fantasy MMORPG mobile game that combines high quality, fast-paced gameplay, and innovative features. As the best ——— instalment in the series by far, it offers impressive dynamic costumes and stunning graphic performance. Log in now and win the Archangel Set!

games.name: Drive Me Broke
games.text: Survive 🏚️, Gain Reputation ✊, Earn Money 💸, Build Your Car 🛠️, Win Races 🏁, Become a Legend 👑

games.name: Siegeturtle
games.text: Upgrade your turtle, recruit cute animals like unicorns, giant squids, otters and more, and blast through waves in an idle roguelite auto battler! Swim farther with each run, unlock new skills, and get closer to home every time you grow stronger.

games.name: Landscaper Simulator
games.text: Lawns are wild. Parks are buried in weeds. Streets are littered. The world needs a hero, and that’s where you come in. As the Landscaper, it’s your job to turn disorder into beauty. With your weed whacker, pressure washer, and trash vacuum, you’ll trim, wash, and restore every space to perfection.

games.name: Pickle Pete
games.text: A roguelite bullet heaven where you dodge and auto-shoot through waves of enemies. Build devastating weapon, gear and mutation combinations with deep synergies. Face over 30 unique bosses across diverse biomes in this challenging arena shooter.

games.name: Feed the Scorchpot
games.text: A dice roguelike about feeding a dragon for twenty years. Roll ingredients, build your island, and fuse absurd recipes into combos that break the score wide open. Miss a meal and you're next on the menu.

games.name: Dawncaster | The RPG Cardventure
games.text: What if you combine the best of story-driven RPGs with the strategic decision-making of cardgames? ——— was created to answer that question, containing over 1100 handcrafted cards and over 100 unique challenges designed by veterans of the cardgame genre.

games.name: 纵横麻将 Matrix Mahjong
games.text: No Mahjong experience needed! A strategy card game focused on crafting Hu (winning hands). Easier to Hu, but takes deeper strategy. Form melds on a grid, and use items to complete Hu with multiple Faans (scoring patterns). Every game unfolds differently—adapt on the fly and play with the flow!

games.name: MapleStory M
games.text: The MapleStory you missed is calling you. ——— is an MMORPG full of MapleStory's signature charm and worldview. Enjoy jobs bursting with personality, lighthearted battles, an easy leveling-up system, and even co-op gameplay. Begin your own adventure in this adorable 2D side-scrolling world.

games.name: Lazy Witch's Factory
games.text: Your debt comes due in 30 minutes. Twist the rules through demonic contracts and survive impossible production quotas in this chaotic factory-building roguelite.

games.name: Mineral Mining Simulator
games.text: Turns raw rock into valuable minerals and jewelry grade gemstones through a hands on production chain. Mine ore, crush it into fragments, refine it, and scale your operation with better machines and smarter workflow. Optimize every stage of the pipeline to maximize efficiency, quality, and profit.

games.name: Loot Loop
games.text: Build a party of heroes and send them into dungeons in this short incremental RPG. Fight monsters, collect loot, and unlock upgrades. Fast runs, deep skill tree, zero stress.

games.name: Backpack Jianghu
games.text: ——— is a Wuxia theme, inventory management and battle royale game. Choose a starting sect, enter the world with dozens of other players, pick your path, battle and grow, and compete in the final showdown at Mount Hua's peak.

games.name: Mirklurk: Every Step Matters
games.text: You've been exiled to The Mirk - an unforgiving swampland where every step could be your last. You must constantly make choices: what paths to take, which tree to shelter under, what beasts to engage or avoid, what items to bring into the darkness of dungeons, and what treasures to leave behind.

games.name: The Spotter: Dig or Die
games.text: Dig by day, fight by night in this blend of mining and Tower Defense. As the last Spotter at a ruined gas station, hold back mutant hordes, scavenge the wasteland, and repair your receiver to capture the President’s vital message and humanity’s last hope.

games.name: Rewind 99
games.text: You're the last remaining video rental store. From humble VHS clerk to rental racketeer - run your video store and explore Reshoot Springs, building an underground empire. Expand with upgrades, side hustles, store membership, and more. Whatever it takes to survive - solo or in up to 4-player co-op.

games.name: Sector Space
games.text: Explore a procedurally generated galaxy, mine asteroids, refine minerals, colonize planets, build stations, deploy drones, salvage rare items, construct gear, level up, improve your ship, assemble a fleet, engage in combat, and take on the void.

games.name: Leaf it Alone
games.text: Finally, it's that time of the year to clean up this leafy mess. It's been a while since the last time you've done it, so don't waste any second and derust your raking skills!

games.name: The Spike Cross
games.text: "The thrill of spiking in volleyball. Why don't you try it out?" Developed by an indie developer who loves volleyball! The sports game made after numerous trial and error to contain the appeal of volleyball!

games.name: R.I.P. - Reincarnation Insurance Program
games.text: Welcome to the Reincarnation Insurance Program! This top-down roguelite shooter blends Diablo-style looting with Survivor-like mayhem. Face screen-filling zombie tides, use Divine Tech to liquidate them into ash, and farm god-tier gear to forge your OP build.

games.name: YOU ARE THE MONSTER
games.text: Ever wanted to be a giant monster rampaging through a city? Experience mindless chaos as you destroy all in your path, earning new abilities, new monsters and new ways to wreak havoc.

games.name: Tobiano
games.text: ——— is a sport horse simulator with realistic genetics, management, and riding. Shop for horses and train them through the levels to succeed at shows or sell for profit. Breed horses with unique personalities and conformation. Grow your facility to add stables, farm feed, or craft tack.

games.name: Ascend From Nine Mountains
games.text: A cultivation RPG about clawing your way out of mortal obscurity into a god of your own making. Discover powerful techniques, automate your combat style, craft and customise treasures with build-defining powers, and cultivate an entire world within your soul.

games.name: Monster Lab Simulator
games.text: Ready to become a mad scientist? Synthesize, evolve, and command an army of unique creatures in your own lab. Manage your laboratory, master genetic essences, and dominate the battle arena in this deep creature collection simulator!

games.name: Osta
games.text: A militaria collecting simulator where you hunt for items through metal detecting, auctions, and markets to build your collection and customize your home. Travel to various locations to uncover the relics of different conflicts throughout history.

games.name: Claws Of Power
games.text: ——— is a cute, real-time card battle game. With a variety of unique and adorable cat cards, each one could be your key to victory. Strategize by building different decks and using items to overcome challenges and claim the throne as the ultimate cat leader.

games.name: Swarmdustry
games.text: Build a living factory and automate the Swarm. Harvest resources, construct mega factories, and grow a colony of specialized biomechanical bugs. Balance growth, efficiency, and creep spread before hostile robots squish you for trying to consume their world.

games.name: Deep Blue Sushi
games.text: ——— is a casual 1–5 player co-op adventure where you explore the ocean, catch fresh fish, prepare sushi, serve customers, and grow your restaurant while uncovering the secrets of the mysterious Deep Blue.

games.name: Pirate Ships
games.text: ——— is a PvP game about shipbuilding and naval battles. Embark on an epic journey together with other players and fight monsters, pirates and thieves to become the greatest pirate in all of the Caribbean!

games.name: STEINS;GATE RE:BOOT
games.text: STEINS;GATE returns! Rebooted for the modern era! Featuring fully updated visuals, UI, and an all-new story that breathes new life into the streets of Akihabara.

games.name: Model Kit Shop Simulator
games.text: Build and run your own hobby shop in this first-person store management sim. Order stock, fill shelves, set prices, match kits with paints through the Hobby Basket System, and let customers bring their projects to life at Build Tables.

games.name: MyVoiceZoo
games.text: My Voice Zoo is a unique idle zoo game brought to life with your own voice. Record your sounds through the microphone and turn them into animal calls, creating a one-of-a-kind zoo found nowhere else. Start building your very own zoo, complete only with your voice!

games.name: Hariti
games.text: "———" is a first-person psychological horror game. You will play as a mother searching for her missing daughter in a crisis-ridden hospital. Experience an atmosphere of extreme dread within the halls of this abandoned Chinese-style medical facility.

games.name: Lost Wiki: Kozlovka
games.text: Explore a wikipedia-like database and solve a small town mystery in Eastern Europe. Step into the shoes of a journalist in the 90s as you sprawl through articles and uncover the secrets that have been laid in front of you.

games.name: Mythic Kart Maker
games.text: ——— is part level maker, part fantasy kart racer. Vehicular combat, whimsical characters, & a vibrant 64-bit pre-rendered art style come together to create a chaotic, creative playground where you build the race - and then survive it.

games.name: Smack Talk
games.text: Say your moves out loud, trash-talk your friends, and fight to win. ——— is a 1–8 player online PvP platform fighter where your voice controls your attacks. Call moves, land one-liners, and finish foes with wild ultimates.

games.name: Project P.I.T.T.
games.text: Feed rubber ducks to a corporate void. Build physics contraptions. Chain combos for profit as the Maw grows hungrier... and larger. Brutalist PSX satire meets first-person sandbox chaos.

games.name: Cafe Business Manager
games.text: Build, design and manage your own café in this detailed cafe management simulator. Hire staff, craft your menu, serve customers and grow your coffee shop business in a lively island city.

games.name: DEFRAG
games.text: ——— is a game about cleansing corrupted sectors and refining them through optimization to build a stronger system. Collect resources, adjust configurations, and complete your build as you progress.

games.name: Mamon King
games.text: "———" is a monster-raising simulation where you aim to become the King. Battles feature simple turn-based command combat, yet each monster possesses unique skills. Combined with the SP required to activate these skills, this creates intense strategic gameplay that anyone can easily enjoy.

games.name: EA SPORTS™ College Football 27
games.text: Step into the modern era of college football, where personal ambition meets program pride. Balance expectations, identity, and everything Saturday demands while immersed in traditions and pageantry of game day.

games.name: Deep Corp
games.text: Dig mines, extract resources, and produce goods to restore order to the state. Become a successful businessman and an effective state governor in the late Wild West era!

games.name: Space Rock Breaker
games.text: ——— is a short incremental game about mining asteroids in space. Mine asteroids with guns, unlock new materials, process the ore by dropping it into a Plinko machine, and spend your credits on upgrades in a massive skill tree.

games.name: FPV Labs - Drone Simulator
games.text: Fly with true-to-life physics, next-gen visuals, and the most detailed drone configurator in any FPV sim. Build your setup, share community presets, and fly handcrafted real-world locations. Made by real FPV pilots.
