games.name: This Ain’t Even Poker, Ya Joker
games.text: A unique incremental idle clicker where you flip cards to earn money, grow your hand, buy new decks, unlock powerful upgrades, discover new cards, and more. Can you defeat the Jester and escape the carnival?

games.name: Table Battle Simulator
games.text: Ready to build your own figure empire? Open surprise boxes, collect rare warriors, and manage your shop. Set up your table, master strategic tabletop battles, and become the city's ultimate collector!

games.name: Subway Builder
games.text: ——— is a hyperrealistic transit simulation game. Build a new subway system from the ground up while dealing with real-world constraints and costs. Craft the subway system your city deserves.

games.name: Static Dread: The Submarine
games.text: Descend into Lovecraftian horror aboard a claustrophobic military submarine. Assign tasks as a captain’s right hand, analyze sonar signals, make hard decisions, and keep the crew from madness. Dark horrors lurk both within… and beyond the hull.

games.name: Poker Fate - Anime Girls Texas Hold'em
games.text: ——— is an anime-style Texas Hold'em game featuring beautiful heroines. It combines easy-to-learn tutorials for beginners, high-stakes duels for top players, and a variety of thrilling tournaments. Join now and uncover the cards of your destiny with us!

games.name: Out of the Park Baseball 27
games.text: 27 years of sports gaming excellence! ——— is here - officially licensed by MLB, the MLB Players Inc. and KBO! You are firmly in charge of your favorite baseball franchise - today or at any point in history! Your team, your way, your rules.

games.name: Nuclear Epoch
games.text: ———: Open-world survival mixing base building & extraction shooting. Explore with friends, raid dangerous instances for loot, but death means losing everything. Craft weapons with fully customizable stats in this post-apocalyptic wasteland.

games.name: Floorball League 2010
games.text: The first official floorball video game is back! Play real teams, enter tournaments, and relive the fast-paced action of 2010.

games.name: NGL Biathlon 2026
games.text: Biathlon simulator. Race as your athlete, progress in Career, and compete for the Big Crystal Globe. World Cup tracks and all disciplines, including relays. Career from rookie to legend. Wide choice of skis, poles, and rifles. Feel real biathlon vibes

games.name: MOLE
games.text: Pilot the ———, a monstrous post-war drilling machine built to descend deep below the Slavic soil. Fix failing systems, follow voices of the dead, and pray you can survive whatever is sharing your coffin. Will the vessel or your mind break first?

games.name: Drifter Star: Evolution
games.text: From stardust to cosmic sovereign! In this unique space game, evolve by devouring everything. Grow from a tiny rock into a massive galaxy. Each swallow brings growth, each evolution brings victory. Unlock the universe's ultimate secrets!

games.name: Super Battle Golf
games.text: An online 1-8 player golf game where everyone plays at the same time. Swing, shoot, sabotage, and finish first by any means necessary in a free-for-all rush to the hole.

games.name: Combolands: Roguelike Citybuilder
games.text: A mini citybuilding roguelike. Place buildings, stack combos, and master deep strategy in short bursts to create a tiny thriving metropolis!

games.name: Suncraft
games.text: Another sun-filled day begins in this cozy pixel-art adventure. Gather, craft, upgrade, and help the villagers revive the land. Can you rebuild the grand Sunspire and bring the village back to its golden days?

games.name: Dwarf Eats Mountain
games.text: Dwarves hunger for gold, and no mountain shall stand in their way! Mine riches, unearth artifacts, and upgrade your dwarves to devour ever-bigger peaks in this whimsical incremental game.

games.name: Parcel Delivery Simulator
games.text: You've landed a job at a courier company, but your boss has to leave town. Now you're the boss. Deliver packages, sign new contracts, expand your office, buy new vehicles. Hire employees, set up parcel lockers around town, and create the most profitable courier company in the world. Simulation game.

games.name: The Message from Deep Space
games.text: Mission: Translate an interstellar message, using the universal languages of math & science.

games.name: Ludus Magnatus: Gladiator Manager Simulator
games.text: ——— is a classic management experience set in an alternate Ancient Rome. Start in Division VII with one of sixteen clubs, recruit fighters, equip them from the market, and climb the ladder through fully simulated seasons and matches.

games.name: Mall Rivals
games.text: Competitive mall simulation. 1-8 players open stores in the same mall, fight for customers, crush rivals. Team up or go solo. Fair play or dirty tricks? Your call. Procedural maps, employee system,mall cops, smugglers and physical mechanics.

games.name: Dictator Simulator: Gradnar
games.text: Become the Dictator of Gradnar! Rule the nation, choose between democracy and tyranny, wage wars with a unique card-based mechanic, and expand your empire. A political dystopia packed with satire and humor!

games.name: Lucky Shot
games.text: A shooting dopamine machine! ——— is a roguelike mag-builder FPS where you master different weapons, build wild combos, and break the game to reach massive high scores.

games.name: Midnight Hoops
games.text: The court is peaceful after dark. Just you, a ball, and a whole lot of crickets. You put in the hours every evening. While your friends are out partying, you're on the grind. But tonight... you don't feel quite so alone.

games.name: Machine Party
games.text: ——— is a collection of violent party games where failure is lethal. Gather your friends and endure high stakes situations to prove your life is worth more than theirs. Survival is unlikely.

games.name: An Eggstremely Hard Game
games.text: As highly qualified goose parents, work together to bring your little egg home safely. Every crack makes it harder to control, every mistake more hilarious. A co-op physics game for 2 or 4 players about teamwork, clumsiness and honking. HONK!

games.name: Wabisabi SushiDerby
games.text: Adorable sushi race at full speed in a training × racing game! Become a sushi chef, craft unique toppings, and enter your trained sushi into races. Don't forget to cheer on your sushi during the race. Win the prestigious S1 Cup championship, and become a top-tier sushi chef!

games.name: Sovereign Tower
games.text: Play as the Sovereign of a magical tower in this story-rich, Round Table management RPG. Recruit eccentric Knights, assign quests and balance egos whilst carving out your kingdom's destiny. If destiny doesn’t go your way, keep turning back time, uncover secrets and rewrite fate again and again.

games.name: Slayblade
games.text: Build your battle-top and become King of the Streets! Collect 60+ parts, Merge their Powers, and Dominate opponents in this Chill Roguelite! Skate around a vibrant Y2K city, winning Cash and Upgrades on your way to the top. And if you Die in the game, you Die in real life.

games.name: The Sorting Bureau
games.text: A cozy sorting game set in a quiet Tokyo workshop. Clients bring you boxes of clutter: buttons, coins, gears, stamps. Sort them, group them, and put everything back in its place, to satisfying ASMR clicks. No timers. Mistakes cost nothing. Just the joy of tidying up.

games.name: Fears to Fathom® - Scratch Creek
games.text: After noticing bone-chilling similarities to an episode of ———, Tessa and Marcus decide to share their own experience. Scratch Creek is an exclusively online co-op experience.

games.name: Pallet Jack Racing
games.text: Welcome to the "———" — crazy races through endless labyrinths of warehouses! Get comfortable on your trusty pallet truck and hit the gas hard!

games.name: Some of You May Die
games.text: ——— is a strategic autobattler where you can upgrade everything! Go head to head with other players in online PvP where clever tactics and cunning plans make the difference between victory or defeat!

games.name: Punishing: Gray Raven
games.text: As the commandant of the Gray Raven squad, you must assemble the most powerful Construct soldiers ever created and lead them into battle. Uncover the dark truths behind the ——— Virus, push back the Corrupted, and reclaim Earth in this stylish, high-octane action RPG.

games.name: Fishing Inc
games.text: ——— is a cozy incremental fishing game! Catch fish, earn cash, and unlock powerful skills. Master new ponds, fill your Fish Log with Legendary catches, and become the ultimate angler!

games.name: eBaseball™: PRO SPIRIT
games.text: Experience authentic baseball with players from around the world. Feel the arc of every hit, the intensity behind each play, and the roar of the crowd surrounding the stadium. With stunning presentation, the game captures the true intensity of real baseball.

games.name: Genome Guardian 2
games.text: COMBINE WEAPONS in the microscopic shooter with macroscopic depth. BUILD YOUR NANOBOT from hundreds of parts. SURVIVE the microbial onslaught once more in this psychedelic dive to the Abyss, full of mutations, minerals, anomalies and powerup polyps. SHMUP mode turns it into a vertical shoot 'em up!

games.name: VHOLUME
games.text: ——— is a melancholic first-person parkour adventure set in a dystopian brutalist city where bureaucracy turns a simple task into an odyssey.

games.name: Pizza House Simulator🍕
games.text: Run your dream pizzeria solo or with up to 6 players in chaotic online co-op multiplayer. Cook authentic pizzas, automate your kitchen, customize your restaurant, survive disasters, invest in stocks, gamble and build the ultimate Italian restaurant empire.

games.name: EverRail
games.text: Every passenger is a life. Every death brings the end closer. An open world survival crafting game where you explore, scavenge, and craft to endure on the frozen exomoon Inara. Command and upgrade your ever-moving train, solo or with up to 4 players. Move or freeze.

games.name: Marble's Marbles
games.text: A love letter to the classic marble games. Help Marble find his lost marbles and roll through physics-powered worlds packed with wild challenges and quirky contraptions.

games.name: Freefall '95
games.text: Chain massive trick combos, dodge deadly debris, and chase huge scores in this fast-paced arcade adventure. Earn coins, upgrade abilities, collect rare items, and uncover a wild time-bending narrative aboard this doomed flight in the year 1995

games.name: Road to Empress Ⅱ
games.text: Play as the protagonist in this live-action interactive palace survival drama! Take a dynasty's fate into your own hands in Road to Empress II, the new content of the global hit. Defy fate, navigate intrigue, and claim the throne of power. You decide it all!

games.name: Nippets: A Hidden Object Game
games.text: A hand-drawn hidden object game inspired by the joy of people watching and telling small stories. Shake trees, peek through windows and spin curious objects to uncover secrets and follow the lives of its charming inhabitants.

games.name: Sports Card Shop Simulator
games.text: Open packs, search for rare cards, and build the best sports card shop. Hunt for holos, autos, and numbered variants to satisfy your collection obsession. Design custom cards and enjoy the thrill of pulling those creations from a fresh pack!

games.name: Diggin
games.text: Drill into the depths of a meteor crater in this incremental adventure. Mine ores, unlock upgrades and find the cosmic treasure that lies below! Can you uncover what happened to the Moles that came before you?

games.name: The Artisan of Glimmith
games.text: ——— is a cozy, relaxing puzzle game about coloring stained glass and restoring the artworks of a kingdom above the clouds. Explore a world of handcrafted puzzles designed with intent, where simple rules lead to delightful surprises.

games.name: Zenless Zone Zero
games.text: ——— is HoYoverse’s brand-new urban fantasy ARPG. Players act as "Proxies" who explore Hollows alongside a wide range of unique Agents, fighting enemies, and completing commissions on their journey to unveil the mysteries behind New Eridu.

games.name: Cat Chess
games.text: Play the ancient and thrilling game of Chess but with... cats! Lead your furry friends to the Purrfect battle of brains and whiskers!

games.name: Break Shoot
games.text: ——— combines the precision of billiards with roguelike builds. Stack powerful ball abilities and accessories to explode your score and crush each round's target!

games.name: My Winter Car
games.text: ——— is the ultimate challenge for project car owning, building, fixing, tuning and maintenance simulator. Sequel to My Summer Car, but with added challenge for those who can master the original game!

games.name: Survival Log
games.text: The apocalypse is here, and you saw it coming. ——— is a zombie-apocalypse hoarding survival sim. Hoard supplies, reinforce your home, and optimize every run before zombies flood the city. Every failure becomes experience. You must adapt and survive this time.

games.name: Gacha Capsule Shop Simulator - Akihabara
games.text: What's it like to open a shop in Akihabara? Sourcing, displaying, hiring(Staff & Robots), setting your own prices. From a little shop to a legendary otaku shop filled with rare figures. Conquer Akihabara with your gacha business skills. (and sometimes physical means too)!

games.name: Data Center
games.text: Build, cable, and automate. Assemble racks, servers, and switches, connect enough capacity for each app, earn money from processed data, and unlock gear and bigger customers with XP and reputation. Follow colored data packets as your center comes to life.

games.name: I Know a Guy: Shady Life Simulator
games.text: Run your pizza shop up front and handle shady business out back. Help hand-crafted NPCs with favors that never go as planned. Play solo or online co-op with up to four players and expand your operation across Hobarey Town. In this darkly comedic management sim - become that guy everyone knows.

games.name: Retail Hell
games.text: Trapped in an infinite shift, you are the sole clerk of purgatory’s only convenience store. Manage stock, pay your taxes and keep nightmarish creatures at bay as you uncover the secret of why your shift never ends. Clock in. Serve the dead. Survive the shift.

games.name: Wizard Pool
games.text: Pool, but each BALL is ENCHANTED! Master the 7 different magical effects, but don't forget your fundamentals!

games.name: Moonshiner Simulator
games.text: ——— is an in-depth spirits production simulator. Start from the bottom and build your operation into a thriving empire by mastering the intricacies of the craft and creating unique recipes. But beware – there will always be those who want to see you fail.

games.name: Full Stride
games.text: ——— is an authentic jockey racing game where you take on the role of a jockey and challenge the race.

games.name: Smash Hit Museum
games.text: Smash stones. Collect artifacts. Build the world’s most profitable museum. A short clicker game set in the archeology room of a museum. Build up your collection and Upgrade until you break it.

games.name: Don't Panic! It is Just Turbulence
games.text: A frantic co-op puzzle game where a Pilot and an Air Traffic Controller must communicate, decrypt, and improvise to save a failing aircraft. Talk fast, solve faster, and try not to crash.

games.name: Ultrapool
games.text: The pool bar is always open! ——— is a colorful roguelike about playing pool with a bunch of wacky balls with crazy effects. Carefully craft a perfect build and get the craziest trickshots!

games.name: AFK Journey
games.text: Welcome to the enchanted land of Esperia! Play as the legendary mage Merlin and explore a beautifully illustrated storybook world. Outsmart your foes in strategic card battles and uncover the secrets of this world alongside other heroes.

games.name: Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library!
games.text: ———! is a single-player simulation. You need return scattered books to proper places in an Arcane Library. As completed rows of bookshelves, you can learn ability to improve your efficiency. Use your skills and strategies to shelve 3,072 books as quick as you can.

games.name: Cargo Hunters
games.text: ——— is an extraction shooter where you control a humanoid robot scavenging the remains of humanity on an abandoned, dystopian Earth. Play solo or in 4 players co-op.

games.name: Knights End
games.text: Work together to survive the night shift in this challenging co-op PvE horror game. Serve your villagers as disgraced knights by evading danger to fulfill their commands in this cursed kingdom. Reclaim your lost honor to earn your place on the watch. How long can you survive?

games.name: Karigurashi Ren'ai: Living on Borrowed Love
games.text: Welcome back to your childhood town! The Full HD Remaster of ——— perfectly preserves ASa Project's signature blend of comedy and heartwarming charm while offering a stunning new visual experience.

games.name: Wireworks
games.text: Design your defenses, build your module board, and manage your wires. Combine signals and create synergies to empower your weapons and survive in this base-defense roguelike auto-battler.

games.name: Defender of the Crown: The Legend Returns
games.text: The legendary medieval strategy adventure has returned – enhanced for a new generation of knights. Conquer provinces, raise armies, storm castles, and influence the balance of power through bold strategy and action moments.

games.name: Lakehopper
games.text: Take flight in a seaplane flight simulator through a rugged world where you are responsible for the care and maintenance of your plane. Deliver cargo between far-flung communities in a flooded landscape that challenges your piloting skills! Fix your plane and keep flying!

games.name: One Last Hand
games.text: Bid for cards, build your hand, then SLAP YOUR FRIENDS with it. A chaotic 2-6 player online party card battler full of secret bids, unfair Relics, lucky comebacks, and friendships that probably won’t survive the table.

games.name: Ore Factory Squad ⛏️
games.text: ——— is a co-op mining and factory-building game with procedural mining and fun at its core! Play alone or with friends, buy properties, dig deep for valuable resources, complete contracts, upgrade and automate production lines and grow your factory from zero to industry!

games.name: Ragnarok: The New World
games.text: ——— is Gravity's officially licensed cross-platform MMORPG, reimagining RO's cute, classic Midgard with high-quality visuals and audio on PC and mobile. Choose 8 Classes, including the new Druid. Explore, tame MVPs as Mounts, trade freely, and customize 100+ looks with friends!

games.name: Dverghold
games.text: When the Dwarves of ——— awakened something ancient beneath the isle of Rekestt, King Sterren sent word across the Shattered Sea: brave the haunted depths, or let the darkness rise. Oldschool dungeon crawler with turn-based combat and atmospheric soundtrack by Dungeon Synth artist Splendorius.

games.name: Jackpot Valley Slots
games.text: Discover the world's best Casino Slots Games! Play slots with unique game mechanics, explore amazing mini-games and master your casino skills!

games.name: Chrono CCG
games.text: ——— is an indie game from genre veterans where time-traveling agents battle for control of history. Timelines shift mid-match, agents evolve, and deep strategy meets accessible play. For the community, by the community.

games.name: Birds of War
games.text: You are a bird. You have a nest. Other birds want your eggs. ——— is a team-based aerial PvP game. Raid nests, steal eggs, fight beak-to-beak in fast, chaotic matches built around flight and combat. Your mic is always hot. Your enemies can hear you. Plan accordingly.

games.name: Jujutsu Kaisen Phantom Parade
games.text: ◆The world of "TV Anime" and the story of "Jujutsu Kaisen" unique to the game◆ The anime story is recreated with new full voices. Additionally, the story is told from the perspectives of various characters, fully voiced.

games.name: Desktop Detective
games.text: An idle detective game that sits in the corner of your screen while you do other things.

games.name: Sineus Arena Survivors
games.text: Fight hordes and defend your Stronghold in a bullet heaven survivor-like with co-op and tower defense. Gain power-ups every level, collect random artifacts from chests and grow stronger to survive, defeat the boss and claim a top spot on the Sineus Arena leaderboards!

games.name: Path of Idle: Old Gods Rising
games.text: A Lovecraftian idle RPG with auto-battles, loot farming, chests, team strategy, town building, gear crafting, Runewords, stages, towers, realms, and seasons. Serve the Old Gods, build your town, corrupt the chosen, and fight for their awakening!

games.name: Pratfall
games.text: A co-op game for 1-6+ players where you fall, dig, and explode your way down a dangerous cave system to find your lost dog. Catch your friends and watch your step on this journey full of traps, hazards, and the most deadly force of all: gravity. Will you jump into the unknown to rescue your dog?

games.name: Security 51
games.text: You're a security officer deep within Area 51. Scan the staff, verify clearances, and decide who can enter the elevator and who absolutely mustn't leave. The deeper you go, the less certain you are that anyone standing before you is still human.

games.name: E-Shop Tycoon
games.text: Embark on an e-commerce startup journey in ———! Optimize warehouse logistics, hire and train staff, and design unique office spaces as your business grows. Handle industry events and marketing crises. Come grow your startup into an e-commerce giant!

games.name: Meowgic
games.text: A co-op fantasy adventure where your voice is magic. Play as cat wizards, cast spells by shouting into your mic, explore fairy-tale worlds, fight monsters, and return to your hot-air balloon loaded with loot.

games.name: Archon Soul
games.text: ——— is a 2D roguelike dice-builder where you create powerful dice using swappable faces, runes, and bodies with unique effects. ​Draft spells, craft powerful synergies, defeat challenging enemies, and conquer the Archon's palace.

games.name: Farewells clicker
games.text: ——— is an addictive blend of clicker and city builder! Expand your island, develop your city, and produce resources endlessly. Upgrade your buildings and skills through a vast skill tree to progress further and further!

games.name: Zero Stress King: Idle Defense
games.text: A short relaxing incremental game disguised as a tower defense, but enemies can’t reach your walls. Thanks to lava.

games.name: outpost4
games.text: Build your mobile outpost and combine over 20 weapons with 100+ items to create unique builds. Grow stronger against endless enemy hordes, conquer new planets, and experience the thrill of evolving from desperate survival to overwhelming firepower.

games.name: hololive Dreams
games.text: The official hololive rhythm game and RPG -- ——— -- is now on Steam! Enjoy rhythmical gameplay, park development, and mini-games. Featuring 50+ members and 150+ songs, it's perfect for fans and newcomers alike. Play your way!

games.name: Legionbound
games.text: Turn a handful of heroes into a massive legion! ——— is a casual retro RPG autobattler where you recruit heroes, discover class synergies, forge powerful Ascensions, and battle through hordes of enemies across replayable roguelite runs.

games.name: Aurora Hills: Chapter 2
games.text: ——— is the second part in series of point and click puzzle adventure games. Follow the journey of Ethan Hill, a park ranger tasked with investigating strange disappearances from a national park to uncover the mystery of ———!

games.name: Unicycle Together
games.text: A unicycle, a bomb ready to blow, and sausages struggling to balance! Cooperate with your friends or blow them up in this 2-4 player physics-based chaos game! Reach the summit before the bomb goes off. Don't fall, don't explode, and try to stay a sausage!

games.name: Keep on Mining! - Worlds
games.text: ——— is an incremental mining game where you mine rocks, collect resources, and travel through many unique worlds, finding artifacts, crafting pickaxes, and purchasing many permanent upgrades!

games.name: Pound for Pound: MMA Promotion Simulator
games.text: Run your own MMA promotion. Sign fighters, book cards, manage contracts, and build a combat sports empire in a deep, procedurally generated MMA management sim.

games.name: Flock of the Seraphim
games.text: Exorcise hordes of demons using gun-wielding nuns and angels in this survivors-like bullet heaven! Collect and keep angels with unique weapons, stats, and abilities to create god-like builds as you fend off waves of enemies! Do you have enough faith to survive?

games.name: Life Inc.
games.text: You’re 16 with €500. 💼 Choose from 23 career paths. 🏠 Buy and rent property. 📈 Trade stocks. ₿ Invest in crypto. Pay taxes, manage loans, build a company into a holding, and leave a legacy for generations to come.

games.name: Loot Frog
games.text: ——— is an incremental action bullet hell about breaking pots, collecting gems, and fighting an evil cult. Upgrade your gear, unlock new abilities, explore diverse biomes, and push deeper into increasingly chaotic battles.

games.name: Rock Bottom
games.text: Mine. Smelt. Upgrade. Repeat. ——— is an incremental mining game where every swing makes you stronger. Descend through 8 unique layers, unlock devastating abilities, and discover what lies at ———

games.name: Incrempire
games.text: Defend. Upgrade. Dominate. A relaxing incremental base-defense game, packed with powerful skills and a deep skill tree.

games.name: Chef Knight
games.text: Cook what you kill in this cozy fantasy incremental game! Dive into dangerous dungeons, harvest fresh monster ingredients, and serve delicious dishes to hungry adventurers. Slay, cook, sell and upgrade your way to a sprawling dungeon-food empire!

games.name: The Skin Stapler
games.text: ——— is a retro-styled PSX grindhouse horror adventure set in the rotting, crime-soaked sprawl of Carrion City. Players follow jaded detective Dick Slater and his eager rookie partner Robbie Knox as they hunt a mysterious serial killer known only as ———.

games.name: FISH
games.text: ——— is a Platformer Run & Gun Shooter where you play as an armed ——— violently exploring through multiple levels. The game features a funny, unique stylized artstyle that could get a chuckle out of you!

games.name: Hearth and Hamlet
games.text: Start with a campfire. Build a kingdom. ——— is a medieval citybuilder clicker that blends resource management, in-depth upgrade trees and relaxing idle gameplay. Build your empire by researching new technologies, passing new laws, trading with far-off lands, and more.

games.name: Last Pirates: Die Together
games.text: An online co-op horror experience for up to 4 players. Use your elastic arms to grab valuable loot for your captain. But be careful, danger lurks around every corner trying to take your booty!

games.name: Speedway Challenge 2026
games.text: A dynamic speedway game offering a realistic driving model, exciting competition, and multiple game modes. Develop your rider career, race on authentic tracks, and fight for victory in single-player and multiplayer modes. Experience the true thrill of speedway and prove your dominance on the track.

games.name: Trail & Error
games.text: A chaotic co-op survival game for 1–8 players where you travel the trail, manage supplies, survive disasters, and argue with friends. Work together to keep the wagon moving, adapt to random events, and try to make it to the end in one piece.

games.name: EMPULSE
games.text: ——— is a fast-paced 6v6 movement shooter. Wall-run, grapple, Holojump, pilot mechs, and P.A.I.N.T. your way through Freehold's vertical streets. Outmove your opponent or get outgunned.

games.name: Dirty Business
games.text: Build a criminal empire from a hidden underground hangar. Produce drugs, craft weapons, print fake money, operate cartel airstrip and more. Hire workers, expand your gang, upgrade your base and take control of city distribution solo or in co-op.

games.name: Football Rising:Zero to Hero
games.text: A lifestyle football RPG where you rise from the 4th division to world glory. Build a deck from over 100 skill cards, romance 22 unique characters, compete across 8 countries, and pass your legacy to the next generation. Your football life begins now.

games.name: Twisted Party
games.text: Survive. Sabotage. Style on your friends. ——— is a retro horror party game for 2-8 players with open and private lobbies, stuffed with deadly mini-games and buckets of blood. Betray your way to victory and unlock crazy skins by conquering brutal challenges. Last one standing wins.

games.name: Lost & Found: A This Bed We Made Story
games.text: ——— is a standalone, short story game taking place aboard a 1960s transatlantic ship. Play as Sophie Roy in her new job as a stewardess, and help solve a curious series of thefts in this narrative-driven mystery set after the events of This Bed We Made.

games.name: BOXROOM
games.text: ——— allows you to design, define and decorate a room - a sanctuary - for your Steam library, and then revel in the organisation of your game collection.

games.name: Neon Curves Racing
games.text: Burn rubber through glowing city circuits where speed, style, and attitude collide. ——— is a fast-paced top-down arcade racer wrapped in a vibrant kawaii neon aesthetic, blending tight racing mechanics with flashy customization and playful personality.

games.name: Team Principal: A Racing Manager
games.text: A deep yet accessible motorsport management sandbox inspired by the 1990s games of this genre. Manage teams, drivers, finances, engines, and regulations in a fully customizable, ever-changing world where no two seasons play out the same.

games.name: NBA 2K27
games.text: The hustle doesn’t stop and the run never ends in ———. Chase greatness around the clock in MyCAREER, MyTEAM, and MyNBA, and make your hoop dreams a reality.

games.name: Coin Tavern
games.text: ——— is not your average tavern! In this roguelike game, you’ll wield a wild array of quirky coins to build your one-of-a-kind coin deck. Hoard coins, refine strategies, streamline your deck, unlock hidden treasures, and land outrageous combos in randomized runs!

games.name: Ruins of Dawn
games.text: A loot-driven action role-playing game (ARPG) crafted by a solo loot enthusiast. Switch classes anytime, with hundreds of random affix combinations for gear stats, a unique forging system, and tough bosses, rifts, ruins, and trials awaiting your challenge.

games.name: Rift Wizard 3
games.text: Rift Wizard is a hardcore combat strategy roguelike and wizard simulator featuring an extremely deep build system. Customize your Wizard with more than 500 spells and magical artifacts. Blast, summon, or enchant your way through 20 levels of pure turn based chaos.

games.name: Silly Linguine Cat Simulator Deluxe Online
games.text: ——— is a clicker game where progression is replaced with gambling, where the goal is simply to collect the rarest silly linguine cats.

games.name: Soulbound: Online
games.text: ——— is a pixel-art action roguelite with an MMORPG overworld. Run fast-paced bullet-heaven dungeons solo or in 3-player co-op, raid bosses, craft gear from your loot, and build out your personal base. Join thousands of players in the quest to explore, trade, and build a new world.

games.name: Jigokuraku: BATTLE IN HELL'S PARADISE
games.text: The first game adaptation of the TV anime Hell's Paradise, now streaming with Season 2. "———" is now available.

games.name: Three Kingdoms:BOND
games.text: Gather your warlords. Take the realm. One-time purchase, no gacha, no pay-to-win. Unlock 100+ warlords just by playing. Build your army from random picks each match, then win through positioning and smart reads. Fast-paced PvP strategy battles, finished in just 10 minutes.

games.name: Cat Mail Co.
games.text: Run a cozy cat post office. Sort and deliver parcels from the daily boat, organizing everything your way. At night, the moon reveals hidden truths about packages. Clear a strange backlog, help locals, and unlock new abilities and destinations.

games.name: Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6
games.text: ——— is signature Black Ops across a cinematic single-player Campaign, a best-in-class Multiplayer experience and with the epic return of Round-Based Zombies.

games.name: Sitting Ducks
games.text: A chaotic co-op armageddon game where you build ridiculous structures to survive world-ending disasters with sticky hands, physics chaos & friends who probably won’t save you. Don´t be a Sitting Duck!

games.name: HEXSTORM: Tears of Arcadia
games.text: ——— is a tactical tower defense with roguelike structure. Build your flying fortress, upgrade your ship, and combine powerful boosts. Every battle is unique. Uncover the mystery of the fallen captain.

games.name: Pegs X Stickers
games.text: A pachinko-roguelite about scoring big numbers. Build your board, pop pegs, and discover run-breaking stickers.

games.name: Sensory Overload
games.text: A dropper game designed to overwhelm your senses. Twisting tunnels, psychedelic patterns, and breathing walls assault your sense of balance as the chaos escalates with every level.

games.name: Moon Corona
games.text: open your eyes from the ancient temple and embark on this adventure! Embark on an RPG adventure in a dark-themed sandbox world. Explore vast lands, collect all kinds of cards, craft diverse combinations, and make pivotal choices—seeking lost truths and redemption in the chaos and danger.

games.name: the cabin game
games.text: ——— is a 1-4 player, chaotic horror game where you are trapped inside a cabin and the only way out is through a game of cards. Just beware, as the cards you play have a surprising twist on this humble abode...

games.name: Shadow Dungeon
games.text: Nightmarish monsters crawl forth from the darkness, while the Demon Lord lurks beneath the abyss. Venture into the ———, carve your way through blood and chaos, and forge your own legendary epic.

games.name: Limitless Survivor
games.text: Incremental roguelite with infinite progression. Collect powerful artifacts, gather crystals, and scale your stats to absurd levels. Let auto-play handle the grind anytime—even while you're away. New in Ver. 1.1: Drones, a new loot-hunting system!

games.name: The First Million
games.text: An incremental deckbuilder where you constantly unlock new cards and upgrades and discover one game-breaking strategy after another to make ——— — and then many more!

games.name: Planet Harvester: Incremental Odyssey
games.text: ——— is a relaxing low-poly incremental game. Pilot your crawler across beautiful worlds, chew through resources, unlock new tools, hire drones, and customize your machine for ever bigger hauls. Turn small numbers into massive ones!

games.name: This Is Golf
games.text: ——— is a casual but challenging first-person golf game with randomly generated holes. Shot shaping and distance are based entirely on mouse motion. Play solo or in lobbies of up to 8 players, and enjoy a fun, competitive, and slightly goofy golfing experience.

games.name: GRAIN ROT
games.text: A horror co-op extraction builder set in a scorched wasteland where everything burns. Descend with your friends into shifting ruins, rip out furniture, and scavenge for loot before the Corrupted close in. Make it back alive, then rebuild the Outpost to better your chances for the next run.

games.name: OFFBEAT
games.text: ——— is a music-tycoon game where you build the recording studio of your dreams. Collect and upgrade increasingly strange musical objects, complete jobs for cash, and record real, actual music.

games.name: Backpack Dungeon
games.text: A unique pixel-art backpack management roguelike. Your backpack isn't just storage—it's your combat core. Item placement, adjacency, and trigger mechanics determine your survival in the dungeon. A mental challenge of spatial planning and strategy.

games.name: Scary Game 2: The Mad Shepherd
games.text: Your first day as the new shepherd in the village… and everything is going wrong. The animals are missing. The villagers are strange. And the truth is far more terrifying.

games.name: FEED THE AI
games.text: ———. Collect data. Unlock upgrades. Watch the algorithm grow beyond your control. An active incremental where you feed an evolving AI with data and shape what it becomes. Will it save the world... or take it over?

games.name: The 7th Guest Remake
games.text: The iconic game The 7th Guest has been brought back to life with modern technology, delivering an atmospheric story like no other. Explore a foreboding mansion, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover its dark secrets. The 7th Guest is the ultimate mystery adventure, reimagined for modern platforms.

games.name: Stonewards
games.text: DWARF COMBAT! ——— is a 1-4 player co-op first-person roguelite defense game. Lead a crew of stubborn dwarves from your base camp to aid nearby kingdoms, mine deep for resources, forge powerful upgrades, and hold the line against relentless monster attacks.

games.name: Hole Is Mine
games.text: ——— is an incremental adventure about purifying a divine Hole. Dive inside and launch your Mini'Ohs to mine for you. Extract impurities, upgrade your power, and find hidden secrets to grow the Village, customizing your Mini'Ohs with incredible powers. The Hole has spoken!

games.name: NTE: Neverness to Everness
games.text: ——— is a supernatural urban open-world RPG developed by Hotta Studio. Your story begins in Hethereau as an unlicensed anomaly hunter. Team up with a diverse cast of companions, each with unique abilities, to unravel the city's mysteries.

games.name: Myth of Empires: Throne
games.text: ——— is a free seasonal multiplayer warfare sandbox. Explore vast lands inspired by multiple civilizations, tame creatures, forge powerful weapons, and build your guild. Lead cross-server expeditions, conquer territories, and compete with players worldwide for the ultimate throne!

games.name: A Game About Chopping Trees
games.text: Grab your axe, hop on the handcar, and lose yourself in the forest. Chop trees, upgrade your gear, and enjoy the ride - alone or with a friend

games.name: Total Football Online
games.text: Build your All-Star lineup in ———! Easy to pick up, it lets you dive into pure football fun at your fingertips. With events and player updates syncing with real-world tournaments, get ready for a truly immersive football experience.

games.name: MOLDRISE
games.text: It started in your foot. Now it’s in your head. All that remains is the command: GO UP. Meet strange neighbors. Make bad trades. Every ascent teaches you what you should have done differently.

games.name: Alice's Gaze
games.text: "———" is a dark fairy-tale clicker and idle game. Accompany Alice as she awakens in a strange mansion, gaze upon the cat god's altar, delve into the abyss of terror, revive the slumbering rooms one by one, and search for a way to escape.

games.name: FD 27: Direct Your Football Club
games.text: A football management game where you're not the coach, you're the club owner. Hire and fire the coaching staff, sign players, negotiate with sponsors, control the finances and build a winning organisation from the boardroom.

games.name: Dice Have No Eyes
games.text: ★ Surreal dice-rolling roguelike about luck and greed ★ Feed your dice dumplings, collect game bending trinkets, roll too much and lose it all. Or get lucky, unlock King Fetus, meet God and you might just wake up.

games.name: Kin and Conquest
games.text: An incremental / idle action adventure game where you must battle foes, mine rocks, defeat bosses, and grow stronger in your quest to conquer the mountain and defeat the Evil Geomancer.

games.name: Barro 2026
games.text: ——— is a racing game where you choose from 20 cars, master 5 unique tracks, and compete against up to 10 rivals in intense high-speed races.

games.name: Three Kingdoms : Alias
games.text: A world where officers hide their names and abilities. Can you spot Zhuge Liang? A hardcore turn-based strategy simulation for true ——— devotees.

games.name: Animal Company
games.text: ——— is a chaotic multiplayer VR adventure where you and your friends play as thick-cheeked animals to dive into spooky worlds, fight monsters, uncover secret lab experiments, and turn literal trash into powerful physics gear.

games.name: War Room Football
games.text: Build a dynasty from the front office. Draft, trade, sign, and develop players across unlimited seasons. Scout prospects, manage the cap, hire coaches, then watch the league evolve around you.

games.name: DarkStone Restoration
games.text: ——— brings the classic action RPG back to modern PCs with improved stability, compatibility, controls, readability, and quality-of-life improvements — while preserving the spirit of the original game.

games.name: Eslabong
games.text: Arena combat meets mercenary club management. Recruit from a dynamic market, build your squad, and compete season after season in leagues and cups.

games.name: DragonSword : Awakening
games.text: Explore the anime-style open world of the Continent of Orbis, brought to life with Unreal Engine 5! Recruit unique companions, unleash spectacular Status Ailment tag-team action, and embark on an epic journey to save the world from the threat of a Dragon reawakened after 60 years.

games.name: MoeArmy vs SuArmy
games.text: ——— is a 2D auto-battle strategy game. Choose the Moe or Su faction, build structures to deploy formations, combine cards, gear, and commander skills to power up your troops, exploit armor counters in automatic combat, and destroy the enemy base to claim victory!

games.name: Klifur
games.text: Minimalist 2D bouldering. Make your way through over 30 hand-made campaign routes or use the level editor to make your own routes and share them with friends!

games.name: Crownhold
games.text: Noble Rulers — grow your realm and expand your castle in this short incremental game! Manage resources, discover foreign lands and build up an army to lay siege to your enemies.

games.name: Goal Idle
games.text: ——— is a relaxing incremental game focused on scoring goals and earning money. Click to shoot balls into the goal, upgrade to better balls, unlock powerful skills, and hire Helpers that auto-score goals. Start with rubber balls and work your way up to golden balls. Satisfying and addictive.

games.name: Soul Land: Awakening World
games.text: The first-ever 3D open-world MMORPG of the ——— saga is here! Featuring dual-authorization from the original novels and anime—this time, redefine the ——— universe!

games.name: Horse Magnifier: The Full Horse
games.text: this is a game about magnifying horses.

games.name: Sir, We Have an Orc Problem
games.text: ——— is an incremental-style tower defense game where you face an overwhelming number of orcs. Greet them with even more bullets, bombs and lasers!

games.name: Bar After Bar
games.text: ——— is a multiplayer game where 5 friends drive to the top of a mountain. You will be mixing drinks and throwing them at each other the whole way up. The drunker you get, the harder it is to drive. How far can you make it?

games.name: IDLE_DIRECTIVE
games.text: Idly gather and manage resources to repair what's left of a decaying world. Scavenge forgotten ruins, meet scattered survivors, and push back against the inevitable collapse. ——— is a grid-based inventory and resource management idle game.

games.name: Just Keep Fishing
games.text: A short incremental game about catching a lot of fish🎣

games.name: Lazy Kickers
games.text: ——— is an incremental soccer manager! Manage your team, grow balls from plants and shoot goals for coins! Start small and climb the leaderboards, unlocking new upgrades! Score millions and plunge the playing field into total chaos.

games.name: Internet Survivor Survivors
games.text: A top-down action roguelite Touhou fangame featuring Flan, who's... started streaming and has taken the internet by storm!? Collect likes and coins to power up your weapons! Your very viewer count becomes your life! Annihilate the constant hordes of enemies and survive, survive, SURVIVE!

games.name: Scratch the Ticket
games.text: ——— is a first‑person incremental gambling sim where every ticket is a test of nerves. Print tickets, scratch cells, and decide: cash out now or risk it all. The outcome depends only on your choice.

games.name: Fell & Sell
games.text: Slay. Loot. Sell. Survive! Dive into a first-person blend of hack'n'slash roguelike and shop management. Plunder deadly dungeons for loot, escape with your life, craft, and stock your shelves. Then risk it all once more for profit!

games.name: RUNNING TRAIN | 走ル列車！
games.text: New realistic 3DCG Train Game is here! Step into the crew's cabin and immerse yourself as train operator. Navigate 40km+ across Japanese Rural Railway with breathtakingly detailed scenery through the seaside and heart of countryside.

games.name: Fellwood
games.text: Build a wild fantasy lumber empire that bombards a forest across the valley with axes, ballistas, cannons, and magic. Harvest flying logs, stack absurd upgrades, and automate your way to unstoppable woodcutting power.

games.name: Smashing Bottles
games.text: ——— is a short and satisfying incremental game where you break bottles to earn money, upgrade your bat, discover new bottles, and cause chaos! Will you smash enough bottles to buy the universe?

games.name: Rogue Realm: Guardian Grids
games.text: ——— is a medieval fantasy blend of tower defense and roguelike progression. Build defenses on a grid, manage resources, and survive ever-evolving enemies.

games.name: Papa's Mocharia Deluxe
games.text: Create delicious coffee drinks and cannoli in ———! Create stylish layered lattes in the coffeehouse for Papa Louie's loyal customers while earning tips, points, and Special Recipes. Take a trip in the Food Truck to design and serve your own eye-catching creations!

games.name: SeaColony
games.text: ——— is a survival colony-builder set on the open sea. Build and expand a floating colony, manage colonists, research technologies, and develop farming, fishing, production, and power systems. Trade with merchant ships and survive pirate raids, fires, and harsh weather as your colony grows.

games.name: Farm Factory Simulator
games.text: Grow crops, automate production, and manage your own store. Turn fresh harvests into valuable products and create a wide range of goods. Optimize your workflow with efficient production chains and smart business decisions. Expand your facilities and build the fully automated farm-to-market business.

games.name: Tap Dungeon
games.text: Pixel-art isekai roguelike dungeon crawler! 5 classes, mix skills & items freely in turn-based combat across deadly random dungeons. Fight goblins, orcs, undead; collect artifacts, beat hidden bosses. Death = rebirth, endless builds await. Become the hero saving the kingdom!

games.name: Fortune Mill
games.text: An incremental game where you must make $1,000,000 to escape! Throw darts, drop pachinko balls, play scratch-off tickets, unlock automation, and discover powerful synergies as each new game affects all the others!

games.name: S.O.L School Of Labyrinth
games.text: A dungeon crawl RPG set in an otherworldly realm beneath an old school building. Explore again and again, restore your base, and find your way back to everyday life.

games.name: Organize my Shop
games.text: Bring flawless order to the store! Switch between shelves and find the right items in the pile on the conveyor belt. Sort cheeses, meat delicacies, aromatic pastries, and sweets strictly according to the labels. Enjoy the moment of perfect order!

games.name: WE ARE SO DEAD
games.text: A co-op seance communications game where one of you died first, and only you can see what's killing the others. Your only voice is a Ouija board your friends keep misreading. Guide them down 9 floors of a haunted house and banish the demon before sunrise. 2-6 players. Brain required.

games.name: Supermarket Chaos
games.text: ——— is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 4,668 products in a messy supermarket. Enjoy the satisfaction of stocking shelves in a calm, relaxing atmosphere.

games.name: Vespera
games.text: Idle RPG with full offline progression and multiple endgame progression systems. Choose a class and start fighting, gathering, crafting, master elements & talent trees, train mercenaries, join factions and fight world bosses with real players. No microtransactions. By idle players for idle players

games.name: Pixel Texas Hold'em
games.text: Online Texas Hold'em with publicly verifiable fair dealing. We never manipulate outcomes to drive spending. Every hand is decided by player judgment, strategy, nerve, and timing. Play with friends, read opponents, manage your chips, and personalize your table with themes and card backs.

games.name: Hell Deck
games.text: Collect units and build powerful synergies on a restricted grid in ———, a dark roguelike deckbuilder defense game. Construct your own bizarre, twisted ecosystem through a brutal cycle of predation and sacrifice, and defend hell from the holy swarm

games.name: Football Agent
games.text: You're not the manager, you're the agent. Scout hidden gems across 26,000 players, win them over face to face, build their careers, and sell them for millions. A deep football agency career sim where every contract has your name on it.

games.name: Toy Keeper
games.text: Sort up to ∞ toys across massive multi-floor toy stores, solo or with up to ∞ players, unlock powerful upgrades, and turn complete chaos into perfect organization in this cozy 3D cleanup game.

games.name: The One Fish
games.text: An online co-op game for 1-6 players where you fish with your friends to feed ———! Catch fish of all shapes, sizes, and whimsical effects to keep up with its ever-growing appetite.

games.name: Toy Shop Tidy Up
games.text: A cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 1,274 toys in a messy toy shop. Every toy has a category. Every display is yours to design. Arrange the toys freely—no timers, no rules, no constraints. Just enjoy the satisfaction of tidy up the messy toys in your own creative way.

games.name: Rent Due
games.text: Every door in this town owes you money. Buy homes, furnish them, screen tenants face to face, and knock on doors when the rent comes due. Answer the phone, evict with grounds, and outrun the bank's weekly cut, all in first person. The rent is due. Go get it.

games.name: Cleaning Up The Puzzle Gallery
games.text: ——— is a cozy first-person organization simulator about cleaning up 2071 puzzle pieces scattered across a gallery of 87 famous paintings. Whether you want to relax and solve jigsaw puzzles to classical music, or min-max to get the fastest times, the gallery needs cleaning.

games.name: Shelve the Potions!
games.text: ———! Organize 2000+ potions on shelves after the witch's cats have knocked them over, using clues around an enchanted cellar. Learn strange symbols, decipher cryptic notes, and uncover the correct shelf orders in a cozy organizational simple puzzle game.

games.name: TV Archive: Tidy Up Together
games.text: Shelve the videotapes, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the ———. Enjoy the online co-op and online PvP with your friends, or go solo! Fill up the shelves and experience a sense of relief and satisfaction.

games.name: Cellar Keeper
games.text: ——— is a cozy single-player organizing simulator where you sort 2,448 scattered bottles throughout a forgotten cellar. Return every bottle to its proper shelf, organize collections by type, unlock helpful abilities, and restore perfect order as efficiently as possible.

games.name: Moo Who?
games.text: Can you sound like an animal well enough to survive? ——— is a multiplayer voice-mimicry party game where animal players hide among NPCs, and make animal sounds into their mic before hunters figure out who is fake.

games.name: Tidy Up Together
games.text: Catastrophe! An evil wizard has cast a tornado spell on your shop, and now all your products are on the floor. Maybe you'll ask some friends for help to tidy up?

games.name: Konbini Cleanup
games.text: ——— is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 2,928 products in a messy konbini. Clean, learn abilities, and restore order in a calm and atmospheric environment.

games.name: Mall: Tidy Up Together
games.text: Shelve the products, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the ———. Enjoy the online co-op and online PvP with your friends, or go solo! Fill up the shelves and experience a sense of relief and satisfaction.

games.name: Sort Them Ducks
games.text: ——— is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 4,000 unique rubber ducks onto the correct shelves. Enjoy the satisfying process of turning a messy duck store into a perfectly organized collection at your own pace.

games.name: Mimic Party
games.text: A 1-5 player online voice party game. You hear a sound, the whole table gets one shot to imitate it all at once, no turns. Your take is scored on pitch and rhythm, then the wheel decides who gets a bonus and whose take becomes a fart.

collection.selectionMethod: Candidates from Steam tag search relevance order, assigned to all verified genres; fixed-seed random selection of up to 600 per genre. Browser samples randomly within each final genre pool.
